[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:12:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:12:4)


**בִּלֵּעוּ.** קִלְקְלוּ:


**they have destroyed** Spoiled.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:13:1)


**נִצָּב לָרִיב.** שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל מְעֻמָּד, שֶׁלֹּא לְדַקְדֵּק בְּדִינָם:


**stands to plead** [i.e., to judge the case] of Israel standing, so to speak, so as not to be strict in their judgment.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:13:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:13:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:13:2)


**וְעֹמֵד לָדִין עַמִּים.** וּמִתְעַכֵּב וּמַאֲרִיךְ בְּדִינָן שֶׁל אֻמּוֹת. עֲמִידָה זוֹ לְשׁוֹן עַכָּבָה:


**and stands to judge the nations** Heb. ועמד. He delays and dwells on their judgment. This expression of standing means delay.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:14:1)


**ה׳ בְּמִשְׁפָּט יָבוֹא עִם זִקְנֵי עַמּוֹ.** שֶׁהָיָה לָהֶם לִמְחוֹת (שבת נה.), וְלְעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת אוֹמֵר: **אַתֶּם בִּעַרְתֶּם** אֶת כַּרְמִי, אֲנִי קָצַפְתִּי מְעַט וְאַתֶּם עֲזַרְתֶּם לְרָעָה (זכריה א:ו):


**The Lord will enter into judgment with the elders of His people** For they should have protested (Shabbath 55a), and to the nations He says, And you have ravaged My vineyard. I became slightly incensed [against them,] and you helped to do harm.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:14:2)


**גְּזֵלַת הֶעָנִי.** דּוֹר שֶׁהָיוּ עֲנִיִּים בְּמַעֲשִׂים טוֹבִים. כָּל זֶה בְּמִדְרַשׁ אַגָּדָה (שבת נד ב; נה א), וּלְפִי מַשְׁמָעוּת פְּשׁוּטוֹ, כָּל הָעִנְיָן עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְעוֹמֵד לָדִין עַמִּים הֵם הַשְּׁבָטִים:


**the spoils of the poor** [of] a poor generation, for they were poor in good deeds. All this is in the Midrash Aggadah, but according to its simple meaning, the entire section deals with Israel, and “stands to judge the peoples,” refers to the tribes.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:14:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:14:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:14:3)


**וְאַתֶּם בִּעַרְתֶּם הַכֶּרֶם.** הַזְּקֵנִים וְהַשָּׂרִים אָכְלוּ אֶת שְׁאָר הָעָם:


**and you have ravaged the vineyard** The elders and the officers ‘ate up’ the rest of the people.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:15:1)


**מַלָּכֶם.** כְּמוֹ מַה לָּכֶם:


**What to you mean** Heb. מַלָּכֶם, like מַה לָכֶם, what do you mean? [lit. What is to you?]


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:15:2)


**תִּטְחָנוּ.** תְּכַתְּתוּ וּתְמַעֲיטוּ, לְבַזּוֹת בְּדִינָם:


**you grind** Crush and degrade to disgrace them in their lawsuit.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:16:1)


**וַיֹּאמֶר ה׳.** עַל הַנָּשִׁים אֲשֶׁר מָשְׁלוּ בְּעַמִּי, **יַעַן כִּי גָבְהוּ וְגוֹ׳**:


**And the Lord said** Concerning the women who governed My people, “Since the daughters of Zion are so haughty...”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:16:2)


**וּמְשַׂקְּרוֹת עֵינָיִם.** לְשׁוֹן הַבָּטָה. דָּבָר אַחֵר: צוֹבְעוֹת עֵינֵיהֶם בְּסִקְרָא וּבְכָחוֹל:


**and winking eyes** Heb. וּמְשַׂקְּרוֹת, an expression of looking. Another explanation is: They paint their eyes with vermilion or with blue eye shade.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:16:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:16:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:16:3)


**הָלוֹךְ וְטָפֹף תֵּלַכְנָה.** לְשׁוֹן דָּבָר צָף עַל גַּבֵּי חֲבֵירוֹ, כְּמוֹ (דברים יא:ד) ״אֲשֶׁר הֵצִיף״, וּמְתַרְגְּמִינָן ״דְּאַטֵיף״. כָּךְ הָיְתָה אֲרֻכָּה מְהַלֶּכֶת בֵּין שְׁתֵּי קְצָרוֹת, כְּדֵי שֶׁתְּהֵא נִרְאֵית צָפָה לְמַעְלָה מֵהֶם (שבת סב א). וְיוֹנָתָן תִּרְגֵּם: ״וּבְפַוָּתְהוֹן מְקַפָּן״, הָיוּ קוֹשְׁרוֹת פֵּאוֹת נָכְרִיּוֹת, קְלִיעַת שְׂעָרוֹת תְּלוּשִׁין כּוֹרְכוֹת עִם קְלִיעוֹתֵיהֶן, שֶׁיֵּרָאוּ גַּסּוֹת וְטָפוֹפוֹת:


**walking and raising themselves they walk** Heb. ותפוף. This is an expression of something floating on another, as (Deut. 11:4): “over whom He caused...to flow (הֵצִיף),” which the Targum renders as אַטֵיף. Thus, a tall one would walk between two short ones, in order to appear to be floating over them (Shabbath 62b). Jonathan, however, renders: and with wigs they surround themselves. They would tie wigs, braids of cut-off hair. They would twist together with their braids so that they would appear thick and broad.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:16:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:16:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:16:4)


**וּבְרַגְלֵיהֶם תְּעַכַּסְנָה.** כְּשֶׁהָיוּ עוֹבְרוֹת בַּשּׁוּק אֵצֶל בַּחוּרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, דּוֹרַסְתּוֹ בְּרַגְלוֹ וְרוֹמֶזֶת לוֹ צַד חִבַּת נוֹאֲפוֹת, כְּדֵי לְהַבְעִיר בּוֹ יֵצֶר הָרָע כְּעֶכֶס זֶה שֶׁל נָחָשׁ. ״עֶכֶס״ (משלי ז:כב) הוּא אֶרֶס שֶׁל נָחָשׁ:


**and with their feet they spout venom** When they would pass in the street near Jewish youths, they would stamp their feet and hint to them of the affection of the adulteresses, in order to arouse their temptation, like the venom of a serpent. עֶכֶס is the venom of a serpent.



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:17:1)


**וְשִׂפַּח.** לְשׁוֹן צָרַעַת, כְּמוֹ (ויקרא יג:) ״מִסְפַּחַת הִיא״. וְעַל שֶׁנִּכְתַּב בְּשִׁי״ן דָּרְשׁוּ בּוֹ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ (פסיקתא דרב כהנא יז:) שֶׁתֵּעָשֶׂינָה שְׁפָחוֹת מְכֻדָּנוֹת, וְיֵשׁ שֶׁדְּרָשׁוּהוּ (שם) שֶׁהִרְבָּה בָּהֶן מִשְׁפָּחוֹת מִשְׁפָּחוֹת שֶׁל כִּנִּים. **פָּתְהֵן יְעָרֶה.** כֵּלֵיהֶן יְעָרֶה, לְשׁוֹן אֲרַמִּי הִיא ״פַּתְיָא אוּכְמָא״ (פסחים פח.). הֵן הָיוּ אוֹמְרוֹת (ישעיהו ה:ט) ״יְמַהֵר יָחִישָׁה מַעֲשֵׂהוּ״, שַׂר רוֹאֶה אוֹתִי וְנוֹטֵל אוֹתִי. כְּשֶׁבָּא הַפֻּרְעָנוּת הָיוּ שָׂרֵי נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר נוֹטְלִין אוֹתָן לִהְיוֹת לְנָשִׁים מֵחֲמַת יָפְיָן, וְרָמַז הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא וְהָיוּ שׁוֹפְעוֹת כְּאָדָם הַמְעָרֶה מִכְּלִי אֶל כְּלִי, וְכַאֲשֶׁר נֶעֶנְשׁוּ בְּדַם נִדָּה וְהָיוּ נִמְאָסוֹת עֲלֵיהֶן וּמַשְׁלִיכִין אוֹתָן לָאָרֶץ מֵעַל קְרוֹנוֹת שֶׁלָּהֶן. וְיוֹנָתָן תִּרְגֵּם: ״יְקָרְהוֹן יַעְדִּי״׃


**And the Lord shall smite with zaaraath** Heb. וְשִׂפַּח. This is an expression of zaraath [believed to be a form of leprosy, see Commentary Digest II Kings 5:1], as (in Leviticus 13:6): “It is a mispachath (מִסְפַּחַת).” But since it is written with a ‘sin,’ our Sages expounded about it that they would become enslaved maidservants (שְׁפָחוֹת), and some expounded it to mean that He smote them with many families (מִשְׁפָּחוֹת) of lice. **shall pour out their “vessels”** Heb. פָּתְהֵן יְעָרֶה. Their vessels He shall pour out. This is the Aramaic language, like “a black vessel” פַּתְיָא אוּכְמָא [in] (Pesachim 88a). They would say, Let Him hurry and hasten His deed, to bring on the invaders. An officer will see me and take me. When the retribution came, Nebuchadnezzar’s officers took them for wives because of their beauty. Thereupon, the Holy One, blessed be He, signaled to their ‘fountains,’ and blood of an issue flowed from them profusely, as a person pours from one vessel to another. They became loathsome to them, and they cast them to the ground from upon their chariots (Lamentations Rabbah 4:15). Jonathan, however, rendered: He will remove their glory.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:17:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:17:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:17:2)


**פָּתְהֵן.** לְשׁוֹן רֹחַב, לְשׁוֹן גֹּדֶל:


פתהן means wideness or greatness.



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:18:1)


**בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא.** לֶעָתִיד לָבֹא, כְּשֶׁיָּבֹא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לְהָשִׁיב אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵלָיו, יָסִיר ה׳ מֵהֶם אֶת תִּפְאֶרֶת הָעֲכָסִים, שֶׁלֹּא יְהוּ תוֹלִין תִּפְאַרְתָּם בְּנוֹי תַּכְשִׁיטֵי נָשִׁים וְדִבְרֵי נְבָלָה:


**On that day** In the future, when the Holy One, blessed be He, will come to restore Israel to Him, the Lord shall remove from them the glory of the shoes, that they will not depend for their glory on the beauty of women’s jewelry and objects of vanity.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:18:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:18:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:18:2)


**הָעֲכָסִים.** הַמִּנְעָלִים אֲשֶׁר בְּרַגְלֵיהֶם, אֲשֶׁר בָּהֶם תְּעַכֵּסְנָה:


**the shoes** The shoes that were on their feet with which they spouted venom.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:18:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:18:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:18:3)


**וְהַשְּׁבִיסִים.** מִינֵי שְׂבָכָה לְתַכְשִׁיטֵי הָרֹאשׁ, וְהַרְבֵּה יֵשׁ בִּלְשׁוֹן מִשְׁנָה (נגעים יא:א) שָׁבִיס שֶׁל שְׂבָכָה:


**and the embroidered headdresses** Heb. והשביסים. Types of headdresses for the ornaments of the head. Many [instances of this word] are found in the language of the Mishnah: the embroidered headdress (שביס) of the hair net (Kelim 28:10).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:18:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:18:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:18:4)


**וְהַשַּׂהֲרֹנִים.** יוֹנָתָן תִּרְגֵּם ״וְסִבְכַיָּא״:


**and the hair nets** Heb. וְהַשַׂהַרֹנִים. Jonathan renders: the hair nets.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:19:1)


**הַנְּטִיפוֹת.** ״עוּנְקַיָּא״, לָשׁוֹן ״וַעֲנָקִים לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶיךָ״ (משלי א:ט). וְלָשׁוֹן נְטִיפוֹת עַל שֵׁם שֶׁתְּלוּיוֹת עַל הַצַּוָּאר וְנוֹטְפוֹת עַל הֶחָזֶה, וְהֵן כְּמִין מַרְגָּלִיּוֹת נְקוּבוֹת וַחֲרוּזוֹת בְּחוּט, ובלע״ז מושטינצא״ש:


**The necklaces** [Jonathan renders:] עַנְקַיָא, necklaces, an expression similar to (Proverbs 1:9): “And necklaces (עֲנָקִים) for your throat.” They are called נְטָפוֹת, meaning “to drip,” because they hang on the neck and drip onto the breast, and they are a sort of pierced pearls, strung on a string, mostnecs in O.F.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:19:2)


**וְהַשֵּׁירוֹת.** צְמִידֵי הַזְּרוֹעַ, דְּמִתַּרְגֵּם ״וְשִׁירַיָּא״:


**and the bracelets** Heb. וְהַשֵּׁרוֹת, bracelets for the arm, translated וְשִׁירַיָא.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:19:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:19:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:19:3)


**וְהָרְעָלוֹת.** צָנִיף שֶׁמַּצְנִיפוֹת כָּל פַּרְצוּפֵיהֶם חוּץ מִגַּלְגַּל הָעַיִן, כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּתְאַוֶּה אָדָם לִזּוֹן בְּמַרְאוֹת הַלְּסָתוֹת. (סא"א) לָשׁוֹן אַחֵר: וְהָרְעָלוֹת – מִינֵי סַרְבָּלִים נָאִים לְהִתְעַטֵּף בָּהֶן, וּבִלְשׁוֹן מִשְׁנָה יֵשׁ ״מָדִיּוֹת רְעוּלוֹת״ בְּמַסֶּכֶת שַׁבָּת (סה א):


**and the veils** Heb. וְהָרְעָלוֹת. A veil with which they envelop their entire countenance except the eyeball, so that a man will desire to satisfy himself by gazing at the cheeks. Another explanation is that they are types of pretty shawls, with which to enwrap themselves, and in the language of the Mishnah, there is an instance: “Shawled (רְעוּלוֹת) Arabian women,” in Tractate Shabbath (65a).



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:20:1)


**הַפְּאֵרִים.** תַּרְגּוּם ״כְּלִילִיָּא״, כְּמוֹ (שמות לט:כח) ״פַּאֲרֵי הַמִּגְבָּעוֹת״:


**The tiaras** Heb. פְּאֵרִים. The Targum renders: tiaras. This resembles (Exodus 39:28): “the beautiful hats (פַּאֲרֵי הַמִּגְבָּעוֹת).”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:20:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:20:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:20:2)


**וְהַצְּעָדוֹת.** אֶצְעָדָה שֶׁל שׁוֹקַיִם:


**and the foot chains** Heb. וְהַצְּעָדוֹת, circlets for the legs.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:20:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:20:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:20:3)


**וְהַקִּשֻּׁרִים.** כְּמַשְׁמָעוֹ, קִשּׁוּרִים קְצָרִים שֶׁקּוֹשְׁרִין בָּהֶן שְׂעָרָן, וְיֵשׁ שֶׁעוֹשִׂין אוֹתוֹ מֻזְהָבִים, פרשיינ״ש בלע״ז:


**and the hair ribbons** [Lit. ties,] as the name implies, short ties with which they tie their hair, and some make them gilded, fres in O.F.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:20:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:20:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:20:4)


**וּבָתֵּי הַנֶּפֶשׁ.** שֶׁכְּנֶגֶד הַלֵּב, נושק״א בלע״ז:


**and the clasps** Heb. וּבָתֵּי הַנֶּפֶשׁ, [the houses of the soul] opposite the heart, nosche in O.F.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:20:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:20:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:20:5)


**וְהַלְּחָשִׁים.** נִזְמֵי הָאֹזֶן, מָקוֹם שֶׁלּוֹחֲשִׁין לָהּ שָׁם:


**and the earrings** Heb. לְחָשִׁים, rings for the ear, the place into which people whisper (לוֹחֲשִׁים).



### Verse 22

###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:22:1)


**הַמַּחֲלָצוֹת.** ״כִּתּוּנַיָּא״, כְּמוֹ (שמואל ב ב:א) ״וְקַח אֶת חֲלִיצָתוֹ״, שֶׁהַגּוּף מְלֻבָּשׁ בָּהֶם, וּכְשֶׁפּוֹשְׁטִין אוֹתָם חוֹלְצִין אוֹתָם מִן הַגּוּף:


**The tunics** Heb. הַמַּחֲלָצוֹת. [Jonathan renders:] כִּתּוּנַיָּא as in Samuel (2 2:21): and take to yourself his clothing (חֲלִיצָתוֹ), for the body is clothed with them, and when they are removed, they are removed from the body (חוֹלְצִין).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:22:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:22:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:22:2)


**וְהַמַּעֲטָפוֹת.** מַצָּעוֹת הַמִּטָּה, כְּתַרְגּוּמוֹ: ״שׁוֹשִׁיפַיָּא״. **וְהַמִּטְפָּחוֹת** – מַפּוֹת:


**and the bedspreads** Heb. וְהַמַּעֲטָפוֹת, bedspreads, according to the Targum, who renders שׁוֹשִׁיפַיָא.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:22:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:22:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:22:3)


**וְהַחֲרִיטִים.** תַּרְגּוּמוֹ ״מַחְכַּיָּא״, דְּפוּס שֶׁל בֵּית הָרֶחֶם, כְּדִמְתַרְגְּמִינָן ״וְכוּמָז״ (שמות לה:כב) ״מָחוֹךְ״:


**and the tablecloths** Heb. וְהַמִּטְפָחוֹת, tablecloths. and the purses Heb. וְהַחֲרִיטִים. [Jonathan] translates it as מַחְכַּיָּא, [an ornament] bearing the shape of the woman’s private parts, as we translate כּוּמָז (Ex. 35:22) as מָחוֹךְ.



### Verse 23

###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:23:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:23:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:23:1)


**וְהַגִּלְיֹנִים.** הֵן הַמַּרְאוֹת, כְּתַרְגּוּמוֹ: ״מַחְזְיָתָא״ (ספייקיי״ו בלע״ז), עַל שֵׁם שֶׁמְּגַלּוֹת צוּרוֹת הַפָּנִים קְרוּיִין גִּלְיוֹנִים, אוֹ שֶׁמָּא מַרְאוֹת שֶׁלָּהֶם נִגְלָלוֹת הָיוּ:


**The mirrors** Heb. גִּלְיוֹנִים. These are mirrors, as the Targum renders: מַחְזְיָתָא, miradojjr in O.F., and because they reveal (מְגַלּוֹת) the form of the face, they are called גִּלְיוֹנִים, or perhaps their mirrors were rolled (נִגְלָלוֹת).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:23:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:23:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:23:2)


**וְהַסְּדִינִים.** שֶׁל פִּשְׁתָּן הֵם, הַמִּתְעַטְּפִין בָּהֶם:


**and the sheets** of linen with which they would enwrap themselves.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:23:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:23:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:23:3)


**וְהַצְּנִיפוֹת.** מולקי״נש בלע״ז:


**and the turbans** Heb. וְהַצְּנִיפוֹת, molekin in O.F.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:23:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:23:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:23:4)


**וְהָרְדִידִים.** ״כְּבִינְתָא״ (פרמל״ץ בלע״ז), וְהֵם שֶׁל זָהָב שֶׁמְּכַבְּנִין בָּהּ הַסִּרְבָּל שֶׁהָאִשָּׁה מִתְעַטֶּפֶת בּוֹ:


**and the clasps** Heb. וְהַרְדִידִים, Fermalc in O.F., and they are of gold with which the shawl is closed when the woman enwraps herself therein.



### Verse 24

###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:24:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:24:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:24:1)


**וְהָיָה תַחַת בֹּשֶׂם מַק.** מָקוֹם שֶׁהָיוּ מִתְבַּשְּׂמוֹת בּוֹ יִהְיֶה נִמָּק:


**And it shall come to pass, that, instead of perfume, there will be decay** The place where they would perfume themselves will be decayed.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:24:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:24:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:24:2)


**וְתַחַת חֲגוֹרָה נִקְפָּה.** מָקוֹם שֶׁחוֹגְרָה שָׁם, יִהְיֶה נִיקָף, נֶחְתָּךְ בַּחֲבוּרוֹת וְרִשּׁוּמֵי מַכּוֹת, כְּמוֹ ״וְאַחַר עוֹרִי נִקְּפוּ״ (איוב יט:כו), ״וְנִקַּף סִבְכֵי הַיַּעַר״ (ישעיהו י:לד):


**and in the place of a girdle, laceration** Heb. נקפה. The place where she girded herself, there will be lacerated, cut with wounds and signs of blows, as (Job: 19:26): “And after my skin is cut to pieces (נִקְּפוּ)”; (infra 10:34) “and the thickets of forest shall be cut down (וְנִקַּף).”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:24:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:24:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:24:3)


**וְתַחַת מַעֲשֶׂה מִקְשֶׁה.** מָקוֹם שֶׁהָיוּ עוֹשׂוֹת בּוֹ הַמַּעֲשֶׂה הָאָמוּר לְמַעְלָה ״הָלוֹךְ וְטָפוֹף תֵּלַכְנָה״ (ישעיהו ג:טז), וְהוּא בְּגבַהּ הָרֹאשׁ, שָׁם תִּהְיֶה מִקְשֶׁה קָרְחָה, מַכָּה הַמַּקְרַחַת אֶת הָרֹאשׁ. מִקְשֶׁה לְשׁוֹן ״דָּא לְדָא נָקְשָׁן״ (דניאל ה:ו). וַאֲנִי הָיִיתִי מְפָרְשׁוֹ: **תַּחַת הַמַּעֲשֶׂה מִקְשֶׁה,** מָקוֹם שֶׁהָיוּ שָׁם חֲגוּרוֹת נוֹתְנוֹת טַסֵּי הַזָּהָב הָעֲשׂוּיוֹת מִקְשֶׁה בטדי״ץ בלע״ז, אֶלָּא שֶׁהוּא נָקוּד פַּתַּח וְהוּא בַּמְּסוֹרָה בַּעֲשָׂרָה נְקוּדִים פַּתַּח, וְאֵין אֶחָד מֵהֶם דָּבוּק לְתֵיבָה שֶׁל אַחֲרָיו, וְכָל מַעֲשֶׂה שֶׁהוּא דָּבוּק לְתֵיבָה שֶׁל אַחֲרָיו נָקוּד קָמַץ:


**and in the place of the deed, a wound** Heb. (מַעֲשֶׂה מִקְשֶׁה). [The place where they would do the deed mentioned above: “walking and raising themselves they walk,” and that is at the height of the head, there will be] מִקְשֶׁה קָרְחָה, a wound that makes the head bald. מִקְשֶׁה is an expression similar to (Daniel 5:6): “knocked one against the other (נַקְשָׁן).” I would explain it as follows: The place where they would put the plates of gold made by hammering batdec in O.F.but it is vowelized in the Masorah among the ten words vowelized with a ‘pattach’ [i.e., a ‘segol,’ and none of them is connected to the following word, and every [instance of the word] that is in the construct state is vowelized with a ‘kamatz’ [i.e., a ‘tzeireh’].


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:24:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:24:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:24:4)


**וְתַחַת פְּתִיגִיל.** וַהֲוֵי (ספרים אחרים: הֲרֵי) כִּשְׁתֵּי תֵיבוֹת: פְּתִי גִיל, כְּלִי שֶׁהוּא מְבִיאָן לִידֵי גִילָה, וְהוּא בֵּית הָרֶחֶם הָאָמוּר לְמַעְלָה ״פִּתְהֶן״ (ישעיהו ג:יז). חִלּוּף אוֹתָהּ גִילָה תִּהְיֶה **מַחֲגֹרֶת שַׂק** בְּכָל מָתְנֶיהָ:


**and in the place of the organ of levity** Heb. וְתַחַתפְּתִיגִיל. This is like two words: פְּתִי גִיל, a vessel [or organ] that brings levity; the secret parts about which is mentioned above: shall pour out their ‘vessels.’ Instead of that levity, a girdle of sackcloth will be on all loins.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:24:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:24:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:24:5)


**כִּי תַחַת יֹפִי.** כִּי זֹאת הוֹגֶנֶת לִהְיוֹת לָהֶם **תַּחַת יֹפִי** שֶׁהָיוּ מִשְׁתַּחֲצוֹת בּוֹ:


**for this is instead of beauty** For this is fitting for them to have instead of the beauty with which they acted haughtily.



### Verse 25

###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:25:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:25:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:25:1)


**מְתַיִךְ.** גִּבּוֹרֶיךָ, מְתֵי מִלְחֲמוֹתֶיךָ הַיּוֹצְאִים בַּצָּבָא בְּמִנְיָן:


**Your men** Your heroes, your men of war, who go out in the army with a number.



### Verse 26

###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:26:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:26:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:26:1)


**וְאָנוּ.** לְשׁוֹן אֲנִינָה:


**shall lament** Heb. וְאָנוּ, an expression of lamentations.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:26:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:26:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:26:2)


**פְּתָחֶיהָ.** שַׁעֲרֵי עֲיָרוֹת וּבָתִּים, בְּכָל שְׁעָרֶיהָ יְהֵא הֶסְפֵּד:


**her gates** The gates of the towns and houses. In all their gates will be lamentation.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:26:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:26:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:26:3)


**וְנִקָּתָה.** וְתִתְרוֹקֵן מִכֹּל, כְּמוֹ ״וְגַם אֲנִי נָתַתִּי לָכֶם נִקְיוֹן שִׁנַּיִם״ (עמוס ד:ו). וּבִלְשׁוֹן מִשְׁנָה: יָצָא פְּלוֹנִי נָקִי מִנְּכָסָיו (בבא קמא מא א):


**and she shall be emptied out** Heb. ונקתה, lit., and she shall be cleansed, meaning: and she shall be emptied of everything, like (Amos 4:6): “And behold, I have given you cleanness of teeth (נִקְיוֹן שִׁנַּיִם),” [meaning hunger,] and in the language of the Mishnah; “So-and-so was cleaned out (נקי) of his belongings” (Baba Kamma 41a).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 3:26:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:26:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/3:26:4)


**לָאָרֶץ תֵּשֵׁב.** מִגֹּבַהּ לְשִׁפְלוּת, ״יֵשְׁבוּ לָאָרֶץ יִדְּמוּ״ (איכה ב:י) בְּתִשְׁעָה בְּאָב:


**she shall sit on the ground** [This denotes figuratively that they will be reduced] from a high station to a low one. (Lam. 2: 10) “...shall sit on the ground and remain silent,” on the Ninth of Av.



## Chapter 4


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:1:1)


**וְהֶחֱזִיקוּ.** וְיֹאחֲזוּ:


And they shall take hold of.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:1:2)


**שֶׁבַע נָשִׁים בְּאִישׁ אֶחָד.** מֵרֹב אַלְמָנוֹת רַבּוֹת, בְּאִישׁ אֶחָד מְבַקְּשׁוֹת מִמֶּנּוּ שֶׁיִּשָּׂא אוֹתָן:


**Now seven women shall take hold of one man** because of the many widows.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:1:3)


**אֱסֹף.** הַטְמֵן חֶרְפָּתֵנוּ, כְּמוֹ ״וַאֲסַפְתּוֹ אֶל תּוֹךְ בֵּיתֶךָ״ (דברים כא:יב), שֶׁהָאִשָּׁה כְּשֶׁהִיא נְשׂוּאָה אֵין נוֹהֲגִין בָּהּ מִנְהַג הֶפְקֵר. וּמִדְרָשׁ אַגָּדָה (איכה רבה ה:יא): נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּר גָּזַר שֶׁלֹּא יִבְעֲלוּ אֵשֶׁת אִישׁ שֶׁלֹּא יֵעָנְשׁוּ, לָכֵן הָיוּ מְבַקְּשׁוֹת שֶׁיְּהֵא עֲלֵיהֶן שֵׁם אִישׁוּת:


**take away** Heb. אסף [lit., gather in,] hide our reproach, similar to (Deut. 22:2): “And you shall gather it (ואספתו) into your house.” For the woman, when she is married, will not be dealt with licentiously. According to Midrash Aggadah, (Lamentations Rabbah 5:11) Nebuchadnezzar commanded (or decreed upon) [his armies] not to have relations with married women, lest they be punished. They, therefore, begged to be nominally married.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:2:1)


**בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא.** לְאַחַר שֶׁיִּכְלוּ נוֹי תַּכְשִׁיטֵי הַנּוֹאֲפוֹת וְהַנְּבָלוֹת, לֹא תִּכְלֶה (ספרים אחרים: לֹא תִּסּוֹלֶה) עוֹד צְבִי נוֹי כְּבוֹדָם בְּאֵלֶּה:


**On that day** After the beauty of the ornaments of the adulteresses and the wanton women is curtailed, the glory of My people and the beauty of their honor will no longer depend upon these things.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:2:2)


**יִהְיֶה צֶמַח ה׳.** לָכֶם לְנוֹי:


**the sprout of the Lord shall be** to you for beauty.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:2:3)


**לִצְבִי וּלְכָבוֹד.** הֵם הַצַּדִּיקִים הַנִּשְׁאָרִים בָּם וְהַחֲכָמִים תַּלְמִידֵי הַתּוֹרָה, בָּהֶם יִתְלוּ אֶת צְבִי כְּבוֹדָם:


**for beauty and for honor** They are the righteous who remain among them, and the sages, the students of the Torah; upon them will they depend the beauty of their honor.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:2:4)


**וּפְרִי הָאָרֶץ.** הֵם בְּנֵי הַצַּדִּיקִים, פְּרִי עֵץ חַיִּים, הֵם יִהְיוּ **לְגָאוֹן וּלְתִפְאֶרֶת,** אֲשֶׁר בָּהֶם יִתְפָּאֲרוּ וְיִתְהַלְּלוּ פְּלֵיטַת יִשְׂרָאֵל. צְבִי – הוּא נוֹי, דָּבָר צִבְיוֹן שֶׁיֵּשׁ חֵפֶץ בּוֹ:


**and the fruit of the land** They are the children of the righteous, the fruit of the Tree of Life. They shall be for greatness and glory, for the survivors of Israel will boast and praise themselves with them. צְבִי means ‘beauty,’ an object of desire, for there is desire in it.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:3:1)


**וְהָיָה הַנִּשְׁאָר** בָּהֶם בְּצִיּוֹן יִתְיַשְּׁבוּ:


**And it shall come to pass, that every survivor** among them will settle in Zion.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:3:2)


**וְהַנּוֹתָר.** בְּכָל מָקוֹם, יִשְׁכְּנוּ **בִּירוּשָׁלִָם.**


**and whoever is left** anywhere, shall dwell in Jerusalem.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:3:3)


**קָדוֹשׁ יֵאָמֶר לוֹ.** כֻּלָּם יִהְיוּ צַדִּיקִים. וְאִם תֹּאמַר: צַדִּיקִים הַמֵּתִים לִפְנֵי אוֹתוֹ הַיּוֹם אָבַד כְּבוֹדָם? תַּלְמוּד לוֹמַר **כָּל הַכָּתוּב** לְחַיֵּי הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא יִהְיוּ בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם (ויקרא רבה לה, ו). כְּתַרְגּוּם יוֹנָתָן:


**“holy” shall be said of him** All of them will be righteous. Now lest you say that the righteous who died prior to this day have lost their honor, the Scripture states: “anyone inscribed for life,” in the Hereafter, will be in Jerusalem.In this manner, Jonathan translates it.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:4:1)


**אִם רָחַץ.** כְּמוֹ ׳כִּי רָחַץ׳, יֵשׁ ׳אִם׳ מְשַׁמֵּשׁ כֵּן בִּלְשׁוֹן ׳כִּי׳, וְכֵן (איוב ח:יח) ״אִם יְבַלְּעֶנּוּ מִמְּקוֹמוֹ״ – כִּי יְבַלְּעֶנּוּ, ״עַד אִם כָּלוּ לִשְׁתּוֹת״ (בראשית כד:יט):


**When the Lord shall have washed away** Heb. אִם [usually “if.”] When the Lord shall have washed away. There are instances of אִם being used in this manner in the usage of כִּי ; and so (Job 8:18): “But when (אִם) men destroy him from his place,” is [equivalent to] כִּי יְבַלְּעֶנּוּ. Also (Gen. 24:9): “Until when (אִם) they will have finished drinking.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:4:2)


**צֹאַת.** ״תְּגָאֲלַת״ כְּתַרְגּוּמוֹ, כְּלוֹמַר: הֶעֱבִיר עֲוֹנָם עַל יְדֵי יִסּוּרִין וּבִעוּר מִן הָעוֹלָם:


**filth** Defilement, as its Aramaic translation; i.e. to say, when He will remove their iniquity through chastening and purging from the world.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:4:3)


**יָדִיחַ.** לְשׁוֹן רְחִיצָה בִּלְשׁוֹן מִשְׁנָה וּבַמִּקְרָא: ״וְשָׁם יָדִיחוּ אֶת הָעוֹלָה״ (יחזקאל מ:לח):


**He shall rinse** Heb. יָדִיחַ, an expression of ‘washing’ in the language of the Mishnah, and in Scripture (Ezek. 40:38): “There they will rinse (יָדִיחוּ) the burnt offering.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:4:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:4:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:4:4)


**בְּרוּחַ מִשְׁפָּט.** עַל יְדֵי יִסּוּרִין, טלנ״ט בלע״ז, שֶׁיַּעֲלֶה עַל רוּחוֹ לִשְׁפּוֹט אוֹתָם:


**with a spirit of judgment** through chastening. ‘spirit’ [is equivalent] to talant in O.F. When He so desires to judge them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:4:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:4:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:4:5)


**וּבְרוּחַ בָּעֵר.** לְבַעֲרָם מִן הָעוֹלָם. **בָּעֵר** – כְּמוֹ ״לְבָעֵר״, דישקומברמ״ט בלע״ז, לְשׁוֹן פָּעוֹל, הִלּוּךְ:


**and with a spirit of purging** to purge them from the world, בָּעֵר is like לְבָעֵר, to purge, descombrement in O.F., an expression of doing, going.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:5:1)


**וְעַל מִקְרָאֶהָ.** הַקְּרוּאִים בְּתוֹכָהּ:


**וְעַל מִקְרָאֶהָ** and over those summoned therein.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:5:2)


**עָנָן יוֹמָם וְעָשָׁן.** לְהָגֵן עֲלֵיהֶם מִן הָאֻמּוֹת:


**a cloud by day and smoke** to protect them from the nations.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:5:3)


**כִּי עַל כָּל כָּבוֹד** הָאָמוּר לָהֶם תְּהֵא הַחֻפָּה, שֶׁתְּחוֹפֵף שְׁכִינָתִי עֲלֵיהֶם. וְשֶׁבַע חוּפּוֹת יֵשׁ כָּאן: עָנָן, וְעָשָׁן, נֹגַהּ, אֵשׁ, לֶהָבָה, חֻפָּה, שְׁכִינָה:


**for, in addition to every honor** stated to them, shall be a shelter, for I will cause My Shechinah to cover them. Seven chupoth [shelters or canopies] are [mentioned here]: cloud, smoke, splendor, fire, flame, shelter, Shechinah.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:6:1)


**וְסֻכָּה תִּהְיֶה לְצֵל וגו׳ מֵחֹרֶב.** לְהָגֵן מִלַּהַט יוֹם הַבָּא, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר בָּרְשָׁעִים ״וְלִהַט אוֹתָם הַיּוֹם הַבָּא״ (מלאכי ג:יט), שֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא מוֹצִיא חַמָּה מִנַּרְתְּקָהּ וּמְקַדְּרָהּ עֲלֵיהֶם:


**And a tabernacle shall be for shade...from heat** to protect from the burning of the future sun, as it is said in regard to the wicked (Malachi 3:19): “And the coming sun shall set them ablaze,” for the Holy One, blessed be He, will take the sun out of its case, and cause it to burn them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:6:2)


**וּלְמַחְסֶה.** לְשׁוֹן כִּסּוּי:


**and for a shelter** Heb. וּלְמַחְסֶה. [This is] an expression of covering.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:6:3)


**וּלְמִסְתּוֹר.** לְהִסָּתֵר בָּהּ:


**and for a covert** in which to hide.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:6:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:6:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:6:4)


**מִזֶּרֶם.** אֵשׁ הַמְּקַלַּחַת מִנְּהַר דִּינוּר עַל הָרְשָׁעִים בַּגֵּיהִנֹּם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״עַל רֹאשׁ רְשָׁעִים יָחוּל״ (ירמיהו כג:יט) בְּמַסֶּכֶת חגיגה (חגיגה יג ב):


**from stream** of fire gushing forth from the river of fire on the wicked in Gehinnom, as it is said (Jeremiah 23:19): “On the heads of the wicked it shall rest.” [This is found] in Tractate Chagigah 13b.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 4:6:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:6:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/4:6:5)


**וּמִמָּטָר.** מָטָר הַיּוֹרֵד עַל הָרְשָׁעִים, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״יַמְטֵר עַל רְשָׁעִים פַּחִים״ (תהלים יא:ו):


**and from rain** the rain that falls on the wicked, as in the manner stated in Psalms 11:6: “He rains on the wicked burning coals.”



## Chapter 5


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:1:1)


**אָשִׁירָה נָּא לִידִידִי.** הַנָּבִיא אוֹמֵר: ״אָשִׁירָה נָּא לִידִידִי״, תַּחַת יְדִידִי וּבִמְקוֹמוֹ וּבִשְׁלִיחוּתוֹ, כְּמוֹ ״ה׳ יִלָּחֵם לָכֶם״ (שמות יד:יד) בִּשְׁבִילְכֶם:


**I will now sing for my beloved** The prophet says: “I will now sing for my beloved and in his place and as his messenger. [The word לִידִידִי would usually mean, ‘to my beloved.’] Similar to (Exodus 14: 4): “The Lord will wage war for you (לָכֶם), for you [not ‘to you’].”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:1:2)


**שִׁירַת דּוֹדִי** הִיא זוֹ, אֲשֶׁר שָׁר בִּשְׁבִיל כַּרְמוֹ, עַל עִסְקֵי כַּרְמוֹ, כְּמוֹ ״וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ אַנְשֵׁי הַמָּקוֹם לְאִשְׁתּוֹ״ (בראשית כו:ז):


**the song of my beloved about his vineyard** This is the song of my beloved that he sang for his vineyard, about his vineyard, as (Genesis 26:7): “And the people of the place asked about his wife (לְאִשְׁתּוֹ), about his wife [not ‘to his wife’].”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:1:3)


**כֶּרֶם וְגוֹ׳. בֶּן שָׁמֶן** – בְּזָוִית הָעוֹשָׂה פֵּרוֹת שְׁמֵנִים כְּשֶׁמֶן טוֹב:


**a vineyard in a fertile corner** in a corner that produces fat fruit, like good oil.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:1:4)


**בֶּן שָׁמֶן.** זָוִית רָאוּי לְשֶׁמֶן, לְזֵיתִים לַעֲשׂוֹת שֶׁמֶן, כְּמוֹ ״בֶּן מָוֶת״ (שמואל א כ:לא) רָאוּי לָמוּת. וְדֻגְמָא הִיא זוֹ, וּבְסוֹף הָעִנְיָן יְפָרְשֶׁנָּה:


**fertile** Heb. בן-שמן [lit. the son of oil, i.e.,] a corner fit for oil, for olives to produce oil, [like] (I Samuel 20:31) בֶּן-מָוֶת, [lit. a son of death,] fit to die. This is a parable, and at the end of the section, he will explain it.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:2:1)


**וַיְעַזְּקֵהוּ.** סִיְּגוֹ וּגְדָרוֹ סָבִיב, מֻקָּף כְּמִין טַבַּעַת, דִּמְתַרְגְּמִינָן ״עִיזְקָא״:


**And he fenced it in** Heb. וַיְעַזְּקֵהוּ. He fenced it and walled it around, surrounded like a sort of ring, translated into Aramaic as עִיזְקָא.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:2:2)


**וַיְסַקְּלֵהוּ.** הוֹצִיא אֲבָנִים מִתּוֹכוֹ הָרָעִים לַגְּפָנִים, כְּמוֹ ״סַקְּלוּ מֵאֶבֶן״ (ישעיהו סב:י):


**and he cleared it of stones** Heb. וַיְסַקְלֵהוּ. He cleared it of the stones that are detrimental to the vines, comp. (infra 62:10) “Clear of stones (סַקְּלוֹ מֵאֶבֶן).”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:2:3)


**וַיִּטָּעֵהוּ שֹׂרֵק.** הֵם זְמוֹרוֹת הַיָּפוֹת לִנְטִיעָה מִשְּׁאָר זְמוֹרוֹת:


**and he planted it with the choicest vines** They are the best of all branches for planting.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:2:4)


**וַיִּבֶן מִגְדָּל בְּתוֹכוֹ.** גַּת לַעֲצוֹר עֲנָבִים:


**and he built a tower in its midst** A press in which to press the grapes.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:2:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:2:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:2:5)


**וְגַם יֶקֶב חָצַב בּוֹ.** הַבּוֹר שֶׁלִּפְנֵי הַגַּת לְקַבֵּל הַיַּיִן, וְכֵן כָּל ״יֶקֶב״ שֶׁבַּמִּקְרָא לְשׁוֹן בּוֹר הוּא, וְכֵן ״עַד יִקְבֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ״ (זכריה יד:י) תַּרְגּוּם יוֹנָתָן ״עַד שִׁיחַיָּא דְמַלְכָּא״, הוּא עֹמֶק אוֹקְיָנוֹס, וְלָכֵן נוֹפֵל בּוֹ כָּאן לְשׁוֹן חֲצִיבָה, כְּמוֹ ״וּבֹרֹת חֲצוּבִים״ (דברים ו:יא):


**and also a vat he hewed therein** Heb. יֶקֶב, the pit that is before the press, to receive the wine. Likewise, every יֶקֶב in Scripture is an expression denoting a pit. Likewise (Zechariah 14:4), עַד יִקְבֵי הַמֶלֶךְ, which Jonathan renders, “Until the King’s pits.” This is the depth of the ocean. Therefore, the expression of hewing applies, just like (Deut. 6:11): “and hewn pits.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:2:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:2:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:2:6)


**וַיְקַו לַעֲשׂוֹת עֲנָבִים.** וַיְקַו יְדִידִי לַעֲשׂוֹת לוֹ הַכֶּרֶם הַזֶּה עֲנָבִים:


**and he hoped to produce grapes** And my beloved hoped that this vineyard would produce grapes for him.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:2:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:2:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:2:7)


**וַיַּעַשׂ בְּאֻשִׁים.** דּוֹמִים לַעֲנָבִים, וְקוֹרִין אוֹתָם לנברווייש״ט בלע״ז:


**and it produced wild berries** Heb. בְּאֻשִׁים. Similar to grapes, and they are called lanbrojjses in O.F.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:5:1)


**הָסֵר מְשׂוּכָּתוֹ.** לְהָסִיר גָּדֵר הַמְּסוֹכֵךְ וּמֵגִין עָלָיו, ׳מְסוּכָה׳ הוּא סְיָג קוֹצִים, ׳גָּדֵר׳ הוּא גָּדֵר אֲבָנִים:


**I will remove its hedge** I will remove the fence that covers and protects it. מְשׂוּכָה is a fence of thorns; גָדֵר is a fence of stones.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:5:2)


**וְהָיָה.** הַכֶּרֶם:


**and it shall be** [i.e.,] the vineyard.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:5:3)


**לְבָעֵר.** שֶׁיִּרְעוּ בּוֹ בְּהֵמָה וְחַיָּה:


**eaten up** For cattle and wild beasts will graze there.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:6:1)


**וַאֲשִׁיתֵהוּ בָתָה.** לְשׁוֹן שְׁמָמָה וְרֵיקָנוּת הִיא, וְכֵן (ישעיהו ז:יט) ״בְּנַחֲלֵי הַבַּתּוֹת״:


**And I will make it a desolation** Heb. בָתָה, an expression of desolation and emptiness. Compare (infra 7:19): “in the desolate valleys (הַבַּתּוֹת).”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:6:2)


**וְלֹא יֵעָדֵר.** לְשׁוֹן חֲפִירַת כֶּרֶם הוּא:


**nor hoed** Heb. יֵעָדֵר ; this is an expression of digging in a vineyard.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:6:3)


**וְעָלָה שָׁמִיר וָשָׁיִת.** מִינֵי קוֹצִים פָּתַר בָּהֶם מְנַחֵם בֶּן סָרוּק (מחברת מנחם: שמר), וַאֲנִי אוֹמֵר: שָׁמִיר לְשׁוֹן תּוֹלַעַת חָזָק הוּא הַמְבַקֵּעַ אֲבָנִים, שֶׁבּוֹ בָּנָה שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (יחזקאל ג:ט) ״כַּשָּׁמִיר חָזָק מִצּוּר״:


**the shamir and desolation will come up** Heb. שָׁמִיר וָשָׁיִת. Menahem ben Seruk interprets them as kinds of thorns (Machbereth Menahem p. 176), but I say that “shamir” is a word denoting a strong worm that splits stones, with which Solomon built the Temple, like the matter that is written (Ezekiel 3:19), “Like a shamir, stronger than rock.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:6:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:6:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:6:4)


**שָׁיִת.** לְשׁוֹן ״הַשְּׁאֵת וְהַשֶּׁבֶר״ (איכה ג:מז), לְשׁוֹן ״תִּשָּׁאֶה שְׁמָמָה״ (ישעיהו ו:יא), צָדוּ מֵאֵין דּוֹרֵשׁ לִכָּנֵס בּוֹ, וּמִתּוֹךְ כָּךְ תַּעֲלֶה בּוֹ תּוֹלַעַת:


**desolation** Heb. שַׁיִת, an expression similar to (Lamentations 3:47), “desolation (הַשְׁאֵת) and breach,” an expression similar to (infra 6:11), “shall be made desolate (תִּשָּׁאֶה) [as a wilderness”; i.e., it will be] empty with no one seeking it to enter it, and thereby worms will overrun it.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:1)


**כִּי כֶרֶם ה׳ צְבָאוֹת בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל.** לַכֶּרֶם הַזֶּה אַתֶּם מְשׁוּלִים בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, כִּי כָּל מַה שֶּׁעָשָׂה לַכֶּרֶם הַזֶּה עָשָׂה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל. וְהַכֶּרֶם הוּא אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן, כִּי מָצִינוּ בְּמִדְרְשֵׁי אַגָּדָה בִּמְקוֹמוֹת הַרְבֵּה, בְּתַנְחוּמָא וּבִבְרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה (בראשית רבה יט:ב), שֶׁמִּקְרָאוֹת הַלָּלוּ נִדְרָשִׁין עָלָיו. לֹא נִטְרַד אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן עַד שֶׁחֵרֵף וְגִדֵּף, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״וַיְקַו לַעֲשׂוֹת עֲנָבִים״ (ישעיהו ה:ב). וּבְמָקוֹם אַחֵר מָצִינוּ: הוֹשִׁיב עָלָיו שׁוֹמְרִים שֶׁלֹּא יֹאכַל מֵעֵץ הַחַיִּים, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״וְעַל הֶעָבִים אֲצַוֶּה״ (ישעיהו ה:ו). וְכֵן נִדְרְשֵׁנוּ עָלָיו:


**For the vineyard of the Lord of Hosts is the House of Israel** To this vineyard are you compared, O House of Israel, for all that He did for this vineyard, He did for Israel. The vineyard represents Adam, for we find in Midrash Aggadah, in many places in Tanhuma, and in Genesis Rabbah [that] these passages are expounded concerning him, e.g., Adam was not expelled from Paradise until he reviled and blasphemed, as it is said: And He hoped to produce grapes,... (Gen. Rabbah 19:12). And in another place we find: He appointed guards over him that he should not eat from the Tree of Life, as it is said (verse 6): “And I will command the clouds...” (ibid. 21:8). And in this manner, [the following verses] can be expounded concerning him:


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:2)


**כֶרֶם.** זֶה אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן:


**(1) My beloved had a vineyard. A vineyard** This [alludes to] Adam.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:3)


**לִידִידִי.** זֶה הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא:


**My beloved** This is the Holy One, blessed be He.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:4)


**בֶּן שָׁמֶן** בְּגַן עֵדֶן:


**In a fertile corner** in the Garden of Eden.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:5)


**וַיְעַזְּקֵהוּ.** בְּעֶשֶׂר חֻפּוֹת הָאֲמוּרוֹת (יחזקאל כח) בְּפָרָשַׁת חִירָם מֶלֶךְ צוֹר:


**(2) And he fenced it in** with the ten canopies mentioned in Ezekiel (28), in the section dealing with Hiram, king of Tyre.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:6)


**וַיְסַקְּלֵהוּ.** מִיֵּצֶר הָרָע, עַד שֶׁאָכַל מִן הָעֵץ וְנִכְנַס בּוֹ יֵצֶר הָרָע:


**And He cleared it of stones** Of temptation, until he ate from the tree, and temptation gained entry into him.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:7)


**וַיִּטָּעֵהוּ שׂוֹרֵק.** תְּחִלַּת יְצִירָתוֹ מִמְּקוֹם הַמִּזְבֵּחַ:


**And He planted it with the choicest vines** The beginning of his formation was from the place of the altar.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:8)


**וַיִּבֶן מִגְדָּל בְּתוֹכוֹ.** ״וַיִּפַּח בְּאַפָּיו נִשְׁמַת חַיִּים״ (בראשית ב:ז) מִן הָעֶלְיוֹנִים:


**And He built a tower in its midst** And He breathed into his nostrils the spirit of life, from the heavenly beings.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:9)


**וְגַם יֶקֶב חָצַב בּוֹ.** מַעְיָן נוֹבֵעַ, מְקוֹר חָכְמָה:


**And also a vat He hewed therein** A spring flowing, the fountain of wisdom.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:10)


**וַיְקַו לַעֲשׂוֹת עֲנָבִים.** שֶׁיּוֹדֶה וִישַׁבַּח לְפָנָיו:


**And He hoped to produce grapes** that he would thank Him and praise Him.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:11)


**וַיַּעַשׂ בְּאֻשִׁים.** דְּבָרִים נִבְאָשִׁים, חֵרֵף וְגִדֵּף:


**And it produced wild berries** putrid things; he reviled and blasphemed.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:12)


**שִׁפְטוּ נָא.** לְפִי שֶׁסּוֹף הַמָּשָׁל בָּא לוֹמַר, שֶׁאַף הֵם עָשׂוּ כְּמוֹתוֹ, שׁוֹאֵל לָהֶם הַמִּשְׁפָּט:


**(3) Judge now** Since the end of the parable comes to say that they too did like him, he asks them the judgment.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:13)


**אוֹדִיעָה נָּא אֶתְכֶם.** מַה נִּרְאָה בְּעֵינַי לַעֲשׂוֹת לוֹ וְעָשִׂיתִי:


**(5) I will inform you** what I decided to do to him and I did.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:14)


**הָסֵר מְשׂוּכָתוֹ.** טְרַדְתִּיו מִתּוֹךְ חֻפּוֹתָיו:


**I removed its hedge** I expelled him from amidst his canopies.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:15)


**וְהָיָה לְבָעֵר.** סוֹפוֹ לָמוּת וְלִמְשׁוֹל בּוֹ חַיּוֹת רָעוֹת:


**And it shall be eaten up** His end will be to die and to be ruled over by wild beasts.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:16)


**פָּרוֹץ גְּדֵרוֹ.** טְרַדְתִּיו מִמְּחִיצַת גַּן עֵדֶן:


**Breach its wall** I expelled from the enclosure of Paradise.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:17)


**וָאֲשִׁיתֵהוּ בָתָה.** צָדוֹ הוֹשַׁבְתִּיו, שֶׁלֹּא נָתַתִּי תּוֹרָה בְּיָמָיו:


**(6) And I made it a desolation** I made him dwell in desolation, for I did not give the Torah in his days.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:18)


**לֹא יִזָּמֵר וְלֹא יֵעָדֵר.** לֹא יִלְמְדוּ מִמֶּנּוּ, לֹא זְכוּת וְלֹא מַעֲשֶׂה טוֹב:


**It shall neither be pruned nor hoed** They will learn from him neither merit nor good deeds.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:19)


**וְעָלָה שָׁמִיר וָשָׁיִת.** שָׁלַט בּוֹ יֵצֶר הָרָע וּבְדוֹרוֹתָיו אַחֲרָיו, לַעֲשׂוֹת מַעֲשִׂים מְקֻלְקָלִים:


**The shamir and desolation will come up** Temptation ruled over him and his posterity, to perform corrupt deeds.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:20)


**וְעַל הֶעָבִים אֲצַוֶּה.** צִוִּיתִי עָלָיו שׁוֹמְרִים לִשְׁמֹר אֶת דֶּרֶךְ עֵץ הַחַיִּים:


**And I commanded the clouds** I appointed guards over him to guard the way of the Tree of Life.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:21)


**כִּי כֶרֶם ה׳ צְבָאוֹת בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל.** כִּי כְּאוֹתוֹ הַכֶּרֶם לִי בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, עֲשֶׂרֶת הַשְּׁבָטִים הֵם הָיוּ לִי כְּכֶרֶם יַיִן, כְּכֶרֶם זַיִת, כְּקֶרֶן שֶׁמֶן בְּאֶרֶץ שְׁמֵנָה: שֶׁמֶן כְּהֻנָּה, שֶׁמֶן מַלְכוּת, שֶׁמֶן מְנוֹרָה, שֶׁמֶן מְנָחוֹת. עִזַּקְתִּים תְּחִלָּה בְּהֶקֵּף עַנְנֵי כָבוֹד בַּמִּדְבָּר, וְסִקַּלְתִּים וְנִקִּיתִים מִפּוֹשְׁעֵי הַדּוֹר. נְטַעְתִּים שׂוֹרֵק, שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת וָשֵׁשׁ מִצְווֹת כְּמִנְיַן שׂוֹרֵק הוֹסַפְתִּי עֲלֵיהֶם, עַל שֶׁבַע מִצְווֹת שֶׁנִּצְטַוּוּ בְּנֵי נֹחַ. בָּנִיתִי מִגְדָּל בְּתוֹכוֹ מִשְׁכָּנִי וּמִקְדָּשִׁי, וְגַם יֶקֶב הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְהַשִּׁיתִין:


**(7) For the vineyard of the Lord of Hosts is the House of Israel** For the House of Israel is to Me like that vineyard; The ten tribes were to Me like a vineyard producing wine, like an olive orchard, in a fat corner, in a fat land, [producing anointing] oil for the priesthood, [anointing] oil for the kingdom, oil for the Menorah, oil for the meal offerings. I fenced them in first with the encirclement of the clouds of glory in the desert and I cleared them of stones, i.e., I cleansed them of the transgressors of the generation. I planted them with the choicest vines (שׂוֹרֵק) six hundred and six commandments, like the numerical value of שׂוֹרֵק, I added for them to the seven commandments that the children of Noah were commanded. I built a tower in their midst, My Tabernacle and My Temple, and also a vat, the altar and the pits [the pits by the side of the altar into which the remainder of the libations was poured.]


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:22)


**וַיַּעַשׂ בְּאֻשִׁים.** קִלְקְלוּ מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם:


**(2) And it produced wild berries** They corrupted their deeds.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:23)


**וְעַתָּה יוֹשֵׁב יְרוּשָׁלִַם וְאִישׁ יְהוּדָה** אֲשֶׁר לֹא גְלִיתִים עֲדַיִן, יִשְׁפְּטוּ נָא בֵּינִי וּבֵינֵיהֶם עַל הָרָעָה שֶׁהֵבֵאתִי עֲלֵיהֶם: מִי סָרַח עַל מִי? מַה הָיָה לִי לַעֲשׂוֹת עוֹד טוֹבָה לְכַרְמִי וְלֹא עָשִׂיתִי לוֹ?


**(3) And now, dwellers of Jerusalem and men of Judah** who have not yet been exiled, please judge between me and between them concerning the evil that I brought on them; who sinned against whom? **What more could I have done** beneficial deeds **for My vineyard, and I have not done** for it?


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:24)


**אוֹדִיעָה נָּא אֶתְכֶם.** גַּם אַתֶּם הַמַּכְעִיסִים אוֹתִי, אֶת אֲשֶׁר הָגוּן בְּעֵינַי לַעֲשׂוֹת לְכַרְמִי, כְּכָל אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי לְאָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן:


**(5) Now I will inform you** Even you who anger Me, what is fitting in My eyes to do to My vineyard, according to all that I did to Adam, viz.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:25)


**הָסֵר מְסוּכָּתוֹ.** אֲסַלֵּק שְׁכִינָתִי מֵעֲלֵיהֶם, הַמְּסוֹכֶכֶת עֲלֵיהֶם, כְּמָה שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (ישעיהו כב:ח) ״וַיְגַל אֶת מָסַךְ יְהוּדָה״:


**to remove its hedge** I will remove My Shechinah from them, the Shechinah that covers them, as it is said (infra 22:8), “And He bared the covert of Judah.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:26)


**פָּרוֹץ גְּדֵרוֹ.** אֶתּוֹץ חוֹמוֹתָיו:


**Breach its wall** I will demolish its walls.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:27)


**וַאֲשִׁיתֵהוּ בָתָה.** ״וַאֲשַׁוִינוּן רְטִישִׁין״ (תרגום יונתן):


**(6) And I will make it a desolation** And I will make them forsaken [from Targum Jonathan].


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:28)


**לֹא יִזָּמֵר וְלֹא יֵעָדֵר.** ״לָא יִסְתַּעְדוּן וְלָא יִסְתַּמְכוּן״ (תרגום יונתן):


**It will neither be pruned nor hoed** They will not be visited nor will they be supported. [from Targum Jonathan].


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:29)


**וְעָלָה שָׁמִיר וָשָׁיִת.** ״וִיהוֹן מְטַלְטְלִין וּשְׁבִיקִין״, דֻּגְמַת ״שָׁמִיר וָשָׁיִת״ שֶׁל כֶּרֶם, וְאֵצֶל הַכֶּרֶם מַמָּשׁ בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר (ישעיהו ז:כג) הוּא מְתוּרְגָּם: ״הוֹבָאִי וּבוּר״:


**And the shamir and desolation will come up** And they will be wandering and forsaken, represented by the שָׁמִיר וָשָׁיִת [desolation] of the vineyard, and regarding the vineyard itself in another place, it is rendered הֲבָאִי וּבוּר, desolate and fallow.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:30

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:30](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:30)


**וְעַל הֶעָבִים אֲצַוֶּה.** ״וְעַל נְבִיָּיא אַפְקֵד דְּלָא יִתְנַבּוֹן עֲלֵיהוֹן״ (תרגום יונתן). הַנְּבוּאָה נִמְשְׁלָה לְמָטָר, שֶׁהֶעָבִים מְקַבְּלִין אוֹתָהּ מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם, כָּךְ הַנְּבִיאִים מְקַבְּלִין הַנְּבוּאָה מִפִּי הַקְּדוּשָׁה:


**And I will command the clouds** And I will command the prophets not to prophesy on your behalf [Jonathan]. Prophecy is analogous to rain, which the clouds receive from heaven; so do the prophets receive the divine prophecy.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:31

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:31](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:31)


**נְטַע שַׁעֲשׁוּעָיו.** כְּמוֹ ״נֶטַע״ (איוב יד:ט), וּלְפִי שֶׁהוּא דָבוּק נָקוּד (פַּתַּח) כְּמוֹ ״בְּקַר זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים״ (במדבר ז:פח):


**The plant of His joy** Comp. נָטָע (Job 14:9), but since it is in the construct state, it is vowelized with a patach, like (Num. 7:88) בְּקַר זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים, “the cattle of the peace offerings.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:7:32

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:32](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:7:32)


**וַיְקַו.** שֶׁיַּעֲשׂוּ מִשְׁפָּט, וְהִנֵּה מִשְׂפָּח – אֲסִיפַת חֵטְא עַל חֵטְא, כְּמוֹ ״מֵהִסְתַּפֵּחַ״ (שמואל א כו:יט), ״סְפָחֵנִי נָא״ (שמואל א ב:לו). דָּבָר אַחֵר: לְשׁוֹן נֶגַע, וּלְפִי שֶׁהוּא לָשׁוֹן נוֹפֵל עַל הַלָּשׁוֹן בִּקְרִיאָתוֹ, דּוֹמֶה ׳מִשְׁפָּט׳ לְ׳מִשְׂפָּח׳, וְכֵן ׳צְעָקָה׳ לִ׳צְדָקָה׳, נָפַל בּוֹ רוּחַ הַקֹּדֶשׁ בְּפִי הַנָּבִיא:


**and He hoped** that they would perform justice, and behold, there was מִשְׂפָּח, an accumulation of sin upon sin, like (I Sam. 26:19), “From cleaving (מֵהִסְתַּפֵּחַ),” also (ibid. 2:36), “Take me now into (סְפָחֵנִי).” Another explanation is that it is an expression of a lesion, and since it is a similar expression, for, in pronunciation, מִשְׂפָּח resembles מִשְׁפָּט, and so, זְעָקָה resembles צְדָקָה, it fell through divine inspiration into the prophet’s mouth.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:8:1)


**הוֹי מַגִּיעֵי בַיִת בְּבַיִת.** עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁנַיִם ״אַשְׁרֵי״ נֶאֱמַר בְּסֵפֶר תְּהִלִּים עַל מְקַיְּמֵי הַתּוֹרָה, וְעֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁנַיִם ״הוֹי״ אָמַר יְשַׁעְיָה עַל הָרְשָׁעִים. **הוֹי** לְשׁוֹן צַעֲקַת אֲנָחָה עַל פֻּרְעָנוּת הָעֲתִידָה לָבֹא:


**Woe to those who join a house to a house** Twenty-two instances of אַשְׁרֵי, fortunate, were said in the Book of Psalms concerning those who fulfill [the tenets of] the Torah, and Isaiah said twenty-two times, “הוֹי,” woe, concerning the wicked. **Woe** An expression of a cry of a sigh concerning the impending retribution.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:8:2)


**מַגִּיעֵי בַיִת בְּבַיִת.** מְקָרְבִים בָּתֵּיהֶם זֶה אֵצֶל זֶה, וּמִתּוֹךְ כָּךְ גּוֹזְלִים קַרְקַע הָעֲנִיִּים הַחֲלָשִׁים שֶׁבֵּין שְׁנֵי הַבָּתִּים, וְכֵן:


**those who join a house to a house** They draw their houses one to the other, thereby taking the land of the weak poor man between the two houses, and so


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:8:3)


**שָׂדֶה בְשָׂדֶה יַקְרִיבוּ עַד אֶפֶס מָקוֹם.** שֶׁאֵין מָקוֹם לֶעָנִי לָשֶׁבֶת:


**a field to a field they draw near until there is no place** No place for the poor man to live.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:8:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:8:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:8:4)


**וְהוּשַׁבְתֶּם לְבַדְּכֶם בְּקֶרֶב הָאָרֶץ.** כִּסְבוּרִים אַתֶּם שֶׁאֵין חֵלֶק לְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא וְלֹא לַעֲנִיִּים בָּאָרֶץ: חֶלְקוֹ בְּמַעַשְׂרוֹת אַתֶּם גּוֹזְלִים, וְלַעֲנִיִּים אֶת אַרְצָם, שֶׁתִּהְיוּ אַתֶּם לְבַדְּכֶם יוֹשְׁבִים בָּהּ:


**and you will be settled alone in the midst of the land** You think that neither the Holy One, blessed be He, nor the poor, have a share in the land. His share of the tithes you are stealing, and the poor, [you are robbing] of their land, so that you alone will occupy it.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:9:1)


**בְּאָזְנָי ה׳ צְבָאוֹת.** אָמַר הַנָּבִיא: שְׁתֵּי אָזְנַי שָׁמְעוּ כְּשֶׁנִּגְזַר עֲלֵיהֶם גְּזֵרָה מֵאֵת ה׳ וּבִשְׁבוּעָה, **אִם לֹא** עַל דָּבָר זֶה **בָּתִּים רַבִּים לְשַׁמָּה יִהְיוּ,** וּבָתִּים **גְּדוֹלִים וְטוֹבִים** יִהְיוּ **מֵאֵין יוֹשֵׁב**:


**In my ears [spoke] the Lord of Hosts** Said the prophet, Both my ears heard when the decree was decreed upon them by the Lord, and with an oath, “Truly, because of this thing, great houses will become desolate, yea, large ones and good ones, without inhabitants.”



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:10:1)


**כִּי עֲשֶׂרֶת צִמְדֵּי כֶרֶם.** וּמִפְּנֵי הָרָעָב יִגְלוּ יוֹשְׁבֵי הַבָּתִּים וְאֵין יוֹשֵׁב בָּהּ, וְגַם זֹאת תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם מִדָּה בְּמִדָּה עַל הַקְרָבַת הַשָּׂדֶה בַּשָּׂדֶה, שֶׁגְּזַלְתֶּם חֶלְקוֹ שֶׁל מָקוֹם בְּמַעְשַׂר הָאָרֶץ:


**For ten acres of vineyard** And, because of the famine, the inhabitants of the house will be exiled, leaving no one dwelling in them. This, too, will be for your payment in kind for bringing one field near to the other field, for you have stolen the share of the Omnipresent in the tithe of the land.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:10:2)


**עֲשֶׂרֶת צִמְדֵּי כֶרֶם.** ארפינ״ט בלע״ז, וְאוֹמֵר אֲנִי: כְּדֵי עֲבוֹדַת יוֹם אֶחָד בְּצֶמֶד בָּקָר קָרוּי ״צֶמֶד״:


**ten acres of vineyard** arpent in French, and I say that the amount of land requiring the work of one day with a yoke of oxen is called צֶמֶד, a yoke.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:10:3)


**יַעֲשׂוּ בַּת אֶחָת.** מִדָּה אַחַת שֶׁל יַיִן, בַּת שָׁלֹשׁ סְאִין:


**will produce one bath** One measure of wine. A bath is three se’ah.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:10:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:10:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:10:4)


**וְזֶרַע חֹמֶר.** בֵּית כּוֹר, שֶׁהוּא שְׁלֹשִׁים סְאִין שֶׁל תְּבוּאָה, **יַעֲשֶׂה אֵיפָה** שָׁלֹשׁ סְאִין:


**and the seed of a homer** A place where a kur, which is thirty se’ah of grain, is usually produced, will produce an ephah three se’ah.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:11:1)


**מְאַחֲרֵי בַנֶּשֶׁף.** לִשְׁתּוֹת יַיִן בַּלֵּילוֹת:


**They sit until late in the evening** to drink wine at night.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:11:2)


**יַיִן יַדְלִיקֵם.** בּוֹעֵר בָּם:


**wine inflames them** It burns in them.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:12:1)


**כִּנּוֹר וָנֶבֶל.** נִימִין יְתֵרוֹת יֵשׁ בְּנֵבֶל מִן הַכִּנּוֹר, וְלָמָּה נִקְרָא שְׁמוֹ נֵבֶל? שֶׁמְּנַבֵּל כָּל מִינֵי כְּלֵי זֶמֶר (מדרש תהלים פא, ג):


**harp and lute** A lute has more strings than a harp. [Perhaps Rashi explains נֵבֶל as a lyre, which may have more strings than a harp.] Now why is it called נֵבֶל? Because it disgraces (מְנַבֵּל) all kinds of musical instruments. In Midrash Tehillim (81:3).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:12:2)


**תֹּף.** שֶׁל עוֹר הוּא:


**tamborine** That was made of skin.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:12:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:12:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:12:3)


**וְחָלִיל.** אָבוּב שֶׁל קָנֶה, (צלמיי״ל בלע״ז):


**a flute** A flute of reed, chalemel in O.F.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:12:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:12:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:12:4)


**וְאֵת פֹּעַל ה׳ לֹא יַבִּיטוּ.** ״וּבְאוֹרַיְתָא דַה׳ לָא אִסְתַּכָּלוּ״ (תרגום יונתן):


**and the work of the Lord they do not regard** And in the Torah of the Lord they did not look [from Jonathan].


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:12:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:12:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:12:5)


**וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו לֹא רָאוּ.** עָשׂוּ עַצְמָם כְּאִלּוּ לֹא רָאוּ אֶת גְּבוּרוֹתָיו. דָּבָר אַחֵר: לֹא קִלְּסוּהוּ שַׁחֲרִית ׳יוֹצֵר אוֹר׳, וְלֹא עַרְבִית ׳הַמַּעֲרִיב עֲרָבִים׳:


**and the deed of His hands they have not seen** They pretended that they did not see His mighty deeds. Another explanation is: They did not praise Him in the morning by reciting, “He Who forms light,” nor in the evening, by reciting, “He Who brings on the evenings.”



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:13:1)


**מִבְּלִי דָעַת.** לְפִי שֶׁהָיָה לִבָּם בְּלִי דָעַת:


**because of lack of knowledge** because their heart was without knowledge.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:13:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:13:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:13:2)


**וּכְבוֹדוֹ מְתֵי רָעָב.** נִכְבָּדָיו יָמוּתוּ בָּרָעָב:


**and its esteemed ones shall die of hunger** Heb. וכבודו מתי רעב [lit. and its honor dead ones of hunger.] [Some editions add:] Payment in kind, corresponding to the satiety.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:13:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:13:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:13:3)


**צִחֵה צָמָא.** צָמֵא כְּנֶגֶד רוֹב מִשְׁתֵּיהֶם:


**shall be parched from thirst** Thirst corresponds to their elaborate drinking feasts.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:13:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:13:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:13:4)


**צִחֵה.** תַּרְגּוּם שֶׁל צְמֵאָה:


Heb. צחה Aramaic for thirst.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:14:1)


**לָכֵן הִרְחִיבָה.** מִדָּה בְּמִדָּה: הֵם הִרְחִיבוּ נַפְשָׁם לִבְלוֹעַ מַאֲכָל וּמִשְׁתֶּה לָרֹב, וּפָעֲרוּ פֶּה לִבְלוֹעַ, אַף שְׁאוֹל תַּרְחִיב נַפְשָׁהּ לִבְלוֹעַ:


**Therefore, the nether-world has expanded** Retribution corresponding to deed; they expanded themselves to swallow much food and drink, and they opened their mouth to swallow, so will the nether world expand itself to swallow.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:14:2)


**וּפָעֲרָה.** וּפָתְחָה:


**and opened** Heb. פָּעֲרָה.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:14:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:14:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:14:3)


**לִבְלִי חֹק.** בְּאֵין סוֹף, וְלָמָּה **לִבְלִי חֹק**? לְפִי שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה בְּיָדָם שֶׁל אֵלּוּ חֹק וְקִצְבָּה לְתַפְנוּקֵיהֶם:


**without measure** Without end; and why [did the grave open] without measure? Because these people had no measure or limit to their enjoyments.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:14:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:14:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:14:4)


**וְיָרַד** שָׁם הֲדָרָהּ שֶׁל יְרוּשָׁלַיִם:


**shall descend** There the splendor of Jerusalem.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:14:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:14:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:14:5)


**וְעָלֵז בָּהּ.** הָעֲלִיזִים שֶׁבָּהּ:


**And those who rejoice therein** Heb. ועלז בה. [I.e., those who rejoiced in Jerusalem, or in all the Land of Israel, with the plenty they had there, will fall into Sheol, i.e., they will die.]



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:15:1)


**וַיִּשַּׁח.** ״וְיֶחֱלַשׁ תְּקוֹף גַּבְרִין״. וּלְפִי מִדְרָשׁוֹ (סוטה מח א) זֶה הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, שֶׁהֵם גָּרְמוּ לוֹ לְהֵרָאוֹת כְּאִישׁ נִדְהָם (ירמיהו יד:ט), וְכֵן הוּא אוֹמֵר ״צוּר יְלָדְךָ תֶּשִׁי״ (דברים לב:יח), וְאוֹמֵר ״בַּעֲצַלְתַּיִם יִמַּךְ הַמְּקָרֶה״ (קהלת י:יח):


**And man shall be humbled...** and the strong of men shall be weakened. [after Jonathan]. According to the Midrashic interpretation (Sotah 48a), this is the Holy One, blessed be He. They caused Him to appear as a man who is stunned. [The expression originates in Jeremiah 14:9]. And so Scripture states (Deut. 32:18): “The Rock that begot you, you have weakened (תֶּשִׁי),” [interpreting the word as originating from תָּשׁ, weak,] and Scripture states [further] (Ecclesiastes 10:18): “Through slothfulness, the One Who frames His upper chambers will become impoverished.”



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:16:1)


**וַיִּגְבַּה ה׳ צְבָאוֹת בַּמִּשְׁפָּט.** כְּשֶׁיַּעֲשֶׂה מִשְׁפָּטִים בָּהֶם, יִגְבַּהּ שְׁמוֹ בָּעוֹלָם. **בַּמִּשְׁפָּט.** יושטיצ״א בלע״ז:


**And the Lord of Hosts shall be exalted through judgment** When He executes judgment upon them, His Name shall be exalted in the world. **through judgment** Jostise [justice] in O.F.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:16:2)


**וְהָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ.** יִתְקַדֵּשׁ בְּתוֹךְ הַצַּדִּיקִים הַנִּשְׁאָרִים בָּכֶם:


**and the holy God** shall be hallowed among the righteous remaining of you.



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:17:1)


**וְרָעוּ כְבָשִׂים כְּדָבְרָם.** צַדִּיקִים, הַנִּמְשָׁלִים כְּעֵדֶר הָרְחֵלִים:


**And lambs shall graze as their wont** The righteous who are compared to a flock of ewes.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:17:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:17:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:17:2)


**כְּדָבְרָם.** כְּמִנְהָגָם, בְּיֹשֶׁר וּבְמִדָּה, מְכַלְכְּלִים דִּבְרֵיהֶם בְּמִשְׁפָּט כַּכְּבָשִׂים הַלָּלוּ. וְרַבּוֹתֵינוּ דָּרְשׁוּ **כְּדָבְרָם** – כַּמְדֻבָּר בָּם, נֶחָמוֹת הַנִּדְבָּרוֹת לָהֶם:


**as their wont** Heb. כדברם. According to their habit, with equity and with a measure, guiding their affairs with justice, like these lambs. [Variant reading: According to their habit, with equity and of their own, for there will no longer be wicked people in the world, who will rob them.] Our Rabbis expounded כְּדָבְרָם to mean: According to all that was spoken regarding them, [i.e.,] the consolations spoken for them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:17:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:17:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:17:3)


**וְחָרְבוֹת מֵחִים.** בָּתֵּי הָרְשָׁעִים, שֶׁהֵם שְׁמֵנִים:


**and...the ruins of the fat ones** the houses of the wicked, who are fat.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:17:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:17:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:17:4)


**גָּרִים יֹאכֵלוּ.** הַצַּדִּיקִים, שֶׁהֵם כְּגֵרִים, יֹאכְלוּם:


**sojourners shall eat** The righteous, who are like sojourners, shall eat them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:17:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:17:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:17:5)


**מֵחִים.** שְׁמֵנִים, כְּמוֹ ״עוֹלוֹת מֵחִים אַעֲלֶה״ (תהלים סו:טו):


**fat** Heb. מֵחִים, meaning “fat,” as (Psalms 66: 15): “Burnt offerings of fatlings will I offer up.”



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:18:1)


**הוֹי מֹשְׁכֵי הֶעָוֺן.** גּוֹרְרִים יֵצֶר הָרַע עֲלֵיהֶם מְעַט מְעַט בַּתְּחִלָּה בְּחַבְלֵי הַשָּׁוְא כְּחוּט שֶׁל קוּרֵי עַכָּבִישׁ, וּמִשֶּׁנִּתְגָּרֶה בָּהֶם מִתְגַּבֵּר וְהוֹלֵךְ עַד שֶׁנַּעֲשֶׂה כַּעֲבוֹת הָעֲגָלָה שֶׁקּוֹשְׁרִין בּוֹ אֶת הַקָּרוֹן לִמְשׁוֹךְ (סוכה נב, א):


**Woe to those who draw the iniquity** They draw the evil inclination upon themselves little by little; at first with ropes of nothingness, like the thread of a spider web. And since it provokes them, it continuously gains strength until it becomes like cart ropes, with which they tie a wagon in order to pull it.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:18:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:18:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:18:2)


**הַשָּׁוְא.** דָּבָר שֶׁאֵין בּוֹ מַמָּשׁ:


**nothingness** Heb. שָׁוְא, a thing that has no tangibility.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:18:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:18:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:18:3)


**חַטָּאָה.** חֵטְא:


**sin** Heb. חַטָּאָה, sin.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:19:1)


**יְמַהֵר יָחִישָׁה מַעֲשֵׂהוּ.** הַפֻּרְעָנוּת שֶׁהוּא אוֹמֵר לְהָבִיא:


**Let Him hurry; let Him hasten His deed** [i.e.,] the retribution He says He will bring.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:19:2)


**לְמַעַן נִרְאֶה.** דָּבָר מִי יָקוּם:


**so that we may see** whose word will stand up.



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:20:1)


**הָאֹמְרִים לָרַע טוֹב.** מְקַלְּסִין לַעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה, וְרַע בְּעֵינֵיהֶם לַעֲבוֹד הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא שֶׁהוּא טוֹב:


**Those who say of the evil that it is good** They praise idolators [var. idolatry], but they consider it evil to worship the Holy One, blessed be He, Who is good.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:20:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:20:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:20:2)


**שָׂמִים חֹשֶׁךְ לְאוֹר.** דָּבָר שֶׁהוּא עָתִיד לְהָבִיא עֲלֵיהֶם חֹשֶׁךְ, אוֹמְרִים שֶׁיָּאִיר לָהֶם:


**who present darkness as light** A thing which is destined to bring darkness upon them, they say, will bring light to them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:20:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:20:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:20:3)


**שָׂמִים מַר לְמָתוֹק.** עָוֹן, שֶׁהוּא עָתִיד לְהָבִיא עֲלֵיהֶם פֻּרְעָנוּת מַר, אוֹמְרִים שֶׁיַּמְתִּיק לָהֶם:


**who present bitter as sweet** Iniquity, [var. idolatry] which is destined to bring upon them bitter retribution, they say, will be sweet for them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:20:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:20:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:20:4)


**וּמָתוֹק לְמָר.** עֲבוֹדַת הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא הַמְּתוּקָה, אוֹמְרִים: מָרָה הִיא:


**and sweet as bitter** The sweet worship of the Holy One, blessed be He, they say, is bitter.



### Verse 22

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:22:1)


**לִמְסֹךְ שֵׁכָר.** לִמְזוֹג שֵׁכָר, תִּקּוּן הַמַּשְׁקֶה קָרוּי מֶסֶךְ:


**to mix strong wine** Heb. לִמְסֹךְ. To mix (לִמְזֹג) strong wine. Preparation [of the beverage] is called מֶסֶךְ.



### Verse 23

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:23:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:23:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:23:1)


**וְצִדְקַת צַדִּיקִים.** שֶׁהֵן רְאוּיִין לִזְכּוֹת בְּבֵית דִּין, **יָסִירוּ מִמֶּנּוּ,** וּמְחַיְּבִין אוֹתוֹ בַּדִּין וְגוֹזְלִין מָמוֹנוֹ:


**and the innocence of the innocent** who are fit to be exonerated in court, they take away from him, and find him guilty in his suit, and rob him of his money.



### Verse 24

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:24:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:24:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:24:1)


**לָכֵן.** וְהָיָה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לָהֶם וְגוֹ׳:


**Therefore** this thing shall be to them...


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:24:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:24:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:24:2)


**כֶּאֱכֹל קַשׁ לְשׁוֹן אֵשׁ.** כֶּאֱכוֹל אֶת הַקַּשׁ לְשׁוֹן אֵשׁ:


**as a flame of fire consumes stubble** [lit.] as consuming the stubble a flame of fire.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:24:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:24:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:24:3)


**וַחֲשַׁשׁ.** תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן: ״עֲמִירָא״, קַשִּׁין שֶׁל שִׁבֳּלִין; וְכַחֲשַׁשׁ אֲשֶׁר הַלֶּהָבָה תַּרְפֶּנּוּ וְתַעֲשֶׂנּוּ אֵפֶר:


**and straw** Jonathan renders: chaff, the straw of ears of grain; and like straw that the flame shrivels and turns to ashes.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:24:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:24:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:24:4)


**כַּמָּק.** כְּדָבָר הַנִּמּוֹק:


**like rot** Like something that melts.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:24:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:24:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:24:5)


**וּפִרְחָם.** גְּדוּלָּתָם, כְּאָבָק הָעוֹלֶה לִפְנֵי רוּחַ וּמִסְתַּלֶּקֶת, כָּךְ תִּסְתַּלֵּק:


**and their blossom** Their greatness; just as the dust that is raised before the wind and goes away, so will it go away.



### Verse 25

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:25:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:25:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:25:1)


**עַל כֵּן.** עַל מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם הַלָּלוּ:


**therefore** [i.e.,] because of these deeds of theirs.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:25:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:25:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:25:2)


**וַיִּרְגְּזוּ הֶהָרִים.** מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה וְשָׂרֵיהֶם:


**and the mountains have quaked** [This is symbolic of] their kings and their princes.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:25:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:25:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:25:3)


**כַּסּוּחָה.** כְּרוֹק וְקִיא הַנִּיסָח מִתּוֹךְ גּוּפוֹ שֶׁל אָדָם, שֶׁהוּא מָאוּס. וּבִלְשׁוֹן חֲכָמִים קָרוּי סְחִי, וְכֵן ״סְחִי וּמָאוֹס״ (איכה ג:מה):


**like spittle** Heb. כַּסּוּחָה, like spittle and vomit, which is expelled (נִיסָח) from a person’s body, which is repugnant. In the language of the Rabbis, it is called סְחִי and so (Lamentations 3:45): “Loathsome and rejected.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:25:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:25:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:25:4)


**בְּקֶרֶב חוּצוֹת.** כֵּן יִהְיוּ מְאוּסִים בֵּין הַבַּבְלִים:


**in the midst of the streets** So they will be loathsome among the nations.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:25:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:25:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:25:5)


**בְּכָל זֹאת.** הַבָּאָה עֲלֵיהֶם:


**with all this** that has come upon them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:25:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:25:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:25:6)


**לֹא שָׁב אַפּוֹ.** לֹא נִתְקְנוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂיהֶם לְהָשִׁיב אַפּוֹ מֵהֶם:


**His anger has not turned back** They have not been rectified with their deeds to cause His anger to turn back.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:25:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:25:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:25:7)


**נְטוּיָה.** לְהָרַע לָהֶם:


**and His hand is still outstretched** to harm them.



### Verse 26

###### Rashi on Isaiah 5:26:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:26:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/5:26:1)


**וְנָשָׂא.** הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא **נֵס לַגּוֹיִם,** יִרְמוֹז לָהֶם רְמָזִים לְהִתְאַסֵּף וְלָבֹא עֲלֵיהֶם. נְשִׂיאַת נֵס הוּא כְּמוֹ כְּלוּנָס אָרוֹךְ, וְנוֹתְנִין בְּרֹאשׁוֹ בֶּגֶד, וְעוֹלִין בְּרֹאשׁ הַר גָּבוֹהַּ וְרוֹאִין אוֹתוֹ מֵרָחוֹק, וְהוּא סִימָן לְקִבּוּץ בְּנֵי אָדָם. וְכֵן ״אֶל עַמִּים אָרִים נִסִּי״ (ישעיהו מט:כב), וְכֵן ״וְשִׂים אֹתוֹ עַל נֵס״ (במדבר כא:ח). כְּלוּנָס – פירק״א בלע״ז, וְעַל שֵׁם שֶׁהוּא לְאוֹת קָרוּי נֵס:


**And He shall raise** i.e., the Holy One, blessed be He. **an ensign to the nations** and signal to them to gather and to come upon them.
