### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:9:1)


**הֲלֹא כְּכַרְכְּמִישׁ.** כַּאֲשֶׁר בְּנֵי כַּרְכְּמִישׁ שָׂרִים וְשַׁלְטוֹנִים כֵּן בְּנֵי כַּלְנוֹ, עַל כֵּן **אִם לֹא כְּאַרְפַּד** אֲשֶׁר הוּא מִשָּׁלְטָנוּת **חֲמָת** שֶׁלָּקַחְתִּי מִיַּד אֲרָם, וְאִם **לֹא כְדַמֶּשֶׂק** שֶׁלָּקַחְתִּי מִיַּד אֲרָם, כֵּן עָשִׂיתִי לְשׁוֹמְרוֹן. **אִם לֹא כְאַרְפַּד חֲמָת** דָּבוּק הוּא, כְּאַרְפָּד שֶׁל חֲמָת, לְכָךְ נָקוּד פַּתָּח:


**Is not Calno like Carchemish** Just as the inhabitants of Carchemish are princes and governors, so are the inhabitants of Calno. Therefore, if not like Arpad, which is under the rule of Hamath, which I took from Aram, and if not like Damascus, that I took from Aram, so will I do to Samaria. “If not like Arpad of Hamath,” is the construct state, like Arpad of Hamath. Therefore, it is voweled with a ‘pattach’ [i.e., it reads אַרְפַּד rather than אַרְפָּד].



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:10:1)


**וּפְסִילֵיהֶם** הָיוּ **מִירוּשָׁלִַם וּמִשֹּׁמְרוֹן,** מִכָּאן שֶׁרִשְׁעֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָיוּ מַסְפִּיקִין דְּמוּת עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה שֶׁלָּהֶם לְכָל הָאֻמּוֹת סְבִיבוֹתָם (ספרי דברים שיח), וְאַחֲרֵי שֶׁעוֹבְדֵי פְּסִילֵי שׁוֹמְרוֹן וִירוּשָׁלִַם נָפְלוּ בְּיָדִי וְלֹא הִצִּילוּם פְּסִילֵיהֶם, כָּךְ שׁוֹמְרוֹן וִירוּשָׁלִַם לֹא תִנָּצֵל:


**and their graven images** were from Jerusalem and from Samaria. From here we deduce that the wicked of Israel supplied all the nations with their images, and “since the worshippers of the graven images of Samaria and Jerusalem fell into my hands, and their graven images did not save them, so will Samaria and Jerusalem not be saved.”



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:11:1)


**כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי לְשֹׁמְרוֹן וגו׳.** זֹאת יֹאמַר לְאַחַר שֶׁיִּכְבּוֹשׁ אֶת שׁוֹמְרוֹן:


**as I did to Samaria** He shall say this after he conquers Samaria.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:12:1)


**וְהָיָה כִּי יְבַצַּע וְגוֹ׳.** אֲבָל לֹא הָיָה כְּמוֹ שֶׁדִּמָּה, אֶלָּא מֵאַחַר שֶׁיִּגְמוֹר הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא **אֶת כָּל מַעֲשֵׂהוּ** וְנִקְמָתוֹ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִקְצֵה עָרֵי יְהוּדָה, וּמֵאוֹתָהּ יִרְאָה יִכָּנְעוּ בְּנֵי צִיּוֹן וִירוּשָׁלַיִם לָשׁוּב אֵלַי, אוֹדִיעַ לְמֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר כִּי לֹא בְּכֹחוֹ גָּבַר:


**And it shall be, when the Lord completes...** But it did not come about as he thought, but, after the Holy One, blessed be He, completes all His work and His vengeance against Israel and against some of the cities of Judea, and because of that fear, the inhabitants of Zion and Jerusalem will be humbled to return to Me, I will let the king of Assyria know that not by his power was he victorious.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:12:2)


**אֶפְקֹד עַל פְּרִי גֹדֶל לְבַב מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר.** עַל אֲשֶׁר הִפְרָה וְהִרְבָּה גֹּדֶל לְבַב מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר לְהִתְהַלֵּל בְּכֹחוֹ עַל שֶׁקֶר. **פְּרִי גֹדֶל** – קריישמנ״ס דגרנדיי״א בלע״ז שֶׁל לֵב סַנְחֵרִיב:


**I will visit retribution upon the increase of the arrogance of the king of Assyria’s heart** For that which he increased the arrogance of the king of Assyria’s heart, to boast of his power falsely. The fruit of the arrogance is craysement de grandeze in O.F., increase of arrogance, of Sennacherib’s heart.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:12:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:12:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:12:3)


**תִּפְאֶרֶת רוּם עֵינָיו.** עַל שֶׁנִּתְפָּאֵר בְּגַאֲוָתוֹ. **תִּפְאֶרֶת** – ונטמנ״ט בלע״ז:


**the boasting of the haughtiness of his eyes** Since he boasted with his haughtiness. Boasting is vantance in O.F.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:12:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:12:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:12:4)


**רוּם עֵינָיו.** גַּסּוּת רוּחוֹ, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״גְּבַהּ עֵינַיִם וּרְחַב לֵבָב״ (תהלים קא:ה):


**haughtiness of his eyes** Arrogance, as the matter is stated: (Psalms 101:5) “One who has proud eyes and a haughty heart.”



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:13:1)


**כִּי אָמַר בְּכֹחַ יָדִי עָשִׂיתִי.** כָּל גְּבוּרָתִי לֹא מֵאֵת הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא:


**For he said, With the strength of my hand I accomplished this** None of my might is from the Holy One, blessed be He.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:13:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:13:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:13:2)


**נְבֻנוֹתִי.** חָכַמְתִּי:


**I am clever** [More exactly,] I have become clever.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:13:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:13:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:13:3)


**וַעֲתוּדוֹתֵיהֶם.** מַעֲמָדָם וּמַצָּבָם:


**and their positions** Heb. וַעֲתוּדֹתֵיהֶם, their stand and their position.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:13:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:13:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:13:4)


**וְאוֹרִיד.** הוֹרַדְתִּים מִגְּדֻלָּתָם:


**and I lowered** I lowered them from their greatness.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:13:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:13:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:13:5)


**כַּאבִּיר יוֹשְׁבִים.** יוֹשְׁבִים רַבִּים, **כַּבִּיר** – פולשור״ש:


**many inhabitants** Heb. כַּאבִּיר יוֹשְׁבִים, plousors in O.F., several.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:14:1)


**כַּקֵּן.** כְּקִינֵי עוֹפוֹת הֶפְקֵר:


**like a nest** like nests of ownerless birds.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:14:2)


**וְכֶאֱסֹף בֵּיצִים עֲזֻבוֹת.** וְכַאֲשֶׁר יֶאֱסֹף אִישׁ **בֵּיצִים עֲזֻבוֹת** שֶׁעֲזָבַתָּם אִמָּם, וְאֵין מוֹחֶה בְּיָדָם לְכַסּוֹת עֲלֵיהֶם:


**and as one gathers abandoned eggs** And as one gathers abandoned eggs which their mother abandoned, and no one protests against him by covering them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:14:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:14:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:14:3)


**נוֹדֵד כָּנָף וּפֹצֶה פֶה וּמְצַפְצֵף** כָּל הַלָּשׁוֹן הַזֶּה נוֹפֵל בְּעוֹפוֹת; לְפִי שֶׁדִּמָּה אוֹתָם הַגּוֹלִים לְקֵן צִפֳּרִים וּלְבֵיצִים עֲזוּבוֹת, אָמַר לָשׁוֹן זֶה: לֹא צִפְצְפוּ עֲלֵיהֶם הָאָב וְהָאֵם:


**and no one moved a wing, or opened his mouth or chirped** This entire expression is apropos to birds; since he compared those exiles to a bird’s nest and to abandoned eggs, he used this expression, saying that neither the father nor the mother chirped about them.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:15:1)


**הֲיִתְפָּאֵר הַגַּרְזֶן.** הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אוֹמֵר: לֹא הָיָה לְךָ לְהִתְהַלֵּל בְּזֹאת, כִּי אֵינְךָ אֶלָּא כְּגַרְזֶן שֶׁלִּי, וַאֲנִי הַחוֹצֵב בְּךָ נִפְרָע עַל יָדְךָ מֵאוֹיְבַי. אַתָּה **הַמַּשּׂוֹר** וַאֲנִי **הַמְּנִיפוֹ,** וְכִי דֶּרֶךְ הַמַּשּׂוֹר לְהִתְהַלֵּל עַל מְנִיפוֹ? **מַשּׂוֹר** מייר״א בלע״ז:


**Shall the axe boast** The Holy One, blessed be He, says: You should not have boasted about this, since you are merely like My axe, and I am hewing with you; I visit retribution upon My enemies. You are the saw, and I am He Who wields it. Now is it customary for the saw to boast over the one who wields it? מַשּׂוֹר is dolodojjre in O.F., a small axe.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:15:2)


**כְּהָנִיף שֵׁבֶט וְאֶת מְרִימָיו.** כְּאִלּוּ הָיָה הַשֵּׁבֶט מֵנִיף אֶת עַצְמוֹ וְאֶת יַד הַמְּרִימוֹ, וַהֲלֹא אֵין שֵׁבֶט מְנִיפוֹ אֶלָּא הָאָדָם?


**It is as though the rod wields those who raise it** It is as though the rod was raising [itself and] the hand of him who was raising it. Is it not so that the rod does not wield itself but the man?


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:15:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:15:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:15:3)


**כְּהָרִים מַטֶּה לֹא עֵץ.** לֹא הָעֵץ הוּא הַמֵּרִים, אֶלָּא הָאָדָם הוּא הַמֵּרִים:


**When the staff is raised, it is not the wood** It is not the wood that raises it, but it is the man who raises it.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:16:1)


**וְתַחַת כְּבֹדוֹ.** תַּחַת בִּגְדֵיהֶם יִהְיוּ נִשְׂרָפִין, הַבְּגָדִים הֵם מְכַבְּדִים אֶת הָאָדָם:


**and in the place of his honor** Under their clothing they shall be burnt. The garments [are referred to as “his honor” since] they command respect for the man.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:16:2)


**יֵקַד יְקֹד.** יִשָּׂרֵף שְׂרֵפָה כִּשְׂרֵפַת אֵשׁ. וּמִדְרַשׁ אַגָּדָה (תנחומא צו ב): כָּאן פָּרַע לִבְנֵי שֵׁם הַכָּבוֹד שֶׁעָשָׂה שֵׁם לְאָבִיו, כְּשֶׁכִּסָּה עֶרְוַת נֹחַ אָבִיו, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (בראשית ט:כג): ״וַיִּקַּח שֵׁם וָיֶפֶת וְגוֹ׳״:


**a burning shall burn** A burning shall burn like the burning of fire. The Midrash Aggadah [states]: Here He repaid the children of Shem for the respect Shem showed for his father, when he covered the nakedness of Noah his father, as it is said (Gen. 9:23): “And Shem and Japeth took the garment...”



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:17:1)


**אוֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל.** הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁעוֹסֵק בָּהּ חִזְקִיָּהוּ תִּהְיֶה **לְאֵשׁ** לְסַנְחֵרִיב:


**the light of Israel** The Torah in which Hezekiah engages shall become fire for Sennacherib.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:17:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:17:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:17:2)


**וּקְדוֹשׁוֹ.** הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא. דָּבָר אַחֵר: **וּקְדוֹשׁוֹ** – צַדִּיקִים שֶׁבַּדּוֹר:


**and his holy one** The Holy One, blessed be He. Alternatively, “And his holy one,” refers to the righteous of the generation.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:17:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:17:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:17:3)


**שִׁיתוֹ וּשְׁמִירוֹ.** שָׂרָיו וְגִבּוֹרָיו:


**his thorns and his worms** [They symbolize] his nobles and his heroes.



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:18:1)


**וּכְבוֹד יַעְרוֹ וְכַרְמִלּוֹ.** הֵם רִבּוּי חֲיָלוֹתָיו:


**And the glory of his forest and his stately forest** They are his numerous armies.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:18:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:18:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:18:2)


**כַּרְמֶל.** יַעַר גָּבוֹהַּ:


כַּרְמֶל is a tall forest.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:18:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:18:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:18:3)


**כִּמְסוֹס נוֹסֵס.** לְפִי שֶׁדִּמָה אוֹתָם לַעֲצֵי יַעַר, דִּמָה פֻּרְעָנוּתָם לְתוֹלַעַת הַנּוֹסֵר בְּפִיו וְטוֹחֵן הָעֵץ, וְקוֹרְהוּ ׳סָס׳, כְּמוֹ ״כַצֶּמֶר יֹאכְלֵם סָס״ (ישעיהו נא:ח):


**as a tree eaten to powder by the worms** Since he compared them to forest trees, he compared their retribution to the worm that saws with his mouth and grinds the tree. He called him סָס, as (infra 51:8): “Like wool, the worm (סָס) shall devour them.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:18:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:18:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:18:4)


**כִּמְסוֹס נוֹסֵס.** כְּמָגוֹר הַמְּגוֹרֵר:


**as a tree eaten to powder by the worms** As the grinder grinds.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:18:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:18:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:18:5)


**כִּמְסוֹס נוֹסֵס.** כִּמְסוֹס שֶׁל נוֹסֵס שֶׁהוּא נִטְחָן דַּק דַּק, שֶׁהַתּוֹלַעַת טוֹחֵן. כָּךְ הָיָה הָאֵפֶר וּשְׂרֵיפַת גּוּפָן דַּק. מְסוֹס הוּא הַנִּטְחָן וְנוֹפֵל עַל יְדֵי תּוֹלַעַת, נוֹסֵס הוּא הַתּוֹלַעַת:


**as a tree eaten to powder by the worms** Heb. כִּמְסֹס נֹסֵס, [lit.] as that which is sawed by the sawyer, which is pulverized very finely, which the worm grinds. So fine were the ashes of their burnt bodies. מְסֹס is that which is ground and falls off because of the worm. נֹסֵס is the worm.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:19:1)


**וּשְׁאָר עֵץ יַעְרוֹ.** הַנּוֹתָרִים בַּחֲיָלוֹתָיו:


**And the remaining trees of his forest** The survivors of his armies.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:19:2)


**מִסְפָּר יִהְיוּ.** נוֹחִים לִסְפּוֹר, כִּי מְעַט הֵם, וְנַעַר יוּכַל לְכָתְבָם. וְאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ (איכה רבה ד, טו): עֲשָׂרָה נִשְׁאַר מֵהֶם, שֶׁאֵין לְךָ קָטָן שֶׁאֵינוֹ כּוֹתֵב יוּ״ד קְטַנָּה:


**shall be few** [lit. a number, i. e.,] easy to count, for they will be few, and a lad will be able to write them, and our Rabbis said that ten remained of them, for there is no small child who cannot write a small ‘yud.’



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:20:1)


**לְהִשָּׁעֵן עַל מַכֵּהוּ.** לִסְמוֹךְ עַל מַלְכֵי מִצְרַיִם, שֶׁהֵם הָיוּ תְּחִלַּת הַמְּצִיקִים לָהֶם:


**to lean on him that smote them** [i.e.,] to lean on the kings of Egypt, who were the first to oppress them.



### Verse 21

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:21:1)


**שְׁאָר יָשׁוּב.** הַשְּׁאֵרִית שֶׁבָּהֶן יָשׁוּבוּ אֶל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא:


**A remnant shall return** The remnant of them shall return to the Holy One, blessed be He.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:21:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:21:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:21:2)


**אֵל גִּבּוֹר.** שֶׁהֶרְאָה לָהֶם גְּבוּרָה בְּסַנְחֵרִיב:


**the mighty God** Who demonstrated His might against Sennacherib.



### Verse 22

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:22:1)


**כִּי אִם יִהְיֶה עַמְּךָ.** לְחִזְקִיָּהוּ אָמַר הַנָּבִיא: **אִם יִהְיֶה עַמְּךָ כְּחוֹל הַיָּם**, הַשְּׁאָר שֶׁיָּשׁוּב בּוֹ לְמוּטָב תִּשְׁטֹף אֶת כִּלָּיוֹן הֶחָרוּץ לָבֹא עֲלֵיהֶם, וִיעַכְּבֶנּוּ מִלָּבֹא בִּצְדָקָה שֶׁיִּתְנַהֵג בָּהּ:


**For if your people** The prophet says to Hezekiah, If your people are like the sand of the sea, the remnant of them that return to do good, will wash away the destruction sentenced to come upon them, and prevent it from coming, through the righteousness with which they will behave.



### Verse 23

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:23:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:23:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:23:1)


**כִּי כָלָה וְנֶחֱרָצָה.** תִּרְאוּ שֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא עוֹשֶׂה (דִּין) בָּרְשָׁעִים, וְתִכָּנְעוּ וְתָשׁוּבוּ אֵלָיו:


**For destruction and annihilation** you shall see that the Holy One, blessed be He, executes upon the wicked, and you shall humble yourselves and return to Him.



### Verse 24

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:24:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:24:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:24:1)


**לָכֵן.** לְפִי שֶׁיָּדַעְתִּי שֶׁתָּשׁוּבוּ אֵלָיו חִזְקִיָּה וְסִיעָתוֹ. (דבר אחר: **לָכֵן** – לְשׁוֹן שְׁבוּעָה, לָכֵן בֶּאֱמֶת.)


**Therefore** Since I know that Hezekiah and his company will return to Him. [Aternatively, לָכֵן is an expression of an oath. לָכֵן indeed.]


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:24:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:24:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:24:2)


**כֹּה אָמַר ה׳ אַל תִּירָא מֵאַשּׁוּר בַּשֵּׁבֶט יַכֶּכָּה.** בַּשֵּׁבֶט פִּיו יְחָרֵף וִיגַדֵּף אֶתְכֶם עַל יְדֵי רַבְשָׁקֵה:


**so said the Lord... Fear not,...Assyria; with a rod may he smite you** With the “rod” of his mouth will he insult and deride you through Rabshakeh.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:24:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:24:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:24:3)


**וּמַטֵּהוּ יִשָּׂא עָלֶיךָ.** לְאַיֵּים כְּדֶרֶךְ שֶׁעָשָׂה לְמִצְרַיִם. וְעוֹד יֵשׁ לְפָרֵשׁ **בַּשֵּׁבֶט יַכֶּכָּה** – אֲשֶׁר עַד הֵנָּה הִכָּךְ בַּשֵּׁבֶט, וְהֻרְגַּל לָשֵׂאת עָלֶיךָ מַטֵּהוּ וְאֵימָתוֹ כְּדֶרֶךְ הַמִּצְרִיִּים. מִשּׁוּם רַבִּי מְנַחֵם אָמַר לִי רַבִּי יוֹסֵף:


**and his staff may he bear over you** to frighten you, the way he did to Egypt. It may alternatively be explained: With a rod does he smite you[i.e.,] who has smitten you until now with a rod and has become accustomed to bearing his staff and his fright over you as the Egyptians did. Rabbi Joseph told me this in the name of Rabbi Menahem.



### Verse 25

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:25:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:25:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:25:1)


**כִּי עוֹד** יָמִים **מְעַט מִזְעָר וְכָלָה**, הַזַּעַם שֶׁלִּי שֶׁנִּתַּן לְמַטֶּה בְּיַד אַשּׁוּר, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמוּר לְמַעְלָה: ״וּמַטֶּה הוּא בְיָדָם זַעְמִי״ (ישעיהו י:ה):


**For [in] yet** very few days...**the fury shall be over** My fury, which was given as a staff into the hand of Assyria, as he said above, “And My fury is a staff in his hands” (v. 5).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:25:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:25:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:25:2)


**וְאַפִּי.** שֶׁהָיָה לְשֵׁבֶט, יָשׁוּב. **עַל תַּבְלִיתָם.** לְשׁוֹן ״תֶּבֶל עָשׂוּ״ (ויקרא כ:יב), עַל חֵרוּפִין וְגִדּוּפִין ״אֲשֶׁר גִּדְּפוּ נַעֲרֵי מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר אוֹתִי״ (ישעיהו לז:ו):


**and My wrath** that became a rod, shall return **because of their blasphemy** Heb. (עַל-תַּבְלִיתָם). Comp. (Lev. 20:12) “they have committed a disgrace (תֶּבֶל),” i.e., because of the insults and blasphemies which the servants of the king of Assyria blasphemed Me.



### Verse 26

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:26:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:26:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:26:1)


**וְעוֹרֵר עָלָיו.** וּלְעוֹרֵר עָלָיו:


**And...shall stir up against him** And to stir up.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:26:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:26:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:26:2)


**שׁוֹט.** מַכַּת יִסּוּרִין:


**a scourge** A tortuous blow.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:26:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:26:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:26:3)


**כְּמַכַּת מִדְיָן.** שֶׁנֶּהֶרְגוּ בְּלַיְלָה אֶחָת, וְהַמְּלָכִים שֶׁבָּרְחוּ מֵהֶם וְנִמְלְטוּ, נֶהֱרַג עוֹרֵב בְּצוּר עוֹרֵב, כִּדְמְפוֹרָשׁ בְּסֵפֶר שׁוֹפְטִים (שופטים ז:כה), אַף זֶה, לְאַחַר שֶׁיָּשׁוּב לְאַרְצוֹ, יָמוּת שָׁם בַּחֶרֶב:


**like the smiting of Midian** who were slain in one night, and as for the kings who fled from them and escaped, Oreb was slain at the Rock of Oreb, and is related in the Book of Judges (7:25). This one, too, after he returns to his land, will die there by the sword.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:26:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:26:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:26:4)


**וּמַטֵּהוּ עַל הַיָּם.** וְעוֹד יְעוֹרֵר עָלָיו אֶת מַטֵּהוּ, אֲשֶׁר הָיָה **עַל הַיָּם** בְּפַרְעֹה וּבְחֵילוֹ:


**and his staff on the sea** And furthermore, He shall stir up against him, His staff, which was on the sea against Pharaoh and his army.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:26:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:26:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:26:5)


**וּנְשָׂאוֹ.** וְטִלְטְלוֹ מִן הָעוֹלָם, כְּדֶרֶךְ שֶׁנָּשָׂא אֶת **מִצְרָיִם**:


**and He shall carry him off** And He shall carry him away from the world after the manner that He carried off Egypt.



### Verse 27

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:27:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:27:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:27:1)


**וְחֻבַּל עֹל.** סַנְחֵרִיב **מִפְּנֵי** חִזְקִיָּהוּ, שֶׁהָיָה נוֹחַ לְדוֹרוֹ כַּשֶּׁמֶן. וְרַבּוֹתֵינוּ פֵּרְשׁוּ (סנהדרין צד ב): מִפְּנֵי שַׁמְנוֹ שֶׁל חִזְקִיָּהוּ, שֶׁהָיָה דּוֹלֵק בְּבָתֵּי כְּנֵסִיּוֹת וּבְבָתֵּי מִדְרָשׁוֹת, שֶׁהִשִּׂיאָם לַעֲסוֹק בַּתּוֹרָה, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״אֲשֶׁר הֶעְתִּיקוּ אַנְשֵׁי חִזְקִיָּהוּ וְגוֹ׳״ (משלי כה:א):


**and the yoke shall be destroyed** The yoke of Sennacherib shall be destroyed because of Hezekiah, who was mild to his generation, as oil. Our Rabbis, however, explained [that Sennacherib’s yoke would be destroyed] because of Hezekiah’s oil which burnt in the synagogues and in the study-halls, for he persuaded them to engage in Torah, after the matter that is written (Proverbs 25: 1): “Which the men of Hezekiah strengthened.”



### Verse 28

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:28:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:28:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:28:1)


**בָּא עַל עַיַּת.** מוֹנֶה וְהוֹלֵךְ מַסָּעוֹת שֶׁנָּסַע סַנְחֵרִיב, וּבָא עַל עָרֵי יְהוּדָה לָבֹא יְרוּשָׁלַיִם בְּיוֹם מַפַּלְתּוֹ: עַיַּת, מִגְרוֹן, וּמִכְמָשׂ, רָמָה, גִּבְעַת שָׁאוּל, בַּת גַּלִּים, לַיְשָׁה, עֲנָתוֹת, מַדְמֵנָה, גֵּבִים – כֻּלָּן מְקוֹמוֹת הֵן:


**He came upon Aiath** He goes on to enumerate the travels which Sennacherib traveled when he came upon the cities of Judah, to come to Jerusalem, on the day of his downfall: Aiath, Migron, Michmas, Ramah, Gib’ath Saul, Bath-galim, Laishah, Anathoth, Madmenah, and Gebim. They are all places.

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:31:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:31:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:31:1)


**הֵעִיזוּ.** נֶאֶסְפוּ לִבְרוֹחַ, וְרַבּוֹתֵינוּ דָּרְשׁוּ **צַהֲלִי קוֹלֵךְ** וְכָל הַמִּקְרָא בְּמִדְרָשׁ אַחֵר בְּאַגָּדַת חֵלֶק (סנהדרין צב ב), וְהֶעֱמִידוּ הַמַּסָּעוֹת עַל עֶשֶׂר; אֲבָל יוֹנָתָן תִּרְגֵּם אֶת כֻּלָּן שְׁמוֹת מְקוֹמוֹת:

### Verse 32

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:32:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:32:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:32:1)


**עוֹד הַיּוֹם בְּנֹב לַעֲמֹד** כָּל הַדֶּרֶךְ הַזֶּה נִתְלַבֵּט כְּדֵי לַעֲמוֹד בְּעוֹד הַיּוֹם בְּנוֹב, לְפִי שֶׁאָמְרוּ לוֹ אִיצְטַגְנִינָיו: ״אִם תִּלָּחֵם בָּהּ הַיּוֹם תִּכְבְּשֶׁנָּה״. וּכְשֶׁעָמַד בְּנוֹב וְרָאָה אֶת יְרוּשָׁלַיִם קְטַנָּה, לֹא חָשׁ לְדִבְרֵי אִיצְטַגְנִינָיו, וְהִתְחִיל לְהָנִיף יָדוֹ בְּגַאֲוָה: ״וְכִי עַל עִיר כָּזוֹ הִרְגַּזְתִּי כָּל הַחֲיָילוֹת הַלָּלוּ? לִינוּ פֹּה הַלַּיְלָה, וּלְמָחָר יַשְׁלִיךְ בָּהּ אִישׁ אַבְנוֹ״:


**Still today, [he intends] to stand in Nob** All this way he hastened, in order to stand in Nob while it is still day, since his stargazers told him, If you attack it today, you will conquer it. And, when he stood in Nob and saw that Jerusalem was small, he did not heed the words of his stargazers and began to wave his hand arrogantly: For a city like this have I mustered all these armies? Stay here overnight, and tomorrow, each one will cast his stone upon it.

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:33:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:33:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:33:3)


**בְּמַעֲרָצָה.** בְּמַשּׂוֹר הַמְקַצֵּץ עֲנָפִים. אֵין **פֻּארָה** זוֹ לְשׁוֹן ׳גַּת׳, שֶׁהֲרֵי לֹא נִכְתַּב בְּוָי״ו, כְּמוֹ ״פּוּרָה דָּרַכְתִּי״ (ישעיהו סג:ג), וּכְמוֹ ״לַחְשֹׂף חֲמִשִּׁים פּוּרָה״ (חגי ב:טז), אֶלָּא בְּאָלֶ״ף, כְּמוֹ ״וַתֶּאֱרַכְנָה פֹּארֹתָיו״ (יחזקאל לא:ה). וּ**מְסָעֵף** הוּא לְשׁוֹן ׳מְקַצֵּץ עֲנָפִים׳, אישברנקיי״ר בלע״ז, כְּמוֹ ״וְכִלָּה סְעִיפֶיהָ״ (ישעיהו כז:י), וְכֵן ״בִּסְעִיפֶיהָ פֹּרִיָּה״ (ישעיהו יז:ו):


**with a saw** Heb. בְּמַעֲרָצָה, with a saw that cuts the boughs. This [word פֻּארָה] is not an expression denoting a winepress, for it is not spelled with a ‘vav,’ like (infra 63: 3) “A winepress (פּוּרָה) I trod,” and like (Haggai 2:16) “To draw off fifty measures from the winepress (פּוּרָה),” but with an ‘aleph,’ like (Ezekiel 31:5) “And its boughs became long (פֹּארֹתָיו).” מְסָעֵף is an expression of cutting off branches [esbranchier in O.F.], like (infra 27:10) “And he will destroy its branches (סְעִיפֶיהָ), and (infra 17:6) “On its branches (בִּסְעִיפֶיהָ) the fruitful one.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:33:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:33:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:33:4)


**בְּמַעֲרָצָה.** בִּכְלִי מַשְׁחִית הָעוֹרֵץ וְשׁוֹבֵר אוֹתָם:


**with a saw** Heb. בְּמַעֲרָצָה, with an implement of destruction, which breaks them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:33:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:33:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:33:5)


**וְרָמֵי הַקּוֹמָה.** הַמְּלָכִים וְהַשָּׂרִים:


**and those of lofty height** [This alludes to] the heroes.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:33:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:33:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:33:6)


**גְּדוּעִים.** אֵין לְשׁוֹן ׳גִּדּוּעַ׳ נוֹפֵל אֶלָּא בְּאִילָנוֹת וְדָבָר קָשֶׁה:


**are hewn down** The expression of hewing is apropos only to trees and hard things.



### Verse 34

###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:34:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:34:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:34:1)


**וְנִקַּף.** אַף זֶה לְשׁוֹן ׳קְצִיצָה׳, כְּמוֹ ״כְּנֹקֵף זַיִת״ (ישעיהו יז:ו), **וְנִקַּף** לְשׁוֹן ׳נִפְעַל׳:


**And...shall be cut off** Heb. וְנִקַּף. This, too, is an expression of cutting, as (ibid.) “Like one who cuts off olives (כְּנֹקֶף).” וְנִקַּף is in the passive voice.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:34:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:34:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:34:2)


**סִבְכֵי הַיַּעַר.** הַעֲנָפִים הַחֲשׁוּבִים וְהַגִּבּוֹרִים:


**the thickets of the forests** The prominent branches, symbolizing the heroes.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:34:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:34:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:34:3)


**וְהַלְּבָנוֹן.** עֳבִי יַעְרוֹ וְכַרְמִילוֹ, הֵן מַרְבִּית חֲיָלוֹתָיו:


**and the Lebanon** The thickness of his forest and his stately forest. They are the multitudes of his armies.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 10:34:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:34:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/10:34:4)


**בְּאַדִּיר יִפּוֹל.** עַל יְדֵי מַלְאָךְ יִפּוֹלוּ. דָּבָר אַחֵר: **בְּאַדִּיר** – בִּזְכוּת חִזְקִיָּהוּ שֶׁהוּא אַדִּירָם וּמוֹשְׁלָם שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל, כְּמָה שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״וְהָיָה אַדִּירוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ״ (ירמיהו ל:כא):


**shall fall through a mighty one** Through an angel they shall fall. Alternatively, through a mighty one, in the merit of Hezekiah who is the mighty one and the rulers of Israel, as it is said (Jer. 30:21): “And their leader shall be of themselves.”



## Chapter 11


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 11:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:1:1)


**וְיָצָא חֹטֶר מִגֵּזַע יִשָׁי.** וְאִם תֹּאמְרוּ: ״הֲרֵי תַּנְחוּמִין לְחִזְקִיָּהוּ וְעַמּוֹ שֶׁלֹּא יִפְּלוּ בְּיָדוֹ, וּמַה תְּהֵא עַל הַגּוֹלָה אֲשֶׁר הָגְלָה בַּחֲלַח וְחָבוֹר, שֶׁמָּא אָבַד סִבְרָם?״ – לֹא אָבַד! סוֹף שֶׁיָּבֹא מֶלֶךְ מְשִׁיחֵנוּ וְיִגְאָלֵם:


**And a shoot shall spring forth from the stem of Jesse** And if you say, ‘Here are consolations for Hezekiah and his people, that they shall not fall into his hands. Now what will be with the exile that was exiled to Halah and Habor, is their hope lost?’ It is not lost! Eventually, the King Messiah shall come and redeem them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 11:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:1:2)


**חֹטֶר.** שֵׁבֶט מְלוּכָה:


**a shoot** [This is symbolic of] the royal scepter.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 11:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:1:3)


**וְנֵצֶר.** לְשׁוֹן יוֹנֵק אִילָן:


**and a twig** an expression of a sapling.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 11:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:1:4)


**וְנֵצֶר מִשָּׁרָשָׁיו יִפְרֶה.** וּבְכָל הָעִנְיָן, וּבְסוֹפוֹ ״וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יוֹסִיף ה׳ שֵׁנִית יָדוֹ״ (ישעיהו יא:יא) – הֲרֵי שֶׁנֶּאֶמְרָה נְבוּאָה זוֹ לְנֶחָמַת הַגּוֹלִים מֵאַשּׁוּר. (אָמַר הַמַּעְתִּיק: בִּימֵי חָרְפִּי הִקְשֵׁיתִי לִשְׁאוֹל לְכַמָּה גְּאוֹנִים עַל מַה שֶׁכָּתַב אֲדוֹנִי מוֹרִי זְקֵנִי הָרַמָּ״א בְּהַגָּהָה בְּהִלְכוֹת רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה שֶׁאֱגוֹז בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא חֵ״ט וַהֲלֹא הוּא גַּם גִּימַטְרִיָּא טוֹ״ב, וְתֵרַצְתִּי עַל פִּי הַזֹּהַר מַה שֶׁהִקְשָׁה רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר אֶת אָבִיו רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן בַּר יוֹחַאי):


**and a twig shall sprout from its roots** and the entire section, and at the end (v. 11), “And it shall come to pass, that on that day, the Lord shall apply His hand again...[from Assyria]...Hence, [it is obvious] that this prophecy was said to console those exiled to Assyria.

**And he shall be animated by the fear of the Lord** He shall be filled with the fear of the Lord. [ed enos mera il luy in O.F., and He shall be enlivened.]

**וְלֹא לְמַרְאֵה עֵינָיו יִשְׁפּוֹט.** כִּי בְּחָכְמַת הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא בְּקִרְבּוֹ יֵדַע וְיָבִין מִי זַכַּאי וּמִי חַיָּב:


**and neither with the sight of his eyes shall he judge** For, with the wisdom of the Holy One, blessed be He, which is within him, will he know and understand who is innocent and who is guilty.

### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 11:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:8:1)


**וְשִׁעֲשַׁע.** וְשִׂחַק:


**shall play** Heb. וְשִׁעֲשַׁע, shall play.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 11:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:8:2)


**עַל חוּר פָּתֶן.** עַל חוֹר עָפָר שֶׁהַנָּחָשׁ מְקַנֵּן בְּתוֹכוֹ, קרו״ט בלע״ז. **פֶּתֶן** – נָחָשׁ מִשֶּׁהִזְקִין נַעֲשָׂה חֵרֵשׁ, וְנִקְרָא פֶּתֶן, שׁוּב אֵין לוֹ לַחַשׁ, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (תהלים נח:ו) ״אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִשְׁמַע לְקוֹל מְלַחֲשִׁים״:


**over the hole of an old snake** over a hole in the ground in which the snake makes its nest [krot in O.F.], a cave. an old snake פֶּתֶן. A snake, when it ages, becomes deaf and is called פֶּתֶן. From then on, it cannot be charmed; as it is said (Psalms 58:6): “Who will not hearken to the voice of charmers.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 11:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:8:3)


**וְעַל מְאוּרַת צִפְעוֹנִי.** יוֹנָתָן תִּרְגֵּם: ״חִיזוּ גַּלְגְּלֵי עֵינֵי חִיוֵי חוּרְמָן״, וּמְנַחֵם (מחברת מנחם: חר) פָּתַר בּוֹ לְשׁוֹן נֶקֶב וְחוֹרֵי עָפָר, וְכֵן ״אוּר כַּשְׂדִּים״ (בראשית יא:כח), וְכֵן ״בָּאוּרִים כַּבְּדוּ אֶת ה׳״ (ישעיהו כד:טו):


**and over the eyeball of a venomous snake** Jonathan renders: the eyeballs of venomous snakes [מְאוּרַת from אוֹר, light]. Menahem (Machbereth Menachem p. 32) interpreted it as an expression of a hole, namely holes in the ground. Comp. (Gen. 11:28) “The valley of the Chaldees (אוּר)”; (infra 24:15) “In the valleys (בָּאוּרִים) honor the Lord.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 11:8:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:8:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:8:4)


**גָּמוּל.** תִּינוֹק הַגָּמוּל מִשְּׁדֵי אִמּוֹ:


**a weaned child** a child weaned from his mother’s breasts.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 11:8:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:8:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:8:5)


**יָדוֹ הָדָה.** תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן: ״יְדוֹהִי יוֹשִׁיט״, כְּמוֹ ״הֵד הָרִים״ (יחזקאל ז:ז), וּכְמוֹ ״הֵידָד״ (ישעיהו טז:ט), שֶׁהוּא לְשׁוֹן הֲרָמַת קוֹל, אַף זֶה לְשׁוֹן הֲרָמָה, וְהֵ״א אַחֲרוֹנָה בָּאָה בְּתוֹכָהּ יְסוֹד נוֹפֵל, כְּמוֹ: עָשָׂה, בָּנָה, קָנָה:


**shall stretch forth his hand** Heb. הָדָה. Jonathan renders: shall stretch forth his hands (sic). Comp. (Ezekiel 7:7) “The joyful call (הֵד) of the mountains, also (infra 16: 9) “The cry (הֵידָד),” which is an expression of raising the voice. This, too, is an expression of raising, and the final [letter] ‘heh’ appears in it as a radical which sometimes falls out, like עָשָׂה (made), בָּנָה (built), קָנָה (acquired).

### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 11:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:11:1)


**שֵׁנִית.** כְּמוֹ שֶׁקְּנָאָם מִמִּצְרַיִם, שֶׁהָיְתָה גְּאֻלָּתָם בְּרוּרָה מֵאֵין שִׁעְבּוּד; אֲבָל גְּאֻלַּת בַּיִת שֵׁנִי אֵינָהּ מִן הַמִּנְיָן, שֶׁהֲרֵי מְשֻׁעְבָּדִים הָיוּ לְכוֹרֶשׁ:


**a second time** Just as he acquired them from Egypt, when their redemption was absolute, without subjugation, but the redemption preceding the building of the Second Temple is not counted, since they were subjugated to Cyrus.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 11:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:11:2)


**וּמֵאִיֵּי הַיָּם.** הֵן אִיֵּי כִּתִּים, יְוָנִים:


**and from the islands of the sea** the islands of the Kittim, the Romans, the descendants of Esau.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Isaiah 11:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:12:1)


**וְנָשָׂא נֵס.** פירקא בלע״ז, וְהָיָה לְאוֹת לִקְבּוֹץ אֵלָיו וּלְהָבִיא אֶת גָּלֻיּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִנְחָה לוֹ:


**And he shall raise a banner** Perka, perche in O.F. [i.e., the verse is literally referring to the pole upon which the banner is attached.] And it shall be for a sign to gather to him and to bring the exiles of Israel to Him as a present.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Isaiah 11:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:13:1)


**אֶפְרַיִם לֹא יְקַנֵּא אֶת יְהוּדָה.** מָשִׁיחַ בֶּן יוֹסֵף וּמָשִׁיחַ בֶּן דָּוִד לֹא יְקַנְּאוּ זֶה בָּזֶה (שיר השירים זוטא ד:יא):


**Ephraim shall not envy Judah** The Messiah, the son of David, and the Messiah, the son of Joseph, shall not envy each other.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Isaiah 11:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:14:1)


**וְעָפוּ בְכָתֵף פְּלִשְׁתִּים יָמָּה.** יָעוּפוּ וְיָרוּצוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁכֶם אֶחָד עַל הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים, אֲשֶׁר הֵם בְּמַעֲרָבָהּ שֶׁל אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְיִכְבֹּשׁ אֶת אַרְצָם. כְּמוֹ ״דֶּרֶךְ יְרַצְּחוּ שֶׁכְמָה״ (הושע ו:ט), ״שְׁכֶם אֶחָד״ (צפניה ג:ט). וְכֵן תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן: ״וְיִתְחַבְּרוּן כָּתֵף חַד לְמִימְחֵי פְלִישְׁתָאֵי דִּי בְמַעַרְבָא״:


**And they shall fly of one accord against the Philistines in the west** Heb. בְכָתֵף. Israel will fly and run of one accord against the Philistines who are in the west of Eretz Israel and conquer their land. [כָּתֵף, lit. a shoulder, is used in this case to denote unity. The word שֶׁכֶם, also lit. a shoulder, is used in a similar sense.] Comp. (Hoshea 6:9) “They murder on the way in unison (שֶׁכְמָה)”; (Zeph. 3:9) “One accord (שְׁכֶם אֶחָד).” And so did Jonathan render it: And they shall join in one accord to smite the Philistines who are in the west.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 11:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:14:2)


**וּבְנֵי עַמּוֹן מִשְׁמַעְתָּם.** כְּתַרְגּוּמוֹ: ״יִשְׁתַּמְּעוּן לְהוֹן״, מְקַבְּלִין מִצְוָתָם עֲלֵיהֶם:


**and the children of Ammon shall obey them** As the Targum states: Will hearken to them. They will accept their commandments over them.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 11:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:15:1)


**וְהֶחֱרִים.** לְיַבְּשׁוֹ כְּדֵי שֶׁיַּעַבְרוּ בּוֹ גָּלֻיּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרַיִם:


**And...shall dry up** [lit. shall cut off] to dry it, so that the exiles of Israel will pass through it from Egypt.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 11:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:15:2)


**עַל הַנָּהָר.** נְהַר פְּרָת, לַעֲבוֹר בּוֹ גָּלֻיּוֹת אַשּׁוּר:


**over the river** The Euphrates River, for the exiles from Assyria to cross.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 11:15:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:15:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:15:3)


**בַּעְיָם רוּחוֹ.** אֵין לוֹ דִמְיוֹן בַּמִּקְרָא, וּלְפִי הָעִנְיָן יִפָּתֵר: בְּחֹזֶק רוּחוֹ:


**with the strength of His wind** Heb. בַּעְיָם. This is hapax legomenon in Scripture, and according to the context it can be interpreted as “with the strength of His wind.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 11:15:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:15:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:15:4)


**לְשִׁבְעָה נְחָלִים.** לְשִׁבְעָה גְּזָרִים, לַעֲבוֹר בּוֹ שֶׁבַע גָּלֻיּוֹת הָאֲמוּרוֹת לְמַעְלָה (ישעיהו יא:יא) ״מֵאַשּׁוּר וּמִמִּצְרַיִם וְגוֹ׳״; וּמֵאִיֵּי הַיָּם אֵינוֹ מֵאוֹתוֹ צַד:


**into seven streams** into seven segments, for the aforementioned seven exiles: from Assyria and from Egypt, etc. Those from the islands of the sea are not from that side.

**וְהִדְרִיךְ.** בְּתוֹכוֹ אֶת הַגָּלִיּוֹת:

###### Rashi on Isaiah 11:15:6

**בַּנְּעָלִים.** בַּיַּבָּשָׁה׃

###### Rashi on Isaiah 11:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/11:16:1)


**וְהָיְתָה מְסִלָּה.** בְּתוֹךְ הַמַּיִם לִשְׁאָר עַמּוֹ:

## Chapter 12


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 12:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/12:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/12:1:1)


**וְאָמַרְתָּ.** בִּרְאוֹתְךָ זֹאת:


**And you shall say** when you see the nations being sentenced to disgrace and abhorrence.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 12:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/12:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/12:1:2)


**אוֹדְךָ. כִּי אָנַפְתָּ בִּי** וְהִגְלִיתַנִי, וְכִפֵּר גָּלוּתִי עָלַי; וְעַתָּה נִרְצָה עֲוֹנִי, וְ**יָשֹׁב אַפְּךָ וּתְנַחֲמֵנִי**. וְיוֹנָתָן תִּרְגֵּם: **אוֹדְךָ ה׳ כִּי** חָטָאתִי לָךְ, וְעַל כֵּן **אָנַפְתָּ בִּי,** וְלוּלֵי רַחֲמֶיךָ לֹא הָיִיתִי כְּדַאי לָשׁוּב **אַפְּךָ וּלְנַחֲמֵנִי;** וְהִנֵּה שָׁב אַפְּךָ מִמֶּנִּי:


**I will thank You, O Lord, for you were wroth with me** and You exiled me, and my exile atoned for me, and now, amends have been made for my iniquity. May Your wrath turn away and may You comfort me. Jonathan renders: I will confess before You, O Lord, that I sinned before You, and, therefore, You were wroth with me, and were it not for Your mercy, I would not be worthy to have Your wrath turn away and comfort me, and behold, Your wrath has turned away from me.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 12:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/12:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/12:2:1)


**עָזִּי וְזִמְרָת יָהּ ה׳.** עֹז וְשֶׁבַח שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא הוּא הָיָה **לִי לִישׁוּעָה.** וְאֵין לְפָרֵשׁ **עָזִּי** עֹז שֶׁלִּי, שֶׁלֹּא מָצִינוּ בַּמִּקְרָא ׳עָזִּי׳ נָקוּד חֲטַף קָמַץ אֶלָּא שׁוּרֻק ׳עֻזִּי׳, חוּץ מִשְּׁלֹשׁ מְקוֹמוֹת שֶׁהוּא סָמוּךְ אֵצֶל ׳וְזִמְרָת׳ (שמות טו:ב, ישעיהו יב:ב, תהלים קיח:יד). וְלֹא **וְזִמְרָת** כְּמוֹ ׳וְזִמְרָתִי׳, אֶלָּא עַל כָּרְחֲךָ ׳וְזִמְרָת׳ דָּבוּק הוּא לַתֵּיבָה שֶׁל אַחֲרָיו. לְכָךְ אֲנִי אוֹמֵר, שֶׁאֵין יוֹ״ד שֶׁל ׳עָזִּי׳ אֶלָּא כְּמוֹ יוֹ״ד שֶׁל ״שֹׁכְנִי סְנֶה״ (דברים לג:טז):


**for the strength and the praise of the Eternal the Lord** The strength and the praise of the Holy One, blessed be He, that was my salvation. We cannot, however, explain עָזִּי, like עֻזִּי, my strength, for we do not find in Scripture עָזִּי vowelized with a short ‘kamatz,’ but with a ‘shuruk,’ reading עֻזִּי, with the exception of three places where it is accompanied by וְזִמְרָת. Also, וְזִמְרָת cannot be explained like וְזִמְרָתִי, my praise, but we are forced to say that וְזִמְרָת is connected to the word following it. Therefore, I say that the ‘yud’ of עָזִּי is merely like the ‘yud’ of (Deut. 33:16) שׁוֹכְנִי סְנֶה, “He Who dwells in the thornbush.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 12:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/12:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/12:2:2)


**יָהּ יְהוָה.** עַד הֵנָּה הָיָה שְׁמוֹ חָלוּק, וּבְמַפַּלְתּוֹ שֶׁל עֲמָלֵק נַעֲשָׂה שָׁלֵם, וְכֵן הוּא אוֹמֵר ״כִּי יָד עַל כֵּס יָהּ״ (שמות יז:טז) – אֵין הַכִּסֵּא שָׁלֵם וְאֵין הַשֵּׁם שָׁלֵם עַד שֶׁתְּהֵא מִלְחָמָה לַה׳ בַּעֲמָלֵק:


**the Eternal the Lord** Until now His Name was divided, and with the downfall of Amalek, it became whole, and so Scripture states (Exodus 17:16): “For the hand is on the throne of the Eternal (כֵּס יָהּ),” implying that the throne is incomplete and the Name is incomplete until the Lord wages war against Amalek.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 12:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/12:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/12:2:3)


**וַיְהִי לִי לִישׁוּעָה.** כְּמוֹ ׳הָיָה **לִי לִישׁוּעָה׳.** וְדֶרֶךְ מִקְרָאוֹת לְדַבֵּר כֵּן, כְּמוֹ ״וַאֲשֶׁר לֹא שָׂם לִבּוֹ וְגוֹ׳ וַיַּעֲזֹב אֶת עֲבָדָיו וְאֶת מִקְנֵהוּ״ (שמות ט:כא), וְעוֹד בְּדִבְרֵי הַיָּמִים (דברי הימים ב י:יז): ״וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַיּוֹשְׁבִים בְּעָרֵי יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם רְחַבְעָם״ – הָיָה לוֹ לוֹמַר ׳מָלַךְ עֲלֵיהֶם רְחַבְעָם׳:


**was my salvation.** Heb. וַיְהִי לִי לִישׁוּעָה, like הָיָה לִי לִישׁוּעָה, was to me for a salvation, and it is customary for Scripture to speak in this manner. Comp. (Exodus 9:21) “And he who did not heed the word of the Lord, left (וַיַּעֲזֹב) his slaves and his cattle”; also, in II Chronicles (10:17): “And the children of Israel who dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned (וַיִּמְלֹךְ) over them.” It should say, מָלַךְ עֲלֵיהֶם.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 12:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/12:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/12:3:1)


**וּשְׁאַבְתֶּם.** ״וּתְקַבְּלוּן אוּלְפָן חֲדַת״ (תרגום יונתן):


**And you shall draw water** You shall receive a new teaching [from Targum].


###### Rashi on Isaiah 12:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/12:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/12:3:2)


**מִמַּעַיְנֵי הַיְשׁוּעָה.** כִּי יַרְחִיב לִבָּם עַל יְדֵי יְשׁוּעָה הַבָּאָה לָהֶם, וְיִתְגַּלּוּ לָהֶם רָזֵי הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁנִּשְׁתַּכְּחוּ בְּבָבֶל עַל יְדֵי הַצָּרוֹת:


**from the fountains of the salvation** For their heart will be dilated through the salvation that came to them, and secrets of the Torah that have been forgotten during the exile, because of the troubles, will be revealed to them.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 12:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/12:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/12:4:1)


**עֲלִילוֹתָיו.** מַעֲלָלָיו:

###### Rashi on Isaiah 12:4:2

## Chapter 13


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:1:1)


**מַשָּׂא בָּבֶל.** מַשָּׂא פֻּרְעָנוּת שֶׁעַל בָּבֶל:


**The harsh prophecy of Babylon** The prophecy of the retribution which [will fall] upon Babylon.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:2:1)


**עַל הַר נִשְׁפֶּה שְׂאוּ נֵס.** לְהִקָּבֵץ. עַל הַר שָׁקֵט וּבוֹטֵחַ בְּשֹׁפִי, **שְׂאוּ נֵס** לַגּוֹיִם, וְ**הָרִימוּ קוֹל** לַנִּקְבָּצִים שֶׁיָּבוֹאוּ עָלָיו:


**On a tranquil mountain raise a banner** to gather. On a tranquil, trusting, undisturbed mountain, raise a banner to the nations and raise your voice to those gathering, that they come upon it.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:2:2)


**הָנִיפוּ** לָהֶם יָד לִרְחוֹקִים, שֶׁאֵין יְכוֹלִים לִשְׁמוֹעַ, וְיִרְאוּ אוֹת הֲנָפַת הַיָּד **וְיָבוֹאוּ** בְּ**פִתְחֵי נְדִיבִים** שֶׁל שָׂרֵי בָּבֶל:


**wave your hand** Wave your hand to the distant ones who cannot hear, and let them see the waving of the hand and enter the gates of the nobles, of the princes of Babylon.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:2:3)


**פִּתְחֵי.** כְּמוֹ ׳בְּפִתְחֵי׳; כְּמוֹ ״וְתֵשֵׁב בֵית אָבִיהָ״ (בראשית לח:יא), הַנִּסְתָּר ׳בְּבֵית אָבִיהָ׳. וּמְנַחֵם בֶּן סָרוּק פָּתַר: ׳חֲרָבוֹת׳, כְּמוֹ ״וְהֵמָּה פְתִיחוֹת״ (תהלים נה:כב):


**the gates** Heb. פִּתְחֵי. As though it would say, בְּפִתְחֵי, into the gates. Comp. (Gen. 38:11) “Stay as a widow in your father’s house (בֵּית אָבִיךְ),” interpreted as בְּבֵית אָבִיךְ. Menachem ben Seruk (Machbereth Menachem p. 147) interpreted it as swords. Comp. (Psalms 55:22) “And they are drawn swords (פְּתִיחוֹת).”



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:3:1)


**אֲנִי צִוֵּיתִי לִמְקֻדָּשָׁי.** שֶׁיָּבוֹאוּ וְיַתְחִילוּ לְהִתְגָּרוֹת בָּם, וְהֵם פָּרַס וּמָדַי, אַנְשֵׁי כּוֹרֶשׁ וְדָרְיָוֶשׁ, שֶׁזִּמַּנְתִּים לְכָךְ:


**I commanded My appointed ones** that they come and commence to incite them, and they are Persia and Media, the men of Cyrus and Darius, whom I appointed for this.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:3:2)


**קָרָאתִי גִבּוֹרַי לְאַפִּי.** לַעֲשׂוֹת חֲרוֹן אַפִּי בָּהֶם, שֶׁהֵם **עַלִּיזֵי גַּאֲוָתִי,** שֶׁאֲנִי מִתְפָּאֵר בָּהֶם:


**I summoned My heroes to [execute] My wrath** To execute My wrath upon them, for they rejoice in My pride that I boast of them.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:5:1)


**וּכְלֵי זַעְמוֹ.** הֵם גִּבּוֹרֵי מָדַי וּפָרָס:


**and the weapons of His fury** They are the mighty men of Media and Persia.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:5:2)


**לְחַבֵּל כָּל הָאָרֶץ.** שֶׁל בָּבֶל:


**to destroy all the land** of Babylonia.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:6:1)


**כְּשֹׁד.** כְּיוֹם בִּזָּה מֵאֵת הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא **יָבוֹא**:


**like a raid** Like a day of plunder, from the Holy One, blessed be He, it shall come.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:7:1)


**כָּל יָדַיִם.** שֶׁל בָּבֶל:


**all hands** of the Babylonians.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:8:1)


**צִירִים וַחֲבָלִים.** הֵם לְשׁוֹן יִסּוּרֵי אִשָּׁה הַכּוֹרַעַת לֵילֵד, שֶׁצִּירֵי דַּלְתֵי בִּטְנָהּ מִתְפָּרְקִים לְהִפָּתֵחַ:


**pangs and throes** (צִירִים וַחֲבָלִים) These are expressions of pains of a woman who kneels to give birth, for the hinges (צִירִים) of her womb break apart to open.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:8:2)


**יְחִילוּן.** חִיל וְחַלְחָלָה, לְשׁוֹן רֶתֶת הֵם:


**they shall writhe** Heb. יְחִילוּן. חִיל, חַלְחָלָה are expressions of shivering.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:8:3)


**אִישׁ אֶל רֵעֵהוּ יִתְמָהוּ.** בְּנֵי בָבֶל עַל הַצּוֹבְאִים עֲלֵיהֶם, כִּי מְשֻׁנִּים הֵם:


**each man shall be amazed at his fellow** The Babylonians will be amazed at those who advanced against them, for they are peculiar.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:8:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:8:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:8:4)


**וּפְנֵי לְהָבִים פְּנֵיהֶם.** אוֹמֵר אֲנִי שֶׁפְּנֵיהֶם צְהוּבִים וּמְאוּיָּמִין מְאֹד, אוֹ יֵשׁ לוֹמַר שֶׁהֵם עַם חוֹשְׁבֵי מַחֲשָׁבוֹת, וְאֶת בְּנֵי בָּבֶל (דִּמָּה לָהֶם עַל שֵׁם הַתִּמָּהוֹן):


**their faces are faces of flames** A nation whose faces are red and very frightful, [or alternatively, because they are a pensive people, and he compares the Babylonians to them because of the amazement.]



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:9:1)


**וְחַטָּאֶיהָ.** חוֹטְאֶיהָ (ברכות י א):


**and its sinners** Heb. וְחַטָּאֶיהָ, similar to חוֹטְאֶיהָ.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:10:1)


**וּכְסִילֵיהֶם.** מַזָּלוֹתֵיהֶם:


**and its constellations** Similar to מַזָּלוֹתֵיהֶם.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:10:2)


**יָהֵלּוּ.** יָאִירוּ, וְכֵן ״בְּהִלּוֹ נֵרוֹ״ (איוב כט:ג), וְכֵן ״אוֹר כִּי יָהֵל״ (איוב לא:כו):


**illuminate** Heb. יָהֵלּוּ. They shall illuminate, and so (Job 29:3), “When his lamp shone,” (בְּהִלּוֹ)” (ibid. 31:26). The light when it shone brightly (יָהֵל).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:10:3)


**חָשַׁךְ הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ.** מִתּוֹךְ צָרָתָם נִדְמֶה לָהֶם כְּאִלּוּ **חָשַׁךְ הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ**:


**the sun has become dark** Because of their distress, it seems to them as though the sun has become dark.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:11:1)


**עַל תֵּבֵל.** עַל אַרְצָם:


**upon the earth** On their land.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:12:1)


**אוֹקִיר אֱנוֹשׁ מִפָּז.** בּוֹ בַּלַּיְלָה אֲכַבֵּד אֶת דָּנִיֵּאל מִפָּז, כְּשֶׁהֱבִיאוּהוּ לִקְרוֹת מִכְתָּב ״מְנֵא מְנֵא תְּקֵל וּפַרְסִין״ (דניאל ה:כה); ״בֵּאדַיִן אֲמַר בֵּלְשַׁצַּר וְהַלְבִּישׁוּ יָת דָּנִיֵּאל אַרְגְּוָנָא וְגוֹ׳״ (דניאל ה:כט):


**I will make mortal man dearer than fine gold** On that night I will honor Daniel more than fine gold. When they brought him to read the writing (Dan. 5:25): “Mene mene tekel ufarsin”; (ibid. 5: 25) “Then Belshazzar ordered, and they dressed Daniel in purple...”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:12:2)


**כֶּתֶם אוֹפִיר.** קְבוּצַת זְהַב אוֹפִיר:


**more than a collection of the gold of Ophir** Heb. מִכֶּתֶם אוֹפִיר, a collection of the gold of Ophir.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:13:1)


**שָׁמַיִם אַרְגִּיז.** כָּל צְבָאָם יִרְגַּז, וְאוֹמֵר ״אֵיךְ נָפַלְתָּ מִשָּׁמַיִם הֵילֵל בֶּן שָׁחַר״ (ישעיהו יד:יב), וְאַחַר כָּךְ ״נִגְדַּעְתָּ לָאָרֶץ חוֹלֵשׁ עַל גּוֹיִם״. אַף כָּאן תְּחִלָּה **שָׁמַיִם אַרְגִּיז**, וְאַחַר כָּךְ **וְתִרְעַשׁ הָאָרֶץ** – יִרְעֲשׁוּ יוֹשְׁבֶיהָ לְקוֹל מַפַּלְתָּהּ, שֶׁיִּתְמְהוּ בַּדָּבָר:


**I will make heaven quake** All their host will quake when I cast down the prince of Babylon, for the Holy One, blessed be He, does not punish the nations until He punishes their heavenly princes first, as Scripture states (infra 24:21): “The Lord shall visit upon the heavenly host on high,” and afterwards, “on the kings of the earth on the earth.” Scripture states further (infra 14:12): “How have you fallen from heaven, Lucifer, the morning star?” And then, “You have been cut down to the ground, you who cast lots on nations.” Here too, first, “I will make heaven quake,” and afterwards, “the earth will quake.” Its inhabitants shall quake at the news of its downfall, for they shall be astonished at the event.

**וְהָיָה** יוֹשֵׁב בָּבֶל:


**And he shall be** i.e., every inhabitant of Babylon.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:14:2

**like a roving deer** i.e., like a deer roving from its place.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:15:1)


**כָּל הַנִּמְצָא** בַּחוּץ יִדָּקֵר:


**Everyone who is found** outside, shall be stabbed.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:15:2)


**וְכָל הַנִּסְפֶּה.** עַל בְּנֵי הָעִיר לִהְיוֹת נִקְלָט עִמָּהֶם בַּמָּצוֹר, יִפּוֹל בַּחֶרֶב כְּשֶׁתִּלָּכֵד הָעִיר. **נִסְפֶּה** לְשׁוֹן ״סְפוֹת הָרָוָה״ (דברים כט:יח), ״סְפוּ שָׁנָה עַל שָׁנָה״ (ישעיהו כט:א), ״סְפוּ עַל זִבְחֵיכֶם״ (ירמיה ז:כא), אקוייליי״ר בלע״ז:


**and anyone who takes refuge** with the people of the city to be included with them in the siege, shall fall by the sword when the city capitulates. נִסְפֶּה is an expression similar to (Deut. 29:18): “To add the unintentional sins to the lustful ones (סְפוֹת)”; (infra 29:1) “Add year upon year (סְפוּ)”; (Jer. 7:21) “Add (סְפוּ) to your sacrifices.” [akojjlir in O.F.], to join.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:16:1)


**יְרֻטְּשׁוּ.** יִתְבַּקְּעוּ, וְכֵן ״נְעָרִים תְּרַטַּשְׁנָה״ (ישעיהו יג:יח):


**shall be dashed** Heb. יְרֻטָּשׁוּ. Comp. (verse 18) “Shall dash (תְּרַטַּשְׁנָה) youths.”



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:17:1)


**הִנְנִי מֵעִיר עֲלֵיהֶם אֶת מָדָי.** דָּרְיָוֶשׁ הַמָּדִי הָרַג אֶת בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר, וְכֵן הוּא אוֹמֵר ״בֵּיהּ בְּלֵילְיָא קְטִיל בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר״ (דניאל ה:ל), ״וְדָרְיָוֶשׁ מָדָאָה קַבִּיל מַלְכוּתָא״ (דניאל ו:א):


**Behold I stir up Media against them** Darius the Mede assassinated Belshazzar. So Scripture states (Dan. 5:30): “On that very night, Belshazzar...was slain”; (ibid. 6:1) “And Darius the Mede acquired the kingdom.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:17:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:17:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:17:2)


**וְזָהָב לֹא יַחְפְּצוּ בוֹ.** אֵין חוֹשְׁשִׁין כִּי אִם לַהֲרוֹג וּלְהִנָּקֵם עַל כָּל הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ מַלְכֵי בָּבֶל לְכָל הָעַמִּים:


**and do not desire gold** They do not care [for anything,] but to kill and to avenge the harm the kings of Babylon did to all the peoples.

###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:18:1)

###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:18:3

### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:19:1)


**וְהָיְתָה בָבֶל.** שְׁתֵּי פֻּרְעָנִיּוֹת בָּאוּ לָהּ בִּשְׁתֵּי שָׁנִים: דָּרְיָוֶשׁ הָרַג בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר וּמָלַךְ שָׁנָה, וְלַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁנִיָּה נֶהֶפְכָה כְּמַהְפֵּכַת סְדוֹם מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם. וְכֵן שָׁנִינוּ בְּסֵדֶר עוֹלָם (סדר עולם רבה כח): ״וּבָא בַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁמוּעָה״ שֶׁל דָּרְיָוֶשׁ, וְאַחֲרָיו בַּשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁמוּעָה (ירמיהו נא:מו), **וְהָיְתָה בָבֶל צְבִי מַמְלָכוֹת וְגוֹ׳,** שֶׁהָיְתָה מַצָּב וְרֹאשׁ הַמַּמְלָכוֹת, וְשֶׁהָיְתָה **תִּפְאֶרֶת גְּאוֹן כַּשְׂדִּים** עַתָּה **וְהָיְתָה כְּמַהְפֵּכַת סְדוֹם**:


**And Babylon...shall be** Two calamities befell her in two years. Darius assassinated Belshazzar and ruled a year, and in the second year it was turned over like Sodom from heaven. And so we learned in Seder Olam (ch. 28). And in that year the news came concerning Darius, and after him, in the year, the news, and Babylon that was the beauty of the kingdoms...that was the leader and the head of the kingdoms and that was the glory of the pride of the Chaldees now, shall be like the overturning of Sodom.



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:20:1)


**וְלֹא יַהֵל שָׁם עֲרָבִי.** כְּמוֹ ׳לֹא יַאֲהֵל׳ – לֹא יִפְרֹשׂ שָׁם אֹהֶל, אֲפִלּוּ עֲרָבִי שֶׁדַּרְכָּם לֵישֵׁב בָּאֳהָלִים וּלְהַסִּיעַ מִקְנֵיהֶם מִמָּקוֹם לְמָקוֹם, לֹא תִמְצָא חֵן בְּעֵינֵיהֶם לִקְבֹּעַ שָׁם אָהֳלֵיהֶם, כִּי אַף לְמִרְעֶה צֹאן לֹא תִהְיֶה רְאוּיָה. וְלֹא תִּתְמַהּ עַל **לֹא יַהֵל** הַנִּבְאָר כְּאִלּוּ הָיְתָה בּוֹ אָלֶ״ף, כִּי הַרְבֵּה מְקוֹמוֹת יֵשׁ שֶׁהֲבָרַת קוֹל הָאוֹת בִּמְקוֹם אוֹת, וְכֵן (איוב לה:יא) ״מַלְפֵנוּ מִבַּהֲמוֹת אָרֶץ״ כְּמוֹ ׳מְאַלְפֵנוּ׳, וְכֵן (משלי יז:ד) ״שֶׁקֶר מֵזִין עַל לְשׁוֹן הַוּוֹת״ כְּמוֹ ׳שֶׁקֶר מַאֲזִין׳:


**and no Arab shall pitch his tent there** Heb. יַהֵל, like יַאֲהֵל. Even Arabs, who customarily dwell in tents and move their livestock from place to place, will not be pleased with Babylon, to set up their tents there, for it will not even be fit for pasture for flocks. And do not wonder about לֹא יַהֵל, which is explained like לֹא יַאֲהֵל, for there are many places in which the sound of the letter is substituted for the letter, and so (Job 35:11), “He teaches us (מַלְפֵנוּ) from the beasts of the earth,” like מְאַלְפֵנוּ, and so, (Prov. 17:4), “A liar hearkens (מֵזִין) to a destructive tongue,” like מַאֲזִין.



### Verse 21

###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:21:1)


**צִיִּים.** תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן: ״תַּמְוָן״, הֵם נְמִיּוֹת, מרטרינ״ש בלע״ז:


**martens** Heb. צִיִּים. Jonathan translates: תַּמְוָן, identical with נִמִּיּוֹת [found in the Talmud] martrines in O.F.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:21:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:21:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:21:2)


**אֹחִים.** לֹא יָדַעְתִּי מַה מִין חַיָּה הֵם, (**אֹחִים** – לְשׁוֹן קוֹצִים וְחוֹחִים וְדַרְדָּרִים):


**ferrets** Heb. אֹחִים. I do not know what kind of animal they are. [אֹחִים is an expression of thorns, thistles, and briars.]


###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:21:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:21:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:21:3)


**וּשְׂעִירִים.** שֵׁדִים:


**and satyrs** demons.



### Verse 22

###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:22:1)


**וְעָנָה אִיִּים בְּאַלְמְנוֹתָיו.** ״וְיָגוּרוּ חֲתוּלִים בְּאַרְמְנוֹתָיו״ (תרגום יונתן):


**And cats shall dwell in his palaces** Heb. וְעָנָה אִיִּים בְּאַלְמְנוֹתָיו. And cats shall dwell in his palaces.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:22:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:22:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:22:2)


**וְעָנָה.** כְּמוֹ ״וְעָנְתָה שָׁמָּה״ (הושע ב:יז), ״וּמְעוֹנוֹתָיו טָרֶף״ (נחום ב:יג). וְיֵשׁ לְפָרֵשׁ עוֹד **וְעָנָה**: לְשׁוֹן עֲנִיַּת קוֹל:


וְעָנַָה is similar to (Hosea 2:17) “And she shall dwell (וְעָנְתָה) there.” Also (Nahum 2:13) “And his dens (וּמְעוֹנוֹתָיו) with what he had torn.” וְעָנָה may also be interpreted as an expression of raising the voice.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:22:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:22:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:22:3)


**וְתַנִּים.** יַעֲנוּ **בְּהֵיכְלֵי עֹנֶג** שֶׁלָּהֶם:


**and serpents** shall dwell [or howl] in their temples of pleasure.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 13:22:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:22:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/13:22:4)


**וְיָמֶיהָ.** יְמֵי טוֹבָתָהּ **לֹא יִמָּשְׁכוּ,** כִּי כְּבָר הֻבְטְחוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל (ירמיה כט:י) ״לְפִי מְלֹאת לְבָבֶל שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה אֶפְקֹד אֶתְכֶם״, וְאוֹתָהּ פְּקִידָה עַל יְדֵי כּוֹרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ פָּרַס, שֶׁיִּטּוֹל הַמְּלוּכָה מִבָּבֶל אַחַר דָּרְיָוֶשׁ הַמָּדִי, כִּי שְׁנֵיהֶם, מָדַי וּפָרַס, נִתְחַבְּרוּ עֲלֵיהֶם וְהִתְנוּ בֵּינֵיהֶם: אִי מִינַּן מַלְכֵי מִנַּיְיכוּ אֲפַרְכֵי (מגילה יב א):


**and her days** The days of her flourishing shall not be extended, for Israel was promised (Jer. 29:10): “When seventy years of Babylon are over, I will remember you.” And that remembering will be through Cyrus king of Persia, who will take the kingdom from Babylon after Darius the Mede, for they both, Media and Persia, joined over it, [i.e., over Babylon,] and stipulated between themselves, if the kings are from us, the governors are from you.



## Chapter 14


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 14:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:1:1)


**כִּי יְרַחֵם ה׳ אֶת יַעֲקֹב.** לִשְׁמוֹר לָהֶם הַבְטָחַת גְּאֻלָּתָם מִיַּד בָּבֶל:


**For the Lord shall have mercy on Jacob** to keep for them the promise of their redemption from Babylonia.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 14:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:1:2)


**וּבָחַר עוֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל.** לֶעָתִיד יִגְאָלֵם גְּאֻלָּה שְׁלֵימָה:


**and again choose Israel** in the future, He shall redeem them with a complete redemption.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 14:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:1:3)


**וְנִסְפְּחוּ.** וְנוֹסְפוּ, וְכֵן ״סְפָחֵנִי נָא״ (שמואל א ב:לו), וְכֵן ״מֵהִסְתַּפֵּחַ בְּנַחֲלַת ה׳״ (שמואל א כו:יט):


**and join** And they shall be added on. Comp. (I Sam. 2:36) “Take me now into... (סָפְחֵנִי)” and also (ibid. 27:19) “From cleaving to the Lord’s heritage (מֵהִסְתַּפֵּחַ).”



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 14:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:2:1)


**וְהִתְנַחֲלוּם.** יִהְיוּ נִנְחָלִים מֵהֶם, וְכֵן ״וְהִתְנַחַלְתֶּם אֹתָם״ (ויקרא כה:מו):


**shall inherit** they shall inherit from them, and similarly, “and you shall hold onto them as an inheritance” (Lev. 25:46).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 14:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:2:2)


**וְרָדוּ.** לְשׁוֹן רִדּוּי וּנְגִישָׁה, כְּמוֹ ״לֹא תִרְדֶּה בוֹ״ (ויקרא כה:מו):


**and rule** Heb. וְרָדוּ, an expression of ruling and dominating, as (Lev. 25: 46): “You shall not rule over him (תִרְדֶה).”



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 14:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:3:1)


**בְּיוֹם הָנִיחַ ה׳ לְךָ.** לְיִשְׂרָאֵל הַכָּתוּב מְדַבֵּר:


**on the day the Lord allows you to rest** Scripture is addressing Israel.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 14:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:3:2)


**מֵעָצְבְּךָ וּמֵרָגְזֶךָ** שֶׁעִצְּבְךָ וְהִרְגִּיזְךָ מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל, וּבִרְאוֹתְךָ מַפַּלְתּוֹ יָנִיחַ לְךָ, כִּי תֵצֵא חָפְשִׁי:


**from your sorrow and from your shuddering** which the king of Babylon saddened you and caused you to shudder, and when you see his downfall, you will be eased, since you will go out free.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 14:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:4:1)


**מַדְהֵבָה.** לְשׁוֹן מַרְבִּית גַּאֲוָה וּמַשָּׂא כָּבֵד; וְרַבּוֹתֵינוּ דָּרְשׁוּ (שבת קמט:-קנ.): הָאוֹמְרִים ״מְדוֹד וְהָבֵא״:


**the haughty one** Heb. מַדְהֵבָה. An expression of an excess of haughtiness and a heavy burden. Our Rabbis, however, expound it as: Those who say, ‘Measure and bring.’



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 14:5:1

**שָׁבַר יְהוָה מַטֵּה רְשָׁעִים.** שֶׁהָיָה מַכֶּה עַמִּים בְּעֶבְרָה:


**The Lord has broken the staff of the wicked** For he would smite peoples with wrath.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 14:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:6:1)


**מֻרְדָּף בְּלִי חָשָׂךְ.** מֻרְדָּף כָּל גּוֹי וְגוֹי עַל יָדוֹ **בְּלִי חָשָׁךְ** עַצְמוֹ מֵרְדּוֹף וּמִדְּלוֹק אַחַר כָּל אֻמָּה וְאֻמָּה:


**pursued without relenting** Every nation was pursued by him without his relenting from pursuing and chasing each nation.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Isaiah 14:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:7:1)

**opened [their mouth] in song** This is the song they recited, “All the land rested, became tranquil.”



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 14:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:8:1)


**גַּם בְּרוֹשִׁים שָׂמְחוּ.** ״אַף שַׁלְטוֹנִין חֲדִיאוּ״ (תרגום יונתן) – שָׂמְחוּ עַל מַפַּלְתְּךָ:

### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 14:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/14:9:1)


**לִקְרַאת בּוֹאֶךָ.** כְּשֶׁתֵּרֵד לְגֵיהִנֹּם, וּמַה הִיא הָ׳רָגְזָה׳? לְעוֹרֵר לִקְרָאתְךָ:
