### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:13:1)


**כְּפֶרֶץ.** שֶׁל חוֹמָה שֶׁנָּפַל:


**as a breach** of a fallen wall.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:13:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:13:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:13:2)


**נִבְעֶה בְּחוֹמָה נִשְׂגָּבָה.** מְגוּלָּה לִכָּנֵס בָּהּ, בְּחוֹמוֹת מִשְׂגַּבְּכֶם. **נִבְעֶה** לְשׁוֹן ׳גִּלּוּי׳, כְּמוֹ בְּעוֹבַדְיָה (עובדיה א:ו): ״נִבְעוּ מַצְפּוּנָיו״ – ״אִתְגַּלְיָין מַטְמְרוֹהִי״. וְדוּנָשׁ פָּתַר **נִבְעֶה** ׳בְּלִיטָה׳, שֶׁהַחוֹמָה נַעֲשֵׂית כְּמִין אֲבַעְבּוּעוֹת מִפְּנֵי הַגְּשָׁמִים וְקִלְקוּל טִיט רָעוּעַ:


**revealed in a fortified wall** Revealed to enter thereby the walls of your fortification. נִבְעֶה is an expression of revealing, as in Obadiah (1:6): “His hidden things were revealed (נִבְעוּ).” Dunash, however, interprets נִבְעֶה as a protrusion, since the wall develops blisters (אֲבַעְבּוּעוֹת) because of the rains and the deterioration of the weak mortar.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:14:1)


**נֵבֶל יוֹצְרִים.** נוֹד שֶׁל חֶרֶס:


**a potter’s jug** An earthenware jug.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:14:2)


**וְלֹא יִמָּצֵא.** בִּמְכִתַּת שְׁבָרָיו חֶרֶס גָּדוֹל שֶׁיְּהֵא רָאוּי **לַחְתּוֹת** בּוֹ **אֵשׁ מִיָּקוּד** וְלִשְׁאוֹב בּוֹ אֵשׁ מִן הַהֶסֵּק, כָּל שְׁאִיבַת אֵשׁ נוֹפֵל בָּהּ לְשׁוֹן ׳חֲתִיָּה׳:


**shall not be found** in the crushing of its fragments a shard large enough to scoop fire from a hearth, to pick up fire from a hearth. All scooping up of fire is referred to with an expression of חֲתִיָּה.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:14:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:14:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:14:3)


**וְלַחְשֹׂף מַיִם.** לִדְלוֹת, וְכֵן (חגי ב:טז) ״לַחְשֹׂף חֲמִשִּׁים פּוּרָה״, וְכֵן ״חֶשְׂפִּי שׁוּבָל״ (ישעיהו מז:ב) דְּלִי מַיִם מִן שְׁבִילֵךְ, אשפוייש״נט בלע״ז:


**or to scoop water** Or to draw. Comp. (Haggai 2:16): “To draw off (לַחְשׂף) fifty measures.” Also (below 47:2): “Draw off (חֶשְׂפִּי) the path.” Draw water from your path, Epuyse in O.F.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:14:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:14:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:14:4)


**מִגֶּבֶא.** גּוֹב מָלֵא מַיִם:


**from a cistern** (מִגֶּבֶא) A pit full of water.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:15:1)


**כִּי כֹה אָמַר.** הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לָכֶם זֶה יָמִים: אֵין אַתֶּם צְרִיכִים לְבַקֵּשׁ לָכֶם מָעוֹז מִצְרַיִם וּלְאַבֵּד מָמוֹנְכֶם, כִּי **בְּשׁוּבָה וָנַחַת** תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם תְּשׁוּעָה בְּלֹא שׁוּם טֹרַח, אִם תִּשְׁמְעוּ לִי:


**For so said** the Holy One, blessed be He, to you long ago, “You need not seek for yourselves the strength of Egypt and waste your money, for with tranquility and restfulness you shall have salvation, without any toil, if you listen to Me.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:15:2)


**בְּשׁוּבָה.** לְשׁוֹן יִשּׁוּב וּמַרְגּוֹעַ, וְכֵן ״שׁוּבָה ה׳ רִבְבוֹת אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל״ (במדבר י:לו):


**with tranquility** (בְּשׁוּבָה) an expression of restfulness and tranquility, Comp. (Num. 10:36): “Rest (שׁוּבָה), O Lord, with the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:15:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:15:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:15:3)


**בְּהַשְׁקֵט** הַבָּא לָכֶם מֵאִתִּי, **וּבְבִטְחָה תִּהְיֶה גְּבוּרַתְכֶם**:


**with quietude** that comes to you from Me, and with trust, shall be your might.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:16:1)


**עַל סוּס נָנוּס.** נִתְקַשֵּׁר בְּמַלְכֵי מִצְרַיִם, וְנָבִיא מִשָּׁם סוּסִים קַלִּים לָנוּס:


**on horses will we flee** (נָנוּס) We will ally ourselves with the king of Egypt, and we will bring from there swift steeds in order to flee.



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:17:1)


**אֶלֶף אֶחָד** מִכֶּם **מִפְּנֵי גַּעֲרַת אֶחָד** מִן הָאוֹיְבִים, אוֹ כֻּלְּכֶם **מִפְּנֵי גַּעֲרַת חֲמִשָּׁה תָּנֻסוּ.**


**One thousand [of you], because of the shout of one** of the enemies, or all of you because of the shout of five, shall flee.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:17:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:17:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:17:2)


**אִם נוֹתַרְתֶּם.** כְּמוֹ ׳אֲשֶׁר נוֹתַרְתֶּם׳:


**you remain** (lit., if you remain,) like ‘that you remain.’


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:17:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:17:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:17:3)


**כַּתֹּרֶן.** עֵץ גָּבוֹהַ תָּקוּעַ בָּאָרֶץ, כְּמִין תֹּרֶן הַסְּפִינָה שֶׁקּוֹרִין מש״ט בלע״ז:


**like a mast** (כַּתֹּרֶן) a lofty pole, inserted in the ground, like a sort of mast of a ship, that they call ‘mast’ in O.F.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:17:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:17:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:17:4)


**וְכַנֵּס.** אַף הוּא כְּלוֹנָס גָּבוֹהַּ שֶׁנּוֹתְנִים בְּרֹאשׁ הַגִּבְעָה, וּכְשֶׁרוֹאֶה הַצּוֹפֶה גְּיָסוֹת בָּאִין, נוֹתֵן עָלָיו סוּדָר, וְהָרוּחַ מוֹלִיכוֹ, וְהוּא סִימָן שֶׁיָּנוּסוּ אוֹ יִתְקַבְּצוּ:


**and like a flagpole** (וְכַנֵּס) That, too, is a lofty pole, which they place on a hilltop, and when the scout sees troops coming, he places a banner on it, and the wind moves it. This is the signal that they flee or assemble.



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:18:1)


**וְלָכֵן.** עַל שֶׁ**לֹּא אֲבִיתֶם** לִשְׁמוֹעַ:


**Therefore** Because you would not obey.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:18:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:18:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:18:2)


**יְחַכֶּה ה׳ לַחֲנַנְכֶם** אֵינוֹ מְדַלֵּג לָכֶם עַל הַגְּזֵרָה הָרָעָה שֶׁנִּגְזְרָה עֲלֵיכֶם, כְּדֵי לְמַהֵר וּלְהָבִיא הַטּוֹבָה, אֶלָּא יְחַכֶּה וְיַמְתִּין עַד בֹּא קִצָּהּ:


**the Lord shall wait to be gracious to you** He (acc. to Parshandatha) does not skip for you over the evil decree, which was decreed upon you, in order to hasten and to bring the good, but He will wait until its end comes.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:18:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:18:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:18:3)


**וְלָכֵן יָרוּם לְרַחֶמְכֶם.** יִתְרַחֵק לְרַחֶמְכֶם:


**and therefore, He shall withdraw to have mercy upon you** (יָרוּם) He shall draw Himself far away to have mercy upon you.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:18:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:18:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:18:4)


**כִּי אֱלֹהֵי מִשְׁפָּט ה׳.** וְיִפָּרַע תְּחִלָּה מִן הַמּוֹרְדִים בּוֹ:


**for the Lord is a God of justice** and He first metes out justice upon those who rebel against Him.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:18:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:18:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:18:5)


**אַשְׁרֵי כָל חוֹכֵי לוֹ.** לַנֶּחָמוֹת אֲשֶׁר הִבְטִיחַ, כִּי לֹא יִפּוֹל דָּבָר:


**fortunate are all who wait for him** for the consolations that He promised, for nothing shall fail.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:19:1)


**כִּי.** עוֹד יָמִים בָּאִים אֲשֶׁר יִשָּׁאֵר לִהְיוֹת יוֹשֵׁב **בְּצִיּוֹן** וּ**בִירוּשָׁלִַם**, צַדִּיק יִהְיֶה:


**For** days will yet come that he who remains to be dwelling in Zion and in Jerusalem, will be righteous. ([Manuscripts read:] For days will yet come and a righteous nation will dwell in Zion and in Jerusalem.) ([Other manuscripts read:] For the nation that He shall leave to be dwelling in Zion and in Jerusalem, shall be righteous people.)


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:19:2)


**בָּכוֹ לֹא תִבְכֶּה.** לֹא תִצְטָרֵךְ לְבַקֵּשׁ בַּקָּשָׁה מֵאֵת הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא בִּבְכִי, כִּי **לְקוֹל זַעֲקֶךָ עָנָךְ**:


**you shall not weep** You shall not need to offer supplication to the Holy One, blessed be He, with weeping, for, at the sound of your cry, He shall respond to you.



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:20:1)


**לֶחֶם צָר וּמַיִם לָחַץ.** לֹא תִהְיוּ כְּרוּכִים אַחַר תַּעֲנוּגִים כַּאֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עַתָּה, כְּמָה שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״הַשּׁוֹתִים בְּמִזְרְקֵי יַיִן״ (עמוס ו:ו), ״הִנֵּה שָׂשׂוֹן וְשִׂמְחָה״ (ישעיהו כב:יג):


**scant bread and water of oppression** You shall not run after pleasures as you do now, as it is said (Amos 6:6): “Who drink from basins of wine.” (Above 22:13) “And behold joy and happiness.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:20:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:20:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:20:2)


**וְלֹא יִכָּנֵף.** לֹא יִתְכַּסֶּה מִמְּךָ בִּכְנַף בְּגָדָיו, כְּלוֹמַר, לֹא יַסְתִּיר מִמְּךָ פָּנָיו:


**shall no longer be concealed** (לֹא יִכָּנֵף) shall not be covered from you with the skirt of His garments, i.e., He shall not hide His countenance from you.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:20:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:20:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:20:3)


**מוֹרֶיךָ.** הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא הַמְלַמֶּדְךָ לְהוֹעִיל:


**your Teacher** The Holy One, blessed be He, who teaches you for your profit.



### Verse 21

###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:21:1)


**וְאָזְנֶיךָ תִּשְׁמַעְנָה וְגוֹ׳.** לֹא כְּמוֹ שֶׁאַתֶּם עוֹשִׂים עַתָּה, שֶׁאַתֶּם מוֹאֲסִים בִּדְבָרוֹ וְאוֹמְרִים ״לֹא תֶחֱזוּ לָנוּ נְכוֹחוֹת״ (ישעיהו ל:י), כִּי אִם אָזְנֶיךָ יִהְיוּ נְטוּיוֹת אַף אַחֲרֶיךָ לִשְׁמוֹעַ **דָּבָר** מֵאִתִּי, אוּלַי יָבֹא נָבִיא וְיוֹרְךָ דֶּרֶךְ לָלֶכֶת בֵּין יָמִין וּבֵין שְׂמֹאל:


**And your ears shall hear from behind you** Not as you do now, that you despise My words and say, “You shall not prophesy for us true things” (verse 10), but your ears shall be bent also behind you to hear from Me, perhaps a prophet will come and instruct you the way to go, whether right or left.



### Verse 22

###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:22:1)


**אֲפֻדַּת.** נוֹי:


**the adornment** the beauty.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:22:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:22:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:22:2)


**כְּמוֹ דָוָה.** יִהְיוּ מְאוּסִים בְּעֵינֶיךָ כְּנִדָּה (שבת פב א):


**like a menstruant** They shall be repugnant in your eyes like a menstruant.



### Verse 23

###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:23:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:23:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:23:1)


**וְנָתַן.** הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אֶת **מְטַר זַרְעֲךָ**:


**And He shall give** I.e., the Holy One, blessed be He, shall give the rain for your seed.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:23:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:23:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:23:2)


**וְשָׁמֵן.** לְשׁוֹן ׳דָּבָר שָׁמֵן׳, וְאֵינוֹ לְשׁוֹן ׳שֶׁמֶן׳, לְפִיכָךְ טַעֲמוֹ לְמַטָּה, וְנָקוּד קָמַץ:


**fat** (וְשָׁמֵן) an expression of fat. Therefore, its accent is below (on the last syllable) and it is voweled with a kamatz (tzeireh).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:23:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:23:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:23:3)


**כַּר נִרְחָב.** עַד שֶׁיִּהְיוּ הַכָּרִים שְׁמֵנִים וּרְחָבִים:


**a fattened lamb** until the lambs will become fat and wide.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:23:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:23:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:23:4)


**כַּר.** כֶּבֶשׂ. לָשׁוֹן אַחֵר: מִישׁוֹר **נִרְחָב**, כְּמוֹ (בראשית יב:י) ״כִּכַּר הַיַּרְדֵּן״, וּכְמוֹ (ויקרא כג:יד) ״כַּרְמֶל״ – כַּר שֶׁהוּא מָלֵא תְּבוּאָה:


**lamb** (כַּר) a lamb. Alternatively, a wide plain. Comp. (Gen. 12:10) “the plain (כִּכַּר) of the Jordan,” (below 32:15) “Carmel,” meaning a wide plain, full of grain.



### Verse 24

###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:24:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:24:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:24:1)


**וְהָאֲלָפִים.** שְׁוָרִים:


**And the oxen.** (אֲלָפִים) oxen.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:24:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:24:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:24:2)


**בְּלִיל חָמִיץ.** כְּמוֹ ״עַל בְּלִילוֹ״ (איוב ו:ה), קַשִּׁין וְתֶבֶן מְחֻמָּצִין וּמְחֻזָּקִין בַּתְּבוּאָה שֶׁבְּתוֹכָם **יֹאכֵלוּ**:


**enriched provender** (בְּלִיל חָמִיץ) comp. (Job 6:5) “On his provender (בְּלִילוֹ).” Stubble and straw, strengthened and enriched with the grain within them, they shall eat.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:24:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:24:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:24:3)


**אֲשֶׁר זֹרֶה** הַתְּבוּאָה פַּעֲמַיִם: אַחַת **בָּרַחַת** וְאַחַת **בַּמִּזְרֶה**, כְּדֵי לְנַקּוֹת הַתְּבוּאָה. לְפִיכָךְ יִהְיֶה הַתֶּבֶן בָּלוּל בַּתְּבוּאָה שֶׁזּוֹרֶה **בַּמִּזְרֶה** אֵצֶל הַקַּשִּׁין:


**which was winnowed** The grain is winnowed twice, once with a shovel and once with a fan, in order to clean the grain. Therefore, the straw will be mixed with grain that was winnowed with a fan near the stubble.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:24:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:24:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:24:4)


**רַחַת.** פיל״א בלע״ז:


**shovel** (רַחַת) paile (pelle) in O.F.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:24:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:24:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:24:5)


**מִזְרֶה.** וו״ן בלע״ז, וּמִדְרַשׁ אַגָּדָה (תנחומא משפטים יז): **בְּלִיל** – לְשׁוֹן ׳בָּלוּל׳, שֶׁיְּהֵא הָאֹכֶל בָּלוּל בַּתֶּבֶן:


(fan, [מִזְרֶה] van in O.F.) And the Midrash Aggadah states that בְּלִיל is an expression of mixing, that the food will be mixed into the straw. (I.e., the grain will be so plentiful that it will be mixed into the straw eaten by the cattle and donkeys.)



### Verse 25

###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:25:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:25:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:25:1)


**יִבְלֵי מָיִם.** נַהֲרֵי מַיִם, כְּמוֹ (ירמיהו יז:ח) ״וְעַל יוּבַל יְשַׁלַּח שָׁרָשָׁיו״:


**rivulets of water** (יִבְלֵי מָיִם), rivers of water. Comp. (Jer. 17:8) “And upon the river (יוּבַל) he sends forth his roots.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:25:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:25:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:25:2)


**בְּיוֹם הֶרֶג רָב.** שֶׁיְּהֵא טֶבַח גָּדוֹל (בְּאֶרֶץ אַשּׁוּר), וְיוֹנָתָן תִּרְגֵּם: ״בְּיוֹם קְטוֹל רַב בְּמֵיפַל רַבְרְבִין״:


**on the day of the great slaying** when there will be a great slaughter (in the land of Assyria), and Jonathan renders: On the day of the great slaying, when the great ones will fall.



### Verse 26

###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:26:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:26:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:26:1)


**שִׁבְעָתַיִם כְּאוֹר שִׁבְעַת הַיָּמִים. שִׁבְעָתַיִם** – שֶׁבַע שְׁבִיעִיּוֹת כְּאוֹר שֶׁל שִׁבְעַת הַיָּמִים, הֲרֵי אַרְבָּעִים וְתֵשַׁע שְׁבִיעִיּוֹת, הָעוֹלִים לִשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת וְאַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁלֹשָׁה (רש"י פסחים סח א):


**sevenfold** (שִׁבְעָתַיִּם.) This means seven sevens as the light of the seven days, i.e., forty nine sevens, equaling three hundred forty-three.



### Verse 27

###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:27:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:27:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:27:1)


**שֵׁם ה׳** גְּבוּרָתוֹ, שֶׁתְּהֵא לוֹ לְשֵׁם, מַה שֶׁיַּעֲשֶׂה סַנְחֵרִיב:


**the Name of the Lord** His might, which will be for Him as a name, viz., what He will do to Sennacherib.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:27:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:27:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:27:2)


**בָּא מִמֶּרְחָק.** לְהַאֲמִין מַה שֶׁהִבְטִיחַ זֶה יָמִים רַבִּים:


**comes from long ago** (מִמֶּרְחָק, lit. from afar.) To realize what He promised long ago.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:27:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:27:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:27:3)


**מַשָּׂאָה.** הֵ״א יְתֵירָה, וְאֵינוֹ אֶלָּא כְּמוֹ מַשָּׂא, לְפִיכָךְ נְקוּדָה רָפִי:


**the burden** (מַשָּׂאָה) The ‘heh’ is superfluous, and it is only like מַשָּׂא. Therefore, the ‘heh’ is silent, not punctuated by a mappiq.



### Verse 28

###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:28:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:28:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:28:1)


**כְּנַחַל שׁוֹטֵף.** אֲשֶׁר הָעוֹבֵר בּוֹ **יֶחֱצֶה** בּוֹ **עַד צַוָּארוֹ**, שֶׁאֵין בּוֹ שׁוּם כֹּחַ לַעֲמוֹד בִּפְנֵי שֶׁטֶף הַמַּיִם:


**is like a flooding stream** which divides the one who crosses it, up to his neck, for he has no strength to stand against the current of the water.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:28:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:28:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:28:2)


**לַהֲנָפָה.** ׳לְהָנִיף׳, אווני״ר בלע״ז:


**to wave** (לַהֲנָפָה) to wave, vaner in O.F.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:28:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:28:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:28:3)


**בְּנָפַת שָׁוְא.** לֹא לְהוֹעִיל לָהֶם, וְהֵם סְבוּרִים לְהוֹעִיל:


**with a vain waving** Not to avail them, but they think it will avail.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:28:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:28:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:28:4)


**רֶסֶן.** פרומבי״א פרינ״ק בלע״ז:


**and a bit** (רֶסֶן) a bit, freynk in O.F., (a rein or curb).



### Verse 29

###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:29:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:29:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:29:1)


**הַשִּׁיר יִהְיֶה לָכֶם.** בְּלֵיל הַפֶּסַח תָּבֹא לָכֶם שִׂמְחָה זוֹ:


**This song shall be to you** On the night of Passover shall this joy come to you.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:29:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:29:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:29:2)


**כְּלֵיל הִתְקַדֶּשׁ חָג.** כְּמוֹ שֶׁאֲמַרְתֶּם שִׁיר שֶׁל הַפְּסָחִים בְּמִצְרַיִם. וְנִרְאֶה מִקְרָא זֶה כְּאִלּוּ בָּא לְלַמֵּד עַל סַנְחֵרִיב וְלִמֵּד עַל פַּרְעֹה, שֶׁאָמְרוּ הַלֵּל בְּלֵיל אֲכִילַת פְּסָחִים (מדרש תהלים א כ):


**as the night of the sanctification of the festival** Just as you recited a song over the Paschal sacrifices in Egypt [It appears from this verse as though he wishes to teach us about Sennacherib, but he teaches us about Pharaoh, that they recited Hallel on the night of the eating of the Paschal sacrifices. In Midrash Tehillim (1:20)].


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:29:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:29:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:29:3)


**כַּהוֹלֵךְ בֶּחָלִיל.** וְתִשְׂמְחוּ בְּמַפֶּלֶת סַנְחֵרִיב כְּשִׂמְחַת מְבִיאֵי בִּכּוּרִים, שֶׁהָיָה הֶחָלִיל מַכֶּה לִפְנֵיהֶם **לָבוֹא בְהַר ה׳**, כְּמוֹ שֶׁשָּׁנִינוּ בְּמַסֶּכֶת בִּכּוּרִים (בכורים ג ד):


**like one who goes with a flute** And you shall rejoice with the downfall of Sennacherib like the joy of those who bring the First Fruits, before whom the flute would play, to come upon the mountain of God, as we learned in Tractate Bikkurim (3:4).



### Verse 30

###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:30:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:30:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:30:1)


**וְנַחַת זְרוֹעוֹ.** אֵין זֶה לְשׁוֹן ׳נוֹחַ׳, אֶלָּא לְשׁוֹן ׳נוֹחַת׳, פושלמנ״ט בלע״ז, כְּמוֹ: ״וַיָּנַח בְּכָל גְּבוּל מִצְרָיִם״ (שמות י:יד). הַנָּחַת גְּבוּרָתוֹ **ירְאֶה** בְּ**לַהַב אֵשׁ**, שֶׁנִּשְׂרְפוּ אֻכְלוּסֵי סַנְחֵרִיב:


**and the laying down of His arm** This is not an expression of resting but an expression of placing, posement in O.F. Comp. (Exod. 10:14) “And placed it (וַיָּנַח) throughout the entire boundary of Egypt.” The placing of His might He will show in a flame by which the armies of Sennacherib were burnt.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:30:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:30:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:30:2)


**נֶפֶץ.** לְשׁוֹן שִׁבּוּר יוֹתֵר:


**bursting** (נֶפֶץ) an expression of more intense breaking, (shattering).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:30:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:30:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:30:3)


**וָזֶרֶם.** קִלּוּחַ מָטָר סוֹחֵף:



### Verse 31

###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:31:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:31:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:31:1)


**מִקּוֹל ה׳ יֵחַת אַשּׁוּר.** אָזְנַיִם פָּתַח לָהֶם, וְשָׁמְעוּ שִׁירָה מִפִּי חַיּוֹת וּמֵתוּ (סנהדרין צה ב):


**from the Lord’s voice Assyria shall be broken** he opened up their ears, and they heard the song from the mouth of the Chayoth, and they died. In the Aggadah of Chapter Chelek.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:31:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:31:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:31:2)


**בַּשֵּׁבֶט יַכֶּה.** אַשּׁוּר אֲשֶׁר הָיָה רָגִיל לְהַכּוֹתְךָ בְּשִׁבְטוֹ:


**with a rod he would smite** Assyria, who was wont to smite you with his rod.



### Verse 32

###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:32:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:32:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:32:1)


**וְהָיָה כֹּל מַעֲבַר מַטֵּה מוּסָדָה.** כָּל מַעֲבָרוֹת תֹּקֶף יְסוֹדוֹת אֻכְלוּסָיו, כָּל הַמְּקוֹמוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָבְרוּ שָׁם וְהִשְׁחִיתוּם; וּבְיוֹם מַפַּלְתָּם **יָנִיחַ ה׳** עֲלֵיהֶם עַל שְׁמוּעַת מַפַּלְתָּם וְהֵם יִהְיוּ **בְּתֻפִּים וּבְכִנֹּרוֹת**, וְכֹה פִּתְרוֹן הַמִּקְרָא בְּסֵרוּס: **וְהָיָה בְּתֻפִּים וּבְכִנּוֹרוֹת כָּל מַעֲבַר מַטֵּה מוּסָדָה אֲשֶׁר** יַנִּיחֵם **ה׳ עָלָיו וּבְמִלְחֲמוֹת תְּנוּפַת** שָׁוְא מַעֲלֶה וּמוֹרִיד **נִלְחַם בָּם** הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא. וּמִדְרַשׁ אַגָּדָה (פסיקתא דרב כהנא ח:): תְּנוּפַת קְצִיר הָעוֹמֶר עָמְדָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאוֹתָהּ מִלְחָמָה, כִּי לֵיל שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר בְּנִיסָן הָיָה:


**And it shall be, every place where the established staff shall pass** All the crossings of the strength of the foundations of his armies; all the places they passed and destroyed, and on the day of their downfall the Lord shall grant peace upon them through the news of their downfall, and they shall be joyful with drums and harps. And this is the interpretation of the verse in inverted order: And it shall be with drums and harps, every passing of the established staff upon which the Lord shall grant peace, and with wars of vain waving, lifting and lowering, did the Holy One, blessed be He, fight against them. And, according to Midrash Aggadah, the waving of the harvest of the Omer stood up for Israel in that war, for it was the night of the sixteenth of Nissan.



### Verse 33

###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:33:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:33:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:33:1)


**כִּי עָרוּךְ מֵאֶתְמוּל.** יוֹם שֵׁנִי לִבְרִיאַת עוֹלָם, יוֹם שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ תְמוֹל וְאֵין לוֹ שִׁלְשׁוֹם:


**For...is set up from yesterday** The second day of the Creation of the world a day that has a yesterday but not a day before yesterday.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:33:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:33:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:33:2)


**תָּפְתֶּה.** גֵּיהִנֹּם (בראשית רבה ד ו), שֶׁכָּל הַמִּתְפַּתֶּה בְּיִצְרוֹ נוֹפֵל שָׁם (עירובין יט א):


**Tophteh** Gehinnom, for whoever is enticed (מִתְפַּתֶּה) by his temptation falls into there.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:33:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:33:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:33:3)


**לַמֶּלֶךְ הוּכָן.** לְצוֹרֶךְ סַנְחֵרִיב וְחֵילוֹ:


**has been prepared for the king** For the necessity of Sennacherib and his army.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:33:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:33:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:33:4)


**מְדֻרָתָהּ.** לְשׁוֹן אֵשׁ נִסֶּקֶת, מַעֲרֶכֶת עֵצִים עַל הָאֵשׁ קְרוּיָה מְדוּרָה:


**its pile** (מְדֻרָתָהּ) an expression of a heated fire. An arrangement of wood on the fire is called מְדוּרָה.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:33:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:33:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:33:5)


**נִשְׁמַת ה׳.** נְפִיחַת רוּחוֹ:


**the breath of the Lord** the blowing of His breath.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 30:33:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:33:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:33:6)


**בֹּעֲרָה.** בּוֹעֶרֶת:


**burning** (בֹּעֲרָה) equivalent to בּוֹעֶרֶת.



## Chapter 31


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 31:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:1:1)


**הוֹי.** עַל הוֹשֵׁעַ וַעֲשֶׂרֶת הַשְּׁבָטִים **הַיּוֹרְדִים מִצְרַיְמָה לְעֶזְרָה**, אֲשֶׁר שָׁלְחוּ ״מַלְאָכִים אֶל סוּא מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם״ (מלכים ב יז:ד):


**Woe** Concerning Hoshea and the ten tribes who went down to Egypt for aid, who sent emissaries to So, king of Egypt (II Kings 17).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 31:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:1:2)


**וְעַל סוּסִים.** הַבָּאִים מִשָּׁם, שֶׁהֵם קַלִּים לָרוּץ:


**on horses** that come from there, for they are swift runners.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 31:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:1:3)


**יִשָּׁעֵנוּ.** (כְּמוֹ **״וְלֹא שָׁעוּ** אֶל **קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל״**), כְּמוֹ שֶׁעָשָׂה חִזְקִיָּה, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (מלכים ב יח:ה-ז): ״בַּה׳ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּטָח... וַיִּמְרֹד בְּמֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר״:


**rely** (יִשָּׁעֵנוּ) and they did not rely on the Holy One of Israel as Hezekiah did, concerning whom it is written: (II Kings 18:5,7): “He trusted in the Lord God of Israel...and he rebelled against the king of Assyria.”



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 31:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:2:1)


**וְאֶת דְּבָרָיו לֹא הֵסִיר.** אֲשֶׁר אָמַר ״וְהֶשִׁיבְךָ ה׳ מִצְרַיִם בָּאֳנִיּוֹת״ (דברים כח:סח), מִדָּה כְּנֶגֶד מִדָּה, שֶׁאָמַרְתִּי לְךָ (שם) ״לֹא תוֹסִיף עוֹד לִרְאוֹתָהּ״, וְאַתָּה הָלַכְתָּ מִדַּעְתְּךָ, סוֹפְךָ לֵילֵךְ בְּגָלוּת עַל כָּרְחֲךָ:


**and His words He did not retract** What He said, “And the Lord shall take you back to Egypt in ships” (Deut. 28:68). This is payment in kind, for I said to you, “You shall no longer see it (ibid.),” and you went there of your own free will. Eventually, you shall go there in exile against your will.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 31:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:2:2)


**וְקָם.** עַל עֲשֶׂרֶת הַשְּׁבָטִים, שֶׁהֵם **בֵּית מְרֵעִים**, וְעַל מִצְרַיִם, אֲשֶׁר הֵם לָהֶם **לְעֶזְרָה**:


**and He rose** on the ten tribes, who are a house of evildoers, and on the Egyptians who came to their aid.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 31:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:3:1)


**יַטֶּה יָדוֹ.** שֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא סוֹמֵךְ הַכֹּל בְּיָדוֹ, וּכְשֶׁיַּטֶּה אוֹתָהּ יִפְּלוּ, כָּזֶה שֶׁאוֹחֵז דָּבָר בְּכַפּוֹ, וּכְשֶׁהוּא מַרְכִּין כַּפּוֹ הוּא נוֹפֵל. כָּךְ וּמִדְרַשׁ אַגָּדָה (מכילתא בא שירה ט), וְיוֹנָתָן תִּרְגֵּם: ״יָרִים יַד מְחַת גְּבוּרְתֵּיהּ״:


**shall turn His hand** For the Holy One, blessed be He, supports everything with His hand, and when He turns it, they will fall, like one who holds something in his hand, and when he inclines his hand, it falls. So is the Midrash Aggadah (Mechilta, Exodus 15:12). Jonathan, however, renders: shall raise the blow of His might.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 31:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:4:1)


**כַּאֲשֶׁר יֶהְגֶּה.** הֲמִיַּת קוֹל, כְּמוֹ ״וְכַיּוֹנִים הָגֹה נֶהְגֶּה״ (ישעיהו נט:יא):


**As...growls** (יֶהְגֶּה) a roaring sound. Comp. (infra 59:11) “And like doves we will moan (הָגֹה נֶהְגֶּה) .”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 31:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:4:2)


**אֲשֶׁר יִקָּרֵא עָלָיו מְלֹא רֹעִים.** יֵאָסְפוּן עָלָיו בִּקְרִיאַת קוֹל הָמוֹן:


**although a band of shepherds gather against him** (יִקָּרֵא, lit., will be called.) They will gather upon him with a stirring shout.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 31:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:4:3)


**מְלֹא רוֹעִים.** אֲסִיפַת רוֹעִים, וְכֵן ״קָרְאוּ אַחֲרֶיךָ מָלֵא״ (ירמיהו יב:ו), וְכֵן ״יַחַד עָלַי יִתְמַלָּאוּן״ (איוב טז:י), כֻּלָּם לְשׁוֹן ׳קִבּוּץ׳:


**band of shepherds** (מְלֹא) a gathering of shepherds. Comp. (Jer. 12:6) “They called after you a band (מָלֵא).” Comp. also (Job 16:10) “Together they gather (יִתְמַלָּאוּן) against me.” All of these are expressions of gathering.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 31:4:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:4:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:4:4)


**לֹא יַעֲנֶה.** לֹא יִכָּנַע, לֹא יַעֲשֶׂה עַצְמוֹ עָנִי, וְכֵן ״לַעֲנֹת מִפָּנַי״ (שמות י:ג), וְכֵן ״וְעָנָה גְאוֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל״ (הושע ה:ה):


**he is not subdued** (יַעֲנֶה) he will not humble himself, he will not make himself as a poor man. Comp. (Exodus 10:3) “To humble yourself (לֵעָנוֹת) from before Me.” Comp. also (Hosea 5:5) “And the pride of Israel shall be humbled (וְעָנָה).”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 31:4:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:4:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:4:5)


**כֵּן יֵרֵד.** וְלֹא יִפְחַד מֵהֲמוֹן הָאֻמּוֹת:


**so shall...descend** (This intimates that God will descend) and will not be afraid of the stirring (or the multitude) of the nations.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 31:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:5:1)


**פָּסֹחַ.** דִּלּוּג, וְיֵשׁ עוֹד לְפָתְרוֹ לְשׁוֹן ׳חַיִּס׳ (מכילתא בא פסחא יא):


**passing over** (פָּסוֹחַ) passing over. Alternatively, it may be interpreted as an expression of sparing.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 31:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:5:2)


**וְהִמְלִיט.** יוֹצִיא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן הַצָּרָה, לְשׁוֹן ׳הַמְלָטָה׳, אישקמוציי״ר בלע״ז:


**and rescuing** He will extricate Israel from the strait. This is an expression of rescue (esmoucer in O. F.).



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 31:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:6:1)


**שׁוּבוּ.** לְמִי שֶׁהֶעֱמַקְתֶּם מַחֲשָׁבוֹת הֵיאַךְ לָסוּר מִמֶּנּוּ, וְסַרְתֶּם מֵעָלָיו, עַתָּה שׁוּבוּ אֵלָיו:


**Return** To the One about Whom you have thought deeply how to turn away from Him, now return to Him.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 31:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:9:1)

**And his rock shall pass from fear** And his strength shall be weakened from great fear.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 31:9:2

**וְחַתּוּ מִנֵּס.** מִפְּנֵי הַנִּסִּים, שֶׁיִּרְאוּ שֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא עוֹשֶׂה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל:


**shall be dismayed at the miracle** Because of the great miracles that the Holy One, blessed be He, performs for Israel.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 31:9:3

**אֲשֶׁר אוּר לוֹ בְּצִיּוֹן.** שָׁם יִהְיֶה הָאֵשׁ מוּכָן לְשָׂרְפָם:


**whose fire is in Zion** There the fire will be prepared to burn them.



## Chapter 32


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:1:1)


**הֵן לְצֶדֶק יִמְלָךְ מֶלֶךְ.** הֵן אֵין מִשְׁפַּט מֶלֶךְ לִמְלוֹךְ, כִּי אִם לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפַּט צֶדֶק:


**Behold, for righteousness shall a king reign** Behold a king has no right to reign except to execute righteous judgment.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:1:2)


**וּלְשָׂרִים לְמִשְׁפָּט יָשֹׂרוּ.** וְעַל מִי יֵשׁ לוֹ לִמְלוֹךְ? עַל שָׂרִים אֲשֶׁר לְמִשְׁפָּט יָשֹׂרוּ. וְאָמַר הַנָּבִיא זֹאת עַל אָחָז שֶׁהָיָה רָשָׁע, אֲבָל חִזְקִיָּהוּ בְּנוֹ יִמְלוֹךְ, וּכְדַאי הוּא:


**and over princes who rule with justice** And over whom should he reign? Over princes who rule with justice. The prophet says this concerning Ahaz, who was a wicked man, but Hezekiah his son shall rule, and he is worthy. ([Manuscripts read:] And he is worthy of reigning.)



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:2:1)


**וְהָיָה אִישׁ.** הַגִּבּוֹר בְּיִרְאַת הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, הוּא חִזְקִיָּה, יִהְיֶה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל:


**And the man shall be** The hero in the fear of the Holy One, blessed be He - that is Hezekiah - shall be for Israel.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:2:2)


**כְּמַחֲבֵא רוּחַ.** כְּמַחֲסֵה סֶלַע, שֶׁנֶּחְבָּאִים בּוֹ מִפְּנֵי רוּחַ, וְנִסְתָּרִים שָׁם מִפְּנֵי חֹרֶב, כֵּן יִבְטְחוּ בּוֹ הַנּוֹתָרִים מֵעֲשֶׂרֶת הַשְּׁבָטִים:


**as a hiding place from the wind** As a shelter of a rock, where people hide because of the wind, and they hide there because of the heat ([mss. read:] because of the rain), so will those remaining from the ten tribes trust in him.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:2:3)


**בְּצָיוֹן.** לְשׁוֹן ׳יֹבֶשׁ׳, צִיָּה:


**in an arid land.** (בְּצָיוֹן) an expression of dryness, desolation (צִיָּה).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:2:4)


**כְּצֵל סֶלַע כָּבֵד בְּאֶרֶץ עֲיֵפָה.** בִּמְקוֹם שֶׁמֶשׁ, שֶׁהָאָרֶץ עֲיֵפָה שָׁם וַחֲרֵבָה, וּתְאֵבָה לַצֵּל:


**as the shade of a huge rock in a weary land** In a sunny place, where the earth is weary and dry and yearning for shade.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:3:1)


**וְלֹא תִשְׁעֶינָה עֵינֵי רֹאִים.** לֹא כְּמוֹת שֶׁהֵם עַכְשָׁיו ״אָזְנָיו הַכְבֵּד וְעֵינָיו הָשַׁע״ (ישעיהו ו:י), לְשׁוֹן ׳טוּחַ׳:


**And the eyes of them that see shall not be sealed** (Heb. תִשְׁעֶינָה) Not as they are now, that “his ears are becoming heavy, and his eyes are becoming sealed (הָשַׁע)” (supra 6:10), an expression of sealing.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:4:1)


**וּלְבַב נִמְהָרִים יָבִין לָדָעַת.** לֹא כְּמוֹ שֶׁעַכְשָׁיו ״הַשְׁמֵן לֵב הָעָם״ (ישעיהו ו:י):


**And the heart of the hasty shall understand to know** Not like now, that “this people’s heart is becoming fat” (ibid.).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:4:2)


**וּלְשׁוֹן עִלְּגִים וְגוֹ׳.** וְלֹא כְּמוֹ שֶׁעַכְשָׁיו, ״כִּי בְּלַעֲגֵי שָׂפָה״ (ישעיהו כח:יא):


**and the tongue of the stammerers, etc.** Not like now, “for with distorted speech” (supra 28:11).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:4:3)


**עִלְּגִים.** כָּל מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ יוֹדֵעַ לְכַוֵּן דִּבּוּרוֹ לִהְיוֹת צַח, קָרוּי ׳עִלֵּג׳ וְ׳נִלְעָג׳:


**stammerers** Anyone who does not know how to direct his speech to be clear is termed עִלֵּג or נִלְעַג.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:5:1)


**וּלְכִילַי.** רַמַּאי, נוֹכֵל, חוֹרֵשׁ רָעִים:


**deceitful** (כִּילַי) a plotting deceiver, who plots evil.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:5:2)


**שׁוֹעַ.** לְשׁוֹן ׳אָדוֹן׳, שֶׁהַכֹּל שׁוֹעִין וּפוֹנִין אֵלָיו:


**noble** (שׁוּעַ) an expression of a lord, to whom everyone turns (שׁוֹעִין).



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:6:1)


**נְבָלָה יְדַבֵּר.** מְדַבֵּר, לָשׁוֹן הוֹוֶה הוּא:


**speaks villainy** (יְדַבֵּר) like מְדַבֵּר, a present tense.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:6:2)


**יַעֲשֶׂה אָוֶן.** יְקַבֵּץ מַחְשְׁבוֹת אָוֶן, כְּמוֹ (דברים ח:יז) ״עָשָׂה לִי הַחַיִל הַזֶּה״:


**works iniquity** (יַעֲשֶׂה) Gathers thoughts of iniquity. Comp. (Deut. 8:17) “Gathered (עָשָׂה) for me this wealth.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:6:3)


**לַעֲשׂוֹת חֹנֶף.** חוֹשֵׁב מַחֲשָׁבוֹת אֵיךְ יוּכַל לַעֲשׂוֹת חֲנוּפָה. ׳חֹנֶף׳ שֵׁם דָּבָר, לְכָךְ טַעְמוֹ לְמַעְלָה, וְנָקוּד פַּתַּח:


**to practice flattery** (לֲַעֲשׂוֹת) He thinks thoughts how he can practice flattery. חֹנֵף is a noun; therefore, the accent is on the first syllable, it is vowelized with a ‘pattah’ (now called a ‘segol’).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:6:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:6:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:6:4)


**וּמַשְׁקֵה צָמֵא יַחְסִיר.** לְפִי פְּשׁוּטוֹ, שֶׁגּוֹזְלִין הָעֲנִיִּים. וְתַרְגּוּמוֹ: ״פִּתְגָמֵי אוֹרַיְיתָא דְּאִינּוּן כְּמַיָּא לְצָחְיָא מְדַמָּן לְבַטָּלָא״:


**and the drink of the thirsty he causes to fail** According to the simple meaning, they rob the poor. The Targum, (however, paraphrases:) The words of the Torah, which are like water to the thirsty, they plan to nullify.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:7:1)


**וּבְדַבֵּר אֶבְיוֹן מִשְׁפָּט.** לְחַבֵּל אֶבְיוֹן בְּמִשְׁפָּטוֹ, **מִשְׁפָּט** זֶה לְשׁוֹן תְּחִלַּת דְּבָרִים בְּמִשְׁפָּט; כְּשֶׁמְּדַבֵּר הָאֶבְיוֹן טַעֲנוֹתָיו, זֶה יוֹעֵץ מְזִמּוֹת לְהַכְשִׁילוֹ בְּנִכְלָיו. ׳מִשְׁפָּט׳ מְשַׁמֵּשׁ שְׁלֹשָׁה לְשׁוֹנוֹת: תְּחִלַּת טַעֲנוֹת דשריינמנ״ט בלע״ז, וּגְמַר הַדִּין יואיימנ״ט בלע״ז, וּמִשְׁטָר שֶׁשּׁוֹטְרִין אוֹתוֹ בְּיִסּוּרִין יושטיצ״א בלע״ז:


**and when the needy speaks a plea** (מִשְׁפָּט) To destroy the needy in his plea (מִשְׁפָּטוֹ). This word מִשְׁפָּט is an expression denoting the initial presentation of the case; when the needy presents his pleas, this one plans wicked plots to trap him with his devices. The word מִשְׁפָּט has three meanings: the initial pleas (derajjsnement in O.F.), the sentence (joujjment), and the execution of the verdict, that they discipline him with chastisement (joustize in O.F.).



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:8:1)


**עַל נְדִיבוֹת יָקוּם.** בִּשְׁבִיל נְדִיבוֹתָיו תִּהְיֶה לוֹ תְּקוּמָה:


**because of generous deeds, shall stand** Because of his generous acts, he will have preservation.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:9:1)


**נָשִׁים שַׁאֲנַנּוֹת.** ״מְדִינָן דְּיָתְבָן שַׁלְיָן״ (תרגום יונתן):


**Complacent women** Provinces that dwell in tranquility [from Jonathan].


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:9:2)


**בָּנוֹת בֹּטְחוֹת.** ״כַּרְכִּין דְּיָתְבִין לְרוּחְצָן״ (תרגום יונתן):


**confident daughters** Walled cities that dwell confidently [from Jonathan].



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:10:1)


**יָמִים עַל שָׁנָה.** כְּמוֹ ״סְפוּ שָׁנָה עַל שָׁנָה״ (ישעיהו כט:א), וְתָמִיד עֲוֹנוֹתֵיכֶם מִתְגַּבְּרִין, וְסוֹף **תִּרְגַּזְנָה** אֵלּוּ שֶׁהֵן עַכְשָׁיו לָבֶטַח, כִּי יִכְלֶה מֵהֶם **בָצִיר** הָעֲנָבִים, וְ**אֹסֶף** הַתְּבוּאָה לֹא **יָבוֹא** אֶל הַבַּיִת:


**Year after year** (lit., ‘days upon a year.’) Comp. (supra 29:1) “Add year to year,” and your sins are constantly becoming more serious, until eventually you shall be troubled, those who are now confident, for the vintage of the grapes shall be over for them, and the ingathering of the grain shall not come into the house.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:10:2)


**אֹסֶף.** שֵׁם דָּבָר, לְכָךְ טַעְמוֹ לְמַעְלָה, וְנָקוּד פַּתַּח:


**the ingathering** (אֹסֶף) This is a noun; therefore, its accent is on the first syllable and it is vowelized with a ‘pattah’ (now called a ‘segol’).



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:11:1)


**רְגָזָה.** כְּמוֹ ׳לִרְגֹּז׳:


**to be troubled** (רְגָזָה) to be troubled. (This is an infinitive despite the absence of the ‘lammed.’)


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:11:2)


**פְּשֹׁטָה.** כְּמוֹ ׳לִפְשֹׁט׳:


**to undress** (פְּשֹׁטָה) to undress. (This too is an infinitive with the ‘lammed’ missing.)


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:11:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:11:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:11:3)


**וְעֹרָה.** כְּמוֹ ׳לַעֲרוֹת׳, לְשׁוֹן ״עֶרְיָה״ (מיכה א:יא):


**and to bare** (וְעֹרָה) An expression of ‘naked’ (עֶרְיָה) (Micah 1:11).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:11:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:11:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:11:4)


**וַחֲגוֹרָה.** כְּמוֹ ׳לַחֲגוֹר׳, לְכָךְ טַעֲמוֹ לְמַעְלָה. וְכֵן תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן: ״שְׁלַחוּ אִיתְעַרְטִילוּ וְאִסְרוּ עַל חַרְצִין״, מִתּוֹךְ שֶׁיִּפְשְׁטוּ וְיִתְעָרְמוּ מִבִּגְדֵיהֶם, לֹא יַחְגְּרוּ עַל בִּגְדֵיהֶם, כִּי עַל מָתְנֵיהֶם:


**and to gird** (וַחֲגוֹרָה) Therefore, the accent is before the last syllable, and so did Jonathan render: Undress and bare yourselves and gird on your loins. Since they will undress and bare themselves of their garments, they will not gird on their garments but on their loins.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:12:1)


**עַל שָׁדַיִם סֹפְדִים.** יְטַפְּחוּ עַל לִבָּם:


**on the breasts, lamenting** They shall beat their heart.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:12:2)


**עַל שְׂדֵי חֶמֶד.** עַל שְׂדוֹת חֶמְדָּתָן (מועד קטן כז ב). וּמִדְרַשׁ אַגָּדָה (איכה רבה פתיחתא כד): עַל חַכְמֵי סַנְהֶדְרָאוֹת, שֶׁהֵם כְּשָׁדַיִם הַמֵּינִיקִים יִסְפְּדוּ, וְעַל עִיר חֶמְדָּתָן שֶׁתֵּחָרֵשׁ כְּשָׂדֶה, וְ**עַל גֶּפֶן פֹּרִיָּה** הֵם יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁנִּקְרְאוּ גֶפֶן, כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״גֶּפֶן מִמִּצְרַיִם תַּסִּיעַ״ (תהלים פ:ט):


**for the desirable fields** For the fields of their desire. The Midrash Aggadah (See twenty-fourth poem to Lamentations Rabbah) states: For the sages of the Sanhedrin, who are like breasts that nurture, they will lament, and for the city of their desire that will be plowed up like a field, and for the fruitful - vine that is Israel, called a vine, as it is said (Psalms 80:9): “You plucked a vine out of Egypt.”



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:13:1)


**קוֹץ שָׁמִיר.** ״הוּבֵאִי וּבוּר״, כִּי כָּל חֻרְבָּן זֶה יִהְיֶה **עַל כָּל בָּתֵּי מָשׂוֹשׂ** וְעַל **קִרְיָה עַלִּיזָה**, יְרוּשָׁלַיִם שֶׁהִיא ״מָשׂוֹשׂ לְכָל הָאָרֶץ״ (איכה ב:טו):


**Thorns and briers** The Targum renders: הוּבֵאִי וּבוּר various types of thorns, for all this destruction shall be on all houses of joy, and on **the joyful city** Jerusalem, which is “the joy of all the land” (Lamentations 2:15).



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:14:1)


**כִּי אַרְמוֹן.** הֵיכַל הַמֶּלֶךְ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה **נֻטַּשׁ**:


**For the palace** The king’s palace has been forsaken.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:14:2)


**וַהֲמוֹן עִיר** גָּלָה:


**the multitude of the city** has been exiled.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:14:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:14:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:14:3)


**עֹפֶל וָבַחַן.** בֵּית מִקְדָּשִׁי, שֶׁהָיָה לָהֶם לְמִבְצָר:


**rampart and tower** My Temple, which was a fortification for them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:14:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:14:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:14:4)


**הָיָה בְעַד מְעָרוֹת.** יִהְיֶה בְּתוֹךְ חֻרְבּוֹת. מְעָרוֹת לָשׁוֹן ״עָרוּ עָרוּ״ (תהילים קלז:ז), וּ**בְעַד** כְּמוֹ ״הַבְעַד עֲרָפֶל יִשְׁפּוֹט״ (איוב כב:יג):


**are amidst ruins** (הָיָה בְּעַד מְעָרוֹת), shall be amidst ruins. מְעָרוֹת is an expression similar to (Psalms 137:7) “Raze it, raze it (עָרוּ עָרוּ).” בְּעַד is like “(Job 22:13) Can He judge through (הַבְעַד) a thick cloud?”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:14:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:14:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:14:5)


**עַד עוֹלָם.** עַד עֵת קֵץ. **עֹפֶל וָבַחַן** – שְׁנֵיהֶם לְשׁוֹן ׳מִבְצָר׳:


**forever** Until the time of the end.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:14:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:14:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:14:6)


**מְשׂוֹשׂ פְּרָאִים.** לְתַאֲוַת יִשְׁמָעֵאל וּלְמִרְעֶה אֱדוֹם וַחֲיָלוֹתָיו:


**a joy for wild donkeys** For the lust of Ishmael and his hosts.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:15:1)


**עַד יֵעָרֶה עָלֵינוּ.** יִשְׁפּוֹךְ עָלֵינוּ, כְּמוֹ ״וַתְּעַר כַּדָּהּ״ (בראשית כד:כ). לְשׁוֹן ׳שְׁפִיכָה׳ נוֹפֵל עַל הָרוּחַ, כְּמוֹ ״וְשָׁפַכְתִּי עַל בֵּית דָּוִד רוּחַ חֵן״ (זכריה יב:י), וְכֵן ״אֶשְׁפּוֹךְ רוּחִי עַל כָּל בָּשָׂר״ (יואל ג:א):


**Until...be poured upon us** (יֵעָרֶה) He shall pour upon us. Comp. (Gen. 24:2) “And she emptied (וַתְּעַר) her pitcher.” An expression of pouring applies to spirit. Comp. (Zech. 12:10) “And I will pour upon the house of David...a spirit of grace.” Comp. also (Joel 3:1) “I will pour My spirit upon all flesh.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:15:2)


**לַיַּעַר יֵחָשֵׁב.** ״קִירְוִין סַגִּיאִין״, כַּיַּעַר הַזֶּה שֶׁהוּא מָלֵא עֵצִים:


**shall be regarded as a forest** (Jonathan renders:) Great cities, like this forest, which is full of trees.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:16:1)


**וְשָׁכַן בַּמִּדְבָּר מִשְׁפָּט.** בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם, שֶׁהִיא כְּמִדְבָּר:


**And justice shall dwell in the desert** In Jerusalem, which is like a desert.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:16:2)


**וּצְדָקָה בַּכַּרְמֶל.** הִיא אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל, שֶׁתְּהֵא בְּאוֹתָן הַיָּמִים כַּכַּרְמֶל:


**and righteousness shall reside in the fruitful field** That is the land of Israel, which in those days shall be like a fruitful field.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:19:1)


**וּבָרַד בְּרֶדֶת הַיָּעַר.** עַל כָּרְחֲךָ אֵין ׳בָּרַד׳ זֶה שֵׁם דָּבָר, שֶׁהֲרֵי נָקוּד חֶצְיוֹ קָמַץ וְחֶצְיוֹ פַּתַּח בִּלְשׁוֹן ׳פָּעַל׳, וְכֵן פִּתְרוֹנוֹ לְשׁוֹן ׳פְּעוּלָה׳, כְּמוֹ ׳וְרָחַץ׳ וְ׳יָשַׁב׳ וְ׳עָמַד׳, וּבָרַד וְיִבְרוֹד אֶת בְּרִידַת הַיַּעַר, וְיִהְיֶה הַבֵּי״ת שֶׁל ׳בְּרֶדֶת׳ מִן יְסוֹד כְּמוֹ ׳עֲטֶרֶת׳ ׳עֲקֶרֶת׳, כְּלוֹמַר: וְיַמְטִיר הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אֶת מְטַר פַּחֵי הָרְשָׁעִים שֶׁהֵם עַכְשָׁיו בְּנוּיִים וּמְלֵאִים עָרִים כְּיַעַר:


**And He shall hail down the hailing of the forest** (וּבָרַד בְּרֶדֶתהַיָּעַר) Perforce, this word וּבָרָד is not a noun, since half of it is vowelized with a ‘kamatz’ and half of it with a ‘pattah’ in an expression of פָּעַל. (Rashi distinguishes בָּרַד from בָּרָד, the noun denoting hail.) And so is its interpretation, an expression of an action, like ‘and he shall wash’ (וְרָחַץ), ‘and he shall sit’ (וְיָשַׁב), ‘and he shall stand’ (וְעָמַד). Here too, וּבָרַד ‘and He shall hail down the hailing of the forest.’ Then the ‘beth’ of בְּרֶדֶת is a radical, like עֲטֶרֶת, ‘a crown,’ עֲקֶרֶת ‘a barren woman.’ That is to say that the Holy One, blessed be He, shall rain down the rain of the coals of the wicked, those who are now built up and full of cities like a forest.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:19:2)


**וּבַשִּׁפְלָה.** שֶׁנִּשְׁפְּלוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד עַכְשָׁיו:


**and into the low state** Into which Israel has been humbled until now,


###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:19:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:19:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:19:3)


**תִּשְׁפַּל הָעִיר.** מֶטְרוֹפּוֹלִין שֶׁל פָּרַס, וְדֻגְמָא כֵּן תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן: ״וְיֵחוֹת בַּרְדָּא וְיִקְטוֹל מַשְׁרְיַית עַמְמַיָּא״:


**shall the metropolis** of Persia (Seir, Edom, [according to various mss.]) **be humbled.** In a similar manner did Jonathan render it: And hail will come down and kill the camps of the nations.



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Isaiah 32:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:20:1)


**אַשְׁרֵיכֶם** יִשְׂרָאֵל, שֶׁהִצְלִיחָה זְרִיעַת צִדְקַתְכֶם כְּזוֹרְעִים **עַל מָיִם**, מֵעַתָּה תִּקְצְרוּ וְתַאַסְפוּ תְּבוּאַת שְׂכַרְכֶם הַטּוֹב. תְּשַׁלְּחוּ **רֶגֶל הַשּׁוֹר** לָדוּשׁ הַתְּבוּאָה, **וְהַחֲמוֹר** לְהָבִיא אֶל הַבַּיִת. כָּךְ תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן, כְּלוֹמַר: תְּקַבְּלוּ שְׂכַר פְּעֻלַּתְכֶם הַטּוֹבָה:


**Fortunate are you** Israel, that the sowing of your righteousness has succeeded like those who sow by all waters. From now on, you shall reap and gather the grain of your good reward; you shall send forth the feet of the ox to thresh the grain, and the donkey to bring it into the house. So did Jonathan render it: You shall receive the reward of your good work.



## Chapter 33


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:1:1)


**הוֹי.** הָאוֹיֵב, שֶׁאַתָּה **שׁוֹדֵד** תָּמִיד **וְאַתָּה לֹא שָׁדוּד, וּבוֹגֵד** אַתָּה תָּמִיד, וְאֵין אָדָם בּוֹגְדְךָ וּבוֹזְזְךָ:


**Woe** To the enemy, that you constantly spoil, but you are not spoiled, and you constantly deal treacherously, but no man deals treacherously with you or spoils you.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:1:2)


**כַּהֲתִמְךָ.** לִהְיוֹת **שׁוֹדֵד**, כְּכַלּוֹתְךָ שְׁדִידָתְךָ בְּאוֹתָם שֶׁנִּגְזְרָה גְּזֵרָה עֲלֵיהֶם לִהְיוֹת שְׁדוּדִים עַל יָדְךָ, **תּוּשַּׁד**:


**when you finish** being a spoiler, when you finish your spoiling of those upon whom it was decreed to be spoiled by you, you shall be spoiled.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:1:3)


**כַּנְּלֹתְךָ לִבְגֹּד.** מְנַחֵם חִבֵּר ׳כַּנְּלֹתְךָ׳ עִם ״לֹא יִטֶּה לָאָרֶץ מִנְלָם״ (איוב טו:כט) בְּחֵלֶק אֶחָד, וּ׳מִנְלָם׳ הַמֵּ״ם הָרִאשׁוֹנָה בּוֹ יְסוֹד נוֹפֵל, כְּמוֹ מֵ״ם שֶׁל ׳מַאֲמָר׳ וְשֶׁל ׳מַדָּע׳. וְיִתָּכֵן לִהְיוֹת לְשׁוֹן ׳כִּלָּיוֹן׳ לְפִי הָעִנְיָן:


**when you finish dealing treacherously** (כַּנְּלֹתְךָ) Menahem classified כַּנְלֹתְךָ with (Job 15: 29) “And their destruction (מִנְלָם) shall not fall to the earth,” in one group (Machbereth Menahem, p. 123). In the word מִנְלָם, the first ‘mem’ is a radical which sometimes is absent, like the ‘mem’ of מַאֲמָר, a statement, and of מַדָּע, knowledge, and it is possibly an expression of ending, according to the context.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:1:4)


**כַּנְּלֹתְךָ.** לְשׁוֹן ׳כַּכְּלוֹתְךָ׳, ״וְלֹא יִטֶּה לָאָרֶץ מִנְּלָם״ (שמואל ב יד:יד) – כִּלָּיוֹן הַנִּגְזָר עֲלֵיהֶם לֹא יִטֶּה לָאָרֶץ לִהְיוֹת בָּטֵל וְהוֹלֵךְ, אֶלָּא הוֹלֵךְ וְחָזָק:


כַּנְּלֹתְךָ is an expression of ‘when you finish.’ “And מִנְלָם shall not fall to the earth,” the destruction decreed upon them shall not fall to the earth to become progressively void, but will become progressively stronger.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:2:1)


**הֱיֵה זְרֹעָם.** שֶׁל שְׁדוּדִים בְּיַד הַשּׁוֹדֵד:


**Be their arm** of the spoiled ones in the hand of the spoiler. (Note that we followed other editions of Rashi. Nach Lublin is erroneous in this passage.)


###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:2:2)


**לַבְּקָרִים.** מִדֵּי יוֹם יוֹם, כְּשֶׁהוּא מֵצֵר לָהֶם, **אַף יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ** תִּהְיֶה **בְּעֵת צָרָה**:


**every morning** Daily, when they are in straits, also You be our salvation in time of trouble.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:3:1)


**מִקּוֹל הָמוֹן**, הַבָּא מִלְּפָנֶיךָ, **נָדְדוּ עַמִּים** עַד הֵנָּה, כְּשֶׁהִפְלֵאתָ לָנוּ נִסֶּיךָ:


**From the sound of roaring** that emanated from before You, peoples wandered until here when You performed wondrous miracles for us.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:4:1)


**וְאֻסַּף שְׁלַלְכֶם.** זֶה מוּסָב עַל ״כַּנְּלֹתְךָ לִבְגֹּד יִבְגְּדוּ בָךְ״ (ישעיהו לג:א). **וְאֻסַּף שְׁלַלְכֶם** – אַתֶּם הַבּוֹגְדִים אֶת עַמִּי, בְּבֹא פְּקֻדַּתְכֶם יָבֹזּוּ אֶתְכֶם שְׁאֵרִית עַמִּי, וְיַאַסְפוּ שְׁלַלְכֶם כַּאֲסִיפַת חָסִיל, שֶׁאוֹסֵף לוֹ תְּבוּאָה בַּקַּיִץ, כָּל אֶחָד לְעַצְמוֹ, אַף כָּאן יָבֹזּוּ אִישׁ לוֹ:


**And your booty shall be gathered** This refers back to “when you finish dealing treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with you,” and your booty, you, who spoil My people, when your reckoning comes, the remnant of My people shall plunder you and gather your booty like the gathering of locusts, each one of whom gathers grain for himself in summer; here too, each one will plunder for himself.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:4:2)


**כְּמַשַּׁק גֵּבִים שׁוֹקֵק.** כְּקוֹל נַהַם מַיִם הַנֶּאֱסָפִים וְנוֹפְלִין בַּ**גֵּבִים** בְּנַהַם, כֵּן יִנְהֲמוּ הַבָּאִים לִשְׁלוֹל וְלָבֹז. **מַשַּׁק** לְשׁוֹן ׳נַהַם׳, כְּמוֹ (משלי כח:טו) ״אֲרִי נוֹהֵם וְדֹב שׁוֹקֵק״, וְכֵן ״מִמְשַׁק חָרוּל״ (צפניה ב:ט) – כְּשֶׁהָרוּחַ מְנַשֶּׁבֶת בַּחֲרוּלִים וְהֵם מַכִּים זֶה עַל זֶה נוֹתְנִים קוֹל, וְכֵן ״בָּעִיר יְשֹׁקּוּ״ (יואל ב:ט):


**like the roaring of the cisterns** Like the sound of the roar of water gathering and falling into the cisterns in the river, so will those coming to plunder and pillage, roar. מַשַּׁק is an expression of roaring. Comp. (Prov. 28:15) “A roaring lion and a growling (שׁוֹקֵק) bear.” Also (Zeph. 2:9), “The noise (מִמְשַׁק) of the thorns.” When the wind blows on the thorns, and they knock against one another, they produce a sound. Comp. also, (Joel 2:9) “In the city they roar (יָשֹׁקּוּ).”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:4:3)


**גֵּבִים.** כְּמוֹ ״לַחְשֹׂף מַיִם מִגֶּבֶא״ (ישעיהו ל:יד), וְרַבּוֹתֵינוּ דְּרָשׁוּהוּ בְּאַגָּדַת חֵלֶק (סנהדרין צד ב) בְּבִזַּת אֻכְלוּסֵי סַנְחֵרִיב:


**cisterns** (גֵּבִים) like (supra 30: 14) “or to scoop water from a cistern (מִגֶּבֶא).” Our Sages expounded it in the Aggadah of Chapter Chelek (San. 94b) as referring to the booty of Sennacherib’s soldiers.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:5:1)


**כִּי שֹׁכֵן מָרוֹם.** הֶרְאָה גְּבוּרָתוֹ, שֶׁהוּא רָם עַל כֹּל וְיָדוֹ עַל הָעֶלְיוֹנָה:


**for He dwells on high** He demonstrated His might, that He is exalted above all, and He has the upper hand.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:6:1)


**וְהָיָה אֱמוּנַת עִתֶּיךָ וגו׳.** וְהָיָה לְ**חֹסֶן יְשׁוּעוֹת** וּלְחָכְמָה **וָדַעַת** אֶת אֲשֶׁר תַּאֲמִין לְבוֹרְאָךְ עִתִּים שֶׁקָּבַע לָךְ לִתְרוּמוֹת וּלְמַעַשְׂרוֹת בְּעֵת הַפְרָשָׁתָן, לְלֶקֶט שִׁכְחָה וּפֵאָה בְּעִתָּם, לְקַיֵּם שְׁמִטִּין וְיוֹבְלוֹת בְּעִתָּם. דָּבָר אַחֵר **אֱמוּנַת עִתֶּךָ,** אֶת שֶׁהֶאֱמַנְתָּ בְּהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא בְּעִתִּים שֶׁעָבְרוּ עָלֶיךָ וְצִפִּיתָ לִישׁוּעָה תִּהְיֶה לְךָ לְ**חֹסֶן**:


**And the faith of your times, etc.** And it shall be for you for strength of salvations and for wisdom and knowledge, that you will be faithful to your Creator concerning the times that He set for you for terumoth and tithes at the time of their separation, for gleanings, forgotten sheaves, and the corner of the field in their time, to leave them over for the poor, to keep release years and jubilee years in their time. Another explanation is: **faith of your times** What you believed in the Holy One, blessed be He, in times that passed over you, and you hoped for salvation, shall become your strength.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:6:2)


**יִרְאַת ה׳.** שֶׁתִּירָא מִלְּפָנָיו, **הִיא** אוֹצָר טוֹב לְהִפָּתַח לְךָ מֵאִתּוֹ עַל יָדָהּ:


**fear of the Lord** That you shall fear Him - that is a good treasure to open up for you from before Him.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:7:1)


**הֵן אֶרְאֶלָּם צָעֲקוּ חוּצָה.** הָיָה הַנָּבִיא מִתְנַבֵּא נֶחָמוֹת וְאוֹמֵר, שֶׁהַפֻּרְעָנוּת כְּבָר אֲכָלוּהוּ, וּמֵעַתָּה אָקוּם וְאֶנָּשֵׂא לְגָאֳלָם. הֵן עַל אֲרְאֵלִים שֶׁלָּהֶם, הוּא הַמִּזְבֵּחַ (ישעיהו כט:א), כְּבָר **צָעֲקוּ** וְסָפְדוּ בְּחוּצוֹתָם וּבִרְחוֹבוֹת בִּבְכִי וְנֶהִי:


**Behold [for] their altar they have cried in the street** The prophet was prophesying consolations and saying that the retribution had already been completed, and from now I will rise and exalt Myself to redeem them. Behold for their Arel - that is the altar (see above 29:1) - they have already cried and lamented in their streets and in their squares with weeping and wailing.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:7:2)


**מַלְאֲכֵי שָׁלוֹם.** מַלְאֲכֵי שְׁלִיחוּתָם, שֶׁהָיוּ רְגִילִין לְבַשֵּׂר שָׁלוֹם, **מַר יִבְכָּיוּן**, וְאוֹמְרִים: ״נָשַׁמּוּ מְסִלּוֹת שָׁבַת עוֹבֵר אוֹרַח״:


**ambassadors of peace** And the ambassadors whom they send, who were wont to bring tidings of peace, cry bitterly and say, “Highways have become desolate, the wayfarer has stopped.”



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:8:1)


**הֵפֵר.** הָאוֹיֵב **בְּרִית** שֶׁכָּרַת לְיִשְׂרָאֵל:


**he has abrogated the treaty** The enemy has abrogated the treaty he made with Israel.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:8:2)


**מָאַס עָרִים.** בִּזָּה בְּעֵינָיו כָּל שׂוֹנֵא, אֵינוֹ חוֹשֵׁב **אֱנוֹשׁ**:


**despised cities** He despised in his eyes; no enemy considers any man.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:9:1)


**אָבַל.** לְשׁוֹן ׳אֲבֵלוּת׳:


**mourns** (אָבֵל) an expression of mourning.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:9:2)


**קָמַל.** יָבֵשׁ וְנִכְרַת:


**it was cut off** Dried and cut off.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:9:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:9:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:9:3)


**הָיָה.** לְשׁוֹן עָבָר הוּא:


**became** (הָיָה, lit. was.) This is the past tense.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:9:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:9:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:9:4)


**הַשָּׁרוֹן.** שֵׁם מָחוֹז מִרְעֶה בְּהֵמוֹת, כְּמוֹ שֶׁשָּׁנִינוּ (מנחות פז א): אֵילִים מִמּוֹאָב, עֲגָלִים מִשָּׁרוֹן:


**the Sharon** The name of a region of pasture for animals, as we learned (Men. 87a): Rams from Moab, calves from Sharon.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:9:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:9:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:9:5)


**כָּעֲרָבָה.** חֻרְבָּה:


**like the plain** a ruin.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:9:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:9:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:9:6)


**וְנֹעֵר.** לְשׁוֹן ״תִּשְׁנוֹק״, כְּמוֹ ״וַיְנַעֵר ה׳״ (שמות יד:כז):


**have become emptied** (וְנֹעֵר) An expression of shaking out. Comp. (Ex. 14:27): “And the Lord shook (וַיְנַעֵר).”



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:10:1)


**עַתָּה אָקוּם.** מֵרֹב רָעוֹת שֶׁעָשָׂה הָאוֹיֵב לְעַמִּי, לֹא אֶתְאַפַּק עוֹד, **עַתָּה אָקוּם** וְ**אֵרוֹמָם וְאֶנָּשֵׂא**:


**Now I will rise** Because of the many evils the enemy perpetrated against My people, I will no longer restrain Myself; now I will rise, be raised and be exalted.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:11:1)


**חֲשַׁשׁ.** מִין מוֹץ; דָּבָר שֶׁנּוֹחַ לִדָּלֵק:


**chaff** (חֲשַׁשׁ) a kind of chaff, something that is easily ignited.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:11:2)


**רוּחֲכֶם אֵשׁ.** מִגּוּפְכֶם תֵּצֵא רוּחַ **אֵשׁ** וְתֹאכַל הֶחָשַׁשׁ וְהַקַּשׁ:


**your breath is fire** From your body shall emanate breath of fire and will consume the chaff and the stubble.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:12:1)


**כְּסוּחִים.** קְצוּצִים, כְּסוּחִים כְּמוֹ (ויקרא כה:ד) ״לֹא תִזְמֹר״ תַּרְגּוּם אוֹנְקְלוֹס ״לָא תִכְסָח״:


**severed** (כְּסוּחִים) Comp. (Lev. 25:4) “You shall not prune.” Onkelos renders: לָא תִכְסָח.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:13:1)


**רְחוֹקִים.** הַמַּאֲמִינִים בִּי וְעוֹשִׂים רְצוֹנִי מִנְּעוּרֵיהֶם:


**you far-off ones** Those who believe in Me and do My will from their youth.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:13:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:13:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:13:2)


**קְרוֹבִים.** בַּעֲלֵי תְּשׁוּבָה שֶׁנִּתְקָרְבוּ אֵלַי מֵחָדָשׁ (ברכות לד ב):


**you near ones** Repentant sinners who have recently drawn near to Me.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:14:1)


**פָּחֲדוּ בְצִיּוֹן חַטָּאִים.** הֵיאַךְ יִמְצְאוּ פֶּתַח לִתְשׁוּבָה?


**Sinners in Zion were afraid** How they would find an opening to repent.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:14:2)


**מִי יָגוּר לָנוּ אֵשׁ אוֹכֵלָה.** כְּלוֹמַר, מִי יַעֲמוֹד בַּעֲדֵנוּ לְשַׁכֵּךְ חֵמָה בּוֹעֶרֶת? לָשׁוֹן אַחֵר: **מִי יָגוּר לָנוּ**, פֵּרוּשׁ: מִי הוּא לָנוּ שֶׁיָּגוּר בְּצִיּוֹן עִם הַצּוּר שֶׁהוּא **אֵשׁ אוֹכֵלָה**? וְהוּא מֵשִׁיב **״אֹהֵב צְדָקוֹת וְגוֹ׳״**:


**Who will stand up for us against a consuming fire?** (lit., Who will live for us a consuming fire?) I.e., who will stand up for us to appease burning wrath? Alternatively, who among us will dwell, i.e., who among us will dwell in Zion with the Rock, Who is a consuming fire? And he replies, “He who walks righteously, etc.”



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:15:1)


**הוֹלֵךְ צְדָקוֹת.** מִי הוּא יִמָּצֵא הוֹלֵךְ צְדָקוֹת?


**He who walks righteously** Who will be found? One who walks righteously.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 33:15:2
