### Verse 24

###### Rashi on Isaiah 40:24:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:24:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:24:1)


**אַף בַּל נִטָּעוּ.** אַף הֲרֵי הֵם כְּמִי שֶׁלֹּא נִטְעוּ:


**Even [as though] they were not planted** They are even as though they were not planted.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 40:24:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:24:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:24:2)


**אַף בַּל זֹרָעוּ.** וְעוֹד יָתֵר מִכָּאן, שֶׁיְּשֹׁרְשׁוּ וְיֵעָקְרוּ כְּאִלּוּ לֹא זֹרְעוּ. זְרִיעָה פְּחוּתָה מִנְּטִיעָה:


**even [as though] they were not sown** And still more than this, that they shall be uprooted and plucked out, as if they were not sown. Sowing is less than planting.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 40:24:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:24:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:24:3)


**בַּל שֹׁרֵשׁ בָּאָרֶץ גִּזְעָם.** לִכְשֶׁיֵּעָקְרוּ, לֹא יַשְׁרִישׁ הַגֶּזַע בָּאָרֶץ, שֶׁיְּהֵא מַחֲלִיף. כָּל ׳שֹׁרֶשׁ׳ שֶׁבַּמִּקְרָא טַעְמוֹ בְּאוֹת רִאשׁוֹנָה וּנְקוּדָה הָרֵי״שׁ פַּתַּח, וְזֶה טַעְמוֹ לְמַטָּה וְנָקוּד קָמַץ, לְפִי שֶׁהוּא לְשׁוֹן פּוֹעֵל, אינרצינ״י בלע״ז:


**their trunk is not rooted in the earth** When they will be plucked out, the trunk will not take root in the ground that it will grow up anew. Every שֹׁרֶשׁ, root, in Scripture is accented on the first letter, and the ‘reish’ is vowelized with a ‘pattah’ [segol]. This one, however, is accented on the latter syllable and it is vowelized with a ‘kamatz katan’ [tzeireh] because it is a verb, present tense, [enracinant in French] being rooted.



### Verse 26

###### Rashi on Isaiah 40:26:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:26:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:26:1)


**מִי בָרָא אֵלֶּה.** כָּל הַצָּבָא אֲשֶׁר תִּרְאוּ בַּמָּרוֹם:


**who created these** All the host that you will see on high.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 40:26:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:26:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:26:2)


**מֵרֹב אוֹנִים.** שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ, וְשֶׁהוּא **אַמִּיץ כֹּחַ, אִישׁ** מֵהַצָּבָא **לֹא נֶעְדָּר** שֶׁלֹּא יִקְרָא בְּשֵׁם:


**because of His great might** that He has, and that He is strong in power, no one of His host is missing, that He does not call by name.



### Verse 27

###### Rashi on Isaiah 40:27:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:27:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:27:1)


**לָמָּה תֹאמַר** עַמִּי **יַעֲקֹב וּתְדַבֵּר** בַּגָּלוּת:


**Why should you say** My people ([K’li Paz, mss.:] the people of) Jacob, and speak in exile.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 40:27:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:27:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:27:2)


**נִסְתְּרָה דַרְכִּי מֵה׳.** הֶעְלִים מִנֶּגֶד עֵינָיו כָּל מַה שֶּׁעֲבַדְנוּהוּ, וְהִמְשִׁיל עָלֵינוּ אוֹתָם שֶׁלֹּא יְדָעוּהוּ:


**My way has been hidden from the Lord** He hid from before His eyes all that we served Him, and gave those who did not know Him, dominion over us.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 40:27:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:27:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:27:3)


**וּמֵאֱלֹהַי מִשְׁפָּטִי יַעֲבוֹר.** הֶעֱבִיר מִלְּפָנָיו מִשְׁפַּט הַגְּמוּל הַטּוֹב, שֶׁהָיָה לוֹ לְשַׁלֵּם לַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְלָנוּ:


**and from my God, my judgment passes?** He ignores the judgment of the good reward He should have paid our forefathers and us.



### Verse 28

###### Rashi on Isaiah 40:28:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:28:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:28:1)


**בּוֹרֵא קְצוֹת הָאָרֶץ וְגוֹ׳ אֵין חֵקֶר לִתְבוּנָתוֹ.** וּמִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ כֹּחַ כָּזֶה וְחָכְמָה כָּזוֹ, הוּא יוֹדֵעַ אֶת הַמַּחֲשָׁבוֹת. לָמָּה הוּא מְאַחֵר טוֹבַתְכֶם? אֶלָּא כְּדֵי לְכַלּוֹת אֶת הַפֶּשַׁע וּלְהָתֵם אֶת הַחַטָּאת עַל יְדֵי הַיִּסּוּרִין:


**the Creator of the ends of the earth...there is no fathoming His understanding** And One who has such strength and such wisdom—He knows the thoughts. Why does He delay your benefit, only to terminate the transgression and to expiate the sin through afflictions.



### Verse 29

###### Rashi on Isaiah 40:29:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:29:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:29:1)


**נוֹתֵן לַיָּעֵף כֹּחַ.** וְסוֹפוֹ לְהַחֲלִיף כֹּחַ לַעֲיֵפוּתְכֶם:


**Who gives the tired strength** And who will eventually renew strength for your tiredness.



### Verse 30

###### Rashi on Isaiah 40:30:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:30:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:30:1)


**וְיִעֲפוּ נְעָרִים.** גְּבוּרַת הַכַּשְׂדִּים הַמְנֹעָרִים מִן הַמִּצְווֹת תִּיעָף:


**Now youths shall become tired** Heb. נְעָרִים. The might of your enemies who are devoid (מְנֹעָרִים) of commandments, shall become faint.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 40:30:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:30:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:30:2)


**וּבַחוּרִים כָּשׁוֹל יִכָּשֵׁלוּ.** אוֹתָם שֶׁהֵם עַכְשָׁיו גִּבּוֹרִים וַחֲזָקִים, יִכָּשְׁלוּ, וְאַתֶּם **קוֹוֵי ה׳** תַּחֲלִיפוּ **כֹּחַ** חָדָשׁ וְחָזָק:


**and young men shall stumble** Those who are now mighty and strong, shall stumble, but you, who put your hope in the Lord shall gain new strength and power.



### Verse 31

###### Rashi on Isaiah 40:31:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:31:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/40:31:1)


**אֵבֶר.** כָּנָף:


**wings** [The Hebrew אבר means] a wing.



## Chapter 41


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:1:1)


**הַחֲרִישׁוּ אֵלַי.** כְּדֵי לִשְׁמוֹעַ דָּבָר:


**Be silent to Me** in order to hear My words.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:1:2)


**אִיִּים.** אֻמּוֹת שֶׁל עֲבוֹדַת כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת:


**islands** Heathens ([mss. Kli Paz:] nations).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:1:3)


**יַחֲלִיפוּ כֹחַ.** יִתְקַשְּׁטוּ וְיִתְחַזְּקוּ בְּכָל גְּבוּרָתָם, אוּלַי יַעַמְדוּ בַּדִּין בְּכֹחַ:


**shall renew [their] strength** They shall adorn themselves and strengthen themselves with all their might perhaps they will succeed in their judgment by force.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:1:4)


**יִגְּשׁוּ.** הֲלוֹם, וְאָז מִשֶּׁיִּגְּשׁוּ **יְדַבֵּרוּ**:


**they shall approach** here, and then, when they approach, they shall speak.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:1:5)


**לַמִּשְׁפָּט נִקְרָבָה.** לְהוֹכִיחָם עַל פְּנֵיהֶם:


**to judgment let us draw near** to reprove them to their faces.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:2:1)


**מִי הֵעִיר מִמִּזְרָח** אוֹתוֹ, שֶׁ**צֶּדֶק יִקְרָאֵהוּ לְרַגְלוֹ**; מִי הֵעִיר אֶת אַבְרָהָם לַהֲבִיאוֹ מֵאֲרָם, שֶׁהִיא בַּמִּזְרָח, וְצֶדֶק שֶׁהָיָה עוֹשֶׂה, הִיא הָיְתָה לִקְרַאת רַגְלָיו בְּכָל אֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ:


**Who aroused from the East** one whom righteousness accompanied? Who aroused Abraham to bring him from Aram which is in the East and the righteousness that he would perform that was opposite his feet wherever he went.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:2:2)


**יִתֵּן לְפָנָיו גּוֹיִם.** מִי שֶׁהֵעִירוֹ מִמְּקוֹמוֹ לְהַסִּיעַ, הוּא נָתַן לְפָנָיו אַרְבָּעָה מְלָכִים וַחֲיָלוֹתֵיהֶם:


**He placed nations before him** He, Who aroused him to leave his place to cause him to move, He placed before him four kings and their hosts.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:2:3)


**יַרְדְּ.** יִרְדֶּה:


**He gave him dominion** Heb. יַרְדְּ, like יַרָדֶּה.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:2:4)


**יִתֵּן כֶּעָפָר חַרְבּוֹ.** ״רְמָא כְּעַפְרָא קְטִילִין קֳדָם חַרְבֵּיהּ״ (תרגום יונתן), נָתַן אֶת חַרְבּוֹ וְעוֹשֶׂה חֲלָלִים רַבִּים כֶּעָפָר, וְאֶת **קַשְׁתּוֹ** נָתַן מַרְבֶּה הֲרוּגִים וְנוֹפְלִים **כְּקַשׁ נִדָּף** (בראשית רבה מג ג):


**He made his sword like dust** [Jonathan paraphrases:] He cast slain ones before his sword like dust. He suffered his sword to take its toll of casualties as [numerous as] grains of dust, and his bow He suffered to take its toll of casualties who would fall like wind blown stubble.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:3:1)


**יִרְדְּפֵם יַעֲבוֹר שָׁלוֹם.** הָלַךְ עַל מַעֲבְרוֹתָיו בְּשָׁלוֹם, לֹא נִכְשַׁל בְּרָדְפוֹ אוֹתָם:


**He pursued them and passed on safely** He traversed all his fords safely; he did not stumble when he pursued them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:3:2)


**אֹרַח בְּרַגְלָיו לֹא יָבֹא.** דֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר לֹא בָּא קֹדֶם לָכֵן בְּרַגְלָיו, לֹא יָבֹא – לֹא הָיָה רָגִיל לָבֹא:


**a path upon which he had not come with his feet** A road upon which he had not come previously with his feet. [The future tense of] יָבוֹא means that he was not accustomed to come.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:4:1)


**מִי פָעַל וְעָשָׂה.** לוֹ אֶת זֹאת? מִי שֶׁהוּא **קוֹרֵא הַדֹּרוֹת מֵרֹאשׁ** לְאָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן, הוּא עָשָׂה לְאַבְרָהָם גַּם אֶת זֹאת:


**Who worked and did** for him all this? He Who called the generations from the beginning, to Adam, He did this also for Abraham.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:4:2)


**אֲנִי ה׳ רִאשׁוֹן.** לְהַפְלִיא פֶּלֶא וְלַעֲזוֹר:


**I, the Lord, am first** to perform wonders and to aid.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:4:3)


**וְאֶת אַחֲרֹנִים אֲנִי הוּא.** אַף עִמָּכֶם, בָּנִים אַחֲרוֹנִים, אֶהְיֶה וַאֲעָזוֹר אֶתְכֶם:


**and with the last ones I am He** Also with you, the last sons, I will be, and I will aid you.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:5:1)


**רָאוּ אִיִּים.** עוֹבְדֵי עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה הַגְּבוּרוֹת שֶׁאֶעֱשֶׂה **וְיִירָאוּ**:


**The islands shall see** [lit. saw.] The heathens shall see the mighty deeds that I will perform, and they shall fear.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:5:2)


**קָרְבוּ וַיֶּאֱתָיוּן.** זֶה אֵצֶל זֶה נֶאֱסָפִים לְהִלָּחֵם, כְּשֶׁיִּרְאוּ הַגְּאֻלָּה:


**they have approached and come** One to another they will gather to war when they see the redemption.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:6:1)


**אִישׁ אֶת רֵעֵהוּ וְגוֹ׳. יֹאמַר חֲזַק** לַמִּלְחָמָה, אוּלַי יַעַמְדוּ לָהֶם אֱלֹהֵיהֶם:


**Each one...his fellow etc.** He shall say, “Strengthen yourself” for war, perhaps their gods will protect them [lit. stand up for them].



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:7:1)


**וַיְחַזֵּק חָרָשׁ.** נוֹסֵךְ הַפֶּסֶל:


**And the craftsman strengthened** [i.e.,] the one who molds the idol.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:7:2)


**אֶת צֹרֵף.** הַמְּרַקְּעוֹ בְּזָהָב:


**the smith** who plates it with gold.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:7:3)


**מַחֲלִיק פַּטִּישׁ.** בָּאַחֲרוֹנָה, כְּשֶׁהוּא מַכֶּה בְּנַחַת לְהַחֲלִיק אֶת הַמְּלָאכָה:


**the one who smoothes with the hammer** The final stage, when he taps lightly to flatten out the work.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:7:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:7:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:7:4)


**אֶת הוֹלֶם פָּעַם.** הוּא הַמַּתְחִיל בָּהּ כְּשֶׁהִיא עֲשֶׁת, וּמַכֶּה בְּכָל כֹּחוֹ:


**the one who wields the sledge hammer** He is the one who commences on it when it is a block, and beats it with all his might.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:7:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:7:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:7:5)


**אֹמֵר לַדֶּבֶק טוֹב הוּא.** עַל אוֹתָן שֶׁהָיוּ מְחַזְּרִין אַחַר קַרְקַע טוֹבָה לְדַבֵּק בָּהּ עֲשָׁשִׁיּוֹת בַּרְזֶל:


**he says of the cement, “It is good,”** Heb. דֶּבֶק. He alludes to those who seek suitable ground upon which to adhere iron plates.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:7:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:7:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:7:6)


**דֶּבֶק.** שולדור״א בלע״ז:


דֶּבֶק is soudure in French, weld.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:7:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:7:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:7:7)


**וַיְחַזְּקֵהוּ.** לַצֶּלֶם:


**and he strengthened it** The idol.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:7:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:7:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:7:8)


**בְּמַסְמְרִים לֹא יִמּוֹט.** כֻּלָּם יְחַזְּקוּ זֶה אֶת זֶה:


**with nails that it should not move** All of them will strengthen each other.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:8:1)


**וְאַתָּה יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדִּי**, וְעָלַי יֵשׁ לַעֲזוֹר לְךָ. סוֹף הַמִּקְרָא **אַל תִּירָא כִּי אִתְּךָ אֲנִי**. כָּךְ נִרְאֶה לִי חִבּוּר הָעִנְיָן לְפִי פְּשׁוּטוֹ. וּמִדְרַשׁ אַגָּדָה בִּבְרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה (בראשית רבה מד ז) דּוֹרֵשׁ כָּל הָעִנְיָן בְּמַלְכִּי צֶדֶק וְאַבְרָהָם:


**But you, Israel My servant** and I am obliged to help you. The end of this sentence is (infra 10): “Do not fear.” This appears to me to be the sequence of the section according to its simple meaning. But the Midrash Aggadah in Gen. Rabbah 44:7 expounds the entire section as alluding to Malchizedek and Abraham.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:8:2)


**רָאוּ אִיִּים.** אוֹתָהּ מִלְחָמָה **וְיִירָאוּ**. שֵׁם נִתְיָרֵא מֵאַבְרָהָם, פֶּן יֹאמַר לוֹ: הֶעֱמַדְתָּ רְשָׁעִים אֵלּוּ בָּעוֹלָם, וְאַבְרָהָם נִתְיָרֵא מִשֵּׁם, לְפִי שֶׁהָרַג אֶת בְּנֵי עֵילָם שֶׁהֵם מִשֵּׁם:


**[5] Islands saw** the war and feared. Shem [Malchizedek] feared Abraham, lest he say to him, You begot these wicked men in the world. And Abraham feared Shem, since he slew his sons, the people of Elam, who was descended from Shem.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:8:3)


**אִיִּים.** כְּשֵׁם שֶׁאִיֵּי הַיָּם מְסֻיָּמִין בָּעוֹלָם, כָּךְ אַבְרָהָם וְשֵׁם הָיוּ מְסֻיָּמִין בָּעוֹלָם:


**islands** Just as the islands of the sea are distinguished and recognized in the sea, so were Abraham and Shem distinguished in the world.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:8:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:8:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:8:4)


**אִישׁ אֶת רֵעֵהוּ יַעֲזֹרוּ.** זֶה עוֹזֵר אֶת זֶה בִּבְרָכוֹת ״בָּרוּךְ אַבְרָם״ (בראשית יד:יט), וְזֶה עוֹזֵר אֶת זֶה בְּמַתָּנוֹת ״וַיִּתֶּן לוֹ מַעֲשֵׂר מִכֹּל״ (בראשית יד:כ):


**[6] Each one aided his fellow** This one [Shem] aided this one [Abraham] with blessings, “Blessed be Abram” (Gen. 14:19), and this one [Abraham] aided this one [Shem] with gifts, “And he gave him tithe from everything” (ibid. verse 20).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:8:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:8:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:8:5)


**וַיְחַזֵּק חָרָשׁ.** זֶה שֵׁם, שֶׁהָיָה נַפָּח לַעֲשׂוֹת מַסְמְרוֹת וּבְרִיחִים לַתֵּבָה:


**[7] And the craftsman strengthened** This is Shem, who was a blacksmith, to make nails and bars for the ark.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:8:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:8:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:8:6)


**אֶת צוֹרֵף.** זֶה אַבְרָהָם, שֶׁהוּא צוֹרֵף אֶת הַבְּרִיּוֹת לְקָרְבָן אֶל הַשְּׁכִינָה:


**the smith** This is Abraham, who purified (צוֹרֵף) the people, to bring them near to God [lit. to Heaven].


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:8:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:8:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:8:7)


**אֶת הוֹלֵם פַּעַם.** זֶה אַבְרָהָם, שֶׁהָלַם כָּל הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה פַּעַם אַחַת:


**the sledge hammer** This is Abraham, who smote (הָלַם) all these kings at one time.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:8:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:8:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:8:8)


**אוֹמֵר לַדֶּבֶק טוֹב הוּא.** טוֹב לִדָּבֵק בֵּאלוֹהַּ שֶׁל זֶה:


**He says of the cement** Heb. דֶּבֶק. The nations said, It is good to cleave to this one’s God [rather than to Nimrod’s idols].


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:8:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:8:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:8:9)


**וַיְחַזְּקֵהוּ.** שֵׁם לְאַבְרָהָם לִהְיוֹת דָּבֵק בְּהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, וְ**לֹא יִמּוֹט**:


**And he strengthened him** Shem strengthened Abraham to cleave to the Holy One, blessed be He, and not to move.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:8:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:8:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:8:10)


**וְאַתָּה יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדִּי** אַבְרָהָם, שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה מִזֶּרַע צַדִּיקִים, עָשִׂיתִי לוֹ כָּל זֹאת, וְאַתָּה יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדִּי, הַקָּנוּי לִי מִשְּׁנֵי אָבוֹת:


**[8] And you, Israel My servant** Abraham, who was not descended from righteous men—I did all this for him, and you, Israel My servant, who belong to Me by dint of two forefathers.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:8:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:8:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:8:11)


**זֶרַע אַבְרָהָם אֹהֲבִי.** שֶׁלֹּא הִכִּירָנִי מִתּוֹךְ תּוֹכָחָה וְלִמּוּד אֲבוֹתָיו, אֶלָּא מִתּוֹךְ אַהֲבָה:


**the seed of Abraham, who loved Me** who did not recognize Me because of the admonition and the teaching of his fathers, but out of love.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:9:1)


**אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱזַקְתִּיךָ.** לְקַחְתִּיךָ לְחֶלְקִי, כְּמוֹ (שמות ד:ד) ״וַיִּשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וַיַּחֲזֶק בּוֹ״:


**whom I grasped** Heb. הֶחֱזַקְתִּיךָ. I took you for My share. Comp. (Ex. 4:4) “And he stretched out his hand and grasped (וַיְּחֲזֵק) it.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:9:2)


**מִקְצוֹת הָאָרֶץ.** מִשְּׁאָר הָעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת:


**from the ends of the earth** from the other nations.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:9:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:9:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:9:3)


**וּמֵאֲצִילֶיהָ.** מִן הַגְּדוֹלִים שֶׁבָּהֶן:


**and from its nobles** from the greatest of them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:9:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:9:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:9:4)


**קְרָאתִיךָ.** בְּשֵׁם לְחֶלְקִי, ״בְּנִי בְכוֹרִי יִשְׂרָאֵל״ (שמות ד:כב):


**I called you** by name for My share, “My firstborn son, Israel” (ibid. v. 22).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:9:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:9:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:9:5)


**וְלֹא מְאַסְתִּיךָ.** כָּזֶה שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר בּוֹ (מלאכי א:ג) ״שָׂנֵאתִי״:


**and I did not despise you** like Esau, as it is said (Malachi 1:3), “And Esau I hated.”



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:10:1)


**אַל תִּשְׁתָּע.** אַל יִמַּס לִבְּךָ לִהְיוֹת כְּשַׁעֲוָה זוֹ (בראשית רבה סה יט). וְזֶה הַכְּלָל: כָּל תֵּיבָה שֶׁתְּחִלַּת יְסוֹדָהּ שִׁי״ן, כְּשֶׁבָּא לְדַבֵּר בִּלְשׁוֹן מִתְפַּעֵל, הִתְפַּעֵל אוֹ יִתְפַּעֵל, הַתָּי״ו חוֹלֶקֶת וְנִכְנֶסֶת בֵּין שְׁתֵּי אוֹתִיּוֹת שָׁרְשֵׁי הַתֵּיבָה, כְּמוֹ ״וַיִּשְׁתּוֹמֵם״ (ישעיהו נט:טז), ״וְיִשְׁתַּמֵּר חֻקּוֹת עָמְרִי״ (מיכה ו:טז), ״תִּשְׁתַּכָּרִין״ (שמואל א א:יד), ״תִּשְׁתַּפֵּךְ נַפְשִׁי״ (איוב ל:טז):


**be not discouraged** Heb. אַל תִּשְׁתָּע. Let your heart not melt like wax (שַׁעֲוָה). This is the rule: Every word whose first radical is ‘shin,’ when it is used in the reflexive present, past, or future, the ‘tav’ separates it and enters between the first two radicals. Comp. (infra 49:16) “And He was astounded (וַיַּשְׁתּוֹמֵם)”; (Micah 6:16) “For the statutes of Omri shall be observed (וְיִשְׁתַּמֵּר)”; (I Sam. 1: 14) “will you be drunk (תִּשְׁתַּכָּרִין)?”; (Job 30:16) “My soul is poured out (תִּשְׁתַּפֵּךְ).”



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:14:1)


**תּוֹלַעַת יַעֲקֹב.** מִשְׁפַּחַת יַעֲקֹב הַחֲלָשָׁה כְּתוֹלַעַת, שֶׁאֵין לָהּ גְּבוּרָה אֶלָּא בְּפִיהָ (תנחומא בשלח ט). **תּוֹלַעַת** – וירמונ״א בְּלַעַ״ז:


**O worm of Jacob** Heb. תּוֹלַעַת. The family of Jacob, which is weak like a worm, which has no strength except in its mouth. תּוֹלַעַת is vermener in O.F., [vermisseau in Modern French, a worm].


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:14:2)


**מְתֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל.** מִסְפַּר יִשְׂרָאֵל:


**the number of Israel** Heb. מְתֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, the number of Israel.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:15:1)


**לְמוֹרַג חָרוּץ.** כְּלִי הוּא שֶׁל עֵץ וְכָבֵד, וְעָשׂוּי חֲרִיצִים חֲרִיצִים כְּעֵין כְּלִי נַפָּחִים שֶׁל בַּרְזֶל, שֶׁקּוֹרִין לימ״א בלע״ז, וְגוֹרְרִין עַל הַקַּשִּׁין שֶׁל שִׁבֳּלִין וּמְחַתְּכָן עַד שֶׁנַּעֲשׂוּ תֶּבֶן דַּק:


**a...grooved threshing sledge** It is a heavy wooden implement made with many grooves, similar to the ironsmiths’ tool known as ‘lime’ in French, a file, and they drag it over the straw of the ears of grain and it cuts them until they become fine straw.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:15:2)


**חָדָשׁ.** כְּשֶׁהוּא חָדָשׁ, עַד שֶׁלֹּא הֻחְלְקוּ פִּיּוֹת חֲרִיצָיו, הוּא חוֹתֵךְ הַרְבֵּה, אֲבָל מִשֶּׁנִּתְיַשַּׁן, הֻחְלְקוּ פִּיּוֹת חֲרִיצָיו:


**new** When it is new, before the points of its grooves are smoothed off, it cuts very much, but when it becomes old, the points of the grooves are smoothed off.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:15:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:15:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:15:3)


**בַּעַל פִּיפִיּוֹת.** הֵם חִדּוּדֵי הַחֲרִיצִין:


**with sharp points** Heb. פִּיפִיוֹת. Those are the points of the grooves.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:15:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:15:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:15:4)


**תָּדוּשׁ הָרִים.** מְלָכִים וְשָׂרִים:


**you shall thresh the mountains** kings and princes.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:16:1)


**תִּזְרֵם.** תִּזְרֶה אוֹתָם כְּבַמִּזְרֶה לָרוּחַ:


**You shall winnow them** You shall scatter them, as with a pitchfork, to the wind.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:16:2)


**וְרוּחַ תִּשָּׂאֵם.** מֵאֲלֵיהֶם לְגֵיהִנֹּם:


**and a wind shall carry them off** by themselves to Gehinnom.



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:17:1)


**מְבַקְשִׁים מַיִם.** נִתְנַבֵּא הַנָּבִיא עַל אַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים (עמוס ח:יא-יב): ״לֹא רָעָב לַלֶּחֶם וְלֹא צָמָא לַמַּיִם כִּי אִם לִשְׁמוֹעַ אֶת דְּבַר ה׳, יְשׁוֹטְטוּ לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת דְּבַר ה׳ וְלֹא יִמְצָאוּ״, וּכְשֶׁיָּשׁוּב אַפּוֹ יָכִין לָהֶם לֶחֶם וּמַיִם, וְיַשְׁכֹּן שְׁכִינָתוֹ וְרוּחַ בְּפִי נְבִיאֵיהֶם:


**seek water** The prophet prophesied concerning the end of days (Amos 8:11), “Not a famine for bread nor a thirst for water, but to hear the words of the Lord...They shall wander to seek the word of the Lord, but they shall not find it.” And when His wrath subsides, He shall prepare for them bread and water and cause His Shechinah and His spirit to rest in the mouth of their prophets.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:17:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:17:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:17:2)


**נָשָׁתָּה.** לְשׁוֹן ״וְנִשְּׁתּוּ מַיִם מִהַיָּם״ (ישעיהו יט:ה), לְשׁוֹן ״הַשֵּׁאת וְהַשֶּׁבֶר״ (איכה ג:מז), וְכֻלָּן לְשׁוֹן חֻרְבָּה וְיֹבֶשׁ. וּלְכָךְ הַתָּי״ו מֻדְגֶּשֶׁת, שֶׁהֲרֵי בָּאָה בִּמְקוֹם שְׁתַּיִם, שֶׁאֵין שֵׁאת בְּלֹא תָּי״ו, וְהָיָה לוֹ לוֹמַר לִנְקֵבָה ׳נָשְׁתְתָה׳, שֶׁהֲרֵי לְזָכָר יָחִיד יֹאמַר ׳נִשְׁתָה׳ וְלִרְבִּים ׳וְנִשְׁתּוּ׳:


**is parched** Heb. נָשָׁתָּה. An expression similar to (supra 19:5) “And water from the sea shall dry up (וְנִשְּׁתּוּ).” An expression similar to (Lam. 3:45) “The destruction (הַשֵּׁאת) and the breach.” And all of them are an expression of destruction and dryness. Therefore, a ‘dagesh’ appears in the ‘tav,’ since it comes instead of two, for there is no שֵׁאת without a ‘tav,’ and he should have said for the feminine וְנָשָׁתְתָה, since for the masculine singular he says נשתה and for the plural ונשתו.



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:18:1)


**נְהָרוֹת.** לֵב מֵבִין לַתּוֹרָה וְלַנְּבוּאָה:


**rivers** an understanding heart for Torah and prophecy.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:18:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:18:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:18:2)


**מִדְבָּר.** מָקוֹם שֶׁלֹּא הָיְתָה חָכְמַת הַתּוֹרָה:


**a desert** A place where there was no Torah wisdom.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:19:1)


**אֶתֵּן בַּמִּדְבָּר אֶרֶז שִׁטָּה.** כָּל מִינֵי יִשּׁוּב, אַף בָּם אֶתֵּן כָּל מִינֵי חָכְמָה וְטוֹבָה וְשָׁלוֹם:


**I will give in the desert cedars, acacia trees** all kinds of civilization. Even in them will I give all kinds of wisdom, goodness, and peace.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:19:2)


**תִּדְהָר וּתְאַשּׁוּר.** שְׁמוֹת אִילָנֵי סְרָק הָעֲשׂוּיִין לְבִנְיָן:


**firs and cypresses** Names of trees that do not produce fruit, used for building.



### Verse 21

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:21:1)


**קָרְבוּ רִיבְכֶם.** כָּל הָעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת, בּוֹאוּ וְרִיבוּ וְהִתְוַכְּחוּ עִם בָּנַי:


**Present your plea** All the heathens ([mss. K’li Paz:] nations), come and contend and debate with My children.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:21:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:21:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:21:2)


**עֲצֻמוֹתֵיכֶם.** טְעָנוֹת בְּרִיאוֹת וַחֲזָקוֹת שֶׁלָּכֶם, וְלָשׁוֹן ׳רִיב׳ הוּא זֶה בִּלְשׁוֹן מִשְׁנָה: ״שְׁנַיִם שֶׁהָיוּ מִתְעַצְּמִין בַּדִּין״ בְּמַסֶּכֶת סַנְהֶדְרִין (סנהדרין לא ב):


**your strong points** Heb. עַצֻּמוֹתֵיכֶם, Your sturdy and strong arguments. This is an expression of a dispute in Mishnaic Hebrew: “Two who were engaged in a legal dispute (מִתְעַצְּמִין),” in Tractate Sanhedrin (31b).



### Verse 22

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:22:1)


**יַגִּישׁוּ.** הָעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת אֶת נְבִיאֵיהֶם וְקוֹסְמֵיהֶם:


**Let them present** Let those who deny the Torah ([mss., K’li Paz:] the nations) present their prophets and their soothsayers.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:22:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:22:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:22:2)


**וְיַגִּידוּ לָנוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרֶינָה.** לֶעָתִיד:


**and tell us what will happen** in the future.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:22:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:22:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:22:3)


**הָרִאשֹׁנוֹת.** שֶׁהָיוּ קֹדֶם בְּרִיאַת עוֹלָם, וְעַל מָה נִבְרָא, מָה הֵנָּה. (ספרים אחרים: מְאֹרָעוֹת שֶׁהִתְחִילוּ כְּבָר, מָה יְהֵא בְּסוֹפָן):


**the first things** that were before the Creation of the world, and concerning what was created and what they are. (Other editions: The incidents that have already begun, what will be their end.)


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:22:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:22:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:22:4)


**אוֹ הַבָּאוֹת.** לְעָתִיד יַשְׁמִיעוּנוּ, וְנִרְאֶה אִם יֵשׁ בָּהֶם מַמָּשׁ, שֶׁיִּתְקַיְּמוּ דִּבְרֵיהֶם:


**or the coming events** in the future, let us hear, and we will see if there is any substance to them, that their words will come true.



### Verse 23

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:23:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:23:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:23:1)


**הַגִּידוּ הָאֹתִיּוֹת לְאָחוֹר.** הַמּוֹפְתִים הַבָּאִים בָּאַחֲרוֹנָה:


**Tell the signs coming later** Heb. הָאוֹתִיוֹת לְאָחוֹר, the wonders coming at the end.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:23:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:23:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:23:2)


**וְנִשְׁתָּעָה.** וּנְסַפֵּר דִּבְרֵיהֶם, ״וַיְסַפֵּר״ (בראשית כד:סו) מְתַרְגְּמִינָן ״וְאִשְׁתָּעֵי״:


**let us talk** Heb. וְנִשְׁתָּעָה. Let us tell your words. (Gen. 24:66) “And he told (וַיְּסַפֵּר),” the Targum renders וְאִשְׁתָּעֵי.



### Verse 24

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:24:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:24:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:24:1)


**הֵן אַתֶּם מֵאַיִן.** וְדִבְרֵיכֶם אֵיךְ יִתְקַיְּמוּ?


**Behold you are of naught** and how will your words be fulfilled.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:24:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:24:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:24:2)


**וּפָעָלְכֶם מֵאָפַע.** אֵינְכֶם אֶלָּא פּוֹעִים וּמְרִימִים קוֹל לְהַטְעוֹת בְּדִבְרֵי כָּזָב:


**and your deed is one of shouting** Heb. מֵאָפַע. You shout and raise your voice only to mislead the people with lies.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:24:3

**תּוֹעֵבָה.** הַנִּתְעָבִים הֵם יִבְחֲרוּ **בָּכֶם**, וְלֹא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא וְלֹא עֲבָדָיו וְלֹא מְשָׁרְתָיו:


**the abominable one** Heb. תּוֹעֵבָה [lit. an abomination.] The abominable ones select you, and not the Holy One, blessed be He, or His servants or His ministers.



### Verse 25

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:25:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:25:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:25:1)


**הַעִירוֹתִי מִצָּפוֹן וַיַּאת.** אֲנִי מַגִּיד הָעֲתִידוֹת, הִנְנִי מֵעִיר לִבְנוֹת חָרְבוֹת יְרוּשָׁלַיִם אֶת כּוֹרֶשׁ מִצָּפוֹן, וַיַּאת אֶת בָּבֶל לְהַחֲרִיבָהּ:


**I have aroused from the north and he came** I tell the future events. Behold I arouse Cyrus from the north to build the ruins of Jerusalem, and he came upon Babylon to destroy it.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:25:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:25:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:25:2)


**מִמִּזְרַח שֶׁמֶשׁ יִקְרָא בִשְׁמִי:** ״כָּל מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ נָתַן לִי ה׳ אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם״ (עזרא א:ב), וְנִרְאֶה שֶׁאֶרֶץ פָּרַס בְּמִזְרָחִית צְפוֹנִית הִיא לְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל. דָּבָר אַחֵר: **הַעִירוֹתִי מִצָּפוֹן** אֶת נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר לְהַחֲרִיב אֶת עִירִי **וַיַּאת, וְכוֹרֶשׁ** הַעִירוֹתִי **מִמִּזְרָח** שֶׁ**יִּקְרָא בִשְׁמִי** לִבְנוֹת אֶת עִירִי, שֶׁמַּלְכוּת פָּרַס מִמִּזְרָח אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל הִיא, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״רָאִיתִי אֶת הָאַיִל וְגוֹ׳״ (דניאל ח:ד). וְיוֹנָתָן תִּרְגֵּם: ״אַיְיתִיתִי בְּגַלָּאִי מֶלֶךְ דְּתַקִּיף מֵרוּחַ צְפוֹנָא וְיֵיתֵי כְּמֵפַּק שִׁמְשָׁא בִּגְבוּרְתֵּיהּ מִמְּדִינְתָא, אַגְבְּרִינֵיהּ בִּשְׁמִי״:


**from the rising of the sun he shall call in My name** (Ezra 1:2) “All the kingdoms of the earth has the Lord God of the heavens given me.” And it appears that Persia is northeast of Eretz Israel. Another explanation is: I aroused Nebuchadnezzar from the north to destroy My city, and he came, and I aroused Cyrus from the east, that he call in My name to build My city, for the kingdom of Persia is east of Eretz Israel, as it is stated (Dan. 8:4): “I saw the ram butting etc.” [This verse in Daniel proves it. “I saw the ram butting to the west and to the north and to the south.” We deduce that he came from the east.] Jonathan paraphrases: I brought speedily a king, strong as the north wind, and he will come as the sun comes out with its might from the east; I will strengthen him with My name.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:25:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:25:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:25:3)


**וְיָבֹא סְגָנִים.** וְיָבֹא עַל מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל וְעַל שָׂרָיו, כַּאֲשֶׁר בָּא לִרְמוֹס עַל **חֹמֶר, וּכְמוֹ יוֹצֵר** חֲרָשִׁים **יִרְמָס טִיט** לִכְלֵי חֶרֶס, כֵּן יִרְמוֹס הוּא סְגָנִים:


**and he shall come [upon] princes** And he shall come upon the king of Babylon and upon his princes as he would come to trample upon mire, and as a potter tramples clay for earthenware vessels, so will he trample the princes.



### Verse 26

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:26:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:26:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:26:1)


**מִי** מִנְּבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל **הִגִּיד** כָּמוֹנִי דָּבָר הֶעָתִיד לָבוֹא, וּמִי **מִלְּפָנִים** הִגִּידָהּ, וְלִכְשֶׁתָּבֹא **נֹאמַר** שֶׁהוּא **צַדִּיק** שֶׁנְּבוּאָתוֹ צֶדֶק:


**Who** of the prophets of Baal told, like me, a thing destined to come, and who told it from before, that when it comes we will say that he is just, that his prophecy is just?


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:26:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:26:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:26:2)


**אַף אֵין מַגִּיד.** אֲבָל אֵין בָּכֶם שֶׁיַּגִּיד עֲתִידוֹת וְתִתְקַיֵּם:


**Not one told** But there is none among you who will foretell the future and that it will come true.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:26:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:26:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:26:3)


**אַף אֵין שֹׁמֵעַ אִמְרֵיכֶם.** שֶׁיָּעִיד בְּבֹא עֲתִידָה: פְּלוֹנִי, נְבִיא הַבַּעַל, נִבָּא אוֹתָהּ **מִלְּפָנִים**:


**not one hears your statements** Who will testify when the future comes, that so and so the prophet of the Baal prophesied this from before.



### Verse 27

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:27:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:27:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:27:1)


**רִאשׁוֹן לְצִיּוֹן הִנֵּה הִנָּם.** מֶלֶךְ רִאשׁוֹן שֶׁיִּתֵּן לֵב לְצִיּוֹן, הִנֵּה זֶה הוּא שֶׁאָמַרְתִּי, וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁלֹּא תִּגָּמֵר הַגְּאֻלָּה עַל יָדוֹ, הוּא יִהְיֶה הַמַּתְחִיל: ״מִי בָכֶם מִכָּל עַמּוֹ״ (עזרא א:ג):


**The first to Zion, behold, behold them** The first king who will give heart to Zion, behold he is the one I mentio ned, and even though the redemption will not be completed through him, he will be the one to initiate it. (Ezra 1:3) “Whoever of you from all His people...”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:27:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:27:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:27:2)


**הִנָּם.** זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יִהְיוּ נְכוֹנִים עַל פִּי דְּבָרוֹ לַעֲלוֹת מִן הַגּוֹלָה וּלְהַתְחִיל:


**behold them** The elders of Israel will be ready, according to his statement, to go up from the exile and to begin.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:27:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:27:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:27:3)


**וְלִירוּשָׁלִַם מְבַשֵּׂר אֶתֵּן.** בְּאוֹתָן הַיָּמִים חַגַּי זְכַרְיָה, אֲשֶׁר יְזָרְזוּם לִבְנוֹת בִּימֵי דָּרְיָוֶשׁ הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לְפָרַס:


**and for Jerusalem I will give a herald** in those days, [viz.] Haggai and Zechariah, who will encourage them to build it in the days of Darius III of Persia.



### Verse 28

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:28:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:28:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:28:1)


**וָאֵרֶא וְאֵין אִישׁ.** תָּמִיד אֲנִי מַבִּיט בִּנְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל, וְאֵין אִישׁ מַגִּיד דָּבָר עָתִיד:


**And I look and there is no man** [lit. and I will see, in the future tense.] I always look at the prophets of Baal, and there is no man who tells of a future event.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:28:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:28:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:28:2)


**וּמֵאֵלֶּה.** מִכָּל אֵלֶּה הָעֲתִידוֹת לָבֹא, וְ**אֵין** מֵהֶם **יוֹעֵץ** שֶׁעָמַד בְּסוֹד ה׳ וְיָדַע אוֹתָם:


**and of these** of all these destined to come, and none of them is a counselor who stood in God’s counsel and will know them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:28:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:28:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:28:3)


**וְאֶשְׁאָלֵם וְיָשִׁיבוּ דָבָר.** אֲשֶׁר יָשִׁיבוּ דָבָר אִם אֶשְׁאָלֵם:


**and I ask them that they reply with a word** That they should reply with a word if I should ask them.



### Verse 29

###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:29:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:29:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:29:1)


**הֵן כֻּלָּם אָוֶן.** יֵשׁ לָכֶם לָדַעַת שֶׁכָּל נְבִיאֵי מַכְחִישֵׁי תּוֹרָה אָוֶן, וְ**אֶפֶס** כָּל **מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם נִסְכֵּיהֶם**:


**Behold them all,...naught** You should know that, as for the prophets of those who deny the Torah ([mss.:] pagan prophets;) ([other mss.:] prophets of Baal), all their deeds are naught and of no substance.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 41:29:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:29:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/41:29:2)


דְּמוּת מַסֵּכוֹתָם, כְּמוֹ ״הַפֶּסֶל נָסַךְ חָרָשׁ״ (ישעיהו מ:יט). וְיוֹנָתָן תִּרְגֵּם בְּעִנְיָן אַחֵר. **רִאשׁוֹן לְצִיּוֹן וְגוֹ׳** – ״פִּתְגָמֵי נֶחָמָתָא דְּאִתְנַבִּיאוּ נְבִיָּיא מִלְּקַדְמִין עַל צִיּוֹן הָא אָתוֹ״. וּלְפִי הַתַּרְגּוּם כָּל הָעִנְיָן מְדַבֵּר מִמֶּלֶךְ הַמָּשִׁיחַ וּבַגְּאֻלָּה אַחֲרוֹנָה, אֲבָל אֲנִי רוֹאֶה נְבוּאָה שֶׁנִּתְנַבֵּא יְשַׁעְיָה עַל כּוֹרֶשׁ, כֻּלָּם בִּלְשׁוֹן הַסִּגְנוֹן שֶׁל פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ: ״אֲנִי ה׳ הֲעִירוֹתִיהוּ בְצֶדֶק״ (ישעיהו מה:יג), ״קוֹרֵא מִמִּזְרָח עַיִט״ (ישעיהו מו:יא), ״הָאוֹתִיּוֹת שְׁאָלוּנִי״ (ישעיהו מה:יא), ״מַגִּיד מֵרֵאשִׁית אַחֲרִית״ (ישעיהו מו:י), כֻּלָּהּ נוֹטָה אַחַר עִנְיַן פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ:


**their molten images** Heb. נִסְכֵּיהֶם. Comp. (supra 40:19) “The graven image the craftsman melted (נָסַךְ).” Jonathan renders this section differently: [27] **The first one to Zion etc.** The words of consolation that the prophets prophesied concerning Zion, from before, behold they have come. And according to the Targum, the entire section speaks of the King Messiah and of the last redemption, but I see that the prophecy that Isaiah prophesied concerning Cyrus is all in the same language as this section. Comp. (infra 45:13) “I aroused him with righteousness”; (Infra 46:11) “Calling from the east a bird of prey”; (infra 45:11) “The signs ask Me;” (infra 46:10) “Who tells from the beginning the end.” All of this resembles the topic of this section.



## Chapter 42


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:1:1)


**הֵן עַבְדִּי אֶתְמָךְ בּוֹ.** הֵן עַבְדִּי יַעֲקֹב אֵינוֹ כְּמוֹתְכֶם, כִּי אֶתְמֹךְ בּוֹ:


**Behold My servant, I will support him** Behold My servant Jacob is not like you, for I will support him.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:1:2)


**בְּחִירִי.** יִשְׂרָאֵל קָרוּי בְּחִירִי (תהלים קלה:ד) ״כִּי יַעֲקֹב בָּחַר לוֹ יָהּ״, וְאוֹמֵר (ישעיהו מה:ד) ״לְמַעַן עַבְדִּי יַעֲקֹב וְיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּחִירִי״:


**My chosen one** Israel is called ‘My chosen one’ ([mss.:] His chosen one) (Ps. 135:4) “For the Eternal chose Jacob for Himself.” Scripture states also (infra 45:4): “For the sake of My servant Jacob and Israel My chosen one.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:1:3)


**רָצְתָה נַפְשִׁי.** עָלָיו **נָתַתִּי רוּחִי** לְהוֹדִיעַ נְבִיאָיו אֶת סוֹדוֹ, וְסוֹפוֹ **מִשְׁפָּט לַגּוֹיִם יוֹצִיא**, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (ישעיהו ב:ג) ״וְהָלְכוּ גוֹיִם רַבִּים וְגוֹ׳ וְיוֹרֵנוּ מִדְּרָכָיו וְגוֹ׳״:


**whom My soul desires; I have placed My spirit upon him** to let his prophets know My secret, and his end will be that ‘he shall promulgate justice to the nations,’ as it is stated (supra 2:3): “And let Him teach us of His ways etc.”



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:2:1)


**וְלֹא יִשָּׂא.** לֹא יַגְבִּיהַּ קוֹל, לֹא יִצְטָרֵךְ לְהוֹכִיחַ וּלְהִתְנַבְּאוֹת אֶל הַגּוֹיִם, שֶׁהֵם מֵעַצְמָם יָבוֹאוּ לִלְמוֹד מֵהֶם, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (זכריה ח:כג) ״נֵלְכָה עִמָּכֶם כִּי שָׁמַעְנוּ אֱלֹהִים עִמָּכֶם״:


**nor shall he raise [his voice]** He shall not raise his voice. It will not be necessary to admonish and to prophesy to the nations, for they will come by themselves to learn from them [i.e., from Israel], as the matter is stated (Zech. 8:23): “Let us go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.”



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:3:1)


**קָנֶה רָצוּץ לֹא יִשְׁבּוֹר.** תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן: ״עִינְוְתָנַיָּא דְּאִינוּן כְּקַנְיָא רְעִיעַ לָא יִתְבְּרוּן, וַחֲשִׁיכַיָּא דְּאִינוּן כְּבוּצִין עַמִּי (פֵּרוּשׁ כְּנֵר כָּבֶה) לָא יִטְפוֹן״:


**A breaking reed he shall not break** Jonathan paraphrases: The meek, who are like a breaking reed, shall not break, and the poor, who are like a flickering candle, shall not be quenched.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:3:2)


**וּפִשְׁתָּה כֵהָה.** פְּתִילַת פִּשְׁתָּה לַחָה, שֶׁקְּרוֹבָה לִכְבּוֹת. מֶלֶךְ שֶׁלָּהֶם לֹא יִגְזוֹל אֶת הַדַּלִּים וְלֹא יִרְצֹץ אֶת הָעֲנִיִּים וְאֶת הַחַלָּשִׁים:


**and a flickering flaxen wick** A wet flaxen wick, that is nearly extinguished. Their king will not rob the poor and will not break the poor and the weak.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:4:1)


**וְלֹא יָרוּץ.** כְּמוֹ ׳לֹא יֵרָצֵץ׳, ״כִּי מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ דֵּעָה״ (ישעיהו יא:ט), וְיִשְׁמְעוּ לָהֶן, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (צפניה ג:ט) ״כִּי אָז אֶהְפֹּךְ אֶל עַמִּים וְגוֹ׳״, וְזֶהוּ **לְתוֹרָתוֹ אִיִּים יְיַחֵילוּ** – כֻּלָּם יִשְׁמְעוּ לְתוֹרָתוֹ:


**Neither shall he weaken nor shall he be broken** Heb. וְלֹא יָרוּץ, like לֹא יֵרָצֵץ, he shall not be broken, “for the earth shall be full of knowledge of the Lord as water covers the seabed” (supra 11:9). And they shall obey them, as the matter is stated (Zeph. 3:9): “For then I will make the nations pure of speech etc.” That is what follows: And for his instruction islands shall long. They shall all obey his instruction.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:5:1)


**הָאֵל ה׳.** בַּעַל הַדִּין וּבַעַל הָרַחֲמִים:


**God the Lord** The Master of justice and the Master of clemency.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:5:2)


**בּוֹרֵא הַשָּׁמַיִם.** תְּחִלָּה כְּמִין פָּקִיעַ שֶׁל שְׁתִי, וְאַחַר כָּךְ נָטָה אוֹתָם, כִּדְאִיתָא בְּמַסֶּכֶת חֲגִיגָה (חגיגה יב א):


**the Creator of the heavens** First like a sort of ball of warp thread, and afterward He stretched it out as it is stated in Tractate Hagigah (12a).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:5:3)


**וְצֶאֱצָאֶיהָ.** בּוֹרֵא אֶת הַיּוֹצֵא מִמֶּנָּה:


**and what springs forth from it** And He creates what springs forth from it.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:5:4)


**נוֹתֵן נְשָׁמָה.** נִשְׁמַת חַיִּים:


**Who gave a soul** A soul of life.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:5:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:5:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:5:5)


**לָעָם עָלֶיהָ.** לְכֻלָּם בְּשָׁוֶה:


**to the people upon it** To all of them equally.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:5:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:5:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:5:6)


**וְרוּחַ.** קְדוּשָׁה:


**and a spirit** of sanctity.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:5:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:5:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:5:7)


**לַהֹלְכִים בָּהּ.** לַמִּתְהַלְּכִים לְפָנָיו:


**to those who walk thereon** To those who walk before Him.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:6:1)


**קְרָאתִיךָ.** לִישַׁעְיָה הוּא אוֹמֵר:


**I called you** To Isaiah He says.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:6:2)


**וְאֶצָּרְךָ.** כְּשֶׁיְצַרְתִּיךָ, זֹאת הָיְתָה מַחֲשַׁבְתִּי שֶׁתְּשִׁיב אֶת עַמִּי לִבְרִיתִי וּלְהָאִיר לָהֶם:


**and I formed you** Heb. וְאֶצָּרְךָ. When I formed you (כְּשֶׁיְצַרְתִּיךָ), this was My thought, that you return My people to My covenant and to enlighten them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:6:3)


**לְאוֹר גּוֹיִם.** כָּל שֵׁבֶט קָרוּי גּוֹי לְעַצְמוֹ, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״גּוֹי וּקְהַל גּוֹיִם״ (בראשית לה:יא):


**for a light to nations** Every tribe is called a nation by itself, as the matter is stated (Gen. 35:11): “A nation and a congregation of nations.”



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:7:1)


**לִפְקֹחַ עֵינַיִם עִוְרוֹת.** שֶׁאֵינָם רוֹאִין אֶת גְּבוּרָתוֹ, לָתֵת לֵב לָשׁוּב אֵלַי:


**To open blind eyes** who do not see My might, to take heart to return to Me.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:7:2)


**לְהוֹצִיא מִמַּסְגֵּר אַסִּיר.** וְעַל יְדֵי שֶׁיִּתְפַּקְּחוּ עֵינֵיהֶם, יֵצְאוּ אֲסִירִים מִמַּסְגֵּר. דָּבָר אַחֵר: לְבַשְּׂרָם עַל גָּלוּת בָּבֶל הָעֲתִידָה לָבֹא עֲלֵיהֶן, שֶׁסּוֹפָן לָצֵאת מִמֶּנָּה:


**to bring prisoners out of a dungeon** And because their eyes will be opened, the prisoners will come out of the dungeon. Another explanation: To inform them of the exile destined to befall them, out of which they will eventually come.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:8:1)


**הוּא שְׁמִי.** הוּא מְפֹרָשׁ בִּלְשׁוֹן אַדְנוּת וְכֹחַ, וְעָלַי לְהַרְאוֹת שֶׁאָדוֹן אֲנִי, לְפִיכָךְ **כְּבוֹדִי לְאַחֵר לֹא אֶתֵּן**:


**that is My Name** This is explained as an expression of Lordship and power. I must show that I am the Master. Therefore, My glory I will not give to another, that the heathens shall rule over My people forever and say that the hand of their God is powerful.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:9:1)


**הָרִאשֹׁנוֹת**, שֶׁהִבְטַחְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם עַל גָּלוּת מִצְרַיִם (בראשית טו:יד) ״וְגַם אֶת הַגּוֹי וְגוֹ׳״:


**The former things** that I promised Abraham concerning the exile of Egypt (Gen. 15:14), “And also the nation etc.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:9:2)


**הִנֵּה בָאוּ.** שָׁמַרְתִּי הַבְטָחָתִי, וְעַתָּה **חֲדָשׁוֹת אֲנִי מַגִּיד** לְעַמִּי, לְהַבְטִיחַ עַל גָּלוּת שְׁנִיָּה:


**behold they have come to pass** I kept My promise, and now new things I tell My people, to promise them concerning a second exile.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:10:1)


**תְּהִלָּתוֹ מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ.** עַל כָּרְחָם, כְּשֶׁיִּרְאוּ אֶת גְּבוּרָתִי לְיִשְׂרָאֵל, יוֹדוּ כָּל הָעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת כִּי אֱלֹהִים אֲנִי:


**His praise from the end of the earth** Perforce, when they see My mighty deeds for Israel, all the heathens (nations [Parshandatha, K’li Paz]) will admit that I am God.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:10:2)


**יוֹרְדֵי הַיָּם.** פּוֹרְשֵׂי בִּסְפִינוֹת:


**those who go down to the sea** Those who embark in ships.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:10:3)


**וּמְלֹאוֹ.** הַקְּבוּעִים בַּיָּם, וְלֹא בָּאִיִּים, אֶלָּא בְּתוֹךְ הַמַּיִם שׁוֹפְכִים עָפָר כָּל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד כְּדֵי בַּיִת, וְהוֹלְכִים מִבַּיִת לְבַיִת בִּסְפִינָה, כְּגוֹן עִיר וֵונִיצִיי״א:


**and those therein** Those whose permanent residence is in the sea and not in the islands, but in the midst of the water, they spill earth, each one of them, enough for a house, and go from house to house by boat, like the city of Venice. [As in Warsaw ed. and Parshandatha.]



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:11:1)


**יִשְׂאוּ מִדְבָּר.** קוֹל בְּשִׁיר:


**The desert and its cities shall raise [their voice]** their voice in song.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:11:2)


**חֲצֵרִים תֵּשֵׁב קֵדָר.** (מוּסָב עַל **יִשְׂאוּ**) מִדְבַּר קֵדָר, שֶׁהֵם דָּרִים עַתָּה בּאֳהָלִים, יִשְׂאוּ קוֹל וְיָרֹנּוּ (כְּמוֹ ״וְהַחֲצֵרִים אֲשֶׁר תֵּשֵׁב קֵדָר״), בְּמִדְבַּר קֵדָר שֶׁהֵם דָּרִים עַתָּה בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶם יִהְיוּ עָרִים וַחֲצֵרִים קְבוּעִים:


**Kedar shall be inhabited with villages** (Connected to “The desert...shall raise.” The desert of Kedar, where they now dwell in tents, shall raise their voice and sing. It is like: And the villages with which Kedar is settled.) The desert of Kedar, where they now dwell in tents, will be permanent cities and villages.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:11:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:11:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:11:3)


**יֹשְׁבֵי סֶלַע.** הַמֵּתִים שֶׁיִּחְיוּ (בראשית רבה יג ו); כֵּן תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן:


**rock dwellers** The dead who will be resurrected. So did Jonathan render this.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:11:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:11:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:11:4)


**מֵרֹאשׁ הָרִים יִצְוָחוּ.** ״מֵרֵישׁ טוּרִיָּא יְרִימוּן קָלֵיהוֹן״ (תרגום יונתן):


**from the mountain peaks they shall shout** From the mountain peaks they shall raise their voices [from Jonathan].



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:14:1)


**הֶחֱשֵׁיתִי מֵעוֹלָם.** זֶה יָמִים רַבִּים הֶחֱשֵׁיתִי עַל חֻרְבַּן בֵּיתִי, וְתָמִיד **אַחֲרִישׁ**:


**I was silent from time immemorial** Already for a long time I have been silent about the destruction of My Temple, and always...


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:14:2)


**אֶתְאַפָּק.** לְשׁוֹן הוֹוֶה; עַד עַתָּה הֱצִיקַתְנִי רוּחִי, וּמֵעַתָּה **כַּיּוֹלֵדָה אֶפְעֶה**:


**I am still; I restrain Myself** This is present tense. Until now My spirit has constrained Me, and from now, like a travailing woman will I cry.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:14:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:14:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:14:3)


**אֶשֹּׁם.** אֶתְבַּהֵל:


**I will be terrified** Heb. אֶשֹּׁם, I will be terrified.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:14:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:14:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:14:4)


**וְאֶשְׁאַף.** וְאֶתְאַוֶּה לְהַשְׁמִיד הַכֹּל **יַחַד**, כָּל אוֹיְבַי:


**and destroy [them] together** And I will long to destroy everyone together, all My adversaries.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:15:1)


**אַחֲרִיב הָרִים וּגְבָעוֹת.** אֶהֱרֹג מְלָכִים וְשִׁלְטוֹנִים שֶׁל עוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת׃


**I will destroy mountains and hills** I will slay kings and rulers.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:15:2)


**וְכָל עֶשְׂבָּם.** כָּל הַנִּלְוִים עֲלֵיהֶם:


**and all their grass** All their followers.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:15:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:15:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:15:3)


**אוֹבִישׁ.** לְשׁוֹן יֹבֶשׁ הוּא לְעִנְיַן דָּבָר לַח, כְּגוֹן עֵשֶׂב וּנְהָרוֹת:


**I will dry out** Heb. אוֹבִישׁ. This is an expression of drying, used in reference to wet things, e. g., grass and rivers.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:16:1)


**וְהוֹלַכְתִּי.** יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁהָיוּ **עִוְרִים** עַד הֵנָּה מֵהַבִּיט אֵלַי **בְּדֶּרֶךְ** הַטּוֹב, אֲשֶׁר **לֹא יָדְעוּ** לַהֲלוֹךְ בָּהּ:


**And I will lead the blind** Israel, who were heretofore blind from looking to Me, I will lead in the good way, upon which they did not know to walk.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:16:2)


**עֲשִׂיתִם.** אֶעֱשֶׂה כֵּן. לְשׁוֹן נְבוּאָה לְדַבֵּר עַל הֶעָתִיד כְּאִלּוּ עָשׂוּי:


**I will do them** Heb. עֲשִׂיתִם [lit. I did them], I will do. So is the language of prophecy, to speak of the future as if it was already done.



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:18:1)


**הַחֵרְשִׁים וְהַעִוְרִים.** עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא אוֹמֵר:


**You deaf ones...and you blind ones** He is referring to Israel.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:19:1)


**מִי עִוֵּר** בָּכֶם? אֵין אֶחָד **כִּי אִם עַבְדִּי** הוּא הָעִוֵּר שֶׁבְּכֻלְּכֶם, **וְחֵרֵשׁ** שֶׁבָּכֶם הֲרֵי הוּא **כְּמַלְאָכִי** אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי שׁוֹלֵחַ לְהִנָּבֵא נְבוּאוֹת:


**Who is blind** among you? There is no one but My servant; he is the most blind of all of you. And the most deaf among you is like My messenger whom I send to prophesy prophecies.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:19:2)


**מִי עִוֵּר כִּמְשֻׁלָּם.** מִי הָיָה עִוֵּר בָּכֶם, כְּבָר קִבֵּל יִסּוּרָיו, וַהֲרֵי הוּא כִּמְשֻׁלָּם כָּל תַּגְמוּלָיו וְיוֹצֵא נָקִי:


**He who was blind is as the one who received his payment** He who was blind among you has already received his chastisements, and he is as one who was paid all payments due him and has emerged cleansed.



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:20:1)


**רָאוֹת רַבּוֹת.** רְאִיּוֹת הַרְבֵּה לִפְנֵיכֶם, וְאֵינְכֶם שׁוֹמְרִים לְהַבִּיט בְּמַעֲשַׂי וְלָשׁוּב אֵלַי:


**There is much to see** There are many sights before you, and you do not observe to look at My deeds and to return to Me.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:20:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:20:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:20:2)


**פָּקוֹחַ אָזְנַיִם.** אֲנִי עָסוּק לִפְקוֹחַ אָזְנֵיכֶם עַל יְדֵי נְבִיאַי, **וְלֹא יִשְׁמַע** אִישׁ מִכֶּם אֶת דְּבָרַי, וּלְשׁוֹן הוֹוֶה הוּא:


**to open the ears** I am busy opening your ears through My prophets, but none of you listens to My words. This is a present tense.



### Verse 21

###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:21:1)


**ה׳ חָפֵץ.** לְהַרְאוֹתְכֶם וְלִפְקֹחַ אָזְנֵיכֶם **לְמַעַן צֶדֶק**, וּלְכָךְ הוּא מַגְדִּיל וּמַאְדִּיר לָכֶם **תּוֹרָה**:


**The Lord desires** to show you and to open your ears for His righteousness’ sake; therefore, he magnifies and strengthens the Torah for you.



### Verse 22

###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:22:1)


**וְהוּא.** הָעָם הַזֶּה **בָּזוּי וְשָׁסוּי**, וְסוֹף הָעִנְיָן **וְלֹא יָשִׂים עַל לֵב** (ישעיהו מב:כה) כָּל זֶה לוֹמַר, לָמָּה קְרָאַתְנוּ זֹאת **מִי נָתַן לִמְשִׁסָּה יַעֲקֹב** (ישעיהו מב:כד):


**And it** This people is despised and pillaged, and the end of the section is (infra v. 25) “And they laid not to heart” all of this to say, “Why did this befall me?” (v. 24) “Who subjected Jacob to plunder?”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:22:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:22:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:22:2)


**הָפֵחַ בַּחוּרִים כֻּלָּם.** בַּחוּרֵיהֶם פַּחֵי נֶפֶשׁ כֻּלָּם. תוספת: דָּבָר אַחֵר: **הָפֵחַ בַּחוּרִים כֻּלָּם** – יָשִׂימוּ אֶת עַצְמָם בְּפַחֵי הָאֲדָמָה וּבְחוֹרִים, **וּבְבָתֵּי כְלָאִים הָחְבָּאוּ** יוֹכִיחַ שֶׁכֵּן הוּא:


**all their youths are grieved** Heb. הָפֵחַ בַּחוּרִים, all their youths are grieved. (Addendum: Another explanation of הָפֵח בַּחוּרִים כֻּלָם They will put themselves into snares (פַּחֵי) of the earth and into pits. [The clause,] “And they are hidden in dungeons,” proves that this is so.)


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:22:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:22:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:22:3)


**וְאֵין אֹמֵר הָשַׁב.** כְּמוֹ ׳הָשֵׁב׳, לְפִיכָךְ הוּא רָפֵי, אֲבָל ״הַשָּׁב בְּאַמְתַּחְתֵּינוּ״ (בראשית מג:יח) הוּא דָּגֵשׁ:


**and no one says, “Return.”** Heb. הָשַׁב, like הָשֵׁב [the imperative]. Therefore, it is not punctuated with a dagesh, but (Gen. 43:17) “That returned (הַשָּׁב) in our sacks,” is punctuated with a ‘dagesh.’



### Verse 23

###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:23:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:23:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:23:1)


**יַאֲזִין.** לָתֵת לֵב לְזֹאת **מִי נָתַן לִמְשִׁסָּה יַעֲקֹב**:


**will hearken** to pay attention to this, “Who subjected Jacob to plunder?”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:23:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:23:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:23:2)


**לְאָחוֹר. יַקְשִׁיב וְיִשְׁמַע** דָּבָר שֶׁיַּעֲמוֹד לוֹ בָּאַחֲרוֹנָה, וְכֵן תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן לְאָחוֹר: ״לְסוֹפָא״, וְכֵן כָּל ׳לְאָחוֹר׳ שֶׁבַּמִּקְרָא: עָתִיד לִהְיוֹת הוּא:


**for the future** Who will hearken and hear something that will stand him in good stead at the end? Jonathan, too, renders: לְסוֹפָא, at the end, and likewise, every לְאָחוֹר in Scripture refers to something that is destined to be.



### Verse 24

###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:24:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:24:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:24:1)


**זוּ חָטָאנוּ לוֹ.** זוֹ הִיא שֶׁגָּרְמָה אֶת הַמְּשִׁסָּה וְהַבַּז, אֶת אֲשֶׁר חָטָאנוּ לוֹ:


**This, that we sinned against Him** This is what caused the plunder and the spoiling, what we sinned against Him.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:24:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:24:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:24:2)


**וְלֹא אָבוּ.** אֲבוֹתֵינוּ בִּדְרָכָיו הָלוֹךְ:


**and they did not want** Our forefathers did not want to go in His ways.



### Verse 25

###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:25:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:25:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:25:1)


**וַתְּלַהֲטֵהוּ מִסָּבִיב.** כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּרְאוּ וְיִקְחוּ מוּסָר, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (צפניה ג:ו): ״הִכְרַתִּי גוֹיִם נָשַׁמּוּ פִּנּוֹתָם, אָמַרְתִּי אַךְ תִּירְאִי וְגוֹ׳״:


**and it blazed upon them all around** I brought retribution upon the heathens ([Ms.] nations) all around so that they see and learn their lesson, like the matter stated (Zeph. 3:6f.): “I cut off nations, their towers were desolate...I said, You shall but fear Me, you shall learn a lesson...” ([This appears in certain manuscripts and in printed editions. In Nach Lublin, the reading is:] So that Israel see and learn a lesson.)


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:25:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:25:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:25:2)


**וְלֹא יָדָע.** יוֹדֵעַ הוּא, אֶלָּא שֶׁדָּשׁ בְּעָקֵב; לֹא חָשׁ לְהָבִין זֹאת וְלָשׁוּב מֵרִשְׁעוֹ:


**and they did not know** They actually did know, but they trod with their heels. They did not care to understand this and to repent of their wickedness.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 42:25:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:25:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/42:25:3)


**וַתִּבְעַר בּוֹ.** אַחַר פֻּרְעָנוּת הָעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת שֶׁמִּסָּבִיב, בָּעֲרָה בְּעַצְמוֹ:


**and it burned among them** After the retribution of the heathens ([ms.] nations) around, it burned upon them themselves.



## Chapter 43


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:1:1)


**וְעַתָּה.** אַף כָּל זֹאת **כֹּה אָמַר ה׳... אַל תִּירָא**:


**And now** despite all this, so said the Lord, “...do not fear.”



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:2:1)


**כִּי תַעֲבֹר בַּמַּיִם.** כְּשֶׁעָבַרְתָּ בְּיַם סוּף **אִתְּךָ** הָיִיתִי:


**When you pass through water** When you passed through the Reed Sea, I was with you.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:2:2)


**וּבַנְּהָרוֹת לֹא יִשְׁטְפוּךָ.** גַּרְתָּה בֵּין הַמִּצְרִים וְהָאֻמּוֹת הַמְרֻבִּין כְּמֵי נָהָר, וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לְךָ לְכַלּוֹת:


**and in rivers, they shall not overflow you** You dwelt among the Egyptians and the heathens (peoples [: mss.]) numerous as the waters of a river, and they could not prevail against you to destroy you.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:2:3)


**כִּי תֵלֵךְ בְּמוֹ אֵשׁ.** לֶעָתִיד לָבֹא: ״כִּי הִנֵּה הַיּוֹם בָּא בֹּעֵר כַּתַּנּוּר״ (מלאכי ג:יט), שֶׁאַקְדִּיר חַמָּה עַל הָרְשָׁעִים, ״וְלִהַט אוֹתָם הַיּוֹם הַבָּא״ (שם), גַּם שָׁם **לֹא תִכָּוֶה**:


**when you go amidst fire** In the future, “For behold, a sun is coming, burning like an oven” (Malachi 3:19), for I will cause the sun to burn upon the wicked, “and the coming sun shall burn them.” There, too, you shall not be burnt.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:2:4)


**וְלֶהָבָה.** שֶׁתִּשְׂרוֹף הָאֻמּוֹת, כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״וְהָיוּ עַמִּים מִשְׂרְפוֹת סִיד״ (ישעיהו לג:יב), גַּם הִיא **לֹא תִבְעַר בָּךְ**:


**a flame** which shall burn the heathens ([mss.:] the nations), as it is said (supra 33:12): “And the peoples shall be as the burnings of lime.” That too shall not burn amidst you.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:3:1)


**נָתַתִּי כָפְרְךָ מִצְרַיִם.** וְהֵם הָיוּ לְךָ לְפִדְיוֹן, שֶׁבְּכוֹרֵיהֶם מֵתוּ וְאַתָּה, בְּנִי בְּכוֹרִי, נִצַּלְתָּ, וִהְיִיתֶם חַיָּבִים כְּלָיָה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (יחזקאל כ:ח) ״וָאוֹמַר לִשְׁפּוֹךְ חֲמָתִי עֲלֵיהֶם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם״:


**I have given Egypt as your ransom** And they were your ransom, for their firstborn died, and you, My firstborn son, although you were deserving of destruction, as it is said in Ezekiel (20:8): “And I thought to pour out My fury upon them...in the land of Egypt.”



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:4:1)


**וְאֶתֵּן אָדָם תַּחְתֶּיךָ.** תָּמִיד אֲנִי רָגִיל בְּכָךְ:


**and I give** I am always accustomed to this.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:6:1)


**אֹמַר** לְרוּחַ צָפוֹן **תֵּנִי** הַגָּלֻיּוֹת שֶׁבַּצָּפוֹן:


**I will say** to the north wind, “Give the exiles who are in the north.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:6:2)


**וְלַתֵּימָן**, שֶׁהִיא רוּחַ חֲזָקָה – **אַל תִּכְלָאִי** מִלְּנַשֵּׁב בְּחָזְקָה לְהָבִיא גָּלֻיּוֹתַי. וְכֵן (שיר השירים ד:טז) ״עוּרִי צָפוֹן וּבֹאִי תֵימָן״, מִתּוֹךְ שֶׁהָרוּחַ צְפוֹנִית חַלָּשָׁה צְרִיכָה חִזּוּק, לְכָךְ כָּתוּב ׳עוּרִי׳, ׳תֵּנִי׳. אֲבָל דְּרוֹמִית שֶׁאֵינָהּ צְרִיכָה חִזּוּק (גיטין לא ב), כָּתוּב ׳בּוֹאִי׳ כְּמוֹת שֶׁהִיא, וְכֵן ׳אַל תִּכְלָאִי׳:


**and to the south** which is a strong wind, “Do not refrain from blowing strongly to bring My exiles.” Similarly (Song 4: 16), “Awaken, O north wind, and come, O south wind.” Since the north wind is weak, it needs strengthening. Therefore, it is written, “Awaken,” “Give.” But concerning the south wind which does not need straightening, it is written, “Come,” as it is, and so, “Do not refrain.”



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:7:1)


**כֹּל הַנִּקְרָא בִשְׁמִי וְלִכְבוֹדִי בְּרָאתִיו.** כָּל הַצַּדִּיקִים הַנִּקְרָאִים בִּשְׁמִי, וְכָל הֶעָשׂוּי לִכְבוֹדִי. **יְצַרְתִּיו אַף עֲשִׂיתִיו** – תִּכַּנְתִּיו בְּכָל הַצָּרִיךְ לוֹ, וְהֵכַנְתִּי הַכֹּל. כְּלוֹמַר: אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁעָבְרוּ בַּגּוֹלָה וּבְצָרָה, כְּבָר הִכַּנְתִּי לָהֶם כָּל צָרְכֵי גְּאֻלָּתָם:


**Everyone that is called by My name, and whom I created for My glory** All the righteous, who are called by My name and everyone who was made for My glory, I formed him, yea, I made him. fixed him with all that is necessary for him, and I prepared everything. That is to say, that although they experienced exile and trouble, I prepared for them all the necessities of their redemption.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:8:1)


**הוֹצִיא עַם עִוֵּר.** הוֹצִיא כְּמוֹ לְהוֹצִיא מִן הַגּוֹלָה אוֹתָם שֶׁגָּלוּ עַל שֶׁנַּעֲשׂוּ כְּעִוְּרִים, **וְעֵינַיִם** לָהֶם וְלֹא רָאוּ:


**To bring out a blind people** Heb. הוֹצִיא, like לְהוֹצִיא to bring out of the exile those who were exiled because they became like blind; although they had eyes, they did not see.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:9:1)


**כָּל הַגּוֹיִם נִקְבְּצוּ.** אִם כָּל הַגּוֹיִם מֵעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת נִתְקַבְּצוּ יַחְדָּיו, **מִי בָהֶם** וּבִנְבִיאֵיהֶם **יַגִּיד** עֲתִידוֹת וְכַיּוֹצֵא בָהּ מִפִּי טָעוּתָם, אוֹ **הָרִאשׁוֹנוֹת** שֶׁכְּבָר עָבְרוּ **יַשְׁמִיעֻנוּ** לֵאמֹר: ״אֲנַחְנוּ הִגַּדְנוּ אוֹתָם קוֹדֶם שֶׁבָּאוּ״?


**Were all the nations gathered** If all the nations (of the peoples [Lublin;]) (of the heathens [Warsaw]; absent in all mss. and in K’li Paz) would gather together, who of them and of their prophets would tell the future, or the like, quoting their pagan Gods, or the first events, that have already passed, would they let us know, saying “We foretold them before they came about”?


###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:9:2)


**יִתְּנוּ עֵדֵיהֶם**, שֶׁשָּׁמְעוּ שֶׁנִּבְּאוּ עֲלֵיהֶם קֹדֶם לָכֵן, **וְיִצְדָּקוּ**; אֲבָל אֲנִי יֵשׁ לִי עֵדִים, שֶׁ**אַתֶּם עֵדַי**, שֶׁהִגַּדְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם אֲבִיכֶם הַגָּלֻיּוֹת וּבָאוּ:


**Let them present their witnesses** who heard that they prophesied concerning them prior to their occurrence, and they shall be deemed just. But I have witnesses, for you are My witnesses that I told Abraham your forefather about the exiles, and they came about.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:10:1)


**וְעַבְדִּי.** יַעֲקֹב:


**and My servant** Jacob.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:10:2)


**אֲשֶׁר בָּחָרְתִּי.** הוּא יָעִיד שֶׁהִבְטַחְתִּיו בְּלֶכְתּוֹ לַאֲרַם נַהֲרַיִם, וְשָׁמַרְתִּי הַבְטָחָתִי:


**whom I chose.** He, too, shall testify that I promised him when he went to Mesopotamia, and I kept My promise.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:10:3)


**לְמַעַן תֵּדְעוּ וְגוֹ׳.** כָּל זֶה עָשִׂיתִי לְמַעַן תִּתְּנוּ לֵב לָדַעַת אוֹתִי:


**in order that you know** I did all this in order that you put your heart to know Me.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:12:1)


**אָנֹכִי הִגַּדְתִּי.** הַגָּלֻיּוֹת לְאַבְרָהָם:


**I told** of the exiles to Abraham.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:12:2)


**וְהוֹשַׁעְתִּי.** לְקַיֵּם דְּבָרִי בְּעֵת רָץ:


**and I saved** to fulfill the word at the time [designated for its] end.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:12:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:12:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:12:3)


**וְהִשְׁמַעְתִּי** לָכֶם הָרִאשׁוֹנוֹת:


**and I made heard** to you the first events.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:12:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:12:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:12:4)


**וְאֵין בָּכֶם זָר.** בְּאוֹתָן הַיָּמִים שֶׁעָשִׂיתִי כָּל אֵלֶּה, לֹא נִרְאָה בְּכֻלְּכֶם בֵּינֵי הָעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת אֵל **זָר** לְהַרְאוֹת גְּדֻלָּתוֹ וֶאֱלֹהוּתוֹ בְּפָנַי:


**and there was no stranger among you** In those days, when I did all these, there did not appear among all of you, among the heathens (the children of the nations [mss., K’li Paz]) a strange God, to show his greatness and his Godliness. ([Other manuscripts read:] And I made My Torah heard to you, and none among you estranged himself from accepting.)


###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:12:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:12:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:12:5)


**וְאַתֶּם עֵדַי.** שֶׁפָּתַחְתִּי לָכֶם שִׁבְעָה רְקִיעִים, וְלֹא רְאִיתֶם כָּל תְּמוּנָה:


**and you are My witnesses** that I opened seven heavens for you, and you saw no image.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:13:1)


**גַּם מִיּוֹם אֲנִי הוּא.** לֹא אוֹתוֹ הַיּוֹם לְבַדּוֹ הָיִיתִי לְבַדִּי, כִּי גַּם מֵאָז הֱיוֹת יוֹם אֲנִי הוּא לְבַדִּי:


**Even before the day I am He** Not only that day was I alone, but even before it became day I am He alone.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:13:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:13:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:13:2)


**אֶפְעַל.** אִם בָּאתִי לִפְעוֹל אֵין מֵשִׁיב:
