### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:14:1)


**לְמַעַנְכֶם שִׁלַּחְתִּי בָבֶלָה.** יוֹנָתָן תִּרְגֵּם: ״בְּדִיל חוֹבֵיכוֹן אַגְלֵיתִי יַתְכוֹן לְבָבֶל״:


**Because of you, I sent [you] to Babylon** Jonathan paraphrases: Because of your sins I exiled you to Babylon.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:14:2)


**וְהוֹרַדְתִּי בָרִיחִים כֻּלָּם.** ״וַאֲחֵתִית בִּמְשׁוֹטִין כּוּלְהוֹן״. ׳מְשׁוֹטִין׳ הוּא עֵץ שֶׁמַּנְהִיג אֶת הַסְּפִינָה וּמְיַשְּׁרָהּ:


**and I lowered them all with oars** Heb. וְהוֹרַדְתִּי בָרִיחִים. Jonathan renders: And I lowered with oars (בִּמְשׁוֹטִין), all of them. מְשׁוֹטִין denotes the wood that guides the ship and straightens it out.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:14:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:14:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:14:3)


**וְכַשְׂדִּים** הוֹלִיכוּ אֶתְכֶם **בָּאֳנִיּוֹת רִנָּתָם**, וְגַם יֵשׁ לְפָרְשׁוֹ עַל בְּשׂוֹרַת הַגְּאוּלָּה. **לְמַעַנְכֶם שִׁלַּחְתִּי** אֶשְׁלַח מַלְכֵי מָדַי לְבָבֶל וְאוֹרִיד הַכַּשְׂדִּים בִּסְפִינוֹת וּמְשׁוֹטִין לַגּוֹלָה לְאֶרֶץ מָדַי, **וְכַשְׂדִּים** אוֹרִיד **בָּאֳנִיּוֹת** שֶׁהָיְתָה **רִנָּתָם** בָּהֶם:


**and Chaldees** led you in the ships of their rejoicing. This may also be explained as regards the news of the redemption, as follows: **Because of you, I sent** I will send the kings of Media to Babylon, and I will lower the Chaldees in ships and oars into exile to the land of Media. And the Chaldees I will lower in ships which their rejoicing was [i.e., the Chaldees would be taken into captivity with the very boats in which they had previously rejoiced].



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:16:1)


**הַנּוֹתֵן בַּיָּם דָּרֶךְ.** בְּיַם סוּף, וְשָׁם הוֹצֵאתִי מִצְרַיִם לִרְדּוֹף אַחֲרֵיכֶם **רֶכֶב וָסוּס וְחַיִל וְעִזּוּז**, וְכֻלָּם **יַחְדָּיו יִשְׁכְּבוּ** מֵתִים עַל שְׂפַת הַיָּם **בַּל יָקוּמוּ**:


**Who made a way in the sea** in the Sea of Reeds, and there I drew the Egyptians out to pursue you, with chariots and horses, and an army and power, and all of them lay together dead on the seashore, not to rise.



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:17:1)


**כַּפִּשְׁתָּה כָבוּ.** תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן: ״כְּבוּצִין עַמִּי טְפוֹ״:


**they were quenched** Jonathan renders: Like flax they dimmed, they were quenched.



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:18:1)


**אַל תִּזְכְּרוּ רִאשֹׁנוֹת.** הַנִּסִּים הַלָּלוּ שֶׁאֲנִי מַזְכִּיר לָכֶם שֶׁעָשִׂיתִי בְּמִצְרַיִם, אַל תִּזְכְּרוּ אוֹתָם מֵעַתָּה, כִּי בַּגְּאֻלָּה זוֹ תַּעַסְקוּ לְהוֹדוֹת וּלְהַלֵּל:


**Remember not the first events** These miracles that I mention to you, that I performed in Egypt do not remember them from now on, for you shall be engaged in this redemption, to thank and to praise.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:18:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:18:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:18:2)


**אַל תִּתְבֹּנָנוּ.** אַל תִּסְתַּכְּלוּ בָּהֶן, אַל תִּתְּנוּ לָהֶם לֵב:


**do not meditate** Do not ponder about them; do not pay attention to them.



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:20:1)


**תְּכַבְּדֵנִי חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה.** מָקוֹם שֶׁהוּא חָרֵב וּמַרְבָּץ לְחַיּוֹת הַשָּׂדֶה, לְ**תַנִּים** וְלִ**בְנוֹת יַעֲנָה**:


**The beasts of the field shall honor Me** The place that is desolate and a habitat of the beasts of the field, for the jackals and for the ostriches.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:20:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:20:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:20:2)


**כִּי נָתַתִּי בַמִּדְבָּר מַיִם.** כְּלוֹמַר: בְּאֶרֶץ חֲרֵבָה אֶתֵּן יִשּׁוּב:


**for I gave water in the desert** i.e., in a desolate land I will place a settlement.



### Verse 21

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:21:1)


**עַם זוּ יָצַרְתִּי לִי.** לְמַעַן **תְּהִלָּתִי יְסַפֵּרוּ**:


**This people I formed for Myself** so that they recite My praise.



### Verse 22

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:22:1)


**וְלֹא אֹתִי קָרָאתָ.** וְאַתָּה לֹא אוֹתִי קָרָאתָ בִּפְנוֹתְךָ אַחֲרֵי עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה:


**But you did not call Me** But you did not call Me in your turning after idolatry.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:22:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:22:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:22:2)


**כִּי יָגַעְתָּ בִּי.** נִלְאֵיתֶם מַהֵר בַּעֲבוֹדָתִי (פסיקתא רבתי כט):


**for you wearied of Me** You quickly wearied of My worship.



### Verse 23

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:23:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:23:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:23:1)


**לֹא הֵבֵאתָ לִּי שֵׂה עֹלֹתֶיךָ.** כִּי אִם לַעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה:


**You did not bring Me the lambs of your burnt offerings** but to idolatry.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:23:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:23:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:23:2)


**לֹא הֶעֱבַדְתִּיךָ.** עֲבוֹדָה רַבָּה **בְּמִנְחָה**, קֹמֶץ מְעַט עוֹלֶה לַגָּבוֹהַּ, וְגַם הוּא לֹא אָמַרְתִּי לְךָ לְהַקְרִיב לְךָ חוֹבָה, אֶלָּא נְדָבָה:


**neither did I overwork you** Cause you to do much work with the meal offering; merely a handful would be offered to the Most High, and even that I did not ordain upon you to sacrifice as an obligation but as a free-will offering.



### Verse 24

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:24:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:24:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:24:1)


**לֹא קָנִיתָ לִּי בַכֶּסֶף קָנֶה.** לִקְטֹרֶת לֹא הֻצְרַכְתָּ לִקְנוֹתָהּ בְּכֶסֶף, לְפִי שֶׁהָיְתָה מְצוּיָה בְּאַרְצְכֶם הַרְבֵּה. אָמַר רַבִּי אַבָּא: קִנָּמוֹנִיָּה הָיְתָה גְּדֵלָה בְּאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְהָיוּ אוֹכְלִין אוֹתָהּ עִזִּים וּצְבָיִים (איכה רבה פתיחתא י):


**Neither did you purchase cane for Me with money** for incense. You did not have to purchase it with money, for it was very common in your land. Said Rabbi Abba: Cinnamon grew in the Land of Israel, and goats and deer would eat of it. In Midrash Eichah (Proem X). ([Some manuscripts read:] **Neither did you purchase cane for Me with money** for incense, for you failed to offer to Me what you should have, and you were attracted to idolatry.)


###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:24:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:24:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:24:2)


**הֶעֱבַדְתַּנִי בְּחַטֹּאותֶיךָ.** אַתֶּם גְּרַמְתֶּם לִי לִהְיוֹת שַׁמָּשׁ לְעוֹבְדֵי פְּסִילִים, כְּמוֹ שֶׁרָאָה יְחֶזְקֵאל ״וְהִנֵּה רוּחַ סְעָרָה בָּאָה מִן הַצָּפוֹן״ (יחזקאל א:ד), שֶׁהָיְתָה חוֹזֶרֶת מֶרְכֶּבֶת הַשְּׁכִינָה מִבָּבֶל, שֶׁהָלְכָה לִכְבּוֹשׁ אֶת כָּל הָעוֹלָם תַּחַת יָדוֹ שֶׁל נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר, שֶׁלֹּא יֹאמְרוּ בְּיַד אֻמָּה שְׁפָלָה מָסַר אֶת בָּנָיו, כִּדְאִיתָא בַּחֲגִיגָה (חגיגה יג ב):


**But you have burdened Me** [lit. you have overworked Me.] You have caused Me to be an attendant to pagans, as Ezekiel envisioned (1:4): “And behold a tempest was coming from the north.” For the chariot of the Shechinah was returning from Babylon, where it had gone to conquer the whole world under the domination of Nebuchadnezzar, lest they say that He delivered His children into the hands of an inferior nation, as is found in Hagigah (13b).



### Verse 25

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:25:1

**אָנֹכִי אָנֹכִי.** אֲנִי **הוּא** שֶׁמְּחִיתִים מֵאָז, וַאֲנִי **מֹחֶה** אוֹתָם גַּם עַתָּה:


**I, yea I** I am He Who erased them from time immemorial [lit. from then], and I erase them even now.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:25:2

**for My sake** Neither in your merit nor in the merit of your forefathers.

**הַזְכִּירֵנִי.** כָּל תַּגְמוּל שֶׁיֵּשׁ לְךָ וְלַאֲבוֹתֶיךָ עָלַי:


**Remind Me** all the reward I owe you and your forefathers.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:26:2

### Verse 27

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:27:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:27:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/43:27:1)


**אָבִיךָ הָרִאשׁוֹן חָטָא.** בְּאָמְרוֹ ״בַּמֶּה אֵדַע״ (בראשית טו:ח):


**Your first father sinned** by saying (Gen. 15:8), “How will I know...?”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:27:2

**and your intercessors transgressed against Me** You have none among all the intercessors upon whose merit you rely, in whom I have not found transgression. Isaac loved My enemy [Esau].

###### Rashi on Isaiah 43:28:1

## Chapter 44


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:1:1)


**וְעַתָּה שְׁמַע.** לָשׁוּב לְתוֹרָתִי, **יַעֲקֹב עַבְדִּי**:


**And now, hearken** to return to My Torah, Jacob My servant.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:3:1)


**כִּי אֶצָּק מַיִם עַל צָמֵא.** כְּמוֹ שֶׁאֲנִי יוֹצֵק מַיִם עַל צָמֵא, כֵּן **אֶצֹּק רוּחִי עַל זַרְעֶךָ**:


**As I will pour water on the thirsty** Just as I pour water on the thirsty, so will I pour My spirit on your seed.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:4:1)


**וְצָמְחוּ בְּבֵין חָצִיר.** בְּתוֹךְ עֲמָלֵק, עַל יְדֵי גֵרִים שֶׁיִּתְוַסְּפוּ עֲלֵיהֶם. ׳בֵּין חָצִיר׳ הוּא עֲמָלֵק, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר עָלָיו ״וְהָיְתָה נְוֵה תַנִּים חָצִיר לִבְנוֹת יַעֲנָה״ (ישעיהו לד:יג):


**And they shall sprout among the grass** among Esau (mss. and K’li Paz). [The Jewish nation will grow] through the proselytes who will join them. [The expression,] “among the grass” refers to Esau, for it is stated concerning Edom (supra 34:13): “And it shall be the habitat of jackals, an abode (חָצִיר) for ostriches.” (Editions reading, “Amalek,” are erroneous cf. reference.)



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:5:1)


**זֶה יֹאמַר לַה׳ אָנִי.** אֵלּוּ צַדִּיקִים גְּמוּרִים:


**This one shall say, “I am the Lord’s.”** These are the perfectly righteous.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:5:2)


**וְזֶה יִקְרָא בְשֵׁם יַעֲקֹב.** אֵלּוּ קְטַנִּים, בְּנֵי רְשָׁעִים:


**and this one shall call himself by the name of Jacob.** These are the children, the sons of the wicked.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:5:3)


**זֶה יִכְתֹּב יָדוֹ לַה׳.** אֵלּוּ בַּעֲלֵי תְּשׁוּבָה:


**and this one shall write [with] his hand, “To the Lord,”** These are the repentant.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:5:4)


**וּבְשֵׁם יִשְׂרָאֵל יְכַנֶּה.** אֵלּוּ הַגֵּרִים מֵעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת. כָּךְ שְׁנוּיָה בְּאָבוֹת דְּרַבִּי נָתָן (אבות דרבי נתן לו א):


**and adopt the name Israel** These are the proselytes. So it was taught in Avoth d’Rabbi Nathan (36:1).



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:7:1)


**וּמִי כָמוֹנִי יִקְרָא.** וּמִי יִקְרָא שֶׁהוּא כָּמוֹנִי, וְיַגִּיד וְיַעֲרֹךְ **לִי** אֶת כָּל מַה שֶּׁהָיָה **מִשּׂוּמִי עַם עוֹלָם** וְעַד עַתָּה?


**And who will call [that he is] like Me** And who will call that he is like Me and tell and arrange for me all that transpired since I placed the ancient people and until now?


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:7:2)


**עַם עוֹלָם.** כָּל בְּרִיּוֹת:


**the ancient people** All the creatures.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:7:3)


**וְאֹתִיּוֹת.** דִּבְרֵי מוֹפֵת:


**and the signs** Marvelous things.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:7:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:7:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:7:4)


**וַאֲשֶׁר תָּבֹאנָה.** וְאֶת הָעֲתִידוֹת לָבֹא יַגִּידוּ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאֲנִי עוֹשֶׂה עַתָּה, שֶׁעֲדַיִן לֹא חָרַב הַבַּיִת, וְלֹא גְּלִיתֶם, וְלֹא נוֹלַד כּוֹרֶשׁ, וַאֲנִי מְבַשֵּׂר אֶתְכֶם עָלָיו:


**and those that will come** And those destined to come, let them tell, as I do now, for the Temple has not yet been destroyed, and you have not been exiled, and neither has Cyrus been born, but I am reporting it to you.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:8:1)


**וְאַל תִּרְהוּ.** אֵין לוֹ דִּמְיוֹן, וּפִתְרוֹנוֹ לְפִי הָעִנְיָן כְּמוֹ ׳אַל תֵּחַתּוּ׳ מִלְּהוֹדִיעַ אֶת שְׁמִי לְבֵין הָעֲוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת:


**and be not dismayed** Heb. תִּרְהוּ. There is no similar word, and its interpretation according to its context is like תֵּחַתּוּ, be not dismayed from making My name known among the heathens (nations [K’li Paz and mss.]).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:8:2)


**הֲלֹא מֵאָז הִשְׁמַעְתִּיךָ.** מֵהַר סִינַי, **וְהִגַּדְתִּי** לָכֶם שָׁם שֶׁאֵין **אֱלוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעָדַי**:


**let you hear** from Mount Sinai, and I told you there that there is no God besides Me.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:8:3)


**וְאַתֶּם עֵדָי.** שֶׁפָּתַחְתִּי לָכֶם שִׁבְעָה רְקִיעִים וְהֶרְאֵיתִי אֶתְכֶם שֶׁאֵין אַחֵר, וְאַתֶּם עֵדַי בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה שֶׁאֵין **אֱלוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעָדַי**:


**and you are My witnesses** that I opened for you seven heavens and showed you that there is no other, and you are My witnesses to this thing that there is no God besides Me.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:8:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:8:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:8:4)


**וְאֵין צוּר בַּל יָדָעְתִּי.** תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן: ״וְלֵית דְּתַקִּיף אֶלְהֵן דְּמִן קֳדָמִי מִתְיְהֵב לֵיהּ תַּקִּיף״:


**and there is no rock I did not know** Jonathan renders: And there is no strong one unless he is given strength by Me.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:8:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:8:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:8:5)


**בַּל יָדָעְתִּי.** לְשׁוֹן ״וָאֵדָעֲךָ בְשֵׁם״ (שמות לג:יז), ״יָדַע לֶכְתְּךָ״ (דברים ב:ז), ״אֲנִי יְדַעְתִּיךָ בַּמִּדְבָּר״ (הושע יג:ה):


**I did not know** Heb. יָדַעְתִּי. An expression similar to (Exodus 33:17) “And I knew you by name (וָאֵדָעֲךָ)”; (Deut. 2:7) “He knew (יָדַע) your going”; (Hosea 13:5) “I knew you (יְדַעְתִּיךָ) in the desert.”



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:9:1)


**וְעֵדֵיהֶם הֵמָּה.** הַפְּסִילִים הֵם עֵדִים עַל בֹּשֶׁת עוֹבְדֵיהֶם, שֶׁהֲרֵי אָנוּ רוֹאִין שֶׁאֵינָן לֹא רוֹאִין וְלֹא יוֹדְעִין, וְהָיוּ עוֹבְדִין לָהֶם:


**and they are their witnesses** The idols are witnesses of the shame of their worshipers, for we see that they neither see nor know, yet they were worshiping them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:9:2)


**לְמַעַן יֵבֹשׁוּ.** הָעוֹבְדִים לָהֶם:


**so that they be ashamed** Those who worship them.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:10:1)


**נָסָךְ.** לְשׁוֹן יְצִיקָה וּמַסֵּכָה, וְהַנּוּ״ן בַּתֵּיבָה יְסוֹד הַנּוֹפֵל מִמֶּנּוּ, כְּגוֹן נוּ״ן שֶׁל ׳נָשַׁךְ׳ וְשֶׁל ׳נָגַף׳:


**molded** Heb. נָסָךְ, an expression of pouring and a molten image (מַסֵּכָה). The ‘nun’ in the word is a radical sometimes omitted, e.g., the ‘nun’ of נשך, biting, and of נגף, plaguing.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:11:1)


**הֵן כָּל חֲבֵרָיו.** שֶׁל אוֹתוֹ יוֹצֵר וְנוֹסֵךְ פְּסִילִים, הַמִּתְחַבְּרִים אֵלָיו לַעֲבוֹד אֶת יְצִירָתוֹ וְנִסְכּוֹ, **יֵבֹשׁוּ**:


**Behold, all his colleagues** of that fashioner and molder of graven images, who join him to worship his creation and his molten image, shall be ashamed.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:11:2)


**וְחָרָשִׁים הֵמָּה.** אוֹתָם יוֹצְרִים וְנוֹסְכִים מִבְּנֵי אָדָם הֵם, קַל וָחֹמֶר לִיצִירָתָם שֶׁהִיא הֶבֶל:


**and they are smiths** those fashioners and molders, and they are of men, surely their creation is vanity.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:12:1)


**חָרַשׁ בַּרְזֶל.** חָרָשׁ שֶׁל בַּרְזֶל:


**The ironsmith** a smith of iron.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:12:2)


**מַעֲצָד.** הוּא אֶחָד מִכְּלֵי הַנַּפָּחִים:


**an axe** Heb. מַעֲצָָד. That is one of the tools of the blacksmiths.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:12:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:12:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:12:3)


**וּפָעַל.** הַפֶּסֶל. **בַּפֶּחָם.** קרבו״ן בלע״ז:


**and he works** the image. **with coal** Heb. פֶּחָם, charbon in French.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:12:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:12:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:12:4)


**וּבַמַּקָּבוֹת.** מרטי״ל בלע״ז:


**and with sledge hammers** Heb. מַקָּבוֹת, marteau in French.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:12:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:12:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:12:5)


**יִצְּרֵהוּ.** לְשׁוֹן ׳צִיּוּר׳:


**he fashions it** Heb. יִצְּרֵהוּ, an expression of fashioning.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:12:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:12:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:12:6)


**וַיִּפְעָלֵהוּ בִּזְרוֹעַ כֹּחוֹ גַּם רָעֵב וְגוֹ׳.** גַּם הוּא הַיּוֹצֵר חֲסַר כֹּחַ וְחַלָּשׁ הוּא, שֶׁאִם יִרְעַב **אֵין** בּוֹ **כֹּחַ**, אוֹ אִם **לֹא שָׁתָה מַיִם וַיִּיעָף** לְאַלְתַּר. קַל וָחֹמֶר שֶׁפְּעֻלָּתוֹ אֵין בָּהּ תּוֹעֶלֶת לַעֲזוֹר:


**and he made it with his strong arm; yea he is hungry etc.** Even he, the fashioner, lacks strength and is weak, for if he becomes hungry he has no strength, or if he does not drink water, he becomes faint immediately. Surely his product has no power to help.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:13:1)


**חָרַשׁ עֵצִים.** וְאִם בָּא לַעֲשׂוֹתוֹ שֶׁל עֵץ, וְחָרַשׁ עֵצִים הוּא, כָּךְ דַּרְכּוֹ:


**The carpenter** And if he comes to make it of wood, and he is a carpenter, the following is his method.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:13:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:13:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:13:2)


**נָטָה קָו.** כְּדֶרֶךְ הַנַּגָּרִים, וְעַל פִּי הַקָּו **יְתָאֲרֵהוּ בַשֶּׂרֶד**, מְיַשֵּׁר אוֹתוֹ בְּמַסּוֹר, שֶׁקּוֹרִין דאלאור״א בלע״ז. **יְתָאֲרֵהוּ.** יְיַפֵּהוּ:


**stretched out a line** as is the custom of the carpenters, and according to the line, יְתָאֲרֵהוּ בַשֶּׂרֶד, he straightens it with a saw, which they call doloire in French. **he beautifies it** Heb. יְתָאֲרֵהוּ, he beautifies it.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:13:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:13:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:13:3)


**יַעֲשֵׂהוּ בַּמַּקְצֻעוֹת.** וּמַחְלִיקוֹ בְּרָהִיטְנִי וְאִזְמֵל; **מַקְצֻעוֹת** תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן: ״אִיזְמֵלַיָּא״:


**he fixes it with planes** Heb. מַקְצֻעוֹת. He smoothes it with a plane and a blade. Jonathan renders מַקְצֻעוֹת as אִיזְמֵלַיָּא, knives or blades.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:13:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:13:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:13:4)


**וּבַמְּחוּגָה יְתָאֳרֵהוּ.** לְשׁוֹן ״וְתָאַר הַגְּבוּל״ (יהושע טו:ט), אִם בָּא לַעֲשׂוֹת בּוֹ צִיּוּרִים עֲגוּלִים, מְסַבֵּב אוֹתוֹ בַּמְּחוּגָה, קונפ״ש בלע״ז:


**and with a compass he rounds it** Heb. יְתָאֳרֵהוּ, an expression similar to (Josh. 15:9): “And the border circled (וְתָאַר).” If he comes to make circular drawings, he draws around it with a compass, compas in French.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:13:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:13:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:13:5)


**כְּתִפְאֶרֶת אָדָם.** הִיא הָאִשָּׁה, שֶׁהִיא תִּפְאֶרֶת בַּעְלָהּ:


**like the beauty of a man** That is a woman, who is the beauty of her husband.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:14:1)


**תִּרְזָה וְאַלּוֹן.** מִינֵי אִילָנֵי סְרָק:


**ilex and an oak** kinds of non-fruit-producing trees.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:14:2)


**וַיְאַמֶּץ לוֹ בַּעֲצֵי יָעַר.** עוֹשֶׂה לוֹ חִזּוּקִים, בֵּין לְחִזּוּק בֵּין לְנוֹי, בְּמִינֵי עֵצִים הַמְשֻׁנִּים זֶה מִזֶּה בְּמַרְאֵיהֶן:


**and he reinforced it with forest trees** He makes for it types of reinforcements, either for strength or for beauty, with types of trees, one different from the other in their appearance.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:14:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:14:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:14:3)


**נָטַע אֹרֶן.** כְּשֶׁמּוֹצֵא יִחוּר וְנֶטַע הָרָאוּי לְכָךְ, נוֹטְעוֹ לְכָךְ, וְהַגֶּשֶׁם מְגַדְּלוֹ:


**he planted a sapling** When he finds a branch or a sapling that is fit for that, he plants it for that and the rain makes it grow.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:14:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:14:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:14:4)


**אֹרֶן.** לְשׁוֹן ׳נֶטַע יוֹנֵק׳, פלנצו״ן בלע״ז:


**a sapling** Heb. אֹרֶן, a young sapling, ploncon in O.F.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:15:1)


**וְהָיָה לְאָדָם לְבָעֵר.** וְהָיָה אוֹתוֹ עֵץ מִקְצָתוֹ לְצָרְכֵי אָדָם לְבָעֵר:


**And it was for man to ignite** And part of that very tree was for man’s necessities, [viz.] to ignite.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:15:2)


**וַיִּקַּח** מִן הָעֵצִים. **וַיָּחָם** גּוּפוֹ לְנֶגְדָּם:


**and he took** from the trees. **and he warmed** his body opposite them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:15:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:15:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:15:3)


**אַף יַשִּׂיק.** מֵהֶם תַּנּוּר וְאוֹפֶה **לָחֶם**:


**he even heated** an oven with them and baked bread.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:15:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:15:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:15:4)


**אַף יִפְעַל אֵל.** מִן הַנּוֹתָר:


**he even made a God** from what was left over.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:19:1)


**וְלֹא יָשִׁיב אֶל לִבּוֹ. חֶצְיוֹ שָׂרַפְתִּי בְמוֹ אֵשׁ**:


**And he does not give it thought** [lit. and he does not return to his heart.] Half of it I burnt with fire.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:19:2)


**וְלֹא דַעַת וְלֹא תְבוּנָה** בּוֹ **לֵאמֹר** זֹאת:


**and he has neither knowledge nor understanding** [lit. and there is neither knowledge nor understanding] in him to say this.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:19:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:19:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:19:3)


**לְבוּל עֵץ.** לְרִקְבוֹן עֵץ:

### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:20:1)


**רֹעֶה אֵפֶר לֵב הוּתַל הִטָּהוּ.** לִבּוֹ אֲשֶׁר הוּתַל, הִטָּהוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת לוֹ רוֹעֶה שֶׁל אֵפֶר הַדְּמוּת, שֶׁנִּשְׂרַף חֶצְיוֹ וְנַעֲשָׂה אֵפֶר. הַשּׁוֹטֶה הַזֶּה הָיָה אוֹמֵר שֶׁהוּא לוֹ לְרוֹעֶה וּלְמְפַרְנֵס. דָּבָר אַחֵר: **רוֹעֶה אֵפֶר** לְשׁוֹן ׳רֵיעוּת׳, עוֹבֵד עֲבוֹדַת אֲחֵרִים וּמְחַבֵּר אֵלָיו עֲבוֹדַת אֲחֵרִים שֶׁהִיא אֵפֶר:


**[To] a provider [made] of ashes, a deceived heart has perverted him** His heart, which was deceived, turned him aside to make for himself a provider of ashes. The image, half of which was burned and made into ashes, this fool says that it is his provider and patron. Another explanation: רוֹעֶה אֵפֶר is an expression of companionship. One who worships idols associates himself with the idol, which is ash.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:20:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:20:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:20:2)


**וְלֹא יַצִּיל.** הַנִּתְעֶה אֶת נַפְשׁוֹ לֵאמֹר **הֲלוֹא שֶׁקֶר בִּימִינִי**, וְיִפָּרֵד מֵעָלָיו:


**and he shall not save** [i.e.,] the misled one shall not save his soul, saying, “Is there not falsehood in my right hand?” and separate from it.



### Verse 21

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:21:1)


**לֹא תִנָּשֵׁנִי.** לֹא תִּהְיֶה שָׁכוּחַ מִיִּרְאָתִי:


**do not forget Me** Do not forget My fear.



### Verse 22

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:22:1)

**I erased your transgressions like a thick cloud** in Egypt and in the desert. Now too, return to Me.



### Verse 23

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:23:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:23:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:23:1)


**פִּצְחוּ.** לְשׁוֹן פִּתְחוֹן פֶּה:

### Verse 24

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:24:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:24:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:24:1)


**וְיֹצֶרְךָ מִבָּטֶן.** מֵאָז ״וַיִּתְרוֹצְצוּ הַבָּנִים בְּקִרְבָּהּ״ (בראשית כה:כב) הָיִיתִי לְךָ לְעֶזְרָה וּבְחַרְתִּיךָ:


**and the One Who formed you from the womb** From the time that (Gen. 25:22) “the children struggled within her,” I was your help and I chose you.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:24:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:24:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:24:2)


**נֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם לְבַדִּי**:



### Verse 25

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:25:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:25:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:25:1)


**מֵפֵר אֹתוֹת בַּדִּים.** לְפִי שֶׁאֲנִי נָטִיתִי שָׁמַיִם, לְפִיכָךְ אֲנִי יָכוֹל לְהָפֵר אוֹתָם:


**Who stretched forth the heavens alone...Who frustrates the signs of imposters** Since I stretched forth the heavens, I can, therefore, frustrate their signs.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:25:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:25:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:25:2)


**בַּדִּים.** הֵם הַחוֹזִים בַּכּוֹכָבִים עַל יְדֵי **אֹתוֹת** הַשָּׁמַיִם, וְעַל שֵׁם שֶׁפְּעָמִים הַרְבֵּה שֶׁהֵם מְכַזְּבִים קוֹרִין אוֹתָם ׳בַּדִּים׳, שֶׁאֲנִי מַחֲלִיף הַשָּׂרִים שֶׁלְּמַעְלָה וְטוֹעִין אֵלּוּ הַנִּשְׁאָלִין בָּהֶם. וּלְפִי שֶׁאִצְטַגְנִינֵי בָּבֶל הָיוּ חוֹזִים בַּכּוֹכָבִים, כְּמוֹ שֶׁהוּא אוֹמֵר (ישעיהו מז:יג) ״יַעַמְדוּ נָא וְיוֹשִׁיעוּךְ הוֹבְרֵי שָׁמַיִם״, לְכָךְ הוּא אוֹמֵר שֶׁיָּפֵר אוֹתוֹת בַּדֵּיהֶם, כִּי אֲנִי הוּא שֶׁהֵפַרְתִּי אוֹתוֹת בַּדֵּי מִצְרַיִם:


**imposters** Heb. בַּדִּים. They are stargazers, who predict the future through signs of the heavens, and since many times they lie, they are called בַּדִּים, imposters, for I change the heavenly princes, and these who ask of them err, and since the astrologers of Babylon were stargazers, as Scripture states (infra 47:13), “Let them stand now, and let the gazers into the heavens save you.” He, therefore, states that He will frustrate the signs of their imposters, for I am He Who frustrated the signs of the imposters of Egypt.



### Verse 26

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:26:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:26:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:26:1)


**מֵקִים דְּבַר עַבְדּוֹ.** מֹשֶׁה:


**He fulfills the word of His servant** Moses.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:26:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:26:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:26:2)


**וַעֲצַת מַלְאָכָיו.** מַלְאָךְ אֶחָד אָמַר לְיַעֲקֹב ״יִשְׂרָאֵל יִהְיֶה שְׁמֶךָ״ (בראשית לב:כח), וְקִיַּמְתִּי דְּבָרָיו; אַף כָּאן אֲקַיֵּם עֲצַת נְבִיאַי **הָאוֹמֵר** עַל **יְרוּשָׁלִַם תּוּשָׁב**:


**and the counsel of His messengers** One angel said to Jacob (Gen. 32:27), “Israel shall be your name,” and I fulfilled his words. Here too, I will fulfill the counsel of My prophets who say concerning Jerusalem, “It shall be settled.”



### Verse 27

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:27:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:27:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:27:1)


**הָאֹמֵר לַצּוּלָה חֳרָבִי.** הָאוֹמֵר לְבָבֶל: הִתְיַבְּשִׁי (קהלת רבה יב ח):


**Who says to the deep, “Be dry”** Who says to Babylon, “Be dry.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:27:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:27:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:27:2)


**וְנַהֲרֹתַיִךְ אוֹבִישׁ.** לְפִי שֶׁהִיא יוֹשֶׁבֶת עַל נְהָרוֹת, מְדַמֶּה הֲרִיגַת אֻכְלוּסֶיהָ לְיֹבֶשׁ נְהָרוֹת:


**and I will dry up your rivers** Since it is situated on rivers, he compares the slaying of its population to the drying up of rivers.



### Verse 28

###### Rashi on Isaiah 44:28:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:28:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/44:28:1)


**רֹעִי.** מֶלֶךְ שֶׁלִּי:


**My shepherd** My king.



## Chapter 45


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:1:1)


**לִמְשִׁיחוֹ.** כָּל שֵׁם גְּדֻלָּה קְרוּיָה ׳מְשִׁיחָה׳, כְּמוֹ ״לְךָ נְתַתִּיהָ לְמָשְׁחָה״ (במדבר יח:ח). וְרַבּוֹתֵינוּ אָמְרוּ: לְמֶלֶךְ הַמָּשִׁיחַ אוֹמֵר הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא קוֹבֵל אֲנִי לְךָ עַל כּוֹרֶשׁ, כִּדְאִיתָא בְּמַסֶּכֶת מְגִילָּה (מגילה יב.):


**to His anointed one** Every title of greatness is called anointing. Comp. (Num. 18:8) “To you I have given them for greatness (לְמָשְׁחָה).” Our Sages, however, said: To the King Messiah, the Holy One, blessed be He, says, “I complain to you about Cyrus,” as it is stated in Tractate Megillah 12a.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:1:2)


**לְרַד לְפָנָיו גּוֹיִם.** לְהַרְקִיעַ וּלְרַדֵּד לְפָנָיו גּוֹיִם, **לְרַד** – לִשְׁטוֹחַ:


**to flatten nations before him** Heb. לְרַד, to spread out and to flatten nations before him. לְרַד is equivalent to לְרַדֵּד, to spread out.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:1:3)


**וּמָתְנֵי מְלָכִים אֲפַתֵּחַ.** לְשׁוֹן חַלָּשׁוּת הוּא זֶה וְשֶׁבֶר כֹּחַ, כִּי חֲגוֹרַת מָתְנַיִם הוּא זֵרוּז כֹּחַ, כְּמוֹ ״אֱזָר נָא כְגֶבֶר חֲלָצֶיךָ״ (איוב מ:ז), ״וְאַתָּה תֵאָזֹר מָתְנֶיךָ״ (ירמיהו א:יז). ״וּמְזִיחַ אֲפִיקִים רִפָּה״ (איוב יב:כא) לְשׁוֹן שִׁבְרוֹן כֹּחַ:


**and the loins of kings I will loosen** This is an expression of weakness and breaking strength, for girding the loins constitutes arming with strength. Comp. (Job 38:3) “Gird up your loins like a mighty man”; (Jer. 1:17) “And you gird up your loins”; (Job 12:21) “And the belt of the mighty He loosens”; an expression of breaking strength.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:1:4)


**לִפְתֹּחַ לְפָנָיו** דַּלְתֵי שַׁעֲרֵי בָּבֶל; **שְׁעָרִים** הוּא חֲלַל פֶּתַח הַשַּׁעַר, **דְּלָתַיִם** הֵם הַפּוֹתְחִים וְנוֹעֲלִין בָּהֶן אֶת הַשַּׁעַר:


**to open...before him** the portals of the gates of Babylon. Gates are the space of the opening of the gate; portals are those with which they open and lock the gate.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:2:1)


**וַהֲדוּרִים אֲיַשֵּׁר.** תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן: ״וְשׁוּרַיָּא אֶכְבּוֹשׁ״, כְּמוֹ ״הֲדַר הֲדַרְנָא״ (שבת עז:), עַל שֵׁם שֶׁסּוֹבֶבֶת הַחוֹמָה אֶת הָעִיר. וְיֵשׁ לְפָרֵשׁ **הֲדוּרִים**: אוֹרְחוֹת מְקֻלְקָלוֹת **אֲיַשֵּׁר** לְפָנָיו:


**and I will straighten out crooked paths** Heb. וַהֲדוּרִים אֲיַשֵּׁר. Jonathan renders: I will level the walls. Comp. (Shab. 77b) “the surrounding area (הדר הדרנא),” since the wall surrounds the city. The word may also be explained as: I will straighten out crooked paths before him.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:3:1)


**הַקּוֹרֵא בְשִׁמְךָ.** עֲדַיִן לֹא נוֹלַדְתָּ, וַאֲנִי קוֹרֵא לְךָ שֵׁם כּוֹרֶשׁ:


**Who calls [you] by your name** You are not yet born, and I call you by the name Cyrus.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:4:1)


**לְמַעַן עַבְדִּי יַעֲקֹב.** שֶׁתּוֹצִיאֵהוּ מִגָּלוּת בָּבֶל:


**For the sake of My servant Jacob** that you take him out of Babylonian exile.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:4:2)


**וְלֹא יְדַעְתָּנִי.** לֹא עָשִׂיתָ רְצוֹנִי, כִּי אֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי ״הוּא יִבְנֶה עִירִי״ (ישעיהו מה:יג), וְהוּא כְּשֶׁעָמַד אָמַר ״מִי בָכֶם מִכָּל עַמּוֹ״ (עזרא א:ג), רְשׁוּת נָתַן לָהֶם לֵילֵךְ, וְכָל הַטֹּרַח פָּרַק מֵעַל צַוָּארוֹ:


**yet you have not known Me** You did not do My will, for I said, (infra v. 13) “He shall build My city,” but he when he assumed the throne said, “Whoever among you is from all His people, may ascend.” He gave them permission to go, but he cast off all the trouble from upon his neck.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:7:1)


**יוֹצֵר אוֹר.** לַצַּדִּיקִים:


**Who forms light** for the righteous.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:7:2)


**וּבוֹרֵא חֹשֶׁךְ.** לְבָבֶל, וְכֵן **עֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם וּבוֹרֵא רָע**:


**and creates darkness** for Babylon, and the same applies to “Who makes peace and creates evil.”



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:8:1)


**הַרְעִיפוּ שָׁמַיִם וְגוֹ׳.** ״צֶדֶק״ הָאָמוּר בַּמִּקְרָא מוּסָב עַל הַנֶּזֶל וְעַל הָרְעִיפָה. הַרְעִיפוּ שָׁמַיִם צֶדֶק וּשְׁחָקִים יִזְּלוּ צֶדֶק, כְּלוֹמַר: מֵאִתִּי יָבֹא הַצֶּדֶק לְהֵיטִיב לָהֶם מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם:


**Cause the heavens to drip** Righteousness, mentioned in the verse, is the object of the dripping and the pouring. Make the heavens drip righteousness and the skies shall pour righteousness, i.e., from Me shall come the righteousness to benefit them from the heavens.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:8:2)


**בְּרָאתִיו.** בָּרָאתִי אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה:


**created it** I created this thing.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:9:1)


**הוֹי רָב אֶת יֹצְרוֹ.** נִתְנַבֵּא יְשַׁעְיָה עַל חֲבַקּוּק, שֶׁעָתִיד לַעֲמוֹד וְלִקְרוֹא תִּגָּר עַל אֹרֶךְ הַצְלָחָתוֹ שֶׁל נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר: ״עַד אָנָה ה׳ שִׁוַּעְתִּי וְגוֹ׳״ (חבקוק א:ב), ״וְתַעֲשֶׂה אָדָם כִּדְגֵי הַיָּם״ (חבקוק א:יד). וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אָמַר לִישַׁעְיָה: לָמָּה זֶה בָּא לָרִיב אִתִּי, סָבוּר הוּא שֶׁאֵינִי שָׂם עַל לֵב לְהוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת עַמִּי לְעֵת מְלֹאת אֲשֶׁר ״תִּרְצֶה הָאָרֶץ אֶת שַׁבְּתוֹתֶיהָ״ (ויקרא כו:לד)?


**Woe to him who contends with his Creator** Isaiah prophesied concerning Habakkuk, who was destined to stand and complain about the length of Nebuchadnezzar’s success (1:2): “How long, O Lord, have I entreated [You]?...” (v. 14) “And [why] have You made man like the fish of the sea?” And the Holy One, blessed be He, said to Isaiah, Why does this one come to contend with Me? Does he think that I do not give thought to save My people? When the time lapses, “that the land will appease its sabbaths” (Lev. 26:34).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:9:2)


**אֵין יָדַיִם לוֹ.** אֵין מָקוֹם לוֹ:


**has no place** [lit. has no hands,] has no place.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:10:1)


**הוֹי אֹמֵר לְאָב מַה תּוֹלִיד.** כָּסָבוּר הוּא לִהְיוֹת מְרַחֵם עַל הַבֵּן יוֹתֵר מֵאָבִיו. דָּבָר אַחֵר: הוֹי בֵּן הָאוֹמֵר לְאָב ״לָמָּה הוֹלַדְתָּ?״ דּוֹמֶה הוּא לָזֶה שֶׁהוּא **רָב אֶת יֹצְרוֹ**:


**Woe to him who says to a father, “What do you beget?”** He thinks that he has more pity on the son than his father. Another explanation is: Woe is the son who says to his father, “Why have you begotten?” He is analogous to the one who contends with his Creator.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:11:1)


**הָאֹתִיּוֹת שְׁאָלוּנִי וגו׳.** ה״א נְקוּדָה קָמַץ, לָמַדְתָּ שֶׁאֵינָהּ תְּמִיהָה. וְכֵן פֵּרְשׁוּ: אִם בָּאתֶם לִשְׁאוֹל לִי, אַתֶּם הַנְּבִיאִים, שְׁאָלוּנִי עַל אוֹתוֹת שָׁמַיִם וּמוֹפְתִים אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם רוֹאִים נוֹלָדִים בָּאָרֶץ, עֲלֵיהֶם הֱיוּ שׁוֹאֲלִים אוֹתִי מַה הֵם, אֲבָל **עַל בָּנַי וְעַל פֹּעַל יָדַי** יְשָׁרִים, שֶׁבִּשְׁבִילָם יָצַרְתִּי אֶת הַכֹּל, אַתֶּם בָּאִים לְצַוּוֹתִי וְלִקְרֹא לְפָנַי תִּגָּר?


**Ask Me about the signs etc.** Heb. הָאוֹתִיוֹת. The ‘heh’ is voweled with a ‘kamatz.’ This indicates that it is not the interrogative, but this is its explanation: If you have come to ask Me, you and the prophets, ask Me about the signs of the heavens and the wonders that you see coming about on the earth; about them you may ask Me, what they are, but about My children and about the work of My hands, Israel, for whose sake I formed everything, shall you come to command Me and to complain before Me?


###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:11:2)


**תְּצַוֻּנִי.** תָּמוֹהַּ הוּא, וְכִי עֲלֵיכֶם לְצַוּוֹת **עַל בָּנַי**? אֲנִי כְּבָר בָּרָאתִי לָהֶם הַיְּשׁוּעָה בְּמַחֲשָׁבָה שֶׁעָלְתָה לְפָנַי. כֵּיצַד? ״אָנֹכִי הַעִירוֹתִיהוּ בְצֶדֶק״ (ישעיהו מה:יג) עַל כּוֹרֶשׁ הוּא אוֹמֵר:


**do you command Me?** This is the interrogative. Must you command Me concerning My children? I have already created the salvation for them in the thought that has entered My mind [lit. has come before Me]. How so? I aroused him with righteousness. This is stated regarding Cyrus.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:12:1)


**אָנֹכִי עָשִׂיתִי אֶרֶץ**, וּנְתַתִּיהָ לַאֲשֶׁר יָשָׁר בְּעֵינַי:


**I made the earth** and gave it to whoever pleased Me [lit. was straight in My eyes].



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:14:1)


**יְגִיעַ מִצְרַיִם וְגוֹ׳.** הֲרֵי הוֹדַעְתִּי אֶתְכֶם בַּמֶּה אוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת בָּנַי מִיַּד בָּבֶל, כִּי כּוֹרֶשׁ לְכָךְ **הֶעִירוֹתִהוּ** בְּצִדְקִי. וְעוֹד אֲנִי מוֹדִיעֲכֶם תְּשׁוּעַת סַנְחֵרִיב בִּימֵי חִזְקִיָּהוּ, כַּאֲשֶׁר יָשׁוּב (ישעיהו לו:לו) מֵעַל תִּרְהָקָה מֶלֶךְ כּוּשׁ יָבֹא לִירוּשָׁלַיִם, וְחֶמְדַּת כָּל אוֹצְרוֹת כּוּשׁ וּמִצְרַיִם שֶׁיֵּלְכוּ לַעֲזוֹר אֶת כּוּשׁ בְּיָדוֹ, וְיָבֹא עִם אוֹתוֹ הַשָּׁלָל וְיִפּוֹל בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם, וְחִזְקִיָּהוּ וְעַמּוֹ יָבֹזּוּ אֶת הַכֹּל. כֵּן מְפוֹרָשׁ בְּסֵדֶר עוֹלָם (סדר עולם רבה כג) שֶׁעַל סַנְחֵרִיב נֶאֱמַר:


**The toil of Egypt etc.** I have informed how I will save My children from the hand of Babylon, for I have aroused Cyrus for that purpose with My righteousness. I further inform you of the salvation from Sennacherib that will take place in the days of Hezekiah. When he returns (supra 36:36) from marching upon Tirhaka, king of Cush, he will return to Jerusalem with all the valuable treasures of Cush, and Egypt, who will go to aid Cush, in his possession, and he will come with those spoils and fall in Jerusalem, and Hezekiah and his people will plunder everything. So is it delineated in Seder Olam (ch. 23) that it is stated concerning Sennacherib.

**אַנְשֵׁי מִדָּה.** גּוֹבְהֵי קוֹמָה:

**בַּזִּקִּים יַעֲבֹרוּ.** שֶׁהֱבִיאָם שָׁם סַנְחֵרִיב שְׁלוּלִים בְּקוֹלָרִים, וּלְאַחַר מַפַּלְתּוֹ עָמַד חִזְקִיָּהוּ וּפָטַר אֶת כָּל הַשְּׁבוּיִים, וְנִתְגַּיְּרוּ וְהִכִּירוּ מַלְכוּת שָׁמַיִם:


**they shall come over in chains** For Sennacherib brought them there, with neck-irons fastened to them, and after his defeat, Hezekiah stood and released all those captives, who became converted to Judaism and recognized the kingdom of Heaven.

**Only in you is God** They will acknowledge that there is no God but the Lord alone. ([Mss. and K’li Paz read:] but to Israel.)



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:15:1)


**אָכֵן אַתָּה אֵל מִסְתַּתֵּר** וְכֵן יֹאמְרוּ לְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא: אָכֵן הֲבִינוֹתָנוּ, כִּי לִגְבּוֹת חוֹבוֹתֵיהֶן שֶׁל עַמְּךָ אַתָּה מִסְתַּתֵּר מִלְּהַרְאוֹת נִצְחוֹנְךָ, כִּבְיָכוֹל אֵין בְּךָ יְכֹלֶת, וּבְהִתְעוֹרֵר רַחֲמֶיךָ אַתָּה **אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מוֹשִׁיעַ**. כָּךְ מְפוֹרָשׁ בַּמְּכִילְתָּא (מכילתא בשלח ויהי א):


**Indeed, You are a God Who conceals Himself** And so they shall say to the Holy One, blessed be He, “Indeed, You have given us to understand (we understand [Mss. and K’li Paz]) that to collect the debts of Your people, You conceal yourself from showing Your victory. So to speak, You have not the ability, and when Your mercy is aroused, You are the God of Israel, the Savior.” So it is explained in Mechilta (Ex. 14:4).

### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:19:1)


**לֹא בַסֵּתֶר דִּבַּרְתִּי.** כְּשֶׁנָּתַתִּי אֶת הַתּוֹרָה, וְלֹא אָמַרְתִּי עַל **תֹּהוּ** עַל חִנָּם: **לְזֶרַע יַעֲקֹב בַּקְּשׁוּנִי**, כִּי אִם לְקַבֵּל שָׂכָר גָּדוֹל:


**Not in secret did I speak** When I gave the Torah, and I did not say for naught and in vain to the seed of Jacob, Seek Me, but to receive great reward.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:19:2)


**אֲנִי ה׳ דֹּבֵר צֶדֶק.** מֵאַחַר שֶׁפָּתַחְתִּי לָהֶם בִּדְבַר צִדְקִי לְהוֹדִיעָם מַתַּן שְׂכָרָן, אַחַר כֵּן הִגַּדְתִּי לָהֶם **מֵישָׁרִים** חֻקַּי וְתוֹרָתִי, שֶׁקּוֹדֶם מַתַּן תּוֹרָה נֶאֱמַר לָהֶם (שמות יט:ה) ״וְעַתָּה אִם שָׁמוֹעַ וְגוֹ׳ וִהְיִיתֶם לִי סְגֻלָּה וּמַמְלֶכֶת כֹּהֲנִים וְגוֹ׳״:


**I am the Lord Who speaks righteousness** Since I commenced to speak to them concerning My righteousness, to inform them of the giving of their reward, afterwards I told them things that are right, My statutes and My laws, for before the giving of the Torah it was said to them, “And now, if you heed, etc., you shall be for Me a treasure...a kingdom of priests, etc.” (Ex. 19:5f.).

### Verse 21

###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:21:1)


**הִשְׁמִיעַ זֹאת מִקֶּדֶם.** מִי בִּפְסִילֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁמִיעַ מִקֶּדֶם לְהָבִיא אֱלֹהֵיכֶם תְּשׁוּעָה, אִישׁ אִישׁ לְעוֹבְדָיו?


**who announced this from before** Who of your idols is it that announced from before that your God brought salvation, each one to its worshipers?


###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:21:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:21:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:21:2)


**הֲלֹא אֲנִי ה׳ וְאֵין עוֹד.** שֶׁאֲנִי מוֹדִיעַ מַה אֲנִי עָתִיד לַעֲשׂוֹת לְעַמִּי, וַאֲקַיֵּם דְּבָרִי:


**Is it not I, the Lord, and there are no other** For I announce what I am destined to do for My people, and I fulfill My words.



### Verse 22

###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:22:1)


**פְּנוּ אֵלַי.** וְהַנִּיחוּ פְּסִילֵיכֶם, **כָּל אַפְסֵי אָרֶץ**, וּבְכָךְ תִּוָּשְׁעוּ:


**Turn to Me** and abandon your graven images, all the ends of the earth, and, thereby, you shall be saved.



### Verse 23

###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:23:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:23:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:23:1)


**בִּי נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי.** וְ**יָצָא מִפִּי צְדָקָה** לְקַבֵּל כָּל הַשָּׁבִים אֵלַי, **דָּבָר** דִּבַּרְתִּי **וְלֹא יָשׁוּב.** וּמַהוּ הַצְּדָקָה אֲשֶׁר יָצְאָת מִפִּי? **כִּי לִי תִּכְרַע כָּל בֶּרֶךְ**, וַאֲנִי אֲקַבְּלֵם, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״כִּי אָז אֶהְפֹּךְ אֶל עַמִּים וְגוֹ׳״ (צפניה ג:ט):


**By Myself I swore** and righteousness emanated from My mouth to accept all those who return to Me. I spoke a word, and it will not be retracted. What is the righteousness that emanated from My mouth? That to Me shall every knee kneel, and I will accept them, as the matter is stated (Zeph. 3: 9): “For then will I change for the people a pure language, to call all of them in the name of the Lord...”



### Verse 24

###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:24:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:24:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:24:1)


**אַךְ בַּה׳ לִי אָמַר.** הַמִּקְרָא זֶה מְסֹרָס, וְכֵן פִּתְרוֹנוֹ: **אַךְ לִי בַּה׳ אָמַר צְדָקוֹת וָעֹז**. אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁכָּל הַגּוֹיִם יִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנָיו, אַךְ לִי לְבַדִּי, כְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל, בַּה׳ הֻבְטַח לִי צְדָקוֹת וָעֹז, וְלֹא יָבוֹאוּ מַכְחִישֵׁי תּוֹרָה לְחַלֵּל כְּבוֹדִי:


**But to me did He say by the Lord** Heb. אַךְ בַה' לִי אָמַר [lit. but by the Lord to me He said]. This verse is inverted, and thus is its interpretation: But to me did He say by the Lord righteousness and strength. Although all the nations shall prostrate themselves before Him [correct reading according to Warsaw edition, K’li Paz, and mss.], but to me alone, the congregation of Israel, has been promised by the Lord righteousness and strength, and other nations shall not be included in my glory.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:24:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:24:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:24:2)


**עָדָיו יָבוֹא וְיֵבֹשׁוּ וגו׳. כָּל הַנֶּחֱרִים** בְּהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא יָבוֹאוּ עָדָיו לְהִתְחָרֵט עַל מַה שֶּׁעָשׂוּ בְּחַיֵּיהֶם **וְיֵבֹשׁוּ**:


**to Him shall come and be ashamed etc.** All who were incensed against the Holy One, blessed be He, shall come to Him to regret what they did in their lifetimes and be ashamed.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:24:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:24:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:24:3)


**הַנֶּחֱרִים.** הַמִּתְגָּרִים:


**all who are incensed** Heb. כֹּל הַנֶּחֱרִים בּוֹ, all who are incensed.



### Verse 25

###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:25:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:25:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:25:1)


**בַּה׳ יִצְדְּקוּ וְיִתְהַלְלוּ.** בְּהַבְטָחַת מִשְׁעַן אַהֲבָתוֹ יִמְצְאוּ צְדָקָה וְיִתְפָּאֲרוּ בְּמָעוֹז:


**Through the Lord...find righteousness and boast** Through the promise of the support of His love they shall find righteousness and boast of His strength.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 45:25:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:25:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/45:25:2)


**וְיִתְהַלְלוּ.** פורוונטי״ר בלע״ז:


**boast** Heb. וְיִתְהַלְלוּ, porvantir in O.F.



## Chapter 46


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:1:1)


**כָּרַע בֵּל קֹרֵס נְבוֹ.** אֱלָהוּתֵיהֶם שֶׁל בָּבֶל כָּרְעוּ קָרְסוּ, לְשׁוֹן שְׂחוֹק שֶׁל עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה הוּא, כְּמִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ חֹלִי מֵעַיִם וְאֵינוֹ מַסְפִּיק לֵישֵׁב עַל מוֹשַׁב בֵּית הַכִּסֵּא עַד שֶׁהוּא נִתְרָז:


**Bel squats; Nebo soils himself** The deities of Babylon squatted and soiled themselves. This is an expression of ridicule of the idols, like one who suffers from diarrhea and does not manage to sit down on the seat in the privy before he discharges with a splash.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:1:2)


**כָּרַע בֵּל קֹרֵס נְבוֹ.** אישקרופי״ר בֵּל, קונקיא״ה נְבוֹ. כָּךְ שָׁמַעְתִּי מִשְּׁמוֹ שֶׁל רַבֵּנוּ גֵּרְשׁוֹם מְאוֹר הַגּוֹלָה:


**Bel squats; Nebo soils himself** Heb. כָּרַע בֵּל קֹרֵס נְבוֹ. Akropid sei Bel; konkiad sei Nebo. Bel squats; Nebo soils himself. So I heard in the name of Rabbenu Gershom, the Light of the Diaspora.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:1:3)


**הָיוּ עֲצַבֵּיהֶם.** צַלְמֵי צוּרָתָם שֶׁל **בֵּל** וּ**נְבוֹ** הָיוּ **לַחַיָּה וְלַבְּהֵמָה**, נִדְמוּ לִהְיוֹת כְּחַיָּה וְכִבְהֵמָה, שֶׁמְּזַהֲמִין וּמְלַכְלְכִין עַצְמָן בְּרֵעִי שֶׁלָּהֶם:


**their idols were** The images of the forms of Bel and Nebo were to the beasts and the cattle, compared to the beasts and the cattle, which soil and dirty themselves with their droppings.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:1:4)


**נְשֻׂאֹתֵיכֶם עֲמוּסוֹת מַשָּׂא.** רְעִי שֶׁבִּמְעֵיהֶם כְּבֵדוֹת הֵם לַעֲמוֹס כְּמַשָּׂא לְאָדָם עָיֵף, לְפִיכָךְ **קָרְסוּ כָּרְעוּ יַחְדָּו**, הַקְּרִיסָה עִם הַכְּרִיעָה:


**what you carry is made a load, a burden** The feces in their bowels are heavy to bear like a burden for a weary man. Therefore, they soiled themselves and squatted together, the soiling with the squatting.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:2:1)


**לֹא יָכְלוּ מַלֵּט מַשָּׂא.** לְהַפְלִיט הַצּוֹאָה שֶׁבְּמֵעֵיהֶם כִּשְׁאָר הַמּוֹצִיאִין כַּהֹגֶן:


**they could not deliver the burden** to discharge the feces in their bowels as others discharge, in the normal manner.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:2:2)


**מַלֵּט.** לְשׁוֹן הוֹצָאָה מִמָּקוֹם בָּלוּעַ, וְכֵן (ישעיהו לד:טו) ״שָׁמָּה קִנְּנָה קִפּוֹז וַתְּמַלֵּט״, הוֹצִיאָה בֵּיצָתָהּ, וְכֵן (ישעיהו סו:ז) ״וְהִמְלִיטָה זָכָר״. וְיוֹנָתָן לֹא תִּרְגֵּם כֵּן הַמִּקְרָאוֹת הַלָּלוּ:


**deliver** Heb. מַלֵּט, an expression of discharging from an embedded place. Comp. (supra 34:15) “There, the owl has made its nest, and she has laid eggs (וַתְּמַלֵט),” he has discharged her egg. Comp. also (infra 66:7) “And she has been delivered (וְהִמְלִיטָה) of a male child.” Jonathan, however, did not render these verses in this manner.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:3:1)


**הָעֲמֻסִים מִנִּי בֶטֶן.** מֵאָז נוֹלַדְתֶּם בְּבֵית לָבָן הָאֲרַמִּי, עָמַסְתִּי אֶתְכֶם עַל זְרוֹעוֹתַי, כִּי מֵאָז עָמְדוּ עֲלֵיכֶם עוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר, וְלֹא כְּעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת שֶׁהָיוּ עוֹמְסִים וְנוֹשְׂאִים אֶת אֱלֹהֵיהֶם כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמוּר לְמַעְלָה, אֲבָל אַתֶּם עֲמוּסִים וּנְשׂוּאִים בִּזְרוֹעוֹתַי:


**who are borne from birth** Since you were born in the house of Laban the Aramean, I bore you on My arms, for since then, adversaries stand up against you in every generation and not like the idolaters (other nations [K’li Paz and mss.]) who are laden and carry their Gods, as is mentioned above, but you are laden and borne in My arms.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:4:1)


**וְעַד זִקְנָה.** אֲשֶׁר זְקַנְתֶּם וְכָלָה כֹּחֲכֶם, שֶׁאֵין לָכֶם זְכוּת, **אֲנִי הוּא** בְּרַחֲמַי וּבְמִדַּת טוּבִי לְהוֹשִׁיעֲכֶם וְלַעֲמֹס וְלָשֵׂאת לְמַלֵּט. לְפִי שֶׁאָמַר עַל יִרְאָתָם שֶׁהִיא נִסְבֶּלֶת, וְגַם מַשָּׂאָהּ אֵינָהּ יְכוֹלָה לְמַלֵּט, אָמַר: ״אֲנִי הַסּוֹבֵל אֲחֵרִים וְאֶת מַשָּׂאָם **אֲמַלֵּט**״:


**And until old age** that you have aged and your strength is depleted, that you have no merit, I am the same with My mercy and with My trait of goodness to save you and to bear you and to carry you and deliver you. Since he says regarding their deity, that it is carried and also that it cannot deliver its burden, he says, “But I bear others, and I will deliver My burden.”



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:5:1)


**וְתַמְשִׁלוּנִי.** כְּמוֹ ״וָאֶתְמַשֵּׁל כֶּעָפָר וָאֵפֶר״ (איוב ל:יט), לְשׁוֹן ׳דִּמְיוֹן׳:


**and compare Me** Heb. וְתַמְשִׁלֻנִי. Comp. (Job 30:19) “And I have become like (וָאֶתְמַשֵּׁל) dust and ashes.” An expression of comparison.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:5:2)


**וְנִדְמֶה.** וְנִהְיֶה אֲנִי וְהוּא דּוֹמִין זֶה לָזֶה:


**that we may be alike** That I and he be alike, one to the other.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:6:1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:6:2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:8:1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:8:2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:8:3

### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:9:1

### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:10:1)


**מַגִּיד מֵרֵאשִׁית אַחֲרִית.** גָּלוּת מִצְרַיִם וּגְאֻלָּתָהּ הוֹדַעְתִּי בֵּין הַבְּתָרִים, לִפְנֵי הֱיוֹתָהּ:


**[I] tell the end from the beginning** The Egyptian exile and its redemption I announced in the Covenant between the Segments, before they came about.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:11:1)


**קוֹרֵא מִמִּזְרָח עַיִט.** מֵאֶרֶץ אֲרָם, שֶׁהִיא בַּמִּזְרָח, קָרָאתִי לִי אֶת אַבְרָהָם לִהְיוֹת נִמְלָךְ בַּעֲצָתִי. **עַיִט** – כְּמוֹ ״הֵיתִיב עֵיטָא וְטַעַם״ (דניאל ב:יד), ״אִתְיָעֲטוּ כָּל סָרְכֵי מַלְכוּתָא״ (דניאל ו:ח). וְגַם יֵשׁ לְפוֹתְרוֹ בִּלְשׁוֹן עוֹף: קְרָאתִי לְמַהֵר אַחֲרַי כְּעוֹף הַפּוֹרֵחַ וְנוֹדֵד מִמְּקוֹמוֹ:


**[I] call from the east a swift bird** Heb. עַיִט. From the land of Aram, which is in the east, I called Abraham to Me to take counsel with Me. עַיִט Comp. (Dan. 2:14) “Answered with counsel (עֵיטָא) and discretion”; (ibid. 6:8) “All the presidents of the kingdom have taken counsel (אִתְיָעֲטוּ).” Alternatively, it can be interpreted as an expression of a bird. I called him to hasten after Me like a bird that flies and wanders from its place.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:11:2)


**מֶרְחָק.** קָרָאתִי לְ**אִישׁ עֲצָתִי**, וְעִמּוֹ יָעַצְתִּי בֵּין הַבְּתָרִים ד׳ גָּלֻיּוֹת, כְּמוֹ שֶׁמְּפוֹרָשׁ בִּבְרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה (בראשית רבה מד יז) ״וְהִנֵּה אֵימָה חֲשֵׁכָה גְדוֹלָה וְגוֹ׳״ (בראשית טו:יב):


**from a distant land** I called My man of counsel, and with him I took counsel between the parts concerning the four exiles, as it is explained in Gen. Rabbah (44:17) “And behold, a fear, great darkness was falling upon him.” [“Fear” refers to Babylon... “Darkness” refers to Media, who darkened the eyes of Israel with fasting. “Great” refers to Greece... “Was falling upon him” refers to Edom..., etc.]


###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:11:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:11:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:11:3)


**אַף דִּבַּרְתִּי.** עִמּוֹ הַגָּלֻיּוֹת וּגְאֻלָּתָן, **אַף אֲבִיאֶנָּה**:


**yea I spoke** with him concerning the exiles and their redemption; I will also bring it.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:12:1)


**אַבִּירֵי לֵב.** אֲשֶׁר אִמַּצְתֶּם לְבַבְכֶם וְנִדְבַּקְתֶּם בִּי:


**stout-hearted** You who have strengthened your heart among the heathens (the nations [Parshandatha, K’li Paz]) and have clung to Me.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:12:2)


**הָרְחוֹקִים מִצְּדָקָה.** אֲשֶׁר אָרְכוּ לָכֶם הַיָּמִים, וְלֹא הֶרְאֵיתִי אֶתְכֶם צִדְקָתִי לִגְאוֹל:


**that are far from righteousness** For it has been a long time for you, and I have not demonstrated to you My righteousness to redeem you.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Isaiah 46:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/46:13:1)


**קֵרַבְתִּי צִדְקָתִי.** מֵעַתָּה וְ**לֹא תִרְחָק**:


**I have brought near My righteousness** from now on, and it will not be far off.



## Chapter 47


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:1:1)


**אֵין כִּסֵּא.** אֵין מַלְכוּת:


**without a throne** Without a kingdom.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:1:2)


**כִּי לֹא תוֹסִיפִי.** שֶׁ**יִּקְרְאוּ לָךְ** עוֹד **רַכָּה וַעֲנֻגָּה**:


**for no longer** [lit. for you shall not continue,] that they call you tender and delicate.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:2:1)


**קְחִי רֵחַיִם.** הִיא עֲבוֹדָה קָשָׁה, כְּלוֹמַר: הִשְׁתַּעְבְּדִי מֵעַתָּה לְמַלְכֵי מָדַי וּפָרַס. דָּבָר אַחֵר: **וְטַחֲנִי קָמַח** לְצֵדָה לְדֶרֶךְ גָּלוּתֵךְ:


**Take millstones** This is hard labor, i.e., subordinate yourself from now on, to the kings of Persia and Media. Alternatively: And grind flour for supplies on the road of your exile.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:2:2)


**גַּלִּי צַמָּתֵךְ.** זְרוֹעֵךְ וְשׁוֹקַיִךְ, דָּבָר הַמְצֻמָּת וְקָשׁוּר וּמְכֻסֶּה:


**bare your covered parts** Your arms and your legs, parts veiled, tied, and covered.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:2:3)


**חֶשְׂפִּי שֹׁבֶל.** גַּלִּי הַשְּׁבִילִים מִן הַמַּיִם שֶׁעֲלֵיהֶם, כִּי דֶּרֶךְ שָׁם תֵּצְאִי בַּגּוֹלָה. אוֹ **גַּלִּי** שׁוֹקֵךְ וְ**עִבְרִי נְהָרוֹת**:


**uncover the paths** Heb. חֶשְׂפִּי שֹׁבֶל. Uncover the paths of the water that is upon them, for that way you shall go out into exile, or bare your leg and cross rivers.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:3:1)


**וְלֹא אֶפְגַּע אָדָם.** לֹא אֲבַקֵּשׁ פְּנֵי אָדָם לָקַחַת נִקְמָתִי:


**I will not entreat any man** I will ask no man to take My revenge.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:4:1)


**גֹּאֲלֵנוּ ה׳ צְבָאוֹת שְׁמוֹ.** הַנָּבִיא אוֹמֵר: כָּל זֶה הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא עוֹשֶׂה לְגָאֳלֵנוּ מִשָּׁם:


**Our redeemer, the Lord of Hosts is His name** The prophet states: All this the Lord of Hosts does, to redeem us from there.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:6:1)


**עַל זָקֵן הִכְבַּדְתְּ עֻלֵּךְ.** עַל הַזְּקֵנִים, שֶׁלֹּא הָיוּ יְכוֹלִים לִסְבּוֹל טֹרַח, הִכְבַּדְתְּ עֻלֵּךְ:


**on the aged you made your yoke very heavy** On the aged, who were unable to bear hard work, you made heavy your yoke.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:7:1)


**וַתֹּאמְרִי** בִּלְבָבֵךְ **לְעוֹלָם אֶהְיֶה גְבָרֶת**, וְאֵין פֻּרְעָנוּת בָּא עָלַי, וְהַדָּבָר הַזֶּה הִשִּׂיאָךְ, **עַד לֹא שַׂמְתְּ אֵלֶּה** הַמַּכּוֹת שֶׁיָּבוֹאוּ עָלַיִךְ אֶל **לִבֵּךְ**, וְ**לֹא זָכַרְתְּ אַחֲרִיתָהּ** שֶׁל רָעָתֵךְ שֶׁעָשִׂית:


**And you said** to yourself, “I will forever be a mistress, and no retribution shall come upon me,” and this thing enticed you until you did not take to heart these blows that would come upon you, and you did not remember the end of your evil that you have done.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:8:1)


**עֲדִינָה.** תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן: ״פְּנַקְתָּא״:


**delicate one** Heb. עֲדִינָה. Jonathan renders: מְפַנֶּקְתָּא, delicate.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:8:2)


**וְאַפְסִי עוֹד.** וְ״אֶפֶס מֵאוֹתִי״ (ישעיהו נד:טו) כְּמוֹ ׳אֵין זוּלָתִי׳:


**and there is none besides me** Heb. וְאַפְסִי. And there is none outside of me. Like אֵין זוּלָתִי.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:9:1)


**שְׁתֵּי אֵלֶּה.** שֶׁאָמַרְתְּ, שֶׁלֹּא תֵשְׁבִי אַלְמָנָה, וְלֹא תֵדְעִי שְׁכוֹל, תָּבֹאנָה לָךְ פִּתְאוֹם:


**these two** that you said that you would not sit as a widow and you would not know bereavement, shall suddenly come upon you.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:9:2)


**שְׁכוֹל.** מִיּוֹשְׁבַיִךְ:


**bereavement** of your inhabitants.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:9:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:9:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:9:3)


**וְאַלְמֹן.** מִמַּלְכֵּךְ; כָּל קְבוּרַת בָּנִים וְגָלוּת בְּנֵי הָאָרֶץ קָרוּי ׳שְׁכוֹל׳:


**and widowhood** of your king. Any burial of children or exile of the people of a land is called bereavement.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:9:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:9:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:9:4)


**כְּתֻמָּם.** כֻּלָּם שְׁלֵמִים בִּגְזֵרָתָם, הַשִּׁכּוּל וְהָאַלְמָנוּת:


**in their full measure** All of them, complete in their decree, the bereavement and the widowhood.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:9:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:9:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:9:5)


**חֲבָרָיִךְ.** לְשׁוֹן כְּשָׁפִים, כְּמוֹ ״וְחֹבֵר חָבֶר״ (דברים יח:יא):


**your charms** Heb. חֲבָרַיִךְ. An expression of sorcery. Comp. (Deut. 18:11) “And a charmer (וְחֹבֵר חָבֶר).”



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:10:1)


**חָכְמָתֵךְ וְדַעְתֵּךְ.** חָכְמָתֵךְ וְרוֹעַ לְבָבֵךְ **הִיא שׁוֹבְבָתֶּךְ**, הָפְכוּ לִבֵּךְ לִהְיוֹת שׁוֹבְבָה, אינווייז״א בלע״ז, שִׁבְּבוּךְ מִדֶּרֶךְ שְׁאָר הַבְּרִיּוֹת:


**your wisdom and your knowledge** Your wisdom and the evil of your heart that perverted you. They turned your heart to be perverted, envesede in O.F. It perverted you from the way of other people (other daughters [mss. and K’li Paz]).



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:11:1)


**לֹא תֵדְעִי שַׁחְרָהּ.** ״לֹא תֵדְעִין לְמִבְעֵי עֲלַהּ״ (תרגום יונתן), אֶת פְּנֵי מִי תְשַׁחֲרִי לְמַלְּטֵךְ מִמֶּנָּה?


**you shall not know how to remove it by prayer** Heb. לֹֹא תֵדְעִי שַׁחְרָהּ. You shall not know to pray about it (Jonathan). Whom will you beseech to extricate you therefrom?


###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:11:2)


**כַּפְּרָהּ.** לְקַנְּחָהּ וּלְהַעֲבִירָהּ, וְזֶהוּ כָּל לְשׁוֹן ׳כַּפָּרָה׳, הוּא לְשׁוֹן קִנּוּחַ וְסִלּוּק:


**to rid yourself of it** Heb. כַּפְּרָהּ, to wipe it away and to remove it, and this is every expression of atonement (כַּפָּרָה). It is an expression of wiping and taking away.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:12:1)


**עִמְדִי נָא.** הִתְחַזְּקִי נָא:


**Stand now** Strengthen yourself now.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:12:2)


**אוּלַי תַּעֲרוֹצִי.** ״מֵאִים תִּכְלִין לְמִיתְקַף״ (תרגום יונתן):


**perhaps you will gain strength** Heb. תַּעֲרוֹצִי. Jonathan renders: Perhaps you will be able to become strong.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:13:1)


**הֹבְרֵי שָׁמַיִם.** יוֹנָתָן תִּרְגֵּם כְּמוֹ צוֹפֵי שָׁמַיִם״ דְּמִסְכַּן לְמַזָּלַת שְׁמַיָּא״, דִּמָּהוּ לְ״בָּרָה כַחַמָּה״ (שיר השירים ו:י) וּלְ״בָּרוּר מִלֵּלוּ״ (איוב לג:ג), וְכֵן חִבְּרוֹ מְנַחֵם עִמָּהֶם, מְבָרְרֵי הֲלִיכַת הַמַּזָּלוֹת, וְכֹה פִּתְרוֹנוֹ: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא יוּכְלוּן הַקּוֹסְמִים לַעֲמֹד עַל דַּעַת רִגְעֵי הַיּוֹם וְלַיְלָה, עַד בָּרוּר לָהֶם הַשָּׁמַיִם לְטֹהַר. וְגַם מִיכָה אָמַר בִּנְבוּאָה (מיכה ג:ו) ״חָשְׁכָה לָהֶם מִקְּסֹם״, לִמֵּד כִּי בְּיוֹם מַחְשָׁךְ יֵחָתְמוּ הַכּוֹכָבִים וְלֹא יוּכְלוּ לִקְסֹם:


**astrologers** Heb. הֹבְרֵי שָׁמַיִם. Jonathan renders it like ‘the gazers of the heavens,’ who gaze at the constellations of the heavens. He compares it to (Song 6:10) “Clear (בָּרָה) as the sun,” and to (Job 33: 3) “Spoke a clear (בָּרוּר) word.” And so did Menahem associate it with them (Machbereth Menahem p. 47f.); those who clarify the orbit of the constellations, and he interpreted it thus because the diviners are unable to determine the seconds of the day and the night until the heaven is perfectly clear to them. Micah, too, said in prophecy (3:6), “It has become too dark for you to divine.” This teaches us that on a dark day the stars are sealed, and they cannot divine (ibid. p. 13).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:13:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:13:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:13:2)


**מוֹדִיעִם לֶחֳדָשִׁים מֵאֲשֶׁר יָבֹאוּ עָלָיִךְ.** כִּי בְּהִתְחַדֵּשׁ הַלְּבָנָה רוֹאִים בִּשְׁעַת מוֹלַדְתָּהּ מִקְצָת מִמָּה שֶׁעָתִיד לָבֹא, וְאֵין יוֹדְעִין כָּל הַבֵּרוּר, לְכָךְ נֶאֱמַר ׳מֵאֲשֶׁר׳. וְכֵן הוּא אוֹמֵר בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר (ישעיהו ח:יט): ״הַמְצַפְצְפִים וְהַמַּהְגִּים״, כְּעוֹפוֹת הַלָּלוּ שֶׁמְּצַפְצְפִין וּמְהַגִּים וְאֵין יוֹדְעִים עַל מָה:


**the monthly prognosticators of what will come upon you** For when the moon is in its first phase [lit. renewed], they see at the time of its ‘birth’ part of what is destined to come, but they do not know it clearly. Therefore, it is stated, “of what.” Similarly, he says elsewhere (supra 8:19): “who chirp and mutter,” like these birds who chirp and mutter and do not know why.

**הִנֵּה הָיוּ** חוֹזַיִךְ **כְקַשׁ**:


**Behold they were** Your stargazers were like stubble.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/47:14:2)


**אֵין גַּחֶלֶת לַחְמָם.** אֵין שְׁאֵרִית לָהֶם, **כְקַשׁ** הַזֶּה, שֶׁאֵין בִּדְלִיקָתוֹ גֶּחָלִים לְהִתְחַמֵּם לְאוֹרָם:


**there is no coal by which to warm oneself** They have no remnant, like stubble, the fire of which does not leave over coals by whose fire one can warm himself.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 47:15:1

**each one strayed to his side** each one to his way, to the side of his face [i.e., each one wandered away in the direction he was facing].



## Chapter 48


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 48:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:1:1)


**שִׁמְעוּ זֹאת.** שְׁנֵי שְׁבָטִים הָעֲתִידִין לָלֶכֶת בַּגּוֹלָה לְבָבֶל:


**Hearken to this** The two tribes destined to go in exile to Babylon.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 48:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:1:2)


**בֵּית יַעֲקֹב הַנִּקְרָאִים בְּשֵׁם יִשְׂרָאֵל.** הוּא שֵׁבֶט בִּנְיָמִין שֶׁאֵינָם נִקְרָאִים עַל שֵׁבֶט יְהוּדָה, אֶלָּא עַל שֵׁם סְתָם שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל:


**O house of Jacob, who are called by the name of Israel** That is the tribe of Benjamin, who are not called by the tribe of Judah, but by the general name of the tribes of Israel.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 48:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:1:3)


**וּמִמֵּי יְהוּדָה יָצָאוּ.** וְשֵׁבֶט יְהוּדָה, שֶׁיָּצְאוּ וְנָזְלוּ מִמֵּי דָּלְיוֹ שֶׁל יְהוּדָה, כְּמָה דְאַתְּ אָמַר ״יִזַּל מַיִם מִדָּלְיָו״ (במדבר כד:ז):


**and who emanated from the waters of Judah** And the tribe of Judah who emanated and ran from the waters of Judah’s pail, as Scripture states (Num. 24: 7): “Water shall run out of his pails.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 48:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:1:4)


**לֹא בֶאֱמֶת.** כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר (ירמיהו ה:ב) ״וְאִם חַי ה׳ יֹאמְרוּ לָכֵן לַשֶּׁקֶר וְגוֹ׳״, כְּלוֹמַר: לֹא הֱיִיתֶם כְּדַי לִגָּאֵל, אֶלָּא עַל **כִּי מֵעִיר הַקֹּדֶשׁ נִקְרָאוּ**, וְהִיא גָּרְמָה לָהֶם שֶׁלֹּא גָּלוּ עֲשֶׂרֶת הַשְּׁבָטִים בִּימֵי סַנְחֵרִיב בַּחֲלַח וְחָבוֹר (מלכים ב יז:ו), שֶׁאֵין לָהֶם גְּאֻלָה (סנהדרין קי ב):


**neither in truth** As Jeremiah said, (5:2) “And if they say, ‘As the Lord lives,’ surely they swear falsely,” i.e., you were unworthy of being redeemed, but since they were called [as being] from the Holy City, and that caused them not to be exiled with the ten tribes in the time of Sennacherib, to Halah and Habor, for they have no redemption.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 48:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:2:1)


**וְעַל אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נִסְמָכוּ.** בִּימֵי חִזְקִיָּהוּ, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר בּוֹ ״בַּה׳ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּטָח״ (מלכים ב יח:ה). הִיא גָּרְמָה לָהֶם שֶׁלֹּא גָּלוּ אֶלָּא בִּימֵי נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר, שֶׁהִגְלָם לְבָבֶל, וּתְהִי לָהֶם גְּאֻלָּה עַל יְדֵי כּוֹרֶשׁ:


**and they leaned on the God of Israel** in the days of Hezekiah, about whom it is written (2 Kings 18:5): “He trusted in the Lord God of Israel.” That caused them not to be exiled except in the days of Nebuchadnezzar, who exiled them to Babylon, and they had a redemption through Cyrus.

###### Rashi on Isaiah 48:3:3

### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 48:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:4:1)


**מִדַּעְתִּי כִּי קָשֶׁה אָתָּה.** מֵאֲשֶׁר יָדַעְתִּי אוֹתְךָ כִּי קָשֶׁה אַתָּה, וְאִם יָבֹא הַנֵּס וְלֹא הִגַּדְתִּיו תְּחִלָּה, **תֹּאמַר: ״עָצְבִּי** עֲשָׂאָם״, וְלֹא מֵאֵת הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא הֵם. לְפִיכָךְ **אַגִּיד לְךָ מֵאָז בְּטֶרֶם תָּבֹא וְגוֹ׳**. **מִדַּעְתִּי** – מֵ״ם זוֹ מְשַׁמֶּשֶׁת נְתִינַת טַעַם, כְּמוֹ ׳לְפִי שֶׁיָּדַעְתִּי׳. וְדֻגְמָתוֹ: ״כִּי מֵאַהֲבַת ה׳ אֶתְכֶם וּמִשָּׁמְרוֹ אֶת הַשְּׁבוּעָה״ (דברים ז:ח):


**Because of My knowledge that you are obstinate.** Heb. מִדַּעְתִּי. Because I knew you, that you are obstinate, and if the miracle would come and I had not told of it before, you would say, “My idol performed them, and they were not from the Holy One, blessed be He.” Therefore, I told you from then; when it had not yet come to pass etc. מִדַּעְתִּי [although usually translated ‘from My knowledge,’ in this case,] ; the ‘mem’ denotes the giving of a reason, like ‘Because I knew.’ A similar form [is found in Deut. 7:8:], “For, because of the Lord’s love (מֵאַהֲבַת) for you, and because of His observing (וּמִשָּׁמְרוֹ) the oath.”

###### Rashi on Isaiah 48:6:3

**הִשְׁמַעְתִּיךָ חֲדָשׁוֹת מֵעַתָּה.** עַתָּה אֲנִי חוֹזֵר וּמַשְׁמִיעֲכֶם חֲדָשׁוֹת, שֶׁהֵם חֲדָשׁוֹת לָכֶם, וּלְפָנַי הֵם גְּלוּיוֹת מֵעוֹלָם:
