### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 48:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:8:1)


**גַּם לֹא שָׁמַעְתָּ וגו׳.** תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן: ״אַף לָא שְׁמַעְתָּ לְמִילֵי נְבִיָּיא, אַף לָא קַבִּילְתָּא אוּלְפַן אוֹרַיְיתָא, אַף לְפִתְגָמֵי בִּרְכָן וְלָוְוטִין קַיָּמֵי דְּאַקִימִית עִמְכוֹן בְּחוֹרֵב לָא אַרְכִּינְתָּא אוּדְנָךְ״:


**Neither did you hearken** Jonathan renders: Neither did you hearken to the words of the prophets, neither did you accept the teaching of the Torah, nor did you bend your ear to the words of the blessings and the curses of My covenant that I established with you at Horeb.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 48:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:8:2)


**כִּי יָדַעְתִּי בָּגוֹד תִּבְגּוֹד.** כְּשֶׁיָּרַדְתִּי לְהַצִּילְךָ מִיַּד מִצְרַיִם, גָּלוּי הָיָה לְפָנַי שֶׁסּוֹפְךָ לִבְגּוֹד, וְאַף עַל פִּי כֵן שָׁמַרְתִּי שְׁבוּעוֹת אָבוֹת. וְזֶהוּ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״רָאֹה רָאִיתִי אֶת עֳנִי עַמִּי״ (שמות ג:ז), שְׁתֵּי רְאִיּוֹת רוֹאֶה אֲנִי שֶׁסּוֹפָן לִבְגּוֹד, וּמִכָּל מָקוֹם רָאִיתִי אֶת עֳנִי עַמִּי. כָּךְ דָּרַשׁ רַבִּי תַּנְחוּמָא:


**for I knew that you would deal treacherously** When I came down to save you from the hands of the Egyptians, it was revealed to Me that you would eventually deal treacherously. Nevertheless, I kept the oath of the Patriarchs. This is what is stated (Ex. 3:7): “I saw the affliction of My people.” [The Hebrew expression for “I saw,” is רָאֹה רָאִיתִי, a double verb form, which denotes] two seeings. I see that they will eventually deal treacherously, but, nevertheless, I saw the affliction of My people. Rabbi Tanhuma expounded it in this manner.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 48:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:8:3)


**וּפֹשֵׁעַ מִבֶּטֶן.** מִשֶּׁהָיִיתָ בְּמִצְרַיִם, כְּמוֹ שֶׁמְּפֹרָשׁ (יחזקאל כ:ה-ז) ״וָאִוָּדַע לָהֶם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וְגוֹ׳ וָאוֹמַר אֲלֵיהֶם וְגוֹ׳״:


**and...transgressor from the womb** Since you were in Egypt, as it is related in Ezekiel (20:5): “And I made Myself known in the land of Egypt, etc. (v. 7) and I said to them, [Cast away, each man the abominations of his eyes, and do not contaminate yourselves with the idols of Egypt].”



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 48:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:9:1)


**אַאֲרִיךְ אַפִּי.** לְשׁוֹן הוֹוֶה הוּא:


**I defer My anger** Heb. (אַאֲרִיךְ אַפִּי). Despite the future form, it is an expression of the present.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 48:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:9:2)


**וּתְהִלָּתִי אֶחֱטָם לָךְ.** וְזֹאת הִיא תְהִלָּתִי אֲשֶׁר אֶחֱטָם לָךְ, לְשׁוֹן ׳חֹטֶם׳; אֶסְתּוֹם חָטְמִי מִצֵּאת עָשָׁן נְחִירַי וּמִקְּצוֹף עָלֶיךָ, שֶׁהַכּוֹעֵס יוֹצֵא עָשָׁן מִנְּחִירָיו, כְּמָה דְאַתְּ אָמַר ״עָלָה עָשָׁן בְּאַפּוֹ״ (תהילים יח:ט); וְכֵן כָּל ׳חֲרוֹן אַף׳ הוּא לְשׁוֹן חִמּוּם הַחוֹטֶם: ״חָרָה אַפִּי״ (איוב מב:ז), וְכֵן ״וְעַצְמִי חָרָה מִנִּי חֹרֶב״ (איוב ל:ל) – נִחַר חָטְמִי מֵרֹב חִמּוּם:


**and My praise is that I restrain My wrath** Heb. אֶחֱטָם. And this is My praise, that I restrain My wrath for you. אֶחֱטָם is an expression of חֹטֶם, a nose. I will close My nose not to allow the smoke of My nostrils to go out and not to be angry with you, for, when one is angry, smoke comes out of his nostrils, as Scripture states (Ps. 18:9): “Smoke rose in His nose.” Likewise, every expression of ‘kindling of anger’ (חֲרוֹן אַף) is an expression of the heating of the nose, (Job. 42:7) “My anger was kindled (חָרָה אַפִּי).” Comp. also (ibid. 30:30) “And my bones were burnt (חָרָה) from heat.” My nose was heated (נִחַר) from much heat.”

**but not as silver** [lit. but not with silver.] Not with the fire of Gehinnom, as silver is refined through fire.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 48:10:2

**בְּחַרְתִּיךָ.** בָּחַרְתִּי לְךָ **כּוּר עֹנִי**, כְּנֶגֶד אוֹר. ׳כּוּר׳ הוּא כְּלִי שֶׁמַּתִּיכִין בּוֹ כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב:


**I have chosen for you** Heb. בְּחַרְתִּיךָ. I have chosen for you the crucible of poverty as opposed to the crucible of fire. A crucible (כּוּר) is a vessel in which they melt silver and gold.

### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 48:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:15:1)


**אֲנִי.** גָּאַלְתִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרַיִם, וַאֲנִי אֶגְאַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל מִגָּלוּת אַחֲרוֹן וּמֵאַרְבַּע כַּנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ:

###### Rashi on Isaiah 48:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:15:2)


**אַף קְרָאתִיו.** לְכוֹרֶשׁ, וְיוֹנָתָן תִּרְגֵּם **ה׳ אַהֲבוֹ** לְיִשְׂרָאֵל, **אַף קְרָאתִיו** לְאַבְרָהָם, וּקְרִיאָה זוֹ לְשׁוֹן ׳גִּדּוּל׳ לִהְיוֹת מִקּוֹרְאַי, כְּמוֹ ״אֵלֶּה קְרוּאֵי הָעֵדָה״ (במדבר א:טז):

### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Isaiah 48:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:16:1)


**מֵעֵת הֱיוֹתָהּ שָׁם אָנִי.** ״מֵעִידָּן דְּאִתְפָּרְשׁוּ עַמְמַיָּא מִדַּחַלְתִּי, תַּמָּן אֲנָא קְרִיבְתֵּיהּ לְאַבְרָהָם אֲבוּכוֹן לְפוּלְחָנִי״ (תרגום יונתן):


**from the time it was, there was I** [Jonathan paraphrases:] From the time the nations ceased fearing Me, there I brought Abraham your father near to My service.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 48:16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/48:16:2)


**וְעַתָּה ה׳ אֱלֹהִים שְׁלָחַנִי וְרוּחוֹ.** ״אָמַר נָבִיא: וּכְעַן ה׳ אֱלֹהִים שְׁלָחַנִי וּמֵימְרֵיהּ״. עֵרוּבֵי דְבָרִים – מִי שֶׁאָמַר זֶה לֹא אָמַר זֶה. וּמִדְרַשׁ אַגָּדָה רַבִּי תַּנְחוּמָא (תנחומא יתרו כא) פֵּרֵשׁ: **שִׁמְעוּ זֹאת** – תּוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר בָּהּ ״זֹאת הַתּוֹרָה״. **לֹא מֵרֹאשׁ בַּסֵּתֶר דִּבַּרְתִּי** – בְּסִינַי, וְהַנָּבִיא אוֹמֵר: **מֵעֵת הֱיוֹתָהּ** לְאוֹתוֹ דָבָר שֶׁהוּא אוֹמֵר **שָׁם אָנִי**. וְלָמַדְנוּ מִכָּאן שֶׁכָּל הַנְּבִיאִים עָמְדוּ בְּסִינַי, וְעַתָּה שְׁלָחַנִי לְהִנָּבֵא אֲלֵיהֶם. וְאַף לָשׁוֹן זֶה יֶשְׁנוֹ עֵרוּבֵי דְבָרִים: **לֹא מֵרֹאשׁ בַּסֵּתֶר דִּבַּרְתִּי** אָמְרָה שְׁכִינָה, **מֵעֵת הֱיוֹתָהּ שָׁם אָנִי** אוֹמֵר הַנָּבִיא. וְיֵשׁ לִפְתּוֹר שֶׁלֹּא יְהוּ עֵרוּבֵי דְבָרִים: **קִרְבוּ אֵלַי שִׁמְעוּ זֹאת** שֶׁאֲנִי מִתְנַבֵּא לָכֶם עַל מַפֶּלֶת בָּבֶל וּגְאֻלַּתְכֶם, **לֹא מֵרֹאשׁ בַּסֵּתֶר דִּבַּרְתִּי** אוֹתָהּ, **מֵעֵת הֱיוֹתָהּ** שֶׁגָּזַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לַהֲבִיאָהּ **שָׁם** הָיִיתִי. לוֹמֵד שֶׁמִּשְּׁעַת הַגְּזֵרָה הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא מַעֲמִיד הַנָּבִיא שֶׁעָתִיד לְהִנָּבֵא עַל הַדָּבָר בְּסוֹף פַּמַלְיָא שֶׁל מַעְלָה, וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁעֲדַיִן אֵינוֹ נוֹצָר:


**and now, the Lord God has sent me, and His spirit** [Jonathan paraphrases:] Said the prophet, “And now, the Lord God has sent me, and His word.” This is an intermingling of words. The one who said this did not say that [i.e., the first part of the verse was said by God, and the second part by the prophet]. And the Aggadic Midrash of Rabbi Tanhuma (Yithro 21) explains: Hearken to this—This alludes to Moses’ Torah, referred to as “This is the Torah.” In the beginning, I did not speak in secretat Sinai. And the prophet says, “From the time that thing was that, He says, I was there.” And we learned from here that all the prophets stood at Sinai. And now He sent me to prophesy to them. Even in this version there is an intermingling of words. “In the beginning I did not speak in secret,” was said by the Shechinah. “From the time it was, there was I,” was said by the prophet. It is possible to interpret it so that there should not be intermingling of words [as follows:] Draw near to me, hearken to this what I prophesy to you regarding the downfall of Babylon and your redemption. In the beginning I did not speak that in secret. From the time it was, that the Holy One, blessed be He, decreed to bring it, there I was. This teaches that from the time of the decree, the Holy One, blessed be He, appoints the prophet who is destined to prophesy regarding the matter in the council of the heavenly household, although it has not yet been created.

## Chapter 49


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:1:1)


**מִבֶּטֶן קְרָאָנִי.** מִשֶּׁאֲנִי בַּבֶּטֶן עָלְתָה לְפָנָיו בְּמַחֲשָׁבָה לִהְיוֹת שְׁמִי יְשַׁעְיָה, לְהִנָּבֵא יְשׁוּעוֹת וְנֶחָמוֹת:


**called me from the womb** When I was still in the womb, the thought came before Him that my name should be Isaiah (יְשַׁעְיָה) to prophesy salvations (יְשׁוּעוֹת) and consolations.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:2:1)


**וַיָּשֶׂם פִּי כְּחֶרֶב חַדָּה.** לְהוֹכִיחַ אֶת הָרְשָׁעִים וּלְהִתְנַבְּאוֹת עֲלֵיהֶם פֻּרְעָנוּת:


**And He made my mouth like a sharp sword** to castigate the wicked and to prophesy retribution upon them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:2:2)


**בְּצֵל יָדוֹ הֶחְבִּיאָנִי.** שֶׁלֹּא יוּכְלוּ לְהָרַע לִי:


**He concealed me in the shadow of His hand** that they be unable to harm me.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:2:3)


**לְחֵץ בָּרוּר.** מְמוֹרָט, קלי״ר בלע״ז:


**into a polished arrow** Heb. בָּרוּר, [lit. clear,] polished, kler in O.F.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:2:4)


**בְּאַשְׁפָּתוֹ.** כְּלִי נַרְתֵּק הַחִצִּים, שֶׁקּוֹרִין קוייכר״א בלע״ז:


**in His quiver** A receptacle used as a case for arrows, called koujjbre in O.F.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:4:1)


**וַאֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי לְרִיק יָגַעְתִּי.** כְּשֶׁרָאִיתִי שֶׁאֲנִי מוֹכִיחָם וְאֵינָם שׁוֹמְעִים:


**And I said, I toiled in vain** when I saw that I admonish them and they do not obey.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:4:2)


**אָכֵן מִשְׁפָּטִי אֶת ה׳.** הוּא יוֹדֵעַ שֶׁאֵינָהּ מֵאִתִּי, אֶלָּא מֵאִתָּם:


**Yet surely my right is with the Lord** He knows that it is not from me but from them [i.e., He knows that their failure to obey is not due to my laziness, but to their obstinacy].



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:5:1)


**לוֹ יֵאָסֵף.** אֵלָיו יָשׁוּב בִּתְשׁוּבָה:


**shall be gathered to Him** To Him they shall return in repentance.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:6:1)


**נָקֵל מִהְיוֹתְךָ וגו׳.** מַתָּנָה קְטַנָּה הִיא בְּעֵינַי, שֶׁתְּהֵא לְךָ זֹאת לְבַדָּהּ, שֶׁתְּהֵא **לִי עֶבֶד לְהָקִים אֶת יַעֲקֹב** וּ**לְהָשִׁיב** אֵלַי **נְצוּרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל**, וְהִנְנִי מוֹסִיף לְךָ עוֹד **וּנְתַתִּיךָ לְאוֹר גּוֹיִם** לְהִנָּבֵא עַל מַפַּלְתָּהּ שֶׁל בָּבֶל, שֶׁהִיא שִׂמְחָה לְכָל הָעוֹלָם:


**And He said, “It is too light for you to be, etc.”** In My eyes, it is too small a gift that you should have this alone, that you be My servant to establish Jacob and to bring back to Me the besieged of Israel, and behold I add more to you, “And I will make you a light for the nations,” to prophesy concerning the downfall of Babylon, which will be a joy for the whole world.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:6:2)


**וּנְצוּרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל.** כְּמוֹ (משלי ז:י) ״וּנְצֻרַת לֵב״, שֶׁלִּבָּם מֻקָּף יֵצֶר הִרְהוּרֵי עֲבֵירָה כְּעִיר נְצוּרָה מָצוֹר הַצָּרִים עָלֶיהָ:


**and the besieged of Israel** Heb. וּנְצוּרֵי. Comp. (Prov. 7:10) “With a heart surrounded by evil thoughts (וּנְצֻרַת),” that their heart is surrounded by the inclination of sinful thoughts, like a city besieged by a bulwark of those who besiege it.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:7:1)


**לִבְזֹה נֶפֶשׁ.** נֶפֶשׁ בְּזוּיָה:


**about him who is despised of men** Heb. לִבְזֹה נֶפֶשׁ, a despised soul, about Israel, who are despised.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:7:2)


**לִמְתָעֵב גּוֹי.** לְמִי שֶׁהַגּוֹי מְתַעֲבוֹ:


**about him whom the nation abhors** About him whom the nation abhors, and he is a slave to those who rule over him.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:7:3)


**מְלָכִים יִרְאוּ** אוֹתוֹ וְקָמוּ:


**Kings shall see** him and rise.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:7:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:7:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:7:4)


**אֲשֶׁר נֶאֱמָן.** לִשְׁמוֹר הַבְטָחָתוֹ שֶׁהִבְטִיחַ לְאַבְרָהָם עַל הַמַּלְכִיּוֹת, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״וְהִנֵּה תַנּוּר עָשָׁן וְגוֹ׳״ (בראשית טו:יז):


**Who is faithful** to keep His promise that He promised Abraham concerning the kingdoms, as the matter is stated (Gen. 15:17): “And behold a smoking stove, etc.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:7:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:7:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:7:5)


**קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל.** הוּא **וַיִּבְחָרֶךָּ**:


**the Holy One of Israel** is He, and He chose you.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:8:1)


**בְּעֵת רָצוֹן.** בְּעֵת תְּפִלָּה, שֶׁאַתָּה מִתְרַצֶּה וּמִתְפַּיֵּס לְפָנַי (ברכות ח א):


**In a time of favor** In the time of prayer, when you seek My favor and appease Me.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:8:2)


**וּבְיוֹם יְשׁוּעָה.** שֶׁתְּהֵא צָרִיךְ לִישׁוּעָה:


**and on a day of salvation** When you need salvation.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:8:3)


**וְאֶצָּרְךָ.** וְאֶשְׁמָרְךָ:


**and I will watch you** Heb. וְאֶצָּרְךָ, and I will watch you.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:8:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:8:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:8:4)


**לִבְרִית עָם.** לִהְיוֹת עַם בְּרִית לִי:


**for a people of a covenant** to be a people of a covenant to Me.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:8:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:8:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:8:5)


**לְהָקִים אֶרֶץ.** אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל, הַבְּחוּרָה לִי בְּכָל הָאֲרָצוֹת:


**to establish a land** The land of Israel, chosen by Me from all lands.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:9:1)


**לַאֲסוּרִים צֵאוּ.** לְעֵת אֲשֶׁר אוֹמַר לַאֲסוּרֵי גוֹלָה **צֵאוּ**:


**To say to the prisoners, “Go out!”** At the time I will say to the prisoners of the exile, “Go out!”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:9:2)


**שְׁפָיִים.** תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן ״נַגְדִּין״, נַחֲלֵי מַיִם:


**rivers** Jonathan renders: נַגְדִּין, streams of water.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:10:1)


**שָׁרָב.** חוֹם:


**heat** Heb. שָׁרָב, heat.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:11:1)


**וְשַׂמְתִּי כָל הָרַי לַדָּרֶךְ.** כְּלַפֵּי שֶׁאָמַר (ישעיהו לג:ח) עַל יְדֵי חֻרְבָּנָהּ ״שָׁבַת עוֹבֵר אֹרַח״, עַכְשָׁיו יָשׁוּבוּ וְיֵלְכוּ בּוֹ עוֹבְרִים וְשָׁבִים:


**And I will make all My mountains into a road** In contrast to what he said concerning the days of its ruin (supra 33:8) “The wayfarer has stopped,” now the wayfarers shall return and go therein.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:11:2)


**וּמְסִלֹּתַי יְרֻמוּן.** כְּלַפֵּי שֶׁאָמַר (ישעיהו לג:ח) ״נָשַׁמּוּ מְסִלּוֹת״, נִתְקַלְקְלוּ מֵאֵין מְתַקֵּן אוֹתָם, עַכְשָׁיו וּמְסִלֹּתַי יְרֻמוּן – יְתַקְּנוּ קִלְקוּל הַדְּרָכִים וְיַגְבִּיהַ אוֹתָם כַּמִשְׁפָּט בְּחִלּוּקֵי אֲבָנִים וְעָפָר:


**and My highways shall be raised** In contrast to what he said (ibid.): “Highways have become desolate,” deteriorated with no one to repair them, now My highways shall be raised, they shall repair the deterioration of the roads and raise them as is customary, with smooth pebbles and earth.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:12:1)


**מֵאֶרֶץ סִינִים.** ״מֵאַרַע דָּרוֹמָא״ (תרגום יונתן):


**from the land of Sinim** [Jonathan renders:] from the southland.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:13:1)


**כִּי נִחַם ה׳‏** אֶת **עַמּוֹ**׃


**for the Lord has consoled** His people.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:14:1)


**וַתֹּאמֶר צִיּוֹן.** הִיא הָיְתָה סְבוּרָה שֶׁשְּׁכַחְתִּיהָ:


**And Zion said** She thought that I had forgotten her.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:15:1)


**הֲתִשְׁכַּח אִשָּׁה עוּלָהּ.** עוֹלָל שֶׁלָּהּ:


**Shall a woman forget her sucking child** Heb. עוּלָהּ, similar to עוֹלֵל.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:15:2)


**מֵרַחֵם בֶּן בִּטְנָהּ.** מִלְּרַחֵם עַל בֶּן בִּטְנָהּ:


**from having mercy on the child of her womb** Heb. מֵרֶחֶם בֶּן-בִּטְנָהּ.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:15:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:15:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:15:3)


**גַּם אֵלֶּה תִשְׁכַּחְנָה.** אֲפִילּוּ אִם אֵלֶּה תִּשְׁכַּחְנָה, **אָנֹכִי לֹא אֶשְׁכָּחֵךְ**:


**These too shall forget** Even if these forget, I will not forget you.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:16:1)


**עַל כַּפַּיִם.** עַל כַּפַּי רוֹאֶה אֲנִי כְּאִלּוּ אַתְּ חֲקוּקָה עַל כַּפִּי לִרְאוֹתֵךְ וּלְזָכְרֵךְ תָּמִיד. דָּבָר אַחֵר: **עַל כַּפַּיִם** – מֵעַל עַנְנֵי כָּבוֹד, כְּמוֹ (איוב לו:לב) ״עַל כַּפַּיִם כִּסָּה אוֹר״:


**Behold on [My] hands** Heb. עַל-כַּפַּיִם [lit. on hands]. I see you as though you are engraved on My hands, to see you and always to remember you. Another explanation is: עַל-כַּפַּיִם “from upon the clouds of glory.” Comp. (Job 36:32) “On the clouds (כַּפַּיִם) He covered the rain.”



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:17:1)


**מִהֲרוּ בָּנָיִךְ.** לָשׁוּב:


**Your sons have hastened** to return.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:19:1)


**תֵּצְרִי מִיּוֹשֵׁב.** תְּהִי צָרָה מֵרֹב יוֹשְׁבִים שֶׁיָּבֹאוּ לְתוֹכֵךְ, יְהִי לָהֶם הַמָּקוֹם צַר מִלִּבְנוֹת לָהֶם בָּתִּים:


**you shall be crowded by the inhabitants** You shall be crowded by the multitude of inhabitants that shall come into your midst. The place shall be too narrow for them to build houses for themselves.



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:20:1)


**בְּנֵי שִׁכֻּלָיִךְ.** בָּנִים שֶׁהָיִית שְׁכוּלָה מֵהֶם:


**Your children of whom you were bereaved** [lit. the children of your bereavements.] The children of whom you were bereaved.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:20:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:20:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:20:2)


**גְּשָׁה לִּי.** הִתְקָרֵב לְצַד אַחֵר בִּשְׁבִילִי **וְאֵשֵׁבָה**:


**move over for me** [lit. approach for me.] Draw closer to another side for me, and I will dwell.



### Verse 21

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:21:1)


**גַּלְמוּדָה.** שולד״א בלע״ז:


**and solitary** solede in O.F.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:21:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:21:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:21:2)


**וְסוּרָה.** מוּסֶרֶת מִכָּל אָדָם, הַכֹּל אוֹמְרִים עָלַי: סוּרוּ מִמֶּנָּה:


**rejected** Rejected by everyone. All say about me, “Turn away from her.”



### Verse 22

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:22:1)


**יָדִי... נִסִּי.** סִימָן לְהָבִיא גָּלִיּוֹת:


**My hand...My standard** A signal to bring the exiles.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:22:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:22:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:22:2)


**נִסִּי.** פירקא בלע״ז, כמו ״וְכַנֵּס עַל הַגִבְעָה״ (ישעיהו ל:יז), וְהוּא סִימָן קִבּוּץ, וְנוֹתְנִין בְּרֹאשָׁהּ בֶּגֶד:


**a standard** Perka in O.F., [perche in modern French,] a pole. Comp. (supra 30:17) “And like a flagpole (וְכַנֵּס) on a hill.” It is a signal for gathering, and they place a cloth [a flag] on the end of it.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:22:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:22:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:22:3)


**בְּחֹצֶן.** איישיל״א בלע״ז, וְדוֹמֶה לוֹ בְּעֶזְרָא: ״וגַם (אני) חָצְנִי נָעַרְתִּי״ (נחמיה ה:יג):


**in their armpits** Ajjsela [aisela] in O.F., [aisselle in modern French]. Comp. Ezra (Neh. 5:13): “Also I shook out my armpit (חָצְנִי).”



### Verse 24

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:24:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:24:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:24:1)


**הֲיֻקַּח מִגִּבּוֹר מַלְקוֹחַ.** כִּסְבוּרִים אַתֶּם שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לָקַחַת מֵעֵשָׂיו **מַלְקוֹחַ** שִׁבְיוֹ שֶׁל יַעֲקֹב הַ**צַּדִּיק**?


**Shall prey be taken from a mighty warrior** You think that it is impossible to take from Esau those captured from Jacob the righteous one.



### Verse 25

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:25:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:25:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:25:1)


**וְאֶת יְרִיבֵךְ.** וְעִם מְרִיבַיִךְ אֲנִי אָרִיב:


**and with your contender** Heb. יְרִיבֵךְ. And with your contender I will contend.



### Verse 26

###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:26:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:26:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:26:1)


**וְהַאֲכַלְתִּי אֶת מוֹנַיִךְ.** הַבַּבְלִיִּים לְחַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה **אֶת בְּשָׂרָם**. **מוֹנַיִךְ** – לְשׁוֹן ״אַל תּוֹנוּ״ (ויקרא כה:יד), אוֹנָאַת דְּבָרִים, הַמְקַנְתְּרִים אוֹתָךְ בְּגִדּוּפֵיהֶם:


**And those who taunt you I will feed** their flesh to the beasts of the field. The word מוֹנַיִךְ is an expression akin to (Lev. 25:14) “You shall not taunt (אַל תּוֹנוּ).” This denotes taunting with words, those who anger you with their revilings.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:26:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:26:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:26:2)


**וְכֶעָסִיס.** מֶתֶק יַיִן:


**and as with sweet wine** Heb. וְכֶעָסִיס. The sweetness of wine.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 49:26:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:26:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/49:26:3)


**דָּמָם יִשְׁכָּרוּן.** כֵּן יִשְׁכְּרוּ מִדָּמָם אוֹתָם הָרְגִילִים לִשְׁתּוֹת דָּם, וּמִי הֵם אֵלּוּ? עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם. כֵּן תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן:


**they shall become drunk [from] their blood** So shall those accustomed to drink blood become drunk from their blood. Now who are they? These are the fowl of the heavens. So did Jonathan render this.



## Chapter 50


### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 50:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:2:1)


**מַדּוּעַ בָּאתִי.** לְהִתְקָרֵב אֲלֵיכֶם, **וְאֵין אִישׁ** – מִי מִכֶּם פּוֹנֶה אֵלַי?


**Why have I come** to draw near to you, and none of you turns to Me?



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 50:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:3:1)


**אַלְבִּישׁ שָׁמַיִם.** צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם, שָׂרֵי הָעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת, כְּשֶׁאֲנִי בָּא לִפָּרַע מִן הָאֻמָּה (מכילתא בשלח שירה ב):


**I clothe the heavens** The host of the heavens, the princes of the heathens (nations [Mss. and K’li Paz]), when I come to mete out retribution upon the nations.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 50:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:4:1)


**נָתַן לִי לְשׁוֹן לִמּוּדִים.** יְשַׁעְיָה הָיָה אוֹמֵר: ה׳ שְׁלָחַנִי וְ**נָתַן לִי** לָשׁוֹן הָרָאוּי לְלַמֵּד, כְּדֵי **לָדַעַת לָעוּת אֶת** הָעֲיֵפִים וּצְמֵאִים **לִשְׁמֹעַ** אֶת דִּבְרֵי הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא **דָּבָר**:


**gave me a tongue for teaching** Isaiah was saying, The Lord sent me and gave me a tongue fit to teach, in order to know to establish a time for the faint and thirsty to hear the words of the Holy One, blessed be He.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 50:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:4:2)


**לָעוּת.** מְנַחֵם חִבְּרוֹ בְּמַחֲלוֹקֶת ״עֵת לַעֲשׂוֹת לַה׳״ (תהלים קיט:קכו), לִקְבּוֹעַ לָהֶם עִתִּים:


**to establish times** Heb. לָעוּת. Menahem classified it in the group of (Ps. 119:126) “It is time (עֵת) to do for the Lord.” To establish times for them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 50:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:4:3)


**יָעִיר לִי אֹזֶן.** מְעוֹרֵר אֶת אָזְנִי בְּרוּחַ קָדְשׁוֹ:


**He awakens my ear** He awakens my ear with His Holy Spirit.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 50:4:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:4:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:4:4)


**לִשְׁמֹעַ כַּלִּמּוּדִים.** בְּמִשְׁפַּט הַלִּמּוּדִים, הָאֱמֶת וְהַנְּכוֹחָה:


**to hear according to the teachings** According to the custom of the teachings, the truth and that which is proper.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 50:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:5:1)


**פָּתַח לִי אֹזֶן.** וְהִשְׁמִיעַנִי ״אֶת מִי אֶשְׁלַח״ (ישעיהו ו:ח), שָׁלַחְתִּי אֶת עָמוֹס וְהָיוּ קוֹרִין אוֹתוֹ פְּסִילוּס, שָׁלַחְתִּי אֶת מִיכָה וְכוּ׳, כִּדְאִיתָא בִּפְסִיקְתָּא דְּנַחֲמוּ נַחֲמוּ (פסיקתא דרב כהנא טז ד):


**opened my ear** and let me hear (supra 6:8), “Whom shall I send?” I sent Amos, and they called him ‘pesilus.’ I sent Micah, etc., as is stated in Pesikta of ‘Nachamu nachamu.’


###### Rashi on Isaiah 50:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:5:2)


**וְאָנֹכִי לֹא מָרִיתִי.** מִלֵּילֵךְ בִּשְׁלִיחוּתוֹ, וְ**לֹא נְסוּגוֹתִי אָחוֹר**, אֶלָּא ״וָאוֹמַר הִנְנִי שְׁלָחֵנִי״ (ישעיהו ו:ח):


**and I did not rebel** going on His mission, neither did I turn away backwards, but I said, “Here I am; send me” (ibid.).



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 50:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:6:1)


**גֵּוִי נָתַתִּי לְמַכִּים** הוּא אָמַר לִי: ״יְשַׁעְיָה, בָּנַי סַרְבָנִים הֵם, בָּנַי טַרְחָנִים הֵם, עַל מְנָת שֶׁלֹּא תִּכְעוֹס עֲלֵיהֶם״. אָמַרְתִּי לוֹ: ״עַל מְנָת כֵּן״ (פסיקתא דרב כהנא טז ד):


**I gave my back to smiters** He said to me, Isaiah, My children are obstinate; My children are bothersome. [You may go] on the condition that you do not become angry with them. I said to Him, On that condition.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Isaiah 50:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:7:1)


**וַה׳ אֱלֹהִים יַעֲזָר לִי.** אִם יָקוּמוּ עָלַי:


**But the Lord God helps me** if they rise up against me.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 50:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:8:1)


**קָרוֹב מַצְדִּיקִי.** הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא קָרוֹב לִי, לְזַכּוֹתִי בַּדִּין:


**He Who vindicates me is near** The Holy One, blessed be He, is near to me to vindicate me in judgment.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 50:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:9:1)


**עָשׁ.** תּוֹלַעַת הַבְּגָדִים:


**a moth** Heb. עָשׁ, the worm of the clothing.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 50:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:10:1)


**בְּקוֹל עַבְדּוֹ.** בְּקוֹל הַנְּבִיאִים:


**to the voice of His servant** To the voice of the prophets.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 50:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:10:2)


**אֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ חֲשֵׁכִים.** אֲפִלּוּ צָרָה בָּאָה עָלָיו, **יִבְטַח בְּשֵׁם ה׳**, כִּי הוּא יַצִּילֵהוּ:


**who went in darkness** Even if trouble comes upon him, let him trust in the name of the Lord, for He shall save him.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 50:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:11:1)


**הֵן כֻּלְּכֶם.** שֶׁאֵינְכֶם שׁוֹמְעִים בְּקוֹל נְבִיאָיו:


**Behold all of you** who do not hearken to the voice of His prophets.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 50:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:11:2)


**קֹדְחֵי אֵשׁ.** עֶבְרָתוֹ עֲלֵיכֶם:


**who kindle fire** of His wrath upon yourselves.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 50:11:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:11:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:11:3)


**מְאַזְּרֵי זִיקוֹת.** מַחֲזִיקֵי זִיקוֹת, הֵן גִּצִּין וְגַחֲלֵי אֵשׁ הַנִּזְרָקִין בַּקֶּלַע. וְיֵשׁ לוֹ דֻגְמָא בִּלְשׁוֹן אֲרַמִּי: ״זִיקוּקִין דְּנוּר״ (ברכות נח ב), ״כָּךְ וְכָךְ זִיקָתָא פָּסִיק לָן״ (בבא מציעא צד א):


**and give power to flames** Who strengthen the flames; they are sparks and burning coals that are cast up with a slingshot. It has a cognate in the Aramaic tongue, זִיקוּקִין דְּנוּר, flames of fire (Ber. 58b), so many slingers (זִיקָתָא) are assigned to us (Baba Mezia 94a) [frondeles in O.F., sling].


###### Rashi on Isaiah 50:11:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:11:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:11:4)


**לְכוּ בְּאוּר אֶשְׁכֶם.** לְפִי דַרְכְּכֶם תִּלְקוּ:


**go in the flame of your fire** According to your way, you will be punished.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 50:11:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:11:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/50:11:5)


**מִיָּדִי.** תְּהֵא גְמוּלְכֶם זֹאת לָכֶם:


**from My hand** shall this retribution come to you.



## Chapter 51


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:1:1)


**אֶל צוּר חֻצַּבְתֶּם.** מִמֶּנּוּ:


**look at the rock whence you were hewn** from it.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:1:2)


**וְאֶל מַקֶּבֶת בּוֹר.** שֶׁנּוֹקְבִין וְחוֹצְבִין בָּהּ אֶת הַבּוֹרוֹת, אֲשֶׁר **נֻקַּרְתֶּם** בָּהּ:


**and at the hole of the pit** Heb. מַקֶּבֶת. With which they penetrate (נוֹקְבִין) and hew the pits. **you were dug** with which you were dug.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:1:3)


**נֻקַּרְתֶּם.** לְשׁוֹן ״נִקְרַת הַצּוּר״ (שמות לג:כב), ״יִקְּרוּהָ עֹרְבֵי נַחַל״ (משלי ל:יז). וּמִי הוּא הַ**צּוּר**? הוּא **אַבְרָהָם אֲבִיכֶם**, וּמִי הִיא הַמַּקֶּבֶת? הִיא **שָׂרָה** אֲשֶׁר חוֹלֶלְתְכֶם, אֲשֶׁר יְלַדְתְכֶם, לְשׁוֹן ״כִּי חָלָה גַּם יָלְדָה״ (ישעיהו סו:ח):


**you were dug** Heb. נֻקַּרְתֶּם, an expression similar to (Ex. 33.22) “The cleft (נִקְרַת) of the rock”; (Prov. 30:17) “The ravens of the brook shall pick it (יִקְּרוּהָ).” And who is the rock? He is Abraham your forefather. And who is the hole? She is Sarah who bore you. [תְּחוֹלֶלְכֶם means] ‘who bore you,’ an expression similar to (infra 66: 8) “For Zion experienced pangs (חָלָה) and also bore.”



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:2:1)


**תְּחוֹלֶלְכֶם.** אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵד אֶתְכֶם:


**who bore you** Heb. תְּחוֹלֶלְכֶם [lit. shall bear you.]


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:2:2)


**כִּי אֶחָד קְרָאתִיו.** כִּי אֶחָד הָיָה, יְחִידִי בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֲשֶׁר הִגְלֵיתִיו שָׁם מֵאַרְצוֹ וּמִמּוֹלַדְתּוֹ, **קְרָאתִיו** – רִבִּיתִיו וְגִדַּלְתִּיו, לְשׁוֹן ״קְרִיאֵי הָעֵדָה״ (במדבר א:טז), וּכְשֵׁם שֶׁהוּא הָיָה יָחִיד וְגִדַּלְתִּיו, כֵּן אֲגַדֵּל אֶתְכֶם שֶׁאַתֶּם יְחִידִים לִי:


**for when he was but one I called him** For he was one single person in the land of Canaan where I exiled him from his land and from his birthplace. I called him, meaning that I raised him and exalted him. An expression [similar to] (Num. 1:16) “Those called of (קְרִיאֵי) the congregation.” And just as he was a single person and I exalted him, so will I exalt you, who are singled out to Me.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:3:1)


**וְעַרְבָתָהּ.** אַף הוּא לְשׁוֹן ׳מִדְבָּר׳, כְּמוֹ ״בְּאֶרֶץ עֲרָבָה וְשׁוּחָה״ (ירמיהו ב:ו), אֶלָּא שֶׁהָעֲרָבָה כְּבָר הָיָה בָּהּ יִשּׁוּב וְהֻחְרְבָה:


**and its wasteland** Heb. וְעַרְבָתָהּ. This too is an expression of a desert. Comp. (Jer. 2:6) “In a wasteland (עֲרָבָה) and a land of pits,” but the wasteland once had a settlement and it was destroyed.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:3:2)


**תּוֹדָה.** קוֹל הוֹדָיָה:


**thanksgiving** A voice of thanks.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:4:1)


**כִּי תוֹרָה מֵאִתִּי תֵצֵא.** דִּבְרֵי נְבִיאִים תּוֹרָה הוּא, וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים סוֹפָן לִהְיוֹת מַרְגּוֹעַ וּמְנוּחָה לָעַמִּים, אֲשֶׁר אֶהְפּוֹךְ לָהֶם שָׂפָה בְרוּרָה לְעָבְדֵנִי (צפניה ג:ט):


**When Torah shall emanate from Me** The words of the prophets are Torah, and the judgments shall eventually mean tranquility and rest for the peoples for whom I will turn a pure language to serve Me.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:4:2)


**אַרְגִּיעַ.** אָנִיחַ:


**I will give [them] rest** Heb. אַרְגִּיעַ, I will give them rest.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:5:1)


**יִשְׁפֹּטוּ.** יְיַסְּרוּ, יושטיצ״א בלע״ז:


**shall chasten** Heb. יִשְׁפֹּטוּ, chasten, jostize in O.F.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:6:1)


**שָׁמַיִם כֶּעָשָׁן נִמְלָחוּ.** שָׂרֵי צְבָאוֹת הָאֻמּוֹת שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם:


**the heavens shall vanish like smoke** The princes of the hosts of the heathens who are in heaven.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:6:2)


**נִמְלָחוּ.** נִתְבַּלּוּ, כְּמוֹ (ירמיהו לח:יב) ״בְּלוֹיֵי הַסְּחָבוֹת וְהַמְּלָחִים״, בֶּגֶד הַנִּשְׁחָת. לָשׁוֹן אַחֵר: **נִמְלָחוּ** – נִתְבַּלְבְּלוּ, לְשׁוֹן מַלָּחֵי הַיָּם שֶׁמְּבַלְבְּלִין הַמַּיִם בַּמְּשׁוֹטוֹת מַנְהִיגֵי הַסְּפִינָה, וְכֵן ״מְמֻלָּח טָהוֹר קֹדֶשׁ״ (שמות ל:לה):


**shall vanish** Heb. נִמְלָחוּ, shall rot away. Comp. (Jer. 38:12) “Rags and decayed clothing (בְּלוֹאֵי הַסְּחָבוֹת),” a decayed garment. Another explanation of נִמְלָחוּ is: shall be stirred. This is an expression similar to “the sailors of (מַלָּחֵי) the sea,” who stir the water with the oars that guide the ship. Comp. also (Ex. 30:35) “Stirred (מְמֻלָּח), pure, and holy.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:6:3)


**וְהָאָרֶץ.** שִׁלְטוֹנֵי הָאָרֶץ:


**and the earth** the rulers of the earth.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:6:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:6:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:6:4)


**וְיֹשְׁבֶיהָ.** שְׁאָר הָעָם:


**and its inhabitants** the rest of the people.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:6:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:6:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:6:5)


**וִישׁוּעָתִי.** לְעַמִּי לְעוֹלָם תִּהְיֶה. דָּבָר אַחֵר: שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ מַמָּשׁ, וְכֵן פִּתְרוֹנוֹ: **שְׂאוּ עֵינֵיכֶם וְהַבִּיטוּ** אֶל הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶל הָאָרֶץ וּרְאוּ כַּמָּה הֵם חֲזָקִים וּבְרִיאִים, וְאַף עַל פִּי כֵן יִבְלוּ, **וְצִדְקָתִי וִישׁוּעָתִי** יִהְיוּ **לְעוֹלָם**. הֲרֵי שֶׁצִּדְקָתִי בְּרִיאָה וַחֲזָקָה יוֹתֵר מֵהֶם:


**and My salvation** for My people shall be forever. Another explanation is: [It refers] actually [to] the heavens and the earth, and this is its explanation: Raise your eyes and look at the heaven and at the earth, and see how strong and sturdy they are, yet they shall rot away, but My righteousness and My salvation shall be forever. Hence, My righteousness is sturdier and stronger than they.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:8:1)


**עָשׁ וְסָס.** מִינֵי תוֹלָעִים הֵם:


**the moth...the worm** They are species of worms.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:9:1)


**עוּרִי עוּרִי.** תְּפִלַּת הַנָּבִיא הִיא:


**Awaken, awaken** This is the prophet’s prayer.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:9:2)


**רַהַב.** מִצְרַיִם, שֶׁכָּתוּב בָּהּ ״רַהַב הֵם שָׁבֶת״ (ישעיהו ל:ז):


**Rahab** [lit. pride.] Egypt, about whom it is written (supra 30:7): “They are haughty (רַהַב), idlers.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:9:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:9:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:9:3)


**מְחוֹלֶלֶת.** לְשׁוֹן הֶרֶג חָלָל:


**slew** Heb. מְחוֹלֶלֶת, an expression of slaying, related to חָלָל.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:9:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:9:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:9:4)


**תַּנִּין.** פַּרְעֹה:


**the sea monster** Pharaoh.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:11:1)


**וּפְדוּיֵי ה׳ יְשׁוּבוּן.** לְשׁוֹן תְּפִלָּה, וּמוּסָב עַל **עוּרִי עוּרִי**:


**And the redeemed of the Lord shall return** This is an expression of prayer, and it is connected to “Awaken, awaken.”



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:12:1)


**מִי אַתְּ.** בַּת צַדִּיקִים כְּמוֹתֵךְ, מְלֵאָה זְכֻיּוֹת, לָמָּה **תִּירְאִי מֵאֱנוֹשׁ** אֲשֶׁר סוֹפוֹ לָמוּת?


**who are you** the daughter of the righteous like you and full of merits, why should you fear man, whose end is to die?



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:13:1)


**וַתִּשְׁכַּח ה׳ עֹשֶׂךָ.** וְלֹא נִשְׁעַנְתָּ עָלָיו:


**And you forgot the Lord your Maker** and you did not rely on Him.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:13:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:13:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:13:2)


**הַמֵּצִיק.** מוֹשְׁלֵי אֻמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם הַמְשַׁעְבְּדִים בָּכֶם:


**the oppressor** The rulers of the heathens (the nations of the world [Parshandatha, K’li Paz]) who subjugate you.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:13:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:13:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:13:3)


**כַּאֲשֶׁר כּוֹנֵן.** נִזְדַּמֵּן:


**when he prepared** Prepared himself.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:13:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:13:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:13:4)


**וְאַיֵּה חֲמַת הַמֵּצִיק.** מָחָר בָּא וְאֵינֶנּוּ:


**Now where is the wrath of the oppressor** Tomorrow comes and he is not here.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:14:1)


**מִהַר צֹעֶה לְהִפָּתֵחַ.** אֲפִלּוּ נְקָבִין קָשִׁין עָלָיו, וְצָרִיךְ הוּא לְהִפָּתֵחַ בְּהִלּוּךְ הַמֵּעַיִם כְּדֵי שֶׁ**לֹּא יָמוּת לַשַּׁחַת**, וְכֵיוָן שֶׁמִּהַר לְהִפָּתֵחַ צָרִיךְ הוּא לִמְזוֹנוֹת רַבִּים, שֶׁאִם **יֶחְסַר לַחְמוֹ** אַף הוּא יָמוּת:


**What must be poured out hastened to be opened** Heb. מִהַר צֹעֶה לְהִפָּתֵחַ. Even if his stools are hard, and he must be opened by walking in order to move the bowels in order that he not die by destruction, and once he hastens to open up, he requires much food, for, if his bread is lacking, even he will die.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:14:2)


**צֹעֶה.** לְשׁוֹן דָּבָר הָעוֹמֵד לִהְיוֹת נִירוֹק, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאוֹמֵר בְּמוֹאָב שֶׁדִּמָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא לְיַיִן (ירמיהו מח:יא) ״הַשֹּׁקֵט אֶל שְׁמָרָיו וְלֹא הוּרַק מִכְּלִי אֶל כֶּלִי״, וְנֶאֱמַר שָׁם ״וְשָׁלַחְתִּי לוֹ צֹעִים וְצֵעֻהוּ וְכֵלָיו יָרִיקוּ״. דָּבָר אַחֵר: **מִהַר צֹעֶה** – אוֹתוֹ הָאוֹיֵב **הַמֵּצִיק**, שֶׁהוּא עַכְשָׁיו חֲגוּר מָתְנַיִם, חֲלוּץ כֹּחַ, יְמַהֵר **לְהִפָּתֵחַ** וְלִהְיוֹת חַלָּשׁ:


צֹעֶה An expression of a thing prepared to be poured, as he says concerning Moab, whom the prophet compared to wine (Jer. 48:11): “Who rests on his dregs and was not poured from vessel to vessel.” And he says there (v. 12), “And I will send pourers (צֹעִים) upon him and they shall pour him out (וְצֵעֻהוּ), and they shall empty his vessels.” [This is an illustration of the weakness of man. Consequently, there is no need to fear him.] Another explanation is: מִהַר צֹעֶה That enemy who oppresses you, who is now with girded loins, girded with strength, shall hasten to be opened up and to become weak.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:14:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:14:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:14:3)


**צֹעֶה.** חוֹגֵר, כְּמוֹ (ישעיהו סג:א) ״צֹעֶה בְּרֹב כֹּחוֹ״:


צֹעֶה Girded. Comp. (infra 63:1) “Girded (צֹעֶה) with the greatness of His strength.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:14:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:14:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:14:4)


**וְלֹא יָמוּת.** הַמָּסוּר בְּיָדוֹ **לַשַּׁחַת**, אֲבָל הַלָּשׁוֹן רִאשׁוֹן מִדְּרַשׁ אַגָּדָה הוּא בִּפְסִיקְתָּא רַבָּתִי (פסיקתא רבתי לג:):


**and he shall not die** i.e., the one delivered into his hand [shall not die] of destruction. But the first interpretation is a Midrash Aggadah in Pesikta Rabbathi (34:5).



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:15:1)


**רֹגַע הַיָּם.** לְשׁוֹן ״עוֹרִי רָגַע״ (איוב ז:ה), פרונצ״א בלע״ז:


**Who wrinkles the sea** Heb. רֹגַע, an expression similar to (Job 7:5) “My skin was wrinkled (רָגַע) .” Froncir in O.F. [froncer in Modern French, to wrinkle, gather, pucker].



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:16:1)


**לִנְטֹעַ שָׁמַיִם.** ״לְקַיָּמָא עַמָּא דַּאֲמִיר עֲלֵיהוֹן דְּיִסְגּוֹן כְּכוֹכְבֵי שְׁמַיָּא״ (תרגום יונתן):


**to plant the heavens** to preserve the people about whom it was said that they shall be as many as the stars of the heavens [from Jonathan].


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:16:2)


**וְלִיסֹד אָרֶץ.** ״וּלְשַׁכְלָלָא כְּנִישְׁתָּא דַּאֲמִיר עֲלֵיהוֹן דְּיִסְגּוֹן כְּעַפְרָא דְּאַרְעָא״:


**and to found the earth** And to found the congregation about whom it is said that they shall be as many as the dust of the earth [from Jonathan].



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:17:1)


**קֻבַּעַת.** תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן: ״פַּיְלֵי״, וְהוּא שֵׁם כּוֹס. וְלִי נִרְאֶה: **קֻבַּעַת** – אֵלּוּ הַשְּׁמָרִים הַקְּבוּעִים בְּתַחְתִּית הַכְּלִי, וּמָצִית יוֹרֶה עָלָיו, כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״שְׁמָרֶיהָ יִמְצוּ״ (תהלים עה:ט):


**dregs** Heb. קֻבַּעַת. Jonathan renders: פַּיְלֵי, which is the name of a cup [phiala in Latin]. But it appears to me that קֻבַּעַת, these are the dregs fixed (קְבוּעִים) to the bottom of the vessel, and the word מָצִית, “you have drained,” indicates it, as it is said (Ps. 75:9): “...shall drain (יִמְצוּ) its dregs.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:17:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:17:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:17:2)


**הַתַּרְעֵלָה.** הוּא מַשְׁקֶה הַמְטַמְטֵם וּמַתִּישׁ כֹּחַ הָאָדָם כְּאָסוּר וְקָשׁוּר וּמְעֻטָּף, כְּמוֹ ״וְהַבְּרוֹשִׁים הָרְעָלוּ״ (נחום ב:ד), ״וְהַשֵּׁרוֹת וְהָרְעָלוֹת״ (ישעיהו ג:יט), שֶׁהוּא לְשׁוֹן ׳עִטּוּף׳, וּבְמַסֶּכֶת שַׁבָּת (שבת סה א) מָדִיּוֹת רְעוּלוֹת – מִין סַרְבָּל נָאֶה לְהִתְעַטֵּף בּוֹ:


**weakness** Heb. תַּרְעֵלָה. That is a drink that clogs and weakens the strength of a person, like one bound, tied, and enwrapped. Comp. (Nahum 2:4) “And the cypress trees were enwrapped (הָרְעָלוּ).” Also (supra 3: 19), “And the bracelets and the veils (רְעָלוֹת),” which is an expression of enwrapping, and in Tractate Shabbath (6:6): “Median women (sic) may go out veiled (רְעוּלוֹת),” a kind of beautiful veil in which to enwrap oneself.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:17:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:17:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:17:3)


**תַּרְעֵלָה.** אינטומישמנ״ט בלע״ז:


תַּרְעֵלָה is entoumissant in O.F., (stiffening, weakening, paralyzing).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:17:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:17:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:17:4)


**מָצִית.** אגושטי״ר בלע״ז:


**you have drained** Heb. מָצִית, egoutter in French, [to drain, exhaust].



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:19:1)


**שְׁתַּיִם הֵנָּה קֹרְאֹתַיִךְ.** צָרוֹת כְּפוּלוֹת, שְׁתַּיִם שְׁתַּיִם:


**These two things have befallen you** Twofold calamities, two by two.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:19:2)


**מִי אֲנַחֲמֵךְ.** מִי אָבִיא לָךְ לְנַחֲמֵךְ וְלוֹמַר: אַף אֻמָּה פְּלוֹנִית הִיא לָקְתָה דֻּגְמָתֵךְ?


**[With] whom will I console you?** Whom will I bring to you to console you and to say that also that certain nation suffered in the same manner as you?



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:20:1)


**עֻלְּפוּ.** לְשׁוֹן ׳עֲיֵפוּת׳, כְּמוֹ (עמוס ח:יג) ״תִּתְעַלַּפְנָה הַבְּתוּלוֹת בַּצָּמָא״, פשמי״ר בלע״ז:


**fainted** Heb. עֻלְּפוּ. An expression of faintness. Comp. (Amos 8:13) “The...virgins shall faint (תִּתְעַלַּפְנָה) from thirst.” Pasmer in O.F., (pamer in Modern French).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:20:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:20:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:20:2)


**כְּתוֹא מִכְמָר.** הֶפְקֵר כְּתוֹא זֶה שֶׁנָּפַל לְ**מִכְמָר. תּוֹא** כְּמוֹ ״וּתְאוֹ וָזָמֶר״ (דברים יד:ה):


**like a wild ox in a net** Abandoned like this wild ox that falls into a net. Comp. (Deut. 14:5) “And the wild ox (וּתְאוֹ) and the giraffe.”



### Verse 21

###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:21:1)


**וּשְׁכֻרַת וְלֹא מִיָּיִן. שִׁכֻרֶת** מִדָּבָר אַחֵר שֶׁ**לֹּא מִיָּיִן**:


**and who is drunk but not from wine** Drunk from something else other than wine.



### Verse 22

###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:22:1)


**יָרִיב עַמּוֹ.** אֲשֶׁר יָדִין דִּין עַמּוֹ:


**Who shall judge His people** Who shall judge the case of His people.



### Verse 23

###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:23:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:23:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:23:1)


**מוֹגַיִךְ.** מְנִיעֵיךְ וּמְטַלְטְלֵיךְ, כְּמוֹ ״וְהִנֵּה הֶהָמוֹן נָמוֹג״ (שמואל א יד:טז). קרושלי״ר בלע״ז:


**those who cause you to wander** Heb. מוֹגַיִךְ. Those who cause you to wander and those who cause you to move. Comp. (I Sam. 14:16) “And the multitude was wandering (נָמוֹג),” krosler in O.F.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 51:23:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:23:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/51:23:2)


**שְׁחִי וְנַעֲבֹרָה.** עַל גַּבֵּךְ:


**Bend down and let us cross** on your back.



## Chapter 52


### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:2:1)


**הִתְנַעֲרִי.** אישקור״א בלע״ז, כִּמְנַעֵר אֶת הַטַּלִּית (שבת קמז א):


**Shake yourself** Heb. הִתְנַעֲרִי, escourre in O.F., to shake strongly, like one who shakes out a garment.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:2:2)


**קוּמִי.** מִן הָאָרֶץ, מִגִּזְרַת ״לָאָרֶץ תֵּשֵׁב״ (ישעיהו ג:כו):


**arise** from the ground, from the decree (supra 3:26), “She shall sit on the ground.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:2:3)


**שְׁבִי.** עַל הַכִּסֵּא:


**sit down** on a throne.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:2:4)


**הִתְפַּתְּחִי.** הֱוִי נִתֶּרֶת:


**free yourself** Untie yourself [from Jonathan].


###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:2:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:2:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:2:5)


**מוֹסְרֵי.** קריגל״ש בלע״ז:


**bands of** Heb. מוֹסְרֵי, cringatro umbriah in O.F., [strap].


###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:2:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:2:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:2:6)


**שְׁבִיָּה.** כְּמוֹ ׳שְׁבוּיָה׳:


**captive** Heb. שְׁבִיָה, like שְׁבוּיָה, captive.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:3:1)


**חִנָּם נִמְכַּרְתֶּם.** עַל עִסְקֵי חִנָּם, הוּא יֵצֶר הָרָע שֶׁאֵינוֹ לָכֶם לְשָׂכָר:


**You were sold for nought** Because of worthless matters, i.e., the evil inclination, which affords you no reward.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:3:2)


**וְלֹא בְכֶסֶף תִּגָּאֵלוּ.** אֶלָּא בִּתְשׁוּבָה (ירושלמי תענית א א):


**and you shall not be redeemed for money** but with repentance.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:4:1)


**מִצְרַיִם יָרַד עַמִּי וגו׳.** הֵם הַמִּצְרִיִּים הָיוּ לָהֶם קְצָת חוֹב עֲלֵיהֶם, שֶׁנַּעֲשׂוּ לָהֶם אַכְסַנְיָא וְכִלְכְּלוּם, אֲבָל **אַשּׁוּר** בְּ**אֶפֶס** וּבְחִנָּם **עֲשָׁקוֹ**:


**My people first went down to Egypt** The Egyptians had somewhat of a debt upon them, for they served for them as their hosts and sustained them, but Assyria oppressed them for nothing and without cause.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:5:1)


**מַה לִּי פֹה.** לָמָּה אֲנִי שׁוֹהֵא וּמַשְׁהֵא בָּנַי כָּאן?


**And now, what have I here** Why do I stay and detain My children here?


###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:5:2)


**יְהֵילִילוּ.** מִתְפָּאֲרִים לֵאמֹר: ״יָדֵינוּ רָמָה״ (דברים לב:כז):


**boast** Heb. יְהֵילִילוּ, Boast saying, “Our hand was powerful.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:5:3)


**מְנֹאָץ.** מִתְנָאֵץ, וַהֲרֵי זֶה דֻּגְמַת ״וַיִּשְׁמַע אֶת הַקּוֹל מִדַּבֵּר אֵלָיו״ (במדבר ז:פט):


**is blasphemed** Blasphemes itself, and this is an instance similar to (Num 7:89) “And he heard the voice speaking to him.”



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:6:1)


**יֵדַע עַמִּי.** כְּשֶׁאֶגְאָלֵם יַכִּירוּ, כִּי **שְׁמִי** אָדוֹן, שַׁלִּיט וּמוֹשֵׁל, כְּמַשְׁמָעוֹ (חגיגה טו:-טז.):


**My people shall know** When I redeem them, they will recognize that My name is master, monarch, and ruler, as is its apparent meaning.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:6:2)


**לָכֵן בַּיּוֹם.** גְּאֻלָּתָם יָבִינוּ **כִּי אֲנִי הוּא הַמְדַבֵּר הִנֵּנִי** קִיַּמְתִּי:


**therefore, on that day** The day of their redemption, they will understand that I am He Who speaks, and behold, I have fulfilled the prophecy.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:8:1)


**צֹפַיִךְ.** צוֹפִים שֶׁמַּעֲמִידִין עַל הַחוֹמוֹת וְהַמִּגְדָּלִים לְבַשֵּׂר וְלִרְאוֹת מִי בָּא לָעִיר:


**The voice of your watchmen** The watchmen who are stationed on the walls and the towers to report and to see (to see and to report [Parshandatha]) who comes to the city.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:10:1)


**חָשַׂף.** גִּלָּה:


**has revealed** Heb. חָשַׂף, has revealed.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:11:1

**צְאוּ מִתּוֹכָהּ.** מִתּוֹךְ הַגָּלוּת, כָּל נֶחָמוֹת הָאֵלּוּ הָאַחֲרוֹנוֹת אֵינָן אֶלָּא עַל גָּלוּת הָאַחֲרוֹן:


**touch no unclean one** They shall be abominable to you to touch them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:11:2)


**טָמֵא אַל תִּגָּעוּ.** שֶׁקֶץ יִהְיוּ לָכֶם מִלִּגַּע בָּהֶם:


**get out of its midst** Out of the midst of the exile, for all these last consolations refer only to the last exile.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:11:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:11:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:11:3)


**הִבָּרוּ.** הִטַּהֲרוּ:


**purify yourselves** Heb. הִבָּרוּ, purify yourselves.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:11:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:11:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:11:4)


**נֹשְׂאֵי כְּלֵי ה׳.** הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם, שֶׁהֲיִיתֶם נוֹשְׂאִים כֵּלָיו (שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא) בַּמִּדְבָּר (מִכָּאן לִתְחִיַּת הַמֵּתִים):


**you who bear the Lord’s vessels** You, the priests and the Levites, who carried the vessels of the Holy One, blessed be He, in the desert [from here is proof of the resurrection of the dead].



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:12:1)


**כִּי הוֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵיכֶם.** שְׁנֵי דְבָרִים שֶׁבְּסוֹף הַמִּקְרָא הַזֶּה מְיַשְּׁבִין שְׁנֵי דְבָרִים שֶׁבְּרֹאשׁוֹ: **כִּי לֹא בְחִפָּזוֹן תֵּצֵאוּ** – מָה טַעַם? **כִּי הוֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵיכֶם ה׳** לַנְחוֹתְכֶם הַדֶּרֶךְ, וּמִי שֶׁשְּׁלוּחוֹ מַקְדִּים לְפָנָיו לַנְחוֹתוֹ הַדֶּרֶךְ אֵין יְצִיאָתוֹ **בְחִפָּזוֹן. וּבִמְנוּסָה לֹא תֵלֵכוּן** – לְפִי שֶׁ**מְּאַסִּפְכֶם אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל** הוֹלֵךְ מֵאַחֲרֵיכֶם לִשְׁמֹר אֶתְכֶם מִכָּל רוֹדֵף, כְּמוֹ ״וְנָסַע דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה דָן מְאַסֵּף לְכָל הַמַּחֲנוֹת״ (במדבר י:כה). הַהוֹלֵךְ אַחֲרֵי הַמַּחֲנֶה קָרוּי מְאַסֵּף, לְפִי שֶׁהוּא מַמְתִּין אֶת הַנֶּחֱלָשִׁים וְאֶת הַנִּכְשָׁלִים, וְכֵן הוּא אוֹמֵר בִּיהוֹשֻׁעַ (יהושע ו:יג): ״וְהַמְאַסֵּף הוֹלֵךְ אַחֲרֵי הָאָרוֹן״:


**for...goes before you** Two things at the end of this verse explain two things in its beginning, [viz.] For not with haste shall you go forth. What is the reason? For the Lord goes before you to lead you on the way, and one whose agent advances before him to lead him on the way his departure is not in haste. And not in the flurry of flight shall you go, for your rear guard is the God of Israel. He will follow you to guard you from any pursuer. Comp. (Num. 10:25) “And the division of the camp of Dan shall travel, the rear guard of all the camps.” Whoever goes after the camp is called מְאַסֵּף, the rear guard, because he waits for the stragglers and the stumblers. Similarly, Scripture states in Joshua (6: 13): “And the rear guard was going after the Ark.”



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:13:1)


**הִנֵּה יַשְׂכִּיל עַבְדִּי.** הִנֵּה בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים יַצְלִיחַ עַבְדִּי יַעֲקֹב, צַדִּיקִים שֶׁבּוֹ:


**Behold My servant shall prosper** Behold, at the end of days, My servant, Jacob, [i.e.,] the righteous among him, shall prosper.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:14:1)


**כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמְמוּ.** כַּאֲשֶׁר תָּמְהוּ עֲלֵיהֶם עַמִּים רַבִּים בִּרְאוֹתָם שִׁפְלוּתָם, וְאָמְרוּ זֶה אֶל זֶה: כַּמָּה **מִשְׁחַת מֵאִישׁ מַרְאֵהוּ** (שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל), רְאוּ מַה תָּאֳרָם חָשׁוּךְ מִשְּׁאָר **בְּנֵי אָדָם, כֵּן** כַּאֲשֶׁר אֲנַחְנוּ רוֹאִים בְּעֵינֵינוּ:


**As many wondered** As many peoples wondered about them when they saw them in their humble state, and said to one another, How marred is his [Israel’s] appearance from that of a man! See how their features are darker than those of other people, so, as we see with our eyes.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:15:1)


**כֵּן יַזֶּה גּוֹיִם רַבִּים.** כֵּן עַתָּה גַּם הוּא תִּגְבַּר יָדוֹ וְיַזֶּה אֶת קַרְנוֹת הָעֲוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת אֲשֶׁר זֵרוּהוּ (זכריה ב:ד):


**So shall he cast down many nations** So now, even he his hand will become powerful, and he will cast down the horns of the nations who scattered him.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/52:15:2)


**יִקְפְּצוּ.** יִסְגְּרוּ פִּיהֶם מֵרוֹב תִּמָּהוֹן, **כִּי** כָבוֹד **אֲשֶׁר לֹא סֻפַּר לָהֶם** עַל שׁוּם אָדָם רָאוּ בּוֹ:


**shall shut** Heb. יִקְפְּצוּ. They shall shut their mouths out of great bewilderment. **for** honor. **what had not been told them** concerning any man, they saw in him.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 52:15:3

**they gazed** Heb. הִתְבּוֹנָנוּ, they gazed.



## Chapter 53


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:1:1)


**מִי הֶאֱמִין לִשְׁמֻעָתֵנוּ.** כֵּן יֹאמְרוּ הָעֲוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת אִישׁ לְרֵעֵהוּ: אִלּוּ הָיִינוּ שׁוֹמְעִים מִפִּי אֲחֵרִים מַה שֶּׁאָנוּ רוֹאִים, אֵין לְהַאֲמִין:


**Who would have believed our report** So will the nations say to one another, Were we to hear from others what we see, it would be unbelievable.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:1:2)


**וּזְרוֹעַ ה׳.** כָּזֹאת בִּגְדֻלָּה וְהוֹד, **עַל מִי נִגְלָתָה** עַד הֵנָּה?


**the arm of the Lord** like this, with greatness and glory, to whom was it revealed until now?



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:2:1)


**וַיַּעַל כַּיּוֹנֵק לְפָנָיו.** הָעָם הַזֶּה, לִפְנֵי בָּא לוֹ הַגְּדֻלָּה הַזֹּאת, עַם שָׁפָל הָיָה מְאֹד, וְעָלָה מֵאֵלָיו **כְּיוֹנֵק** מִיּוֹנֶקֶת הָאִילָנוֹת:


**And he came up like a sapling before it** This people, before this greatness came to it, was a very humble people, and it came up by itself like a sapling of the saplings of the trees.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:2:2)


**וְכַשֹּׁרֶשׁ.** עָלָה **מֵאֶרֶץ צִיָּה**:


**and like a root** he came up from dry land.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:2:3)


**לֹא תֹאַר.** הָיָה לוֹ מִתְּחִלָּה **וְלֹא הָדָר**:


**neither form** had he in the beginning, nor comeliness.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:2:4)


**וְנִרְאֵהוּ וְלֹא מַרְאֶה וְנֶחְמְדֵהוּ.** וּכְשֶׁרְאִינוּהוּ מִתְּחִלָּה בְּאֵין מַרְאֶה, הֵיאַךְ נֶחְמְדֵהוּ? **וְנֶחְמְדֵהוּ** תָּמוּהַּ הוּא:


**and we saw him that he had no appearance. Now shall we desire him?** And when we saw him from the beginning without an appearance, how could we desire him? **Now shall we desire him?** This is a question.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:3:1)


**נִבְזֶה וַחֲדַל אִישִׁים.** הָיָה; כֵּן דֶּרֶךְ הַנָּבִיא הַזֶּה: מַזְכִּיר כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד, ״אַל תִּירָא עַבְדִּי יַעֲקֹב״ (ישעיהו מד:ב), וְאַף כָּאן ״הִנֵּה יַשְׂכִּיל עַבְדִּי״ (ישעיהו נב:יג) בְּבֵית יַעֲקֹב אָמַר; וְ׳יַשְׂכִּיל׳ לְשׁוֹן הַצְלָחָה הוּא, כְּמוֹ ״וַיְהִי דָוִד לְכָל דְּרָכָיו מַשְׂכִּיל״ (שמואל א יח:יד):


**Despised and rejected by men** was he. So is the custom of this prophet: he mentions all Israel as one man, e.g., (44:2), “Fear not, My servant Jacob”; (44:1) “And now, hearken, Jacob, My servant.” Here too (52:13), “Behold My servant shall prosper,” he said concerning the house of Jacob. יַשְׂכִּיל is an expression of prosperity. Comp. (I Sam. 18:14) “And David was successful (מַשְׂכִּיל) in all his ways.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:3:2)


**וּכְמַסְתֵּר פָּנִים מִמֶּנּוּ.** מֵרֹב בָּשְׁתָּם וְשִׁפְלוּתָם הָיוּ כְּמַסְתִּיר פָּנִים מִמֶּנּוּ, חֲבוּשֵׁי פָּנִים בְּטָמוּן, כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא נִרְאֶה אוֹתָם, כְּאָדָם מְנֻגָּע שֶׁמַּסְתִּיר פָּנָיו וְיָרֵא מְהַבִּיט:


**and as one who hides his face from us** Because of their intense shame and humility, they were as one who hides his face from us, with their faces bound up in concealment, in order that we not see them, like a plagued man who hides his face and is afraid to look.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:4:1)


**אָכֵן חֳלָיֵנוּ הוּא נָשָׂא.** אָכֵן לְשׁוֹן ׳אֲבָל׳ בְּכָל מָקוֹם. אֲבָל עַתָּה אָנוּ רוֹאִים שֶׁלֹּא מֵחֲמַת שִׁפְלוּתוֹ בָּא לוֹ, אֶלָּא מְיֻסָּר הָיָה בְּיִסּוּרִין:


**Indeed, he bore our illnesses** Heb. אָכֵן, an expression of ‘but’ in all places. But now we see that this came to him not because of his low state, but that he was chastised with pains so that all the nations be atoned for with Israel’s suffering. The illness that should rightfully have come upon us, he bore.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:4:2)


**וַאֲנַחְנוּ חֲשַׁבְנֻהוּ.** אָנוּ הָיִינוּ סְבוּרִים שֶׁהוּא שְׂנָאוּי לַמָּקוֹם, **וְהוּא** לֹא הָיָה כֵּן, אֶלָּא **מְחֹלָל** הָיָה **מִפְּשָׁעֵינוּ** וּ**מְדֻכָּא מֵעֲוֹנוֹתֵינוּ**:


**yet we accounted him** We thought that he was hated by the Omnipresent, but he was not so, but he was pained because of our transgressions and crushed because of our iniquities.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:5:1)


**מוּסַר שְׁלוֹמֵנוּ עָלָיו.** בָּאוּ עָלָיו יִסּוּרֵי הַשָּׁלוֹם שֶׁהָיָה לָנוּ, שֶׁהוּא הָיָה מְיֻסָּר לִהְיוֹת שָׁלוֹם לְכָל הָעוֹלָם:


**the chastisement of our welfare was upon him** The chastisement due to the welfare that we enjoyed, came upon him, for he was chastised so that there be peace for the entire world.

###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:6:2

**הִפְגִּיעַ בּוֹ.** נֶעְתַּר עַל יָדוֹ וְנִתְרַצָּה עַל עֲוֹן כֻּלָּנוּ, שֶׁלֹּא הֶחְרִיב עוֹלָמוֹ. **הִפְגִּיעַ** אשפריאי״ר בלע״ז, לְשׁוֹן ׳תְּחִנָּה׳:

###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:7:1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:7:3
