### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:8:1)


**מֵעֹצֶר וּמִמִּשְׁפָּט לֻקָּח.** הַנָּבִיא מְבַשֵּׂר וְאוֹמֵר, כִּי זֹאת יֹאמְרוּ הָעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמָזָלוֹת בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים, כְּשֶׁיִּרְאוּ כְּשֶׁנִּלְקַח מִן הָעֹצֶר שֶׁהָיָה עָצוּר בְּיָדָם, וּמִמִּשְׁפָּט הַיִּסּוּרִין שֶׁסָּבַל עַד עַתָּה:


**From imprisonment and from judgment he is taken** The prophet reports and says that the heathens (nations [mss., K’li Paz]) will say this at the end of days, when they see that he was taken from the imprisonment that he was imprisoned in their hands and from the judgment of torments that he suffered until now.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:8:2)


**וְאֶת דּוֹרוֹ.** שָׁנִים שֶׁעָבְרוּ עָלָיו:


**and his generation** The years that passed over him.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:8:3)


**מִי יְשׂוֹחֵחַ** אֶת הַתְּלָאוֹת אֲשֶׁר מְצָאוּהוּ? **כִּי נִגְזַר** הָיָה מִתְּחִלָּה וְגוֹלֶה **מֵאֶרֶץ חַיִּים**, הִיא אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל, אֲשֶׁר **מִפֶּשַׁע עַמִּי** בָּא הַ**נֶּגַע** הַזֶּה לַצַּדִּיקִים שֶׁבָּהֶם:


**who shall tell?** The tribulations that befell him, for from the beginning, he was cut off and exiled from the land of the living that is the land of Israel for because of the transgression of my people, this plague came to the righteous among them.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:9:1)


**וַיִּתֵּן אֶת רְשָׁעִים קִבְרוֹ** מָסַר אֶת עַצְמוֹ לְהִקָּבֵר כְּכָל אֲשֶׁר יִגְזְרוּ עָלָיו רִשְׁעֵי הָאֻמּוֹת, שֶׁהָיוּ קוֹנְסִין עֲלֵיהֶם הֲרִיגָה וּקְבוּרַת חֲמוֹרִים בִּמְעֵי הַכְּלָבִים:


**And he gave his grave to the wicked** He subjected himself to be buried according to anything the wicked of the heathens (nations [mss., K’li Paz]) would decree upon him, for they would penalize him with death and the burial of donkeys in the intestines of the dogs.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:9:2)


**אֶת רְשָׁעִים.** לְדַעַת הָרְשָׁעִים נִתְרַצָּה לִקָּבֵר, וְלֹא יִכְפּוֹר בֵּאלֹהִים חַיִּים:


**to the wicked** According to the will of the wicked, he was willing to be buried, and he would not deny the living God.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:9:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:9:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:9:3)


**וְאֶת עָשִׁיר בְּמֹתָיו.** וּלְדַעַת הַמּוֹשֵׁל מָסַר עַצְמוֹ בְּכָל מִינֵי מָוֶת שֶׁגָּזַר עָלָיו, **עַל לֹא** רָצָה לְקַבֵּל עָלָיו כְּפִירָה, לַעֲשׂוֹת רָעָה וְלַחְמוֹס **חָמָס** כְּכָל הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הָיָה גָּר בֵּינֵיהֶם:


**and to the wealthy with his kinds of death** and to the will of the ruler he subjected himself to all kinds of death that he decreed upon him, because he did not wish to agree to (denial) [of the Torah] to commit evil and to rob like all the heathens (nations [mss., K’li Paz]) among whom he lived.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:9:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:9:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:9:4)


**וְלֹא מִרְמָה בְּפִיו.** לְקַבֵּל עָלָיו עֲבוֹדַת כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת:


**and there was no deceit in his mouth** to accept idolatry (to accept a pagan deity as God [Parshandatha]).



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:10:1)


**וַה' חָפֵץ דַּכְּאוֹ הֶחֱלִי.** הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא חָפֵץ לְדַכְּאוֹ וּלְהַחֲזִירוֹ לְמוּטָב, לְפִיכָךְ הֶחֱלִי אוֹתוֹ:


**And the Lord wished to crush him, He made him ill** The Holy One, blessed be He, wished to crush him and to cause him to repent; therefore, he made him ill.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:10:2)


**אִם תָּשִׂים אָשָׁם נַפְשׁוֹ וְגוֹ׳.** אָמַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא: אֶרְאֶה אִם תְּהֵא נַפְשׁוֹ נוֹתֶנֶת וְנִמְסֶרֶת בִּקְדוּשָׁתִי לַהֲשִׁיבָהּ לִי אָשָׁם עַל כָּל אֲשֶׁר מָעַל, אֶגְמֹל לוֹ גְּמוּלוֹ, **וְיִרְאֶה זֶרַע וְגוֹ׳. אָשָׁם** זֶה לְשׁוֹן ׳כֹּפֶר׳, שֶׁנּוֹתֵן אָדָם לְמִי שֶׁחָטָא לוֹ, אמינד״א בלע״ז, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים (שמואל א ו:ג): ״אַל תָּשִׁיבוּ אוֹתוֹ רֵיקָם כִּי הָשֵׁב תָּשִׁיבוּ לוֹ אָשָׁם״:


**If his soul makes itself restitution, etc.** Said the Holy One, blessed be He, “I will see, if his soul will be given and delivered with My holiness to return it to Me as restitution for all that he betrayed Me, I will pay him his recompense, and he will see children, etc.” This word אָשָׁם is an expression of ransom that one gives to the one against when he sinned, amende in O.F., to free from faults, similar to the matter mentioned in the episode of the Philistines (I Sam. 6:3), “Do not send it away empty, but you shall send back with it a guilt offering (אָשָׁם).”



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:11:1)


**מֵעֲמַל נַפְשׁוֹ.** הָיָה אוֹכֵל וְשָׂבֵעַ, וְלֹא הָיָה גּוֹזֵל וְחוֹמֵס:


**From the toil of his soul** he would eat and be satisfied, and he would not rob and plunder.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:11:2)


**בְּדַעְתּוֹ יַצְדִּיק צַדִּיק.** הָיָה שׁוֹפֵט עַבְדִּי מִשְׁפַּט אֱמֶת לְכָל הַבָּאִים לְדִין לְפָנָיו:


**with his knowledge...would vindicate the just** My servant would judge justly all those who came to litigate before him.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:11:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:11:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:11:3)


**וַעֲוֺנֹתָם.** הָיָה סוֹבֵל כְּדֶרֶךְ כָּל הַצַּדִּיקִים, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ תִּשְׂאוּ אֶת עֲוֹן הַמִּקְדָּשׁ״ (במדבר יח:א):


**and their iniquities he would bear** He would bear, in the manner of all the righteous, as it is said (Num. 18:1): “You and your sons shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary.”



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:12:1)


**לָכֵן.** עַל עֲשׂוֹתוֹ זֹאת אֲחַלֵּק לוֹ נַחֲלָה וְגוֹרָל בָּרַבִּים עִם הָאָבוֹת הָרִאשׁוֹנִים (סוטה יד א):


**Therefore** Because he did this, I will allot him an inheritance and a lot in public with the Patriarchs.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:12:2)


**הֶעֱרָה לַמָּוֶת נַפְשׁוֹ.** לְשׁוֹן ״וַתְּעַר כַּדָּהּ״ (בראשית כד:כ):


**he poured out his soul to death** Heb. הֶעֱרָה. An expression like (Gen. 24:20), “And she emptied (וַתְּעַר) her pitcher.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:12:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:12:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:12:3)


**וְאֶת פֹּשְׁעִים נִמְנָה.** סָבַל יִסּוּרִין כְּאִלּוּ חָטָא וּפָשַׁע, וְהוּא בִּשְׁבִיל אֲחֵרִים **נָשָׂא חֵטְא** הָ**רַבִּים**:


**and with transgressors he was counted** He suffered torments as if he had sinned and transgressed, and this is because of others; he bore the sin of the many.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 53:12:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:12:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/53:12:4)


**וְלַפֹּשְׁעִים יַפְגִּיעַ.** עַל יְדֵי יִסּוּרִין שֶׁבָּאת עַל יָדוֹ טוֹבָה לָעוֹלָם:


**and interceded for the transgressors** through his sufferings, for good came to the world through him.



## Chapter 54


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:1:1)


**רָנִּי עֲקָרָה.** יְרוּשָׁלַיִם, אֲשֶׁר הָיְתָה כְּלֹא יָלָדָה:


**Sing, you barren woman** Jerusalem, who was as though she had not borne.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:1:2)


**לֹא חָלָה.** לְשׁוֹן לֵידָה הוּא, שֶׁהַיּוֹלֶדֶת עַל יְדֵי חִיל וַחֲבָלִים יוֹלֶדֶת:


**you who have not experienced birth pangs** Heb. חָלָה, an expression of childbirth, for the woman in confinement gives birth with pains and writhing.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:1:3)


**מִבְּנֵי בְעוּלָה.** בַּת אֱדוֹם:


**for the children of the desolate one** The daughter of Edom.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:2:1)


**יַטּוּ.** לְמֵרָחוֹק׃


**and let them stretch forth** far off.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:2:2)


**מֵיתָרַיִךְ.** הֵם חֲבָלִים דַּקִּים הַתְּלוּיִם בְּשׁוּלֵי אֹהָלִים, וְקוֹשְׁרִים בִּיתֵדוֹת, שֶׁקּוֹרִין קביל״ש בלע״ז, וְתוֹקְעִין בָּאָרֶץ:


**lengthen your cords** These are thin ropes that hang at the bottom of tents, and that are tied to stakes called ‘chevills’ in French, which are thrust into the ground.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:3:1)


**תִּפְרֹצִי.** תִּגְבְּרוּ:


**shall you prevail** Heb. תִּפְרֹצִי, shall you prevail.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:4:1)


**עֲלוּמַיִךְ.** נְעוּרַיִךְ:


**your youth** Heb. עֲלוּמַיִךְ, your youth.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:6:1)


**כִּי תִמָּאֵס.** כְּשֶׁתִּמָּאֵס, פְּעָמִים שֶׁכּוֹעֵס עָלֶיהָ מְעַט:


**who was rejected** When she is rejected at times that her husband is a little wroth with her.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:8:1)


**בְּשֶׁצֶף קֶצֶף.** מְנַחֵם פָּתַר: ׳חֳרִי אַף׳, וְדוֹנָשׁ אָמַר: ׳בִּמְעַט קֶצֶף׳, כְּמוֹ **בְּרֶגַע קָטֹן עֲזַבְתִּיךְ**, וְכֵן תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן:


**With a little wrath** Heb. שֶׁצֶף. Menahem (Machbereth p. 179) interprets this as, “with kindling of wrath,” and Dunash (Teshuvoth p. 20) states, “with a little wrath,” paralleling “For a small moment have I forsaken you,” and so did Jonathan render.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:8:2)


**וּבְחֶסֶד עוֹלָם.** שֶׁיִּתְקַיֵּם עַד עוֹלָם:


**and with everlasting kindness** that will exist forever.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:9:1)


**כִּי מֵי נֹחַ זֹאת לִי.** שְׁבוּעָה בְּיָדִי, וְהוֹלֵךְ וּמְפָרֵשׁ דְּבָרוֹ: **כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי מֵעֲבֹר מֵי נֹחַ וְגוֹ׳**:


**For this is to Me [as] the waters of Noah** [i.e.,] it is an oath in My hand, and He proceeds to explain His words, “as I swore that the waters of Noah shall never again pass over the earth, etc.”



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:10:1)


**כִּי הֶהָרִים יָמוּשׁוּ.** אַף אִם תִּכְלֶה זְכוּת אָבוֹת וְאִמָּהוֹת, **חַסְדִּי מֵאִתֵּךְ לֹא יָמוּשׁ** (ירושלמי סנהדרין י א):


**For the mountains shall depart** Even if the merit of the Patriarchs and the Matriarchs is depleted, My kindness shall not depart from you.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:11:1)


**סֹעֲרָה.** שֶׁלִּבָּהּ סוֹעֵר בְּרוֹבֵי צָרוֹת:


**tempestuous one** whose heart storms with many troubles.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:11:2)


**מַרְבִּיץ בַּפּוּךְ.** רוֹצֵף רִצְפָּתֵךְ מֵאַבְנֵי נֹפֶךְ:


**I will set with carbuncle** I pave your floor with carbuncle stones.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:12:1)


**כַּדְכֹד.** מִין אֶבֶן טוֹבָה:


**jasper** Heb. כַּדְכֹד, a kind of precious stone.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:12:2)


**שִׁמְשֹׁתָיִךְ.** יוֹנָתָן תִּרְגֵּם ״אַעָךְ״, וּמְנַחֵם חִבְּרוֹ עִם ״יְשַׁמְּשׁוּנֵהּ״ (דניאל ז:י), וְיֵשׁ פּוֹתְרִין לְשׁוֹן ׳שֶׁמֶשׁ׳ – חַלּוֹנוֹת שֶׁחַמָּה זוֹרַחַת בָּהֶן, וְעוֹשִׂין כְּנֶגְדּוֹ מְחִיצָה בְּמִינֵי זְכוּכִית צְבָעִים לְנוֹי, וּמִדְרַשׁ תְּהִלִּים פּוֹתֵר ״שִׁמְשׁוֹתַיִךְ״ וְ״שֶׁמֶשׁ וּמָגֵן״ (תהלים פד:יב) שִׁנֵּי הַחוֹמָה:


**your windows** Jonathan renders: your woodwork, and Menahem associated it with (Dan. 7:10): “ministered to Him (יְשַׁמְּשׁוּנֵהּ).” (Menahem, apparently renders: your utensils, i.e., the vessels that serve you.) And some interpret it as an expression of a sun (שֶׁמֶשׁ), windows through which the sun shines, and they make opposite it a barrier of kinds of colored glass for beauty, and Midrash Psalms interprets שִׁמְשׁוֹתַיִךְ as well as שֶׁמֶשׁ וּמָגֵן (Ps. 84:12) as “the pinnacles of the wall.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:12:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:12:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:12:3)


**לְאַבְנֵי אֶקְדָּח.** יוֹנָתָן תִּרְגֵּם ״לְאַבְנֵי גְמַר״, ׳גּוּמְרִין׳ תַּרְגּוּם ׳גֶּחָלִים׳. פָּתַר ׳אֶקְדָּח׳ לְשׁוֹן ״קֹדְחֵי אֵשׁ״ (ישעיהו נ:יא), וְהֵם מִין אֲבָנִים טוֹבוֹת בּוֹעֲרוֹת כַּלַּפִּידִים, וְהוּא קרבונקל״א לְשׁוֹן ׳גַּחֶלֶת׳. וְיֵשׁ פּוֹתְרִין (בבא בתרא עה א) לְשׁוֹן ׳מַקְדֵּחַ׳, אֲבָנִים גְּדוֹלוֹת שֶׁכָּל חֲלַל הַפֶּתַח קָדוּחַ בְּתוֹכוֹ, וְהַמְּזוּזוֹת וְהַמִּפְתָּן וְהַסַּף כֻּלָּן מִתּוֹךְ הָאֶבֶן הֵם:


**of carbuncle stones** Heb. אֶקְדָּח. Jonathan renders: of gomer stones. Gumrin is the Aramaic translation of גֶּחָלִים, coals. He interprets אֶקְדָּח as an expression similar to (supra 50: 11) “who kindle (קֹדְחֵי) fire,” and they are a type of stones that burn like torches and that is the carbuncle (karbokle in O.F.), an expression of a coal. Others interpret it as an expression of a drill, i.e., huge stones of which the entire opening of the doorway is drilled, and the doorposts, the threshold, and the lintel are all hewn from the stone.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:12:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:12:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:12:4)


**לְאַבְנֵי חֵפֶץ.** ״לְאַבְנֵי צְרוּךְ״ (תרגום יונתן):


**of precious stones** Desirable stones [from Jonathan].



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:14:1)


**רַחֲקִי מֵעֹשֶׁק.** כְּמוֹ ״הִתְנַעֲרִי מֵעָפָר״ (ישעיהו נב:ב), תִּרְחֲקִי מִן הָעוֹשְׁקִים אוֹתָךְ:


**go far away from oppression** [Although grammatically this is the imperative, here it is the future,] like (supra 52:2) “Shake yourself from the dust.” You will be far away from those who oppress you.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:14:2)


(**רַחֲקִי מֵעֹשֶׁק.** תִּרְחֲקִי מִלַּעֲשׁוֹק בְּנֵי אָדָם כְּדֶרֶךְ שֶׁעוֹשִׂים רְשָׁעִים, שֶׁאוֹסְפִים מָמוֹן מִגָּזֵל, אֲבָל אַתֶּם לֹא תִצְטָרְכוּ לִגְזוֹל, כִּי לֹא תִירְאוּ מִדַּלּוּת וַעֲנִיּוּת, **וּמִמְּחִתָּה כִּי לֹא** תָבֹא וְ**לֹא תִקְרַב אֵלָיִךְ**. אברבנאל.)


Printed editions of Rashi contain the following addendum: (**go far away from oppression** You will stay far from oppressing other peoples in the manner the wicked do, that they accumulate money through robbery, but you will not need to rob, for you will not fear poverty or straits, or ruin, for it shall neither come nor shall it approach you. [Abarbanel])


###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:14:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:14:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:14:3)


(**בִּצְדָקָה.** שֶׁתַּעֲשֶׂה תִּהְיֶה נְכוֹנָה בִּגְאֻלַּת עוֹלָם, וְתִהְיֶה רְחוֹקָה מֵעֹשֶׁק בְּנֵי אָדָם כִּי לֹא תִירָאִי, אֲפִילּוּ פַּחַד וְיִרְאָה לֹא יִהְיֶה לָךְ מֵהֶם, וְתִהְיֶה רְחוֹקָה מִמְּחִתָּה שֶׁ**לֹּא תִקְרַב אֵלָיִךְ**. איל״ה שלוח״ה.)


(**With righteousness** that you will perform, you will be established with an everlasting redemption, and you will be far from people’s oppression for you will not fear; you will not even have terror or fear of them, and you will be far from ruin, for it will not come near you. [Ayalah Sheluchah])



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:15:1)


**הֵן גּוֹר יָגוּר אֶפֶס מֵאוֹתִי.** הֵן יָרֵא יִירָא וְיָגוּר מְגוֹרַת רָעוֹת, אוֹתוֹ שֶׁאֵין אֲנִי עִמּוֹ, הוּא שְׂעִיר:


**Behold, the one with whom I am not, shall fear** Heb. גּוֹר יָגוּר. Behold, he shall fear and dread evil decrees, he with whom I am not, i.e., Esau. ([Mss. read:] the wicked Esau and his ilk.)


###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:15:2)


**מִי גָר אִתָּךְ.** מִי אֲשֶׁר נֶאֱסַף עָלֶיךָ לְמִלְחָמָה, אוֹ **מִי גָר** – מִי שֶׁנִּתְגָּרָה בָּךְ. וְרַבּוֹתֵינוּ פֵּרְשׁוּהוּ (יבמות כד ב) בְּגֵרִים, לוֹמַר שֶׁאֵין מְקַבְּלִים גֵּרִים לִימוֹת מְשִׁיחֵנוּ. וְאַף בִּפְשׁוּטוֹ שֶׁל מִקְרָא יִתָּכֵן: מִי שֶׁנַּעֲשׂוּ גֵרִים אִתָּךְ בַּעֲנִיּוּתֵךְ, **עָלַיִךְ יִפֹּל** בְּעֲשִׁירוּתֵךְ, כְּמוֹ ״עַל פְּנֵי כָל אֶחָיו נָפָל״ (בראשית כה:יח):


**whoever mobilizes against you** Heb. גָר. Whoever mobilizes against you for war. Alternatively, מִי גָר [means:] whoever contends with you (וְנִתְגָּרֶה). And our Rabbis explained it as referring to the proselytes (גֵּרִים), [i.e.,] to say that we will not accept proselytes in Messianic times. And even according to the simple meaning of the verse it is possible to explain: whoever became sojourners with you in your poverty, shall dwell with you in your wealth. Comp. (Gen. 25:18) “In the presence of all his brethren he dwelt (נָפָל).”



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:16:1)


**הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי.** אֲשֶׁר **בָּרָאתִי חָרָשׁ** הַמְּתַקֵּן כְּלִי, וַאֲנִי אֲשֶׁר בָּרָאתִי מַשְׁחִית הַמְחַבְּלוֹ, כְּלוֹמַר: אֲנִי הוּא שֶׁגֵּרִיתִי בָּךְ אֶת הָאוֹיֵב, אֲנִי הוּא שֶׁהִתְקַנְתִּי לוֹ פֻּרְעָנִיּוֹת:


**Behold I** am He Who created a smith who devises a weapon, and I am He Who has created a destroyer that destroys it. That is, to say: I am He Who incited the enemy against you; I am He Who has prepared retribution for him.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:16:2)


**וּמוֹצִיא כְלִי לְמַעֲשֵׂהוּ.** לְצֹרֶךְ, גּוֹמְרוֹ כָּל צָרְכּוֹ:


**and produces a weapon for his work** For necessity. He completes it according to all that is necessary.



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:17:1)


**כָּל כְּלִי יוּצַר.** כָּל כְּלִי זַיִן אֲשֶׁר יִלְטְשׁוּהוּ וִיחַדְּדוּהוּ בִּשְׁבִילֵךְ לְהִלָּחֵם בָּךְ:


**Any weapon whetted against you** Any weapon that they will whet and sharpen for you, i.e., to battle with you.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 54:17:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:17:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/54:17:2)


**יוּצַר.** לְשׁוֹן ״חַרְבוֹת צוּרִים״ (יהושע ה:ב), ״אַף תָּשִׁיב צוּר חַרְבּוֹ״ (תהלים פט:מד):


**whetted** Heb. יוּצַר, an expression similar to (Jos. 5:2) “sharp knives (חַרְבוֹתצֻרִים),” also (Ps. 89:44) “You have also turned the edge of his sword (צוּר חַרְבּוֹ).”



## Chapter 55


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 55:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/55:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/55:1:1)


**הוֹי כָּל צָמֵא. הוֹי** זֶה, לְשׁוֹן קְרִיאָה וְזִמּוּן וְקִבּוּץ הוּא, וְיֵשׁ הַרְבֵּה בַּמִּקְרָא: ״הוֹי הוֹי וְנֻסוּ מֵאֶרֶץ צָפוֹן״ (זכריה ב:י):


**Ho! All who thirst** Heb. הוֹי. This word הוֹי is an expression of calling, inviting, and gathering, and there are many in Scripture, [e.g.,] (Zech. 2:10) “Ho! Ho! and flee from the north land.”

**buy** Heb. שִׁבְרוּ. Comp. (Gen. 42:3) “To buy (לִשְׁבֹּר) corn,” buy.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 55:1:4

**יַיִן וְחָלָב.** לֶקַח טוֹב מִיַּיִן וְחָלָב:

### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 55:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/55:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/55:8:1)


**כִּי לֹא מַחְשְׁבוֹתַי מַחְשְׁבוֹתֵיכֶם.** אֵין שֶׁלִּי וְשֶׁלָּכֶם שָׁווֹת, לְכָךְ אֲנִי אוֹמֵר לָכֶם **יַעֲזֹב רָשָׁע דַּרְכּוֹ**, וְיִתְפֹּשׂ אֶת דַּרְכִּי:


**For My thoughts are not your thoughts** Mine and yours are not the same; therefore, I say to you, “The wicked shall give up his way,” and adopt My way...


###### Rashi on Isaiah 55:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/55:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/55:8:2)


**וְאִישׁ אָוֶן מַחְשְׁבֹתָיו,** וְיִתְפֹּשׂ אֶת **מַחְשְׁבוֹתַי** לַעֲשׂוֹת הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינַי. וּמִדְרַשׁ אַגָּדָה (תנחומא בובר וישב יא): **כִּי לֹא מַחְשְׁבוֹתַי וְגוֹ׳** אֵין דִּינִי כְּדִינֵי בָּשָׂר וָדָם: אַתֶּם, מִי שֶׁמּוֹדֶה בַּדִּין מִתְחַיֵּב, אֲבָל אֲנִי ״מוֹדֶה וְעוֹזֵב יְרֻחָם״ (משלי כח:יג):


**“and a man of iniquity his thoughts”** and adopt My thoughts, to do what is good in My eyes. And the Midrash Aggadah (Tanhuma Buber, Vayeshev 11 explains:) **For My thoughts are not, etc.** My laws are not like the laws of man [lit. flesh and blood]. As for you, whoever confesses in judgment is found guilty, but, as for Me, whoever confesses and gives up his evil way, is granted clemency (Proverbs 28:13).



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 55:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/55:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/55:9:1)


**כִּי גָבְהוּ שָׁמַיִם וגו׳.** כְּלוֹמַר, כִּי יֵשׁ הֶבְדֵּל וְחִלּוּק מַעֲלוֹת וְשֶׁבַח בִּ**דְרָכַי** יוֹתֵר **מִדַּרְכֵיכֶם** וּבְ**מַחְשְׁבוֹתַי** יוֹתֵר **מִמַּחְשְׁבוֹתֵיכֶם**, כְּגָבוֹהַּ שָׁמַיִם עַל הָאָרֶץ. אַתֶּם נוֹתְנִים לֵב לִמְרוֹד בִּי, וַאֲנִי נוֹתֵן לֵב לְהָשִׁיב אֶתְכֶם:


**As the heavens are higher, etc.** That is to say that there is a distinction and a difference, advantages and superiority in My ways more than your ways and in My thoughts more than your thoughts, as the heavens are higher than the earth; you are intent upon rebelling against Me, whereas I am intent upon bringing you back.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 55:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/55:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/55:10:1)


**כִּי כַּאֲשֶׁר יֵרֵד הַגֶּשֶׁם וְהַשֶּׁלֶג.** וְ**לֹא יָשׁוּב רֵיקָם**, אַךְ יֵיטִיב לָעוֹלָם:


**For, just as the rain and the snow fall** and do not return empty, but do good for you.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 55:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/55:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/55:11:1)


**כֵּן יִהְיֶה דְבָרִי אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא מִפִּי.** לְהוֹדִיעֲכֶם עַל יְדֵי הַנְּבִיאִים **לֹא יָשׁוּב רֵיקָם**, אַךְ יֵיטִיב לָכֶם אִם תִּשְׁמְעוּ לָהֶם:


**so shall be My word that emanates from My mouth** to inform you through the prophets, will not return empty, but will do good to you if you heed them.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Isaiah 55:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/55:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/55:12:1)


**כִּי בְשִׂמְחָה תֵצֵאוּ.** מִן הַגָּלוּת:


**For with joy shall you go forth** from the exile.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 55:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/55:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/55:12:2)


**הֶהָרִים וְהַגְּבָעוֹת יִפְצְחוּ לִפְנֵיכֶם רִנָּה.** שֶׁיִּתְּנוּ לָכֶם פִּרְיָם וְצִמְחָם, וְיֵהָנוּ (יְרוֹנְנוּ) יוֹשְׁבֵיהֶם:


**the mountains and the hills shall burst into song before you** for they will give you their fruit and their plants, and their inhabitants shall derive benefit. ([Some editions read:] And their inhabitants shall sing.)



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Isaiah 55:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/55:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/55:13:1)


**תַּחַת הַנַּעֲצוּץ וְגוֹ׳.** רַבּוֹתֵינוּ דָּרְשׁוּ: תַּחַת הָרְשָׁעִים יַעֲלוּ צַדִּיקִים:


**Instead of the briar, etc.** Our Rabbis expounded [Targum Jonathan]: Instead of the wicked, righteous people shall arise.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 55:13:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/55:13:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/55:13:2)


**נַעֲצוּץ** וְ**סִרְפַּד** – מִינֵי קוֹצִים הֵם, כְּלוֹמַר: הָרְשָׁעִים יֹאבְדוּ וְהַצַּדִּיקִים יִטְּלוּ מֶמְשַׁלְתָּם (מגילה י ב):


**briar...and...nettle** They are species of thorns; i.e., to say that the wicked will be destroyed and the righteous will take their rule.



## Chapter 56


### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 56:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:2:1)


**יַעֲשֶׂה זֹּאת. שׁוֹמֵר שַׁבָּת וְגוֹ׳**:


**who will do this** who observes the Sabbath, etc.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 56:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:3:1)


**הַבְדֵּל יַבְדִּילַנִי ה׳ מֵעַל עַמּוֹ.** לָמָּה אֶתְגַּיֵּר? הֲלֹא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא יַבְדִּילֵנִי מֵעַל עַמּוֹ כְּשֶׁיְשַׁלֵּם שְׂכָרָם:


**“The Lord will surely separate me from His people,”** Why should I become converted? Will not the Holy One, blessed be He, separate me from His people when He pays their reward.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 56:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:3:2)


**וְאַל יֹאמַר הַסָּרִיס.** לָמָּה אֵיטִיב דְּרָכַי וּמַעֲלָלַי? **הֵן אֲנִי** כְּ**עֵץ יָבֵשׁ**, מֵאֵין זִכָּרוֹן:


**Let not the eunnuch say** Why should I better my ways and my deeds? I am like a withered tree, for lack of remembrance.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 56:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:4:1)


**וּמַחֲזִיקִים.** אוֹחֲזִים:


**and hold fast** Heb. וּמַחֲזִיקִים, and hold fast.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Isaiah 56:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:7:1)


**לְכָל הָעַמִּים.** וְלֹא לְיִשְׂרָאֵל לְבַדָּם, כִּי אַף לַגֵּרִים:


**for all peoples** Not only for Israel, but also for the proselytes.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 56:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:8:1)


**עוֹד אֲקַבֵּץ עָלָיו.** מִן הָאֻמּוֹת שֶׁיִּתְגַּיְּרוּ וְנִלְווּ עֲלֵיהֶם:


**I will yet gather** of the heathens ([Mss. and K’li Paz:] of the nations) who will convert and join them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 56:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:8:2)


**לְנִקְבָּצָיו.** נוֹסָפִים עַל קִבּוּצֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל:


(**together with his gathered ones** In addition to the gathered ones of Israel.)



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 56:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:9:1)


**כֹּל חַיְתוֹ שָׂדָי.** כָּל גֵּרֵי הָאֻמּוֹת, **אֵתָיוּ** וְהִתְקָרְבוּ אֵלַי, וְתֹאכְלוּ אֶת **כָּל חַיְתוֹ בַּיַּעַר**, אֶת גִּבּוֹרֵי הָאֻמּוֹת שֶׁאִמְּצוּ אֶת לִבָּם מִלְּהִתְגַּיֵּר:


**All the beasts of the field** All the proselytes of the heathens ([Mss. and K’li Paz:] All the nations) come and draw near to Me, and you shall devour all the beasts in the forest, the mighty of the heathens ([Mss. and K’li Paz:] the mighty of the nations) who hardened their heart and refrained from converting.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 56:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:9:2)


**חַיְתוֹ שָׂדָי.** חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה אֵין כֹּחָהּ רַב כְּחַיַּת הַיַּעַר, חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה חֲלָשָׁה וְתַשּׁוּשַׁת כֹּחַ מֵחַיַּת הַיַּעַר, וְעַל שֶׁאָמַר **עוֹד אֲקַבֵּץ עָלָיו** אָמַר הַמִּקְרָא הַזֶּה:


**the beasts of the field** [The beast of the field is not as strong as the beast of the forest.] The beast of the field is weaker and of weaker strength than the beast of the forest. Since he stated, “I will yet gather others to him,” he stated this verse.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 56:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:10:1)


**צֹפָיו עִוְרִים כֻּלָּם.** לְפִי שֶׁאָמַר ״דִּרְשׁוּ ה׳״ (ישעיהו נה:ו) וְכָל הָעִנְיָן, וְהֵם אֵינָם שׁוֹמְעִים, חוֹזֵר וְאוֹמֵר: הִנֵּה הַנְּבִיאִים צוֹעֲקִים לָהֶם וּמַכְרִיזִים עַל הַתְּשׁוּבָה וְתֵיטִיב לָהֶם, וַהֲרֵי פַּרְנָסֵיהֶם כְּעִוְרִים כֻּלָּם, וְאֵינָם רוֹאִין אֶת הַנּוֹלָדוֹת, כְּצוֹפֶה הַמֻּפְקָד לִרְאוֹת אֶת הַחֶרֶב בָּא לְהַזְהִיר אֶת הָעָם, וְהוּא עִוֵּר מִלִּרְאוֹת אֶת הַחֶרֶב בָּאָה וְאִלֵּם מִלְּהַזְהִיר אֶת הָעָם, כַּכֶּלֶב שֶׁמִּנּוּהוּ לִשְׁמֹר הַבַּיִת וְהוּא אִלֵּם מִ**לִּנְבֹּחַ**, כָּךְ פַּרְנָסֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵינָם מַזְהִירִין אוֹתָם לַחֲזוֹר לַמּוּטָב:


**His lookouts are all blind** Since he said, “Seek the Lord,” and the entire section, and they do not heed, he returns and says, Behold the prophets cry out to them ([Mss.:] to you) and announce concerning repentance, so that it will be good for them. Yet their leaders are all like blind men, and they do not see the results, like a lookout appointed to see the approaching army, to warn the people, but he is blind, unable to see whether the army is coming, and dumb, unable to warn the people, like a dog that was appointed to guard the house, but he is dumb, unable to bark. Similarly, the leaders of Israel do not warn them to repent to do good.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 56:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:10:2)


**הֹזִים שֹׁכְבִים.** פֵּירֵשׁ דּוּנָשׁ: נִרְדָּמִים שׁוֹכְבִין, וְיוֹנָתָן תִּרְגֵּם: ״נַיְימִין שָׁכְבִין״, וְאֵין לוֹ דִּמְיוֹן:


**they lie slumbering** Heb. הֹזִים. Dunash (Teshuvoth Dunash p. 24) explained: lying sound asleep, and Jonathan rendered: lying slumbering, and there is no comparable word in Scripture.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 56:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:11:1)


**וְהַכְּלָבִים עַזֵּי נֶפֶשׁ.** רוֹצִים לְמַלֹּאות כְּרֵסָם (אינגר״ש בלע״ז):


**And the dogs are of greedy disposition** wanting to fill their stomachs [engrote talent in O.F.], sick with hunger.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 56:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:11:2)


**וְהֵמָּה רֹעִים.** כְּמוֹ שֶׁהַכְּלָבִים **לֹא יָדְעוּ שָׂבְעָה**, כֵּן הָ**רֹעִים לֹא יָדְעוּ הָבִין** מַה יִּהְיֶה בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים:


**and they are shepherds** Just as the dogs know no satiety, neither do the shepherds know to understand what will occur at the end of days.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 56:11:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:11:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:11:3)


**כֻּלָּם.** לְדֶרֶךְ הֲנָיָתָם **פָּנוּ אִישׁ לְבִצְעוֹ**, לִגְזוֹל אֶת שְׁאָר הָעָם שֶׁהֵם מְמֻנִּים עֲלֵיהֶם:


**they all** turned to the way of their benefit, each one to his gain, to rob the rest of the people over whom they are appointed.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 56:11:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:11:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:11:4)


**מִקָּצֵהוּ.** כְּמוֹ ״כָּל הָעָם מִקָּצֶה״ (בראשית יט:ד), מִקְצֵה מִנְיָנָם וְעַד קָצֵהוּ, כֻּלָּם נוֹהֲגִים כֵּן:


**every last one** Heb. מִקָּצֵהוּ, [lit. from its end.] Comp. (Gen. 19:4) “all the people from the end (מִקָּצֶה),” from one end of their number until its other end, they all behave in this manner.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Isaiah 56:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/56:12:1)


**אֵתָיוּ אֶקְחָה יַיִן.** כָּךְ הָיוּ אוֹמְרִים זֶה לָזֶה:

###### Rashi on Isaiah 56:12:2

**and tomorrow shall be like this** with feasting and drinking.



## Chapter 57


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:1:4
