### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:2:1)


**יָבֹא שָׁלוֹם.** כִּי כֵן אָמַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא: יָבֹא הַצַּדִּיק הַזֶּה אֶל אֲבוֹתָיו בְּשָׁלוֹם וְאַל יִרְאֶה בָּרָעָה:


**He shall come in peace** for so says the Holy One, blessed be He, Let this righteous man come to his forefathers in peace, and let him not see the evil.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:2:2)


**יָנוּחוּ עַל מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָם.** בִּהְיוֹת הָרָעָה, זֶה שֶׁהָיָה **הֹלֵךְ נְכֹחוֹ** בְּיָשְׁרוֹ, כְּמוֹ ״עֲשׂוֹת נְכֹחָה״ (עמוס ג:י):


**they shall rest in their resting place** when the evil occurs, he who was walking נְכֹחוֹ, in his uprightness. Comp. (Amos 3:10) “To act rightly (נְכֹחָה).”



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:3:1)


**וְאַתֶּם קִרְבוּ הֵנָּה.** הַנּוֹתָרִים מִשֶּׁנִּסְתַּלְּקוּ הַצַּדִּיקִים, וּתְקַבְּלוּ פֻּרְעָנוּתֵיכֶם:


**And you, draw near hither** The survivors after the righteous have departed, and receive your sentences.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:3:2)


**בְּנֵי עֹנְנָה.** בְּנֵי כְּשָׁפִים:


**children of sorcery** Heb. בְּנֵי עֹנְנָה, children of sorcery.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:3:3)


**זֶרַע מְנָאֵף.** שֶׁהַזָּכָר מְנָאֵף:


**children who commit adultery** That the male commits adultery.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:3:4)


**וַתִּזְנֶה.** הַנְּקֵבָה:


**and played the whore** the female.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:4:1)


**עַל מִי תִּתְעַנָּגוּ.** מֵאַחַר שֶׁשַּׁבְתֶּם מֵאַחֲרַי, עַל מִי תִּשָּׁעֲנוּ לְהִתְעַנֵּג בְּטוֹבָה? אִלּוּ זְכִיתֶם, אָז תִּתְעַנְּגוּ עַל ה׳, אֲבָל עַכְשָׁיו עַל מִי תִּתְעַנָּגוּ?


**On whom will you [rely to] enjoy yourselves** Since you have turned away from following Me, on whom will you rely to enjoy yourselves with good. Had you merited, you would then enjoy yourselves with the Lord, but now, on whom will you rely to enjoy yourselves?


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:4:2)


**עַל מִי תַּרְחִיבוּ פֶה.** כְּשֶׁאַתֶּם מְתַעְתְּעִים וּמַלְעִיבִים בִּנְבִיאָיו:


**against whom do you open your mouth wide** when you scorned and mocked His prophets.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:5:1)


**הַנֵּחָמִים בָּאֵלִים.** הַמִּתְחַמְּמִין בְּשִׁכְבַת זֶרַע תַּחַת אֵלָה וְאַלּוֹן (נידה יג א):


**You who inflame yourselves among the terebinths** Who stimulate themselves with semen under the אֵלִים, they are the terebinth and the oak.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:5:2)


**שׁוֹחֲטֵי הַיְלָדִים.** לְקָרְבַּן עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה:


**who slaughter the children** for a sacrifice to the idols.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:5:3)


**סְעִפֵי.** נִקְרַת הַצּוּרִים, וְכֵן (שופטים טו:יא) ״אֶל סְעִיף סֶלַע״:


**clefts** Heb. סְעִפֵי, the clefts of the rocks. Comp. (Jud. 15:11) “to the cleft (סְעִיף) of the rock.”



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:6:1)


**בְּחַלְּקֵי נַחַל.** אֲבָנִים אֲשֶׁר בַּנַּחַל:


**Of the smooth [stones] of the valley** [Lit. of the smooth ones of the valley, i.e.,] among the smooth stones that are in the valley.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:6:2)


**חֶלְקֵךְ.** בָּהֶם יִרְגְּמוּ אוֹתָךְ:


**your portion** With them they will stone you.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:6:3)


**הֵם הֵם גּוֹרָלֵךְ.** לְהִתְעַצֵּב בָּהֶם. לָמָּה? כִּי **גַּם לָהֶם שָׁפַכְתְּ נֶסֶךְ**:


**they, they are your lot** to be saddened with them. Why? For to them too you have poured out libations.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:6:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:6:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:6:4)


**הַעַל אֵלֶּה אֶנָּחֵם.** מִלְּהָרַע לָךְ?


**in the face of these shall I relent** from doing harm to you?



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:7:1)


**שַׂמְתְּ מִשְׁכָּבֵךְ.** מִשְׁכַּב נֵאוּפֵךְ לְעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה עַל הֶהָרִים הָרָמִים:


**you placed your couch** The couch of your adultery to idolatry on the high mountains.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:8:1)


**וְאַחַר הַדֶּלֶת וְהַמְּזוּזָה שַׂמְתְּ זִכְרוֹנֵךְ.** לְמִי שֶׁהוּא מְדַמֶּה אוֹתָהּ לְאִשָּׁה מְנָאֶפֶת, אֲשֶׁר נוֹאֲפֶיהָ צוֹפִים וּמַמְתִּינִים לִפְנֵי פֶּתַח בֵּיתָהּ, וְהִיא לִבָּהּ וְזִכְרוֹנָהּ אֶל הַדֶּלֶת וְהַמְּזוּזָה, אֵיךְ תִּפְתַּח וְתֵצֵא אֲלֵיהֶם:


**And behind the door and the doorpost you have directed your thoughts** Since he compares her to an adulterous woman, for whom her paramours look and wait before the door of her house, while she, lying beside her husband, directs her heart and her thoughts to the door and the doorpost, how she will open the door and come out to them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:8:2)


**כִּי מֵאִתִּי גִּלִּית וַתַּעֲלִי.** אֶצְלִי הָיִית שׁוֹכֶבֶת, וְגִלִּית הַכִּסּוּי שֶׁהָיוּ מְכֻסִּים יַחַד, וַתַּעֲלִי מֵאֶצְלִי:


**for while with Me, you uncovered [us] and went up** You were lying beside Me, and you removed the cover with which we were covered together, and you went up from beside Me.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:8:3)


**הִרְחַבְתְּ מִשְׁכָּבֵךְ.** לְקַבֵּל בּוֹ נוֹאֲפִים הַרְבֵּה:


**you widened your couch** to accommodate many adulterers.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:8:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:8:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:8:4)


**וַתִּכְרָת לָךְ** בְּרִית **מֵהֶם**:


**and made for yourself** a covenant with them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:8:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:8:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:8:5)


**אָהַבְתְּ מִשְׁכָּבָם.** כְּשֶׁ**חָזִית** לָךְ **יָד** וּמָקוֹם לְהַרְאוֹת לָהֶם אַהֲבָתֵךְ:


**you loved their couch** when you chose for yourself יָד, a place, to demonstrate to them your love.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:8:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:8:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:8:6)


**יָד.** אייש״י בלע״ז, וְכֵן ״רְאוּ חֶלְקַת יוֹאָב אֶל יָדִי״ (שמואל ב יד:ל):


**a place** Heb. יָד, aise or ajjse in O.F., a side. Comp. (II Sam. 14: 30) “See Joab’s field is near mine (עַל יָדִי).”



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:9:1)


**וַתָּשֻׁרִי לַמֶּלֶךְ בַּשֶּׁמֶן.** וַאֲנִי מִתְּחִלָּה גִּדַּלְתִּיךְ, וְהָיִית מְקַבֶּלֶת פְּנֵי מַלְכֵּךְ בְּכָל מִינֵי תַּפְנוּקִים. **וַתָּשֻׁרִי** לְשׁוֹן רְאִיַּת פָּנִים, כְּמוֹ ״אֲשׁוּרֶנּוּ וְלֹא קָרוֹב״ (במדבר כד:יז), וְכֵן ״וּתְשׁוּרָה אֵין לְהָבִיא״ (שמואל א ט:ז) דּוֹרוֹן שֶׁל הַקְבָּלַת פָּנִים:


**And you brought a gift to the king with oil** Heb. וַתָּשֻׁרִי. Originally, I aggrandized you, and you would greet your king with all sorts of delights. וַתָּשֻׁרִי is an expression of an audience. Comp. (Num. 24:17) “I see him (אֲשׁוּרֶנוּ) but he is not near.” [Also] (I Sam. 9:7), “And there is no present (תְּשׁוּרָה) to bring,” [i.e.,] a gift for an audience.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:9:2)


**וַתְּשַׁלְּחִי צִירָיִךְ.** שְׁלוּחַיִךְ לְ**מֵרָחוֹק**, לִגְבּוֹת מַס מִמַּלְכֵי הָאֻמּוֹת:


**and you sent your ambassadors** Your messenger afar to collect tribute from the heathen kings. ([Manuscripts and K’li Paz read:] the kings of the nations.)


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:9:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:9:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:9:3)


**וַתַּשְׁפִּילִי.** אֶת חִזְקֵי הָאֻמּוֹת עַד שְׁאוֹל; כֵּן תִּרְגְּמוֹ יוֹנָתָן:


**and you humbled** the laws of the heathens (of the nations [Mss. and K’li Paz]) to the grave. Jonathan rendered it in this manner.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:10:1)


**בְּרֹב דַּרְכֵּךְ יָגַעַתְּ.** נִתְעַסַּקְתְּ בִּצְרָכַיִךְ לְמַלֹּאת תַּאֲוָתֵךְ לְהַרְבּוֹת הוֹנֵךְ:


**With the length of your way you became wearied** You engaged in your necessities, in the filling of your lust, to increase your wealth.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:10:2)


**לֹא אָמַרְתְּ נוֹאָשׁ.** אֶתְיָאֵשׁ מֵאֵלּוּ וְלֹא אָחוּשׁ עוֹד לַעֲסוֹק בָּהֶן, כִּי בַּתּוֹרָה וּבַמִּצְווֹת אֶתֵּן לֵב:


**you did not say, “Despair.”** I will despair of these and I will no longer care to engage in them, but I will pay my attention to Torah and precepts.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:10:3)


**חַיַּת יָדֵךְ מָצָאת.** צֹרֶךְ יָדֵךְ מָצָאת, הִצְלַחְתְּ בְּמַעֲשַׂיִךְ:


**The power of your hand you found** Heb. חַיַּת, the necessity of your hand you have found; you have succeeded in your deeds.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:10:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:10:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:10:4)


**עַל כֵּן לֹא חָלִית.** לֹא נֶחֱלָה לִבֵּךְ לִדְאֹג עַל עֲבוֹדָתִי, לַעֲסֹק בַּתּוֹרָה. **חַיַּת** – לְשׁוֹן עֲרָבִי הוּא: צֹרֶךְ:


**therefore, you were not stricken ill** Your heart was not stricken ill to worry about My service, to engage in the Torah. חַיַּת is an Arabic word, meaning necessity.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:11:1)


**וְאֶת מִי דָּאַגְתְּ.** מִמִּי נִתְיָרֵאת?


**And whom did you dread** Of whom were you afraid?


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:11:2)


**כִּי תְכַזֵּבִי.** כִּי פָּסַקְתְּ לָךְ מֵעֲבוֹדָתִי וְכָזַבְתְּ בִּי, כְּמוֹ ״לֹא יְכַזְּבוּ מֵימָיו״ (ישעיהו נח:יא), ״כָּל הָאָדָם כֹּזֵב״ (תהלים קטז:יא). פליינצ״א בלע״ז, וְכֵן כָּל לְשׁוֹן ׳כָּזָב׳ – מִי שֶׁבּוֹטְחִין עָלָיו וְהוּא כּוֹזֵב וּבוֹגֵד:


**that you failed** Heb. תְּכַזֵּבִי, that you ceased to worship Me and you betrayed Me. Comp. (infra 58:11) “Whose water shall not fail (יְכַזְּבוּ).” Comp. also (Psalms 116:11) “Every man is a traitor (כֹּזֵב).” Falajjnc in O.F., to fail. Likewise, every expression of כָּזָב means one upon whom people rely, and he fails and betrays them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:11:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:11:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:11:3)


**הֲלֹא אֲנִי מַחְשֶׁה.** שֶׁהֶחֱשֵׁיתִי עַל כַּמָּה פְּשָׁעִים שֶׁפָּשַׁעְתְּ בִּי:


**Indeed, I am silent** I kept silent in the face of many transgressions that you transgressed against Me.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:12:1)


**אֲנִי אַגִּיד צִדְקָתֵךְ.** אֲנִי תָּמִיד מַגִּיד לָךְ דְּבָרִים, שֶׁאִם תַּעֲשִׂי אוֹתָם תִּצְדְּקִי:


**I tell your righteousness** Constantly, I tell you things to do, so that you will be righteous.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:12:2)


**וְאֶת מַעֲשַׂיִךְ.** שֶׁאַתָּה עוֹשֶׂה שֶׁלֹּא בִּרְצוֹנִי, **לֹא יוֹעִילוּךְ** בְּעֵת רָעָתֵךְ:


**and your deeds** that you do against My will shall not avail you at the time of your distress.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:13:1)


**בְּזַעֲקֵךְ יַצִּילוּךְ קִבּוּצַיִךְ.** יָקוּמוּ נָא קְבוּצוֹת אֱלִילִים וּפְסִילִים וּמַכְחִישֵׁי תּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר קִבַּצְתָּ, וְיַצִּילוּךְ בְּזַעֲקֵךְ מִצָּרָתֵךְ. הֲלֹא **אֶת כֻּלָּם יִשָּׂא רוּחַ** וְלֹא יוּכְלוּ לְהַצִּיל:


**When you cry out, let your collections save you** Let the collection of your idols and your graven images [and those who deny the Torah] that you collected, rise and save you when you cry out from your distress. Indeed, wind will carry all of them off, and they will not rise, neither will they be able to save.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:14:1)


**וְאָמַר סֹלּוּ סֹלּוּ.** כֹּה אָמַר הַנָּבִיא בִּשְׁמִי לְעַמִּי: כִּבְשׁוּ מְסִלָּה סְלוּלָה, פַּנּוּ יֵצֶר הָרַע מִדַּרְכֵיכֶם (סוכה נב א):


**And he shall say, “Pave, pave”** So will the prophet say in My name to My people, “Pave, pave a paved highway, clear away the evil inclination from your ways.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:14:2)


**הָרִימוּ מִכְשׁוֹל.** סַלְּקוּ הָאֲבָנִים שֶׁאַתֶּם נִכְשָׁלִים רַגְלֵיכֶם בָּהֶם, הֵם הִרְהוּרֵי רֶשַׁע:


**remove the obstacle** Remove the stones upon which your feet stumble; they are wicked thoughts.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:15:1)


**מָרוֹם וְקָדוֹשׁ** אֲנִי **שֹׁכֵן**, וּמִשָּׁם אֲנִי עִם **דַּכָּא וּשְׁפַל רוּחַ**, שֶׁאֲנִי מַרְכִּין שְׁכִינָתִי עָלָיו:


**“With the lofty and the holy ones”** I dwell, and thence I am with the crushed and the humble in spirit, upon whom I lower My Presence.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:15:2)


**שְׁפָלִים. נִדְכָּאִים**, סוֹבְלֵי עֹנִי וָחֳלָיִים:


**humble...crushed** Suffering from poverty and illnesses.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:16:1)


**כִּי לֹא לְעוֹלָם אָרִיב.** אִם אָבִיא יִסּוּרִין עַל הָאָדָם, אֵין תַּחֲרוּתִי עָלָיו לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים, וְלֹא קִצְפִּי **לָנֶצַח**:


**For I will not contend forever** If I bring afflictions upon a person, My contention with him is not for a long time, neither is My anger forever.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:16:2)


**כִּי רוּחַ מִלְּפָנַי יַעֲטוֹף.** כַּאֲשֶׁר רוּחַ הָאָדָם, שֶׁהוּא מִלְּפָנַי שֶׁנִּתַּן בּוֹ מֵאִתִּי, יַעֲטוֹף יוֹדֶה וְיִכָּנַע עַל מַעֲלוֹ, כְּמוֹ (איכה ב:יט) ״הָעֲטוּפִים בָּרָעָב״, ״בֵּעָטֵף עוֹלֵל״ (שם), וְהַנְּשָׁמוֹת שֶׁאֲנִי עָשִׂיתִי:


**when a spirit from before Me humbles itself** Heb. יַעֲטוֹף. When the spirit of man, which is from before Me, humbles itself, confesses and humbles itself because of its betrayal. Comp. (Lam. 2:19) “humbled (הָעֲטוּפִים) with hunger,” “when the small child and the suckling are humbled (בֵּעָטֵף).” And the souls which I made.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:16:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:16:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:16:3)


**כִּי רוּחַ מִלְּפָנַי.** ׳כִּי׳ זֶה מְשַׁמֵּשׁ בִּלְשׁוֹן ׳כַּאֲשֶׁר׳, כְּמוֹ ״כִּי תִרְאֶה״ (שמות כג:ה), ״כִּי תָבוֹא״ (דברים כג:כה). כְּלוֹמַר: כְּשֶׁרוּחוֹ נֶעֱטֶפֶת וְהוּא נִכְנָע, אֲנִי מְבַטֵּל רִיבִי וְקִצְפִּי מֵעָלָיו:


**when a spirit from before Me** Heb. כִּי. This instance of the word כִּי is used as an expression of “when.” Comp. (infra 58:7) “When you see (כִּי תִרְאֶה)”; (Deut. 26:1) “When you come (כִּי תָבוֹא).” That is to say, when his spirit is humbled, and he is humbled, I terminate My quarrel and My anger from upon him.



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:17:1)


**בַּעֲוֺן בִּצְעוֹ.** גְּזֵלָתוֹ:


**For the iniquity of his thievery** Heb. בִּצְעוֹ, his thievery.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:17:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:17:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:17:2)


**קָצַפְתִּי.** תְּחִלָּה **וְאַכֵּהוּ, הַסְתֵּר** פָּנַי תָּמִיד מִצָּרָתוֹ, **וְאֶקְצֹף**, וְעַל כִּי הוֹלֵךְ **שׁוֹבָב בְּדֶרֶךְ לִבּוֹ**. וְסָרֵס אֶת הַמִּקְרָא וְכֵן פֵּרוּשׁוֹ: **בַּעֲוֺן בִּצְעוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ שׁוֹבָב בְּדַרְכֵי לִבּוֹ קָצַפְתִּי וְאַכֵּהוּ**:


**I became wroth** at the beginning and I smote him, always hiding My face from his distress and I was wroth for he went rebelliously in the way of his heart. Transpose the verse and explain it thus: For the iniquity of his thievery and the fact that he went rebelliously in the way of his heart, I became wroth and smote him.



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:18:1)


**דְּרָכָיו רָאִיתִי.** כְּשֶׁהוּא נִכְנָע מִלְּפָנַי שֶׁבָּאַתְהוּ צָרָה:


**I saw his ways** when he humbled himself before Me, when troubles befell him.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:18:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:18:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:18:2)


**וְאֶרְפָּאֵהוּ וְאַנְחֵהוּ.** אוֹלִיכוֹ בְּדֶרֶךְ מַרְפֵּא, אוֹ **וְאַנְחֵהוּ** לְשׁוֹן הֲנָחָה וּמַרְגּוֹעַ:


**and I will heal him, and I will lead him** Heb. וְאַנְחֵהוּ. I will lead him in the way of healing. Alternatively, וְאַנְחֵהוּ is an expression of rest and tranquility.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:18:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:18:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:18:3)


**לוֹ וְלַאֲבֵלָיו.** לַמִּצְטַעֲרִים עָלָיו:


**him and his mourners** to those who are troubled over him.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:19:1)


**בּוֹרֵא נִיב שְׂפָתָיִם.** בּוֹרֵא אֲנִי לוֹ נִיב שְׂפָתַיִם חָדָשׁ, כְּלַפֵּי שֶׁבָּאַתְהוּ צָרָה עַד עַתָּה, וְהַכֹּל קָרְאוּ עָלָיו תִּגָּר, יִקְרְאוּ לוֹ: **שָׁלוֹם שָׁלוֹם**:


**[I] create the speech of the lips** I create for him a new manner of speech. In contrast to the trouble that befell him, and everyone was degrading him, they will call, “Peace, peace.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:19:2)


**לָרָחוֹק וְלַקָּרוֹב.** שְׁנֵיהֶם שָׁוִין: מִי שֶׁנִּתְיַשֵּׁן וְהֻרְגַּל בְּתוֹרָתִי וַעֲבוֹדָתִי מִנְּעוּרָיו, וּמִי שֶׁנִּתְקָרֵב עַתָּה מִקָּרוֹב לָשׁוּב מִדַּרְכּוֹ הָרָעָה (ברכות לד ב). **אָמַר ה׳ וּרְפָאתִיו** מֵחָלְיוֹ וּמֵחֲטָאָיו:


**to the far and to the near** Both are equal; he who aged and was accustomed to My Torah and My worship from his youth, and he who drew near now, just recently to repent of his evil way. Said the Lord, “I will heal him of his malady and of his sins.”



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:20:1)


**וְהָרְשָׁעִים.** שֶׁאֵין נוֹתְנִין לֵב לָשׁוּב:


**But the wicked** who do not give a thought to repent.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:20:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:20:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:20:2)


**כַּיָּם נִגְרָשׁ.** הַיָּם הַזֶּה גַּלָּיו מִתְגָּאִים לָרוּם לְמַעְלָה וְלָצֵאת חוּץ לִגְבוּל הַחוֹל ״אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתִּי גְּבוּל לַיָּם״ (ירמיהו ה:כב), וּכְשֶׁמַּגִּיעַ שָׁם הוּא נִשְׁבָּר עַל כָּרְחוֹ, וְכָל זֶה גַּל חֲבֵרוֹ רוֹאֶה וְאֵינוֹ חוֹזֵר בּוֹ. כָּךְ הָרָשָׁע רוֹאֶה אֶת חֲבֵרוֹ לוֹקֶה בְּרִשְׁעוֹ וְאֵינוֹ חוֹזֵר בּוֹ. וּמָה הַיָּם רִפְשׁוֹ וְסִרְיוֹתוֹ עַל פִּיו, כָּךְ הָרְשָׁעִים סִרְיוֹתָם בְּפִיהֶם; כְּגוֹן פַּרְעֹה אָמַר ״מִי ה׳״ (שמות ה:ב), סַנְחֵרִיב אָמַר ״מִי בְּכָל אֱלֹהֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת״ (ישעיהו לו:כ), נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר אָמַר ״אֶדַּמֶּה לְעֶלְיוֹן״ (ישעיהו יד:יד):


**like the turbulent sea** This seaits waves raise themselves high and strive to go out of the boundary of sand that I made as a boundary for the sea, and when it reaches there, against its will it breaks. The next wave sees all this, yet does not turn back. Similarly, the wicked man sees his friend being punished for his wickedness; yet he does not turn back. Also, just as the sea has its mud and its offensive matter on its mouth, [i.e., on its surface,] so do the wicked have their offensive matter in their mouth; e.g., Pharaoh said, (Exodus 5:2) “Who is the Lord?” Sennacherib said (supra 36:20), “Who are they among all the Gods of the lands...?” Nebuchadnezzar said, (supra 14:14) “I will liken myself to the Most High.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:20:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:20:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:20:3)


**כַּיָּם נִגְרָשׁ.** כְּיָם אֲשֶׁר נִגְרָשׁ, שֶׁגּוֹרֵשׁ כָּל הַיּוֹם רֶפֶשׁ וָטִיט:


**like the turbulent sea** Like the sea, which is turbulent, that casts up all day mud and dirt.



### Verse 21

###### Rashi on Isaiah 57:21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/57:21:1)


**אֵין שָׁלוֹם.** כְּלַפֵּי שֶׁאָמַר לַצַּדִּיקִים וּלְבַעֲלֵי תְּשׁוּבָה ״שָׁלוֹם שָׁלוֹם לָרָחוֹק וְגוֹ׳״ (ישעיהו נז:יט), חָזַר וְאָמַר ״אֵין שָׁלוֹם לָרְשָׁעִים״:


**There is no peace** In contrast to what he said to the righteous and the repentant, “Peace, peace to the far, etc.,” he returned and said, “There is no peace for the wicked.”



## Chapter 58


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:1:1)


**וְהַגֵּד לְעַמִּי פִּשְׁעָם.** אֵלּוּ תַּלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים, שֶׁכָּל שִׁגְגָתָם פֶּשַׁע, שֶׁשִּׁגְגַת תַּלְמוּד עוֹלָה זָדוֹן:


**and relate to My people their transgression** These are the Torah scholars, whose every inadvertent sin is counted as a transgression, for an error in study is accounted as an intentional sin.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:1:2)


**וּלְבֵית יַעֲקֹב חַטֹּאתָם.** אֵלּוּ עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ, שֶׁאַף זְדוֹנָם שְׁגָגָה (בבא מציעא לג ב):


**and to the house of Jacob their sins** These are the ignorant people, whose willful sins, are accounted inadvertent.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:2:1)


**וְאוֹתִי יוֹם יוֹם יִדְרֹשׁוּן.** כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״וַיְפַתּוּהוּ בְּפִיהֶם״ (תהלים עח:לו):


**Yet they seek Me daily** Like the matter that is stated (Ps. 78:36): “And they beguiled Him with their mouth.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:2:2)


**וְדַעַת דְּרָכַי יֶחְפָּצוּן.** חֲפֵצִים לִשְׁאוֹל הוֹרָאוֹת לַחֲכָמִים, כְּאִלּוּ רוֹצִים לְקַיְּמָם:


**and they wish to know My ways** They wish to ask instructions of the wise men as if they wished to fulfill them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:2:3)


**כְּגוֹי אֲשֶׁר צְדָקָה עָשָׂה וגו׳.** כָּךְ שׁוֹאֲלִים אוֹתִי תָּמִיד מִשְׁפַּט צֶדֶק, וְאֵין דַּעְתָּם לְקַיְּמָם. וּכְשֶׁהֵן צָמִים וְאֵין נַעֲנִין, אוֹמְרִים: **לָמָּה צַמְנוּ וְלֹא רָאִיתָ**? וַאֲנִי אוֹמֵר: **הֵן בְּיוֹם צוֹמְכֶם תִּמְצְאוּ חֵפֶץ** – כָּל חֶפְצֵי צָרְכֵיכֶם אַתֶּם עֲמֵלִים לִמְצוֹא, וְאַף בְּגָזֵל וְחָמָס:


**like a nation that performed righteousness, etc.** In this manner they constantly ask Me ordinances of righteousness, but they do not intend to fulfill them, and when they fast and are not answered, they say, “Why have we fasted, and You did not see?” But I say, “Behold, on the day of your fast you pursue business,” all the affairs of your necessities you toil to pursue, even robbery and violence.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:3:1)


**וְכָל עַצְּבֵיכֶם.** בַּעֲלֵי חוֹב שֶׁלָּכֶם, הַנֶּעֱצָבִים עַל יֶדְכֶם, אַתֶּם נוֹגְשִׂים אוֹתָם **בְּיוֹם צֹמְכֶם**:


**and [from] all your debtors** Heb. עַצְּבֵיכֶם [lit. your griefs.] Your debtors, who are grieved because of you, you exact payment from them on the day of your fast.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:4:1)


**לֹא תָצוּמוּ כַיּוֹם.** כְּמִשְׁפַּט הַיּוֹם, לִשְׁבּוֹר לְבַבְכֶם כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּשָּׁמַע **קוֹלְכֶם בַּמָּרוֹם**:


**Do not fast like this day** like the manner of this day, to break your hearts in order that your voice be heard on high.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:5:1)


**הֲלָכֹף.** הֵ״א זוֹ תְּמִיהָא, כְּלוֹמַר: שֶׁמָּא **לָכֹף כְּאַגְמוֹן רֹאשׁוֹ** אֲנִי צָרִיךְ? **אַגְמוֹן** הוּא כְּמִין מַחַט כָּפוּף, וְצָדִין בּוֹ דָּגִים וְקוֹרִין לוֹ איי״ם בלע״ז:


**Is it to bend** Heb. הֲלָכֹף. This ‘hey’ is the interrogative. That is to say, “Perhaps I require bending the head like a fishhook (כְּאַגְמֹן)?” אַגְמֹן is a sort of bent needle with which they catch fish, and they call it ajjm in O.F.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:5:2)


**הֲלָזֶה תִּקְרָא צוֹם.** לְשׁוֹן תְּמִיהָא, לְפִיכָךְ הַהֵ״א נְקוּדָה חֲטַף פַּתַּח:


**Will you call this a fast** Heb. הֲלָזֶה. An interrogative form. Therefore, the ‘hey’ is punctuated with a ‘hataf-pattah.’



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:6:1)


**חַרְצֻבּוֹת.** לְשׁוֹן קִשּׁוּר וְאִסּוּר:


**fetters** Heb. חַרְצֻבּוֹת, an expression of tying and binding.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:6:2)


**מוֹטָה.** הַטָּיַת מִשְׁפָּט:


**perverseness** Heb. מוֹטָה, perversion of justice.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:6:3)


**וְכָל מוֹטָה תְּנַתֵּקוּ.** תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן: ״וְכָל דִּין מַסְטֵי תְּסַלְּקוּן״:


**and all perverseness you shall eliminate** Heb. וְכָל מוֹטָה תְּנַתֵּקוּ. Jonathan renders: And all perversion of justice you shall eliminate.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:7:1)


**וַעֲנִיִּים מְרוּדִים.** נֶאֱנָחִים וְנֶאֱנָקִים עַל צָרָתָם, כְּגוֹן ״עָנְיִי וּמְרוּדִי״ (איכה ג:יט), ״אָרִיד בְּשִׂיחִי״ (תהלים נה:ג):


**moaning poor** Heb. מְרוּדִים. Sighing and moaning about their distress. Comp. (Lam. 3:19) “my affliction and my sighing (וּמְרוּדִי)”; (Ps. 55:3) “I mourn (אָרִיד) in my grief.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:7:2)


**וּמִבְּשָׂרְךָ.** וּמִקְּרוֹבְךָ:


**and from your flesh** And from your kinsman.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:8:1)


**יִבָּקַע כַּשַּׁחַר.** כְּעַמּוּד הַשַּׁחַר הַבּוֹקֵעַ בֶּעָבִים:


**as the dawn** Like the ray of dawn that breaks through the clouds.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:8:2)


**וַאֲרֻכָתְךָ מְהֵרָה.** וּרְפוּאָתְךָ מְהֵרָה, כְּמוֹ ״אַעֲלֶה אֲרֻכָה לָךְ״ (ירמיהו ל:יז):


**and your healing** Heb. וַאֲרֻכָתְךָ, and your healing shall quickly sprout. Comp. (Jer. 30:17) “I will bring up healing (אֲרֻכָה) for you.”



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:10:1)


**וְתָפֵק לָרָעֵב נַפְשֶׁךָ.** בְּתַנְחוּמֵי דְּבָרִים טוֹבִים (בבא בתרא ט ב):


**And you draw out your soul to the hungry** with consolations of good words.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:11:1)


**בְּצַחְצָחוֹת.** בְּעֵת צִמָּאוֹן וּבַצּוֹרֶת; כָּךְ תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן:


**in drought** Heb. בְּצַחְצָחוֹת, at the time of thirst and drought. So did Jonathan render.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:11:2)


**יַחֲלִיץ.** יְזַיֵּן, כְּמוֹ ״חֲלוּצֵי צָבָא״ (במדבר לא:ה):


**strengthen** Heb. יַחֲלִיף [lit. arm.] Comp. (Num. 31:5) “Armed (חֲלוּצֵי) for war.”



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:12:1)


**מְשׁוֹבֵב נְתִיבוֹת לָשָׁבֶת.** תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן: ״מְתִיב רַשִׁיעַיָּא לְאוֹרַיְיתָא״:


**restorer of the paths, to dwell in** Heb. מְשׁוֹבֵב. Jonathan renders: restorer of the wicked to the Torah.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:12:2)


**מְשׁוֹבֵב.** כְּמוֹ ׳מֵשִׁיב׳:


מְשׁוֹבֵב is like מֵשִׁיב, restores.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:12:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:12:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:12:3)


**לָשָׁבֶת.** לְיִשּׁוּבוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם:


**to dwell**, to the Torah, which insures the settlement of the world.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Isaiah 58:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/58:14:1)


**נַחֲלַת יַעֲקֹב אָבִיךָ.** נַחֲלָה בְּלֹא מְצָרִים, כְּמָה שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״וּפָרַצְתָּ יָמָּה וָקֵדְמָה וְגוֹ׳״ (בראשית כח:יד). לֹא כְּאַבְרָהָם שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (בראשית יג:טו) ״הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה רוֹאֶה״. וְיַעֲקֹב שָׁמַר אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (בראשית לג:יח) ״וַיִּחַן אֶת פְּנֵי הָעִיר״, שֶׁקָּבַע תְּחוּמִין עִם דִּמְדּוּמֵי חַמָּה. כָּךְ פֵּרֵשׁ רַבִּי שִׁמְשׁוֹן:


**the heritage of Jacob your father** An inheritance without boundaries, as it is said (Gen. 28: 14): “And you shall spread to the west and to the east, etc.” Not like Abraham, about whom it is stated (ibid. 13:15): “The land that you see...” And Jacob indeed kept the Sabbath, as it is said (ibid. 33: 18): “And he encamped before the city,” i.e., he established the Sabbath limits at twilight. So did Rabbi Samson explain it.



## Chapter 59


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:1:1)


**הֵן לֹא קָצְרָה.** אֶת אֲשֶׁר לֹא נוֹשַׁעְתֶּם, לֹא מִקֹּצֶר יָדוֹ הוּא:


**Behold, the hand of the Lord is not too short** Your failure to be delivered is not due to the shortness of My hand.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:2:1)


**הִסְתִּירוּ פָנִים.** גָּרְמוּ לָכֶם שֶׁהִסְתִּיר פָּנָיו מִכֶּם:


**have caused [Him] to hide [His] face** They caused for you that He hid His face from you.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:3:1)


**נְגֹאֲלוּ.** לְשׁוֹן ׳טִנּוּף׳, וְכֵן ״לֶחֶם מְגֹאָל״ (מלאכי א:ז):


**were defiled** Heb. נְגֹאֲלוּ, an expression of defilement. Comp. (Mal. 1:7) “polluted bread (מְגֹאָל).”



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:5:1)


**צִפְעוֹנִי.** מִין נָחָשׁ רַע:


**vipers** a species of harmful snake.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:5:2)


**בִּקֵּעוּ.** אישקלורש״ט בלע״ז, כְּלוֹמַר: מַעֲשִׂים מְכֹעָרִים שֶׁאֵינָם לְטוֹבָתָם עָשׂוּ:


**hatched** Heb. בִּקְּעוּ, eskloterant in O.F. That is to say that they committed ugly deeds, from which they did not benefit.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:5:3)


**וְקוּרֵי עַכָּבִישׁ.** איריני״ש בלע״ז, וְקוּרֵי – אורטור״ש בלע״ז. **קוּרֵי** הֵם כְּלֵי הָאוֹרֵג שֶׁהַשְּׁתִי מוּסָךְ בָּהֶן, וּמְנַחֵם חִבְּרוֹ בְּמַחְבֶּרֶת קוֹרוֹת, עַל שֵׁם שֶׁהָעַכָּבִישׁ מֵיסָךְ אֲרִיגוֹתָיו בְּקוֹרוֹת:


**and...spider webs** Irajjne in O.F., spider, and קוּרֵי is ordiojjrs in O.F., warp. קוּרֵי are the implements of the weaver, those upon which the warp is mounted. Menahem (Machbereth Menahem p. 158) classifies it in the class of קוֹרוֹת, beams, since the spider mounts the warp of his weavings on beams.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:5:4)


**וְהַזּוּרֶה.** תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן: ״מְשַׁחְנָן״, לְשׁוֹן ׳חִמּוּם׳, שֶׁקּוֹרִין בלע״ז קובי״ר; הַמְחַמְּמָן יוֹצֵא מֵהֶן כְּשֶׁהוּא מְבַקֵּעַ הַקְּלִפָּה. וְעִקַּר לְשׁוֹן וְהַזּוּרֶה לְשׁוֹן ׳עִצּוּר׳ הוּא, לְהוֹצִיא הַבָּלוּעַ בְּתוֹכוֹ, כְּמוֹ ״וַיָּזַר אֶת הַגִּזָּה״ (שופטים ו:לח), וְעִצּוּרוֹ שֶׁל זֶה הוּא חִמּוּמוֹ:


**and what hatches** Heb. וְהַזּוּרֶה. Jonathan renders: וּמְשַׁחְנָן, an expression of warming, called in O.F. kover [couve], hatching when one warms them, it emerges from them when he cracks the shell. The original meaning of וְהַזּוּרֶה is an expression of pressing to extract what is absorbed within. Comp. (Jud. 6:38) “And pressed (וַיָּזַר) the fleece.” The pressing of this one is its hatching.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:5:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:5:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:5:5)


**אֶפְעֶה.** מִין נָחָשׁ שֶׁהוּא רַע, כָּךְ לֹא יִשְׁתַּלְּמוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂיהֶם אֶלָּא רָעָה:


**viper** Heb. אֶפְעֶה, a species of snake that is harmful, so will nothing result from their deeds but evil.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:8:1)


**וְאֵין מִשְׁפָּט בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתָם.** כְּלוֹמַר, אֵין בְּמַעְגַּל דַּרְכֵיהֶם דָּבָר נִשְׁפָּט בֶּאֱמֶת כְּמִשְׁפָּטוֹ:


**and there is no justice in their paths** That is to say that in their paths there is nothing judged truly according to its law.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:8:2)


**נְתִיבוֹתֵיהֶם עִקְּשׁוּ לָהֶם.** הֵם הֶעֱווּ אֶת דַּרְכָּם לְעַצְמָם:


**they have made themselves crooked paths** They made their road crooked for themselves.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:9:1)


**רָחַק מִשְׁפָּט מִמֶּנּוּ.** שֶׁהָיִינוּ צוֹעֲקִים חָמָס מֵאוֹיְבֵינוּ, וְאֵין הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא שׁוֹפֵט לִנְקוֹם נְקָמָה:


**justice is far from us** For we were crying that we were robbed by our enemies, yet the Holy One, blessed be He, does not judge to avenge us.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:9:2)


**וְלֹא תַשִּׂיגֵנוּ צְדָקָה.** הַנֶּחָמוֹת הַטּוֹבוֹת שֶׁהִבְטִיחָנוּ אֵין מַשִּׂיגוֹת אוֹתָנוּ לָבוֹא:


**and righteousness does not overtake us** The good consolations that He promised us are not coming to overtake us.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:9:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:9:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:9:3)


**לִנְגֹהוֹת.** נְקַוֶּה, וּ**בָאֲפֵלוֹת נְהַלֵּךְ**:


**for brightness** we hope, but we walk in gloom.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:10:1)


**בָּאַשְׁמַנִּים.** מְנַחֵם פָּתַר לְשׁוֹן ׳מַחֲשַׁכִּים׳, וְרֹב הַפּוֹתְרִים מוֹדִים לוֹ. אֲבָל דּוּנַשׁ פָּתַר בּוֹ לְשׁוֹן ׳שׁוּמָן׳, וְהָאָלֶ״ף נוֹסָף בּוֹ, כְּמוֹ אָלֶ״ף שֶׁבְּ״אַחֲוָתִי״ (איוב יג:יז), וְשֶׁבְּ״אַכְזָב״ (ירמיה טו:יח), וְ״דֶרֶךְ הָאֲתָרִים״ (במדבר כא:א). אַף כָּאן בֵּין הָאַשְׁמַנִּים בֵּין הַחַיִּים הַשְּׁמֵנִים אֲנַחְנוּ **כַּמֵּתִים**. וְיוֹנָתָן תִּרְגֵּם לְשׁוֹן ׳מַסְגֵּר׳: ״אִיתַאֲחַד בְּאַפְנָא כְּמָה דַאֲחִידִין קִבְרַיָּא בְּאַפֵּי מֵיתַיָּא״:


**in dark places** Heb. בָּאַשְׁמַנִּים. Menahem (Machbereth, p. 35) interpreted it as an expression of dark places, and most exegetes concur with him. Dunash, however, (Tesuhvoth Dunash, p. 93) interprets it as an expression of fat (שׁוּמָן), with the ‘alef’ prefixed to it like the ‘alef’ that is in (Job 13:17) אַחְוָתִי, “my narrative,” [derived from חוה]; and that is in (Jer. 15:18) אַכְזָב, “a failure,” (derived from כזב ; and (Num. 21:1) “the way of the spies (הָאֲתָרִים),” [derived from תור]. Here, too, among the שְׁמֵנִים, among the lusty living, we are like dead. And Jonathan rendered it as an expression of locking: It is locked before us as the graves are locked before the dead.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:11:1)


**הָגֹה נֶהְגֶּה.** לְשׁוֹן ׳יְלָלָה׳:


**we moan** Heb. הָגֹה נֶהְגֶה, an expression of wailing.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:13:1)


**דַּבֶּר עֹשֶׁק.** כְּמוֹ ׳לְדַבֵּר עֹשֶׁק׳:


**speaking oppression** Like: to speak oppression.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:13:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:13:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:13:2)


**הֹרוֹ וְהֹגוֹ.** לִירוֹת וּלְהוֹצִיא. **הֹרוֹ** לְשׁוֹן ״יָרָה בַיָּם״ (שמות טו:ד). דָּבָר אַחֵר: **הֹרוֹ וְהֹגוֹ** – הָרַב וְהַתַּלְמִיד שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹר (סא"א), **וְהֹגוֹ** כְּמוֹ ״כַּאֲשֶׁר הֹגָה מִן הַמְּסִלָּה״ (שמואל ב כ:יג), ״הָגוֹ סִיגִים מִכָּסֶף״ (משלי כה:ד):


**sprouting and giving forth** Heb. הֹרוֹ וְהֹגוֹ to shoot and to give forth. הֹרוֹ is an expression of (Ex. 15:4) “He shot (יָרָה) into the sea.” (Another explanation: הֹרוֹ means: the teacher and the disciple, a gerund.) הֹגוֹ is an expression of (II Sam. 20:13) “When he was removed (הֹגָה) from the highway”; (Prov. 25:4) “Take away (הָגוֹ) the dross from the silver.”



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:14:1)


**וְהֻסַּג אָחוֹר מִשְׁפָּט.** נִקְמָתֵנוּ מֵאוֹיְבֵינוּ, שֶׁהִיא תְּלוּיָה בְּהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, וְצִדְקָתוֹ עוֹמֶדֶת **מֵרָחוֹק**. לָמָּה? **כִּי כָשְׁלָה אֱמֶת** בִּרְחוֹבוֹתֵינוּ, וְכֵיוָן שֶׁהָ**אֱמֶת כָּשְׁלָה** מֵאֶרֶץ, אַף מִשָּׁמַיִם אֵין הַצֶּדֶק וְהַמִּשְׁפָּט בָּאִין:


**And justice has turned away backwards** Our revenge from our enemies, which depends upon the Holy One, blessed be He, and His righteousness stands from afar. Why? For truth has stumbled in our streets, [and since truth has stumbled from the earth, even from heaven righteousness and justice do not come.]



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:15:1)


**מִשְׁתּוֹלֵל.** מֻחְזָק שׁוֹטֶה עַל הַבְּרִיּוֹת (סנהדרין צז א), כְּמוֹ ״אֵלְכָה שׁוֹלָל״ (מיכה א:ח), וְהוּא מִגִּזְרַת ״שׁוֹגֵג״, דִּמְתַרְגְּמִינָן ״שָׁלוּ״ (ויקרא ה:לו), וְכֵן ״עַל הַשַּׁל״ (שמואל ב ו:ז):


**is considered mad** Heb. מִשְׁתּוֹלֵל, considered mad by the people. Comp. (Micah 1:8) “I will go as a mad man (שׁוֹלָל).” This is equivalent to שׁוֹגֵג, inadvertent, which the Targum renders: שָׁלוּ. Likewise (II Sam. 6:7), “For his error (הַשַּׁל).”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:15:2)


**וַיֵּרַע בְּעֵינָיו כִּי אֵין מִשְׁפָּט.** לְפִיכָךְ הֵבִיא עֲלֵיהֶם הַפֻּרְעָנוּת:


**and was displeased for there is no justice** Therefore, He brought retribution upon them.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:16:1)


**וַיַּרְא כִּי אֵין אִישׁ.** וְעַתָּה בְּהִנָּחֲמוֹ עַל הָרָעָה לְעַמּוֹ, רוֹאֶה כִּי אֵין אִישׁ צַדִּיק לַעֲמוֹד בַּפֶּרֶץ:


**And He saw that there was no man** And now, when He repents of the evil to His people, He sees that there is no righteous man to stand in the breach.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:16:2)


**וַיִּשְׁתּוֹמֵם.** וַיַּחֲרֵשׁ לִרְאוֹת אִם יֵשׁ מַפְגִּיעַ בַּעֲדָם, וְ**אֵין מַפְגִּיעַ. וַיִּשְׁתּוֹמֵם** לְשׁוֹן אָדָם הָעוֹמֵד וְתוֹהֶה וְשׁוֹתֵק בְּתִמְהוֹנוֹ, וְתָי״ו וַיִּשְׁתּוֹמֵם כְּתָי״ו שֶׁל מִשְׁתּוֹלֵל, וּשְׁנֵיהֶם כָּאן מְשַׁמְּשׁוֹת לְשׁוֹן מִתְפַּעֵל. וְכֵן דֶּרֶךְ הַתֵּיבָה שֶׁיְּסוֹדָהּ הָרִאשׁוֹן שִׁי״ן אוֹ סָמֶ״ךְ, כְּשֶׁהִיא נֶהְפֶּכֶת לִלְשׁוֹן מִתְפַּעֵל, נִתְפַּעֵל וְיִתְפַּעֵל, בָּא הַתָּי״ו בְּאֶמְצַע אוֹתִיּוֹת שֹׁרֶשׁ הַתֵּיבָה. נִמְצָא וַיִּשְׁתּוֹמֵם לְשׁוֹן ״שֹׁמּוּ שָׁמַיִם״ (ירמיהו ב:יב), ״מַשְׁמִים בְּתוֹכָם״ (יחזקאל ג:טו), ״נָשַׁמּוּ אַחֲרֹנִים״ (איוב יח:כ), לְשׁוֹן ׳תִּמָּהוֹן׳:


**and He was astounded** He was silent to see whether there was an intercessor, and there was no intercessor. וַיִּשְׁתּוֹמֵם is an expression of a man who stands and wonders and remains silent in his wonder, and the ‘tav’ of וַיִּשְׁתּוֹמֵם is like the ‘tav’ of מִשְׁתּוֹלֵל, and both of them serve here as the reflexive, and this is the procedure of the word whose first radical is a ‘shin’ or a ‘samech,’ that when it is converted into the form of מִתְפָּעֵל, the present reflexive, נִתְפָּעֵל, the past reflexive, or יִתְפָּעֵל, the future reflexive, the ‘tav’ comes in the middle of the letters of the radical. The result is that וַיִּשְׁתּוֹמֵם is an expression from the same root as (Jer. 2:12) “Be admonished (שֹׁמּוּ), O ye heavens”; (Ezekiel 3:15) “appalled (מַשְׁמִים) among them”; (Job 18:20) “the later ones will be astonished (נָשַׁמּוּ),” an expression of wonder.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:16:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:16:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:16:3)


**וַתּוֹשַׁע לוֹ זְרֹעוֹ.** וְיִנָּקֵם מֵאוֹיְבָיו:


**and His arm saved for Him** and He will take revenge from His enemies.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:16:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:16:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:16:4)


**וְצִדְקָתוֹ... סְמָכָתְהוּ.** הִיא לְהַשִּׂיאוֹ וּלְאַמֵּץ יָדָיו בְּנִקְמָתוֹ, וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֵין אֲנַחְנוּ הֲגוּנִים לְהוֹשִׁיעַ:


**and His righteousness, that supported Him** to entice Him and to strengthen His hands in His revenge, although we are not worthy of being saved.



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:17:1)


**קִנְאָה.** אינפרימנ״ט בלע״ז, לְקַנְּאוֹת לִשְׁמוֹ הַגָּדוֹל:


**zeal** enprenmant in O.F., to be zealous for His great name.



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:18:1)


**כְּעַל גְּמֻלוֹת.** כְּדָת לְהָשִׁיב **עַל גְּמֻלוֹת** הָאוֹיְבִים:


**According to their deeds** As is fitting to recompense for what the enemies dealt to them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:18:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:18:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:18:2)


**כְּעַל יְשַׁלֵּם.** כְּדָת לְהָשִׁיב עֲלֵיהֶם יְשַׁלֵּם:


**accordingly He shall repay** As is fitting to repay them He shall repay.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:19:1)


**כִּי יָבֹא כַנָּהָר.** צָרָה עַל אוֹיְבָיו:


**For...shall come like a river** distress upon His enemies.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:19:2)


**נֹסְסָה בוֹ.** נִפְלָאוֹת בּוֹ, לְשׁוֹן ׳נֵס׳. דָּבָר אַחֵר: **נוֹסְסָה בּוֹ** – אוֹכֶלֶת בּוֹ כְּתוֹלַעַת בָּעֵץ, כְּמוֹ (ישעיהו י:יח) ״וְהָיָה כִּמְסוֹס נוֹסֵס״:


**is wondrous in it** Heb. נֹסְסָה, is wondrous in it, an expression of a miracle (נֵס). Another explanation: נֹסְסָה [means:] eats into him like a worm in wood. Comp. (supra 10:18) “And it shall be as a tree eaten to powder by the worms.”



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:20:1)


**וּבָא לְצִיּוֹן גּוֹאֵל.** כָּל זְמַן שֶׁצִּיּוֹן חֲרֵבָה, עֲדַיִין לֹא בָּא הַגּוֹאֵל ספר אחרים אומרים:


**And a redeemer shall come to Zion** As long as Zion is in ruins, the redeemer has not yet come.



### Verse 21

###### Rashi on Isaiah 59:21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/59:21:1)


**זֹאת בְּרִיתִי אוֹתָם.** בְּדָבָר זֶה כָּרַתִּי בְּרִיתִי לָהֶם וַאֲקַיֵּם, כִּי אַף בְּגָלוּתָם לֹא תִּשָּׁכַח תּוֹרָתִי מֵהֶם:


**As for Me, this is My covenant with them** In this matter, I made a covenant with them, and I will fulfill it, for even in their exile, My Torah shall not be forgotten from them.



## Chapter 60


### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:4:1)


**עַל צַד תֵּאָמַנָה.** ״עַל גִּיסְסִין״ (תרגום יונתן), כְּסָלִים שֶׁל מְלָכִים תִּהְיֶינָה אֲמוּנוֹת:


**shall be raised on [their] side** [Jonathan renders:] on the flanks, the flanks of the kings, they will be raised.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:5:1)


**אָז תִּרְאִי וְנָהַרְתְּ.** ״בְּכֵן תֶּחֱזִין וְתִנְהֲרִין״ (תרגום יונתן):


**Then you shall see and be radiant** Heb. וְנָהַרְתָּ, from נְהוֹרָה, [Aramaic for light,] then you shall see and be radiant [from Jonathan].


###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:5:2)


**וּפָחַד וְרָחַב לְבָבֵךְ.** וְיִתְמַהּ וְיִרְחַב לִבֵּךְ:


**and your heart shall be startled and become enlarged** And your heart shall wonder and become enlarged.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:5:3)


**כִּי יֵהָפֵךְ עָלַיִךְ הֲמוֹן יָם.** ״אֲרֵי יִתְחַלֵּף לִיךְ עוּתַר מַעַרְבָא״ (תרגום יונתן):


**for the abundance of the west shall be turned over to you** for the abundance of the west shall be turned over to you [after Jonathan].


###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:5:4)


**חֵיל גּוֹיִם.** ״נִכְסֵי דְפָלְחֵי כּוֹכְבַיָּא״:


**the wealth of the nations** The possessions of the nations [after Jonathan].



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:6:1)


**שִׁפְעַת.** רֹב:


**A multitude** Heb. שִׁפְעַת, A multiplicity.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:6:2)


**בִּכְרֵי מִדְיָן.** ״הוֹגְנֵי מִדְיָן״ (תרגום יונתן); הֵם גְּמַלִּים בַּחוּרִים, וְכֵן ״בִּכְרָה קַלָּה״ (ירמיה ב:כג):


**the young camels of Midian** Heb. בִּכְרֵי. [Jonathan renders:] הוֹגְנֵי. They are young camels. Comp. (Jer. 2:23) “a swift young camel (בִּכְרָה).”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:6:3)


**וְעֵיפָה.** גַּם הֵם מִבְּנֵי מִדְיָן, ״עֵיפָה וָעֵפֶר״ (בראשית כה:ד):


**and Ephah** They, too, are of the sons of Midian. Comp. (Gen. 25:4) “Ephah and Epher.”



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:7:1)


**אֵילֵי נְבָיוֹת.** דִּכְרֵי נְבָיוֹת:


**the rams of Nebaioth** Heb. אֵילֵי, rams of Nebaioth [after Jonathan].



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:9:1)


**בָּרִאשֹׁנָה.** כְּמוֹ ׳כְּבָרִאשׁוֹנָה׳, בִּימֵי שְׁלֹמֹה, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (מלכים א י:כב): ״כִּי אֳנִי תַרְשִׁישׁ לַמֶּלֶךְ בַּיָּם אַחַת לְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים תָּבֹא אֳנִי תַרְשִׁישׁ וְגוֹ׳״, **תַּרְשִׁישׁ** שֵׁם הַיָּם:


**as in the beginning** Like ‘as in the beginning,’ meaning in the days of Solomon, like the matter that is stated (I Kings 10:22): “For the king had at sea ships of Tarshish, etc.; once in three years, the ships of Tarshish would come, etc.” Tarshish is the name of the sea.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:9:2)


**לְשֵׁם ה׳ אֱלֹהַיִךְ.** שֶׁנִּקְרָא עָלֶיךָ, כִּי יִשְׁמְעוּ שִׁמְעוֹ וְשֵׁם גְּבוּרָתוֹ וְיָבוֹאוּ:


**in the name of the Lord your God** that is called upon you, for they will hear a report of Him and the name of His might, and come.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:9:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:9:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:9:3)


**כִּי פֵאֲרָךְ.** נָתַן לָךְ פְּאֵר:


**for He has glorified you** He has given you glory.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:10:1)


**וּבִרְצוֹנִי.** וּבְהַרְצוֹתִי לָךְ, אימונ״א פייזמנ״ט בלע״ז:


**and in my grace** Because I favored you; in old French, en mon apayemant.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:11:1)


**וּפִתְּחוּ שְׁעָרַיִךְ תָּמִיד.** לְשׁוֹן ׳פִּתּוּחַ׳, מִמִּשְׁקֹלֶת לָשׁוֹן כָּבֵד, עַל שֵׁם שֶׁפְּתִיחָתָן פְּתִיחַת עוֹלָם, פְּתִיחַת תָּמִיד; כְּמוֹ ׳שִׁבֵּר׳ מִלְּשׁוֹן ׳שְׁבִירָה׳, כָּךְ מִלְּשׁוֹן ׳פְּתִיחָה׳, טי״ש אובירט״ש בלע״ז:


**And they shall open your gates always** Heb. וּפִתְּחוּ. This is an expression of opening in the strong conjugation (פִּעֵל), since their opening is a perpetual opening, a constant opening. Just as שַׁבֵּר is an expression of breaking, so is פִּתְּחוּ an expression of opening. Tresoverts in O.F.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:13:1)


**בְּרוֹשׁ תִּדְהָר וּתְאַשּׁוּר.** מִינֵי עֲצֵי יַעַר לְבָנוֹן:


**box trees, firs, and cypresses** Species of trees of the forest of Lebanon.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:14:1)


**צִיּוֹן קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל.** ״צִיּוֹן דְּאִתְרְעִי בָהּ קַדִּישָׁא דְיִשְׂרָאֵל״ (תרגום יונתן), צִיּוֹן שֶׁל קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל:


**Zion of the Holy One of Israel** [Lit. Zion the Holy One of Israel. Jonathan renders:] Zion desired by the Holy One of Israel, Zion of the Holy One of Israel.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:16:1)


**וְשֹׁד מְלָכִים.** לְשׁוֹן ׳שָׁדַיִם׳, וְ**תִינָקִי** יוֹרֶה עָלָיו:


**and the breast of kings** Heb. וְשֹׁד, an expression of breasts (שָׁדַיִם) and ‘you shall suck’ proves it.



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:17:1)


**תַּחַת הַנְּחֹשֶׁת.** שֶׁנָּטְלוּ מִמֵּךְ:


**Instead of the copper** that they took from you.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:17:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:17:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:17:2)


**וְשַׂמְתִּי פְקֻדָּתֵךְ שָׁלוֹם.** ״וַאֲשַׁוִּי פַּרְנָסָךְ שְׁלָם וְשָׁלְטוֹנִיךְ בִּזְכוּ״ (תרגום יונתן):


**and I will make your officers peace** [Jonathan renders:] And I will make your officers peace and your rulers with righteousness.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:17:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:17:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:17:3)


**פְקֻדָּתֵךְ.** פְּקִידִים שֶׁלָּךְ, וְרַבּוֹתֵינוּ אָמְרוּ (בבא בתרא ט א): הַפְּקֻדּוֹת שֶׁבָּאוּ עָלֶיךָ בְּגָלוּתֵךְ וְהַנּוֹגְשִׂים שֶׁדְּחָקוּךְ יִהְיוּ לָךְ לְ**שָׁלוֹם** וְלִ**צְדָקָה**:


פְקֻדָּתֵךְ Your appointed officers. Our Rabbis stated: The officers who came upon you in your exile and the rulers who pressed you will be counted for you as peace and charity (Baba Bathra 9a). [That is, the money they have exacted from you will be counted as charity.]



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:19:1)


**לֹא יִהְיֶה לָּךְ עוֹד.** לֹא תִצְטָרְכִי לְאוֹר הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ:


**You shall no longer have** You shall not require the light of the sun.



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:20:1)


**לֹא יֵאָסֵף.** לְשׁוֹן ״אָסְפוּ נָגְהָם״ (יואל ב:י), הִכְנִיסוּ אוֹרָם:


**neither...be gathered in** Heb. יֵאָסֵף, an expression similar to (Joel 2:10) “gathered in (אָסְפוּ) their brightness.” Gathered in their light.



### Verse 21

###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:21:1)


**לְהִתְפָּאֵר.** שֶׁאֶהְיֶה מִתְפָּאֵר בָּם, פורוונטי״ר בלע״ז:


**in which I will glory** That I will glory with them. Pourvanter in French.



### Verse 22

###### Rashi on Isaiah 60:22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/60:22:1)


**בְּעִתָּהּ אֲחִישֶׁנָּה.** זָכוּ – אֲחִישֶׁנָּה, לֹא זָכוּ – בְּעִתָּהּ (סנהדרין צח א):


**in its time I will hasten it** If they are worthy, I will hasten it; if they are not worthy, it will be in its time.



## Chapter 61


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 61:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:1:1)


**יַעַן מָשַׁח.** אֵין מְשִׁיחָה זוֹ, אֶלָּא לְשׁוֹן שְׂרָרָה וּגְדֻלָּה:


**since the Lord anointed me** This anointing is nothing but an expression of nobility and greatness.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 61:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:1:2)


**לִקְרֹא לִשְׁבוּיִם דְּרוֹר.** כְּלוֹמַר, לְבַשֵּׂר לָהֶם בְּשׂוֹרַת הַגְּאֻלָּה:


**to declare freedom for the captives** That is to say, to bring them the tidings of the redemption.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 61:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:1:3)


**פְּקַח קוֹחַ.** פְּקַח אֶת מַלְקוֹחָם וְשִׁבְיָם וְהַתִּירֵם:


**to free from captivity** Heb. פְּקַח קוֹחַ. Open their imprisonment and their captivity and release them.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 61:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:2:1)


**שְׁנַת רָצוֹן.** שְׁנַת פִּיּוּס וְרִצּוּי:


**a year of acceptance** A year of appeasement and good will.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 61:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:3:1)


**אֵילֵי הַצֶּדֶק.** לְשׁוֹן ׳אִילָנוֹת׳, כְּמוֹ ״מֵאֵילִים אֲשֶׁר חֲמַדְתֶּם״ (ישעיהו א:ט), וּ**מַטַּע ה׳** יוֹרֶה עָלָיו:


**the elms of righteousness** Heb. אֵילֵי, an expression of trees (אִילָנוֹת). Comp. (supra 1:29) “of the elms (מֵאֵילִים) that you desired.” This is evidenced by the end of the verse, “the planting of the Lord etc.”



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 61:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:5:1)


**אִכָּרֵיכֶם.** מַנְהִיגֵי הַמַּחֲרֵשָׁה:


**your plowmen** Heb. אִכָּרֵיכֶם, those who lead the plow.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 61:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:6:1)


**כֹּהֲנֵי ה׳.** נְשִׂיאֵי הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא:


**priests of the Lord** Princes of the Holy One, blessed be He.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 61:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:6:2)


**חֵיל גּוֹיִם.** ״נִכְסֵי פָּלְחֵי כוֹכָבִיָּא״:


**the possessions of the nations** Heb. חֵיל גּוֹיִם, the possessions of the nations [after Jonathan].


###### Rashi on Isaiah 61:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:6:3)


**תִּתְיַמָּרוּ.** אַתֶּם תִּכָּנְסוּ תַּחְתֵּיהֶם בַּכָּבוֹד שֶׁנָּטְלוּ עַד הֵנָּה:


**you shall succeed [them]** Heb. תִּתְיַמָּרוּ [derived from תְּמוּרָה, exchange]. You shall enter in their stead into the glory they have taken until now.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Isaiah 61:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:7:1)


**תַּחַת בָּשְׁתְּכֶם.** שֶׁהָיָה **מִשְׁנֶה**, אַף הֵם **כְלִמָּה יָרֹנּוּ** תָּמִיד **חֶלְקָם**. כְּלוֹמַר: **תַּחַת** אֲשֶׁר עַד הֵנָּה תָּמִיד עַמִּי הָיוּ רוֹנְנִים **כְלִמָּה חֶלְקָם**. יֵשׁ רִנָּה שֶׁהוּא אֵבֶל, כְּמוֹ (איכה ב:יט) ״קוּמִי רֹנִּי בַלַּיְלָה״, וּכְמוֹ (מלכים א כב:לו) ״וַתַּעֲבֹר הָרִנָּה״ דְּאַחְאָב:


**Instead of your shame** which was twofold, even they would constantly bemoan their disgrace as their lot. That is to say that instead of until now My people were constantly bemoaning disgrace, their lot... There are instances of רִנָּה that is an expression of mourning. Comp. (Lam. 2:19) “Rise, cry (רֹנִּי) at night,” and comp. (I Kings 22:36) “A cry (הָרִנָּה) passed through the camp,” concerning Ahab’s death.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 61:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:8:1)


**כִּי אֲנִי ה׳ אֹהֵב מִשְׁפָּט שֹׂנֵא גָזֵל בְּעוֹלָה.** לְכָךְ אֵינוֹ מְקַבֵּל עוֹלוֹת הָעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמָזָלוֹת, הַשָּׂרִים וְהַשָּׂרוֹת, שֶׁכֻּלָּן גָּזֵל:


**For I am the Lord, Who loves justice, hates robbery in a burnt offering** Therefore, I do not accept burnt offerings from the heathens (the nations [Parshandatha, K’li Paz]), for they are all results of robbery.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 61:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/61:8:2)


**וְנָתַתִּי פְעֻלָּתָם.** שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁתְּהֵא **בֶּאֱמֶת**. אוֹ **וְנָתַתִּי פְעֻלָּתָם** שֶׁפָּעֲלוּ, שָׂכָר שֶׁסָּבְלוּ גִּדּוּפֵי הָעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמָזָלוֹת, הַשָּׂרִים וְהַשָּׂרוֹת עַל כְּבוֹדִי **בֶּאֱמֶת**:


**and I will give their wage** The wage of Israel, which shall be in truth. Alternatively, I will give the reward for the deeds they performed, for they suffered the derisions of the heathens (the nations [Mss. and K’li Paz]) for My honor in truth.

## Chapter 62


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 62:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/62:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/62:1:1)


**לְמַעַן צִיּוֹן.** אֶעֱשֶׂה וְ**לֹא אֶחֱשֶׁה** עַל מַה שֶּׁעָשׂוּ לָהּ:


**For the sake of Zion** I will do, and I will not be silent concerning what they did to her.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 62:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/62:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/62:1:2)


**לֹא אֶשְׁקוֹט.** לֹא יְהֵא שָׁלוֹם לְפָנַי, **עַד יֵצֵא כַנֹּגַהּ צִדְקָהּ**:


**I will not rest** There will be no peace before Me until her righteousness comes out like brilliance.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 62:4:1

### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 62:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/62:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/62:5:1)


**כִּי יִבְעַל וְגוֹ׳.** ״אֲרֵי כְּמָה דְמִתְיַתֵּב עוּלֵם עִם בְּתוּלְתָא, כֵּן יִתְיַיתְבִין בְּגַוֵּיכִי בְּנַיְיכִי״ (תרגום יונתן):

### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 62:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/62:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/62:6:1)


**עַל חוֹמֹתַיִךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַם.** רַבּוֹתֵינוּ דְּרָשׁוּהוּ כְּמַשְׁמָעוֹ: מַלְאָכִים הַמַּזְכִּירִים אֶת ה׳ עַל חֻרְבָּנָהּ לִבְנוֹתָהּ. מַאי אָמְרִי? ״אַתָּה תָקוּם תְּרַחֵם צִיּוֹן״ (תהלים קב:יד), ״כִּי בָחַר ה׳ בְּצִיּוֹן״ (תהלים קלב:יג), כִּדְאִיתָא בִּמְסֶכֶת מְנָחוֹת (מנחות פז א). וְיוֹנָתָן תִּרְגֵּם חוֹמוֹתַיִךְ: אָבוֹת הָרִאשׁוֹנִים, הַמְּגִינִים עָלֵינוּ כַּחוֹמָה:


**On your walls, O Jerusalem** Our Rabbis expounded it according to its apparent meaning as referring to the angels who remind the Lord concerning its destruction, to build it. What do they say? (Ps. 102:14) “You shall rise, You shall have mercy on Zion”; (ibid. 132:13) “For the Lord has chosen Zion.” As is found in the Tractate Menahoth (87a, Rashi ad loc.). Jonathan, [however,] renders “your walls,” the early forefathers, who protect us like a wall.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 62:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/62:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/62:6:2)


**הִפְקַדְתִּי שֹׁמְרִים.** לִכְתּוֹב סֵפֶר זִכְרוֹנוֹת שֶׁלֹּא יִשְׁתַּכַּח זְכוּתָם מִלְּפָנַי:


**I have appointed watchmen** to inscribe a book of remembrances, that their merit be not forgotten from before Me.

**they shall never be silent** not to mention their merit before Me.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 62:6:4

**הַמַּזְכִּירִים אֶת ה׳.** אֶת זְכוּת הָאָבוֹת:


**those who remind the Lord** of the merit of the forefathers.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 62:6:5

**be not silent** Heb. אַל-דֳּמִי לָכֶם, [lit. let there be no silence to you,] be not silent.

###### Rashi on Isaiah 62:10:1

**עִבְרוּ עִבְרוּ בַּשְּׁעָרִים.** ״אָמַר נְבִיָּיא: עִבְרוּ וְתוּבוּ בְּתַרְעַיָּא, אַפְנוּ לִבָּא דְעַמָּא לְאוֹרַח תַּקְנָא״ (תרגום יונתן):

###### Rashi on Isaiah 62:10:2

**סֹלּוּ סֹלּוּ הַמְסִלָּה.** כִּבְשׁוּ הַדֶּרֶךְ בטי״ץ לוקמי״ן בלע״ז. **סֹלּוּ** לְשׁוֹן ׳מְסִלָּה׳ הוּא:


**pave, pave the highway** Heb. סֹלּוּ. Pave the road, batec lokemin in O.F., beat down the road. סֹלּוּ is the same root as מְסִלָּה.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 62:10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/62:10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/62:10:3)


**סַקְּלוּ מֵאֶבֶן.** סַקְּלוּ **הַמְּסִלָּה** וְהַשְׁלִיכוּ אַבְנֵי מִכְשׁוֹל לַצְּדָדִין, **סַקְּלוּ.** אישפירייר״ן בלע״ז:


**clear it of stones** Clear the highway of stones and cast the stumbling blocks to the sides. **clear it of stones** Heb. סַקְּלוּ, espedrec in O.F., to rid of stones.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 62:10:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/62:10:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/62:10:4)


**מֵאֶבֶן.** מִהְיוֹת שָׁם אֶבֶן, וּכְנֶגֶד יֵצֶר הָרָע הוּא אוֹמֵר (תנחומא בהעלתך י), וְיֵשׁ עוֹד לְפוֹתְרוֹ עַל תִּקּוּן הַדְּרָכִים לְקִבּוּץ הַגָּלִיּוֹת:


**of stones** of there being there a stone, and he is alluding to the evil inclination. It may also be interpreted as referring to the repairs of the road for the ingathering of the exiles.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 62:10:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/62:10:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/62:10:5)


**הָרִימוּ נֵס.** כְּלוֹנָס, פורק״א בלע״ז. אוֹת הוּא שֶׁיִּקָּבְצוּ אֵלַי, וְיָבִיאוּ לִי אֶת הַגּוֹלִים אֶצְלָם:


**lift up a banner** A staff, perche in French. That is a sign, that they gather to Me and bring Me those exiled beside them [i.e., those exiled in their land].

**הִנֵּה שְׂכָרוֹ.** שֶׁמּוּכָן לָתֵת לַעֲבָדָיו מוּכָן **אִתּוֹ**:

###### Rashi on Isaiah 62:11:2
