**and His wage** [Lit. His deed.] The reward for the deed they did with Him, is before Him, prepared to give.



## Chapter 63


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:1:1)


**מִי זֶה בָּא מֵאֱדוֹם.** נִתְנַבֵּא הַנָּבִיא עַל שֶׁאָמַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא שֶׁעָתִיד לַעֲשׂוֹת נְקָמָה בֶּאֱדוֹם, וְהוּא עַצְמוֹ בִּכְבוֹדוֹ יַהֲרֹג אֶת שַׂר שֶׁלָּהֶם תְּחִלָּה, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (ישעיהו לד:ה) ״כִּי רִוְתָה בַשָּׁמַיִם חַרְבִּי״ וְאַחַר כָּךְ ״עַל אֱדוֹם תֵּרֵד״, וְנִכָּר בְּזַעַם פָּנָיו שֶׁהֲרָגָם הֶרֶג רַב. וְהַנָּבִיא מְדַבֵּר בִּלְשׁוֹן מִלְחֲמוֹת בְּנֵי אָדָם לְבוּשֵׁי בְּגָדִים, וּבְהָרְגָם הֶרֶג הַדָּם נִתָּז עַל בִּגְדֵיהֶם, כִּי כֵּן דֶּרֶךְ הַכְּתוּבִים מְדַבְּרִים בַּשְּׁכִינָה כְּדֶרֶךְ בְּנֵי אָדָם לְשַׂבֵּר אֶת הָאֹזֶן מַה שֶּׁהִיא יְכוֹלָה לִשְׁמוֹעַ, וְכֵן (יחזקאל מג:ב) ״וְקוֹלוֹ כְּקוֹל מַיִם רַבִּים״, דִּמָּה הַנָּבִיא קוֹל חָזָק שֶׁלּוֹ לְקוֹל מַיִם רַבִּים לְשַׂבֵּר אֶת הָאֹזֶן כְּדֶרֶךְ שֶׁאֶפְשָׁר לָהּ לִשְׁמוֹעַ, שֶׁאֵין לְהָבִין וּלְהַאֲזִין בְּרוּחַ גְּבוּרוֹת אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְהַשְׁמִיעָהּ כְּמוֹת שֶׁהִיא:


**Who is this coming from Edom** The prophet prophesies concerning what the Holy One, blessed be He, said that He is destined to wreak vengeance upon Edom, and He, personally, will slay their heavenly prince, like the matter that is said (supra 34:5), “For My sword has become sated in the heaven.” And afterward, (ibid.) “it shall descend upon Edom,” and it is recognizable by the wrath of His face that He has slain [them with] a great massacre, and the prophet is speaking in the expression of the wars of human beings, dressed in clothes, and when they slay a slaying, the blood spatters on their garments, for so is the custom of Scripture; it speaks of the Shechinah anthropomorphically, to convey to the ear what it can hear. Comp. (Ezek. 43:2) “His voice is like the voice of many waters.” The prophet compares His mighty voice to the voice of many waters to convey to the ear according to what it is possible to hear, for one cannot understand and hearken to the magnitude of the mighty of our God to let us hear it as it is.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:1:2)


**מִי זֶה בָּא מֵאֱדוֹם.** יִשְׂרָאֵל אוֹמֵר: **מִי זֶה וְגוֹ׳**, וּבָא **חֲמוּץ בְּגָדִים** צְבוּעִים בְּדָם, וְכָל דָּבָר שֶׁהוּא מִתְנָאֵץ בְּרֵיחוֹ וּבְמַרְאִיתוֹ נוֹפֵל בּוֹ לְשׁוֹן ׳חִמּוּץ׳:


**Who is this coming from Edom** Israel says, “Who is this, etc.?” And He is coming with soiled garments, colored with blood, and anything repugnant because of its smell and its appearance fits to the expression of חִמּוּץ, soiling.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:1:3)


**מִבָּצְרָה.** אָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ (מכות יב.): שְׁתֵּי טָעֻיּוֹת עָתִיד שַׂר שֶׁל שֵׂעִיר לִטְעוֹת, כְּסָבוּר הוּא שֶׁבָּצְרָה הִיא ״בֶּצֶר בַּמִּדְבָּר״ (דברים ד:מג) שֶׁהָיְתָה עִיר מִקְלָט, וְטוֹעֶה, מִשּׁוּם שֶׁאֵין קוֹלֶטֶת אֶלָּא שׁוֹגֵג וְהוּא הָרַג אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵזִיד. וְעוֹד יֵשׁ מִדְרַשׁ אַגָּדָה (בראשית רבה פג ג), עַל שֶׁהִסְפִּיקָה בָּצְרָה מֶלֶךְ לְשֵׂעִיר בְּמוֹת מַלְכָּהּ הָרִאשׁוֹן ״וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו יוֹבָב בֶּן זֶרַח מִבָּצְרָה״ (בראשית לו:לג), וּבָצְרָה מִמּוֹאָב הִיא, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״עַל קְרִיּוֹת וְעַל בָּצְרָה״ (ירמיהו מח:כד):


**from Bozrah** Our Rabbis said (see Makkoth 12a): “The heavenly prince of Edom is destined to commit two errors. He thinks that Bozrah is identical with Bezer in the desert, which was a refuge city. He will also err insofar as it affords refuge only for inadvertent murder, but he killed Israel intentionally.” There is also an Aggadic midrash (see above 34:6) that because Bozrah supplied a king for Edom when its first king died, as in Gen. (36:33), “And Jobab the son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his stead,” and Bozrah is of Moab, according to the matter that is stated (Jer. 48:24): “Upon Kerioth and upon Bozrah.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:1:4)


**זֶה.** (שֶׁהָיָה) **הָדוּר בִּלְבוּשׁוֹ** וְ**צֹעֶה** וְנֶאֱזָר **בְּרֹב כֹּחוֹ**, וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא מְשִׁיבוֹ: אֲנִי הוּא שֶׁעָלְתָה לְפָנַי לְדַבֵּר בְּצִדְקַת הָאָבוֹת וּבְצִדְקַת דּוֹרוֹ שֶׁל צָרָה, וְצִדְקָתִי גַּם הִיא עִמָּהֶם, וְנִגְלֵיתִי לִהְיוֹת רַב לְהוֹשִׁיעַ. וְהֵם אוֹמְרִים: **מַדּוּעַ אָדֹם לִלְבוּשֶׁךָ**? מַדּוּעַ בְּגָדֶיךָ אֲדוּמִים?


**this one** who was stately in His attire, צֹעֶה, and girded with the greatness of His strength. And the Holy One, blessed be He, replies to him, ‘It is I, upon Whom the time has come to speak of the righteousness of the Patriarchs, and of the righteousness of the generation of religious persecution, and My righteousness, too, is with them, and I have revealed Myself as being great to save.’ And they say, ‘Why is your clothing red? Why are your garments red?’



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:3:1)


**וּמֵעַמִּים אֵין אִישׁ אִתִּי.** מִתְיַצֵּב לְפָנַי לְהִלָּחֵם:


**and from the peoples, none was with Me** standing before Me to wage war.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:3:2)


**וְיֵז נִצְחָם.** דָּמָם, שֶׁהוּא תָּקְפּוֹ וְנִצְחוֹנוֹ שֶׁל אָדָם:


**and their lifeblood sprinkled** Heb. נִצְחָם, Their blood, which is the strength and victory (נִצָּחוֹן) of a man.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:3:3)


**אֶגְאָלְתִּי.** כְּמוֹ ״נִגְאֲלוּ בְדָם״ (איכה ד:יד):


**I soiled** Heb. אֶגְאָלְתִּי. Comp. (Lam. 4:14) “They were defiled (נִגֹּאֲלוּ) with blood.”



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:5:1)


**וָאַבִּיט וְאֵין עֹזֵר** לְיִשְׂרָאֵל:


**And I looked, and there was no one helping** Israel.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:5:2)


**וְאֶשְׁתּוֹמֵם.** לְשׁוֹן ׳שְׁתִיקָה׳, וּכְבָר פֵּרַשְׁתִּי לְמַעְלָה ״וַיִּשְׁתּוֹמֵם כִּי אֵין מַפְגִּיעַ״ (ישעיהו נט:טז):


**and I was astounded** An expression of keeping silent, and I have already explained it above (57:16): “And He was astounded for there was no intercessor.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:5:3)


**וַחֲמָתִי הִיא סְמָכָתְנִי.** חֲמָתִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לִי עַל הָאֻמּוֹת, אֲשֶׁר ״אֲנִי קָצַפְתִּי מְעַט״ עַל עַמִּי ״וְהֵמָּה עָזְרוּ לְרָעָה״ (זכריה א:טו), הִיא סְמָכָתְנִי – חִזְּקָה יָדִי וְעוֹרְרָה אֶת לִבִּי לִפָּרַע מֵהֶם, וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֵין יִשְׂרָאֵל רְאוּיִין וַהֲגוּנִים לִגְאֻלָּה:


**and My fury that supported Me** My fury that I have against the heathens (the nations [mss. and K’li Paz]), for I was a little wrath with My people, and they helped to harm them. That strengthened My hand and aroused My heart to mete recompense upon them although Israel is not fit and worthy of redemption.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:6:1)


**וְאָבוּס.** לְשׁוֹן מִתְגּוֹלֵל בְּדָם וְדוֹרֵךְ בָּרַגְלַיִם, כְּמוֹ ״מִתְבּוֹסֶסֶת בְּדָמָיִךְ״ (יחזקאל טז:ו), וּכְמוֹ ״בֹּסְסוּ אֶת חֶלְקָתִי״ (ירמיהו יב:י):


**And I trod** Heb. וְאָבוּס. An expression of wallowing in blood and treading with the feet. Comp. (Ezekiel 16:6) “wallowing (מִתְבּוֹסֶסֶת) in your blood.” Comp. also (Jer. 12:10): “They trod (בֹּסְסוּ) My field.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:6:2)


**נִצְחָם.** גְּבוּרַת נִצְחוֹנָם:


**their power** Heb. נִצְחָם, the might of their victory.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:7:1)


**חַסְדֵי ה׳ אַזְכִּיר.** הַנָּבִיא אָמַר: אַזְכִּיר אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת חַסְדֵי ה׳:


**The kind acts of the Lord I will mention** The prophet says, I will remind Israel of the kind acts of the Lord.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:7:2)


**וְרַב טוּב. אַזְכִּיר אֲשֶׁר** גָּמַל **לְבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל** בְּ**רַחֲמָיו**:


**and much good** I will remind Israel of what He bestowed upon the house of Israel with His mercies.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:8:1)


**אַךְ עַמִּי הֵמָּה.** אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁגָּלוּי לְפָנַי שֶׁיִּבְגְּדוּ בִּי, מִכָּל מָקוֹם עַמִּי הֵם, וַהֲרֵי הֵם לְפָנַי כְּ**בָנִים** אֲשֶׁר **לֹא יְשַׁקֵּרוּ**:


**They are but My people** Although it is revealed before Me that they would betray Me, they are, nevertheless, My people, and they are to Me like children who will not deal falsely.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:9:1)


**בְּכָל צָרָתָם.** שֶׁהֵבִיא עֲלֵיהֶם:


**In all their trouble** that He would bring upon them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:9:2)


**לֹא צָר.** לֹא הֵצֵר לָהֶם כְּפִי מַעַלְלֵיהֶם שֶׁהָיוּ רְאוּיִין לִלְקוֹת, כִּי **מַלְאַךְ פָּנָיו** הוּא מִיכָאֵל שַׂר הַפָּנִים, מִמְּשַׁמְּשִׁים לְפָנָיו **הוֹשִׁיעָם** תָּמִיד בִּשְׁלִיחוּתוֹ שֶׁל מָקוֹם:


**He did not trouble [them]** He did not trouble them according to their deeds, that they deserved to suffer, for the angel of His presencei.e., Michael the prince of the Presence, of those who minister before Him saved them always as an agent of the Omnipresent.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:10:1)


**וְהֵמָּה מָרוּ.** הִקְנִיטוּ, כְּמוֹ ״מַמְרִים הֱיִיתֶם״ (דברים ט:ז):


**But they rebelled** Heb. מָרוּ. They angered. Comp. (Deut. 9:7) “You were rebellious (מַמְרִים).”



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:11:1)


**וַיִּזְכֹּר יְמֵי עוֹלָם מֹשֶׁה עַמּוֹ.** הַנָּבִיא מִתְאוֹנֵן וְאוֹמֵר בְּלָשׁוֹן תְּחִנָּה: הַיּוֹם בַּגּוֹלָה, זוֹכֵר עַמּוֹ אֶת יְמֵי עוֹלָם, אֶת יְמֵי מֹשֶׁה, וּבְצָרָתוֹ הוּא אוֹמֵר: **אַיֵּה** מֹשֶׁה רוֹעֵנוּ הַמַּעֲלֵנוּ **מִיַּם** סוּף:


**And His people remembered the days of old, [the days of] Moses** The prophet laments and says in an expression of supplication, Today in exile, His people remembers the days of old, the days of Moses, and in its trouble, it says, Where is Moses our shepherd, who drew us up from the Reed Sea?


###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:11:2)


**אֶת רֹעֵי צֹאנוֹ.** דִּמְיוֹן רוֹעֶה הַמַּעֲלֶה אֶת צֹאנוֹ, **אַיֵּה** הוּא אֲשֶׁר **שָׂם** בְּקֶרֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל **אֶת רוּחַ קָדְשׁוֹ** שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, וְלִמְּדָנוּ חֻקִּים וּמִשְׁפָּטִים:


**[like] a shepherd his flock** Compared to a shepherd who brings up his flock. Where is he who placed within Israel the Holy Spirit of the Holy One, blessed be He, and taught us statutes and ordinances?



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:12:1)


**מוֹלִיךְ לִימִין מֹשֶׁה זְרוֹעַ תִּפְאַרְתּוֹ.** הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא הָיָה מוֹלִיךְ לִימִין מֹשֶׁה אֶת זְרוֹעַ גְּבוּרָתוֹ; בְּכָל עֵת שֶׁהָיָה צָרִיךְ לְעֶזְרָתוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, הָיָה זְרוֹעוֹ מוּכָן לִימִינוֹ:


**He led at Moses’ right the arm of His glory** The Holy One, blessed be He, led at Moses’ right the arm of His might. Every time he required the aid of the Holy One, blessed be He, His arm was ready at his right.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:13:1)


**כַּסּוּס בַּמִּדְבָּר.** שֶׁאֵינוֹ נִכְשָׁל, לְפִי שֶׁהִיא אֶרֶץ חֲלָקָה, כֵּן לֹא נִכְשְׁלוּ בַּתְּהוֹם:


**like a horse in the desert** which does not stumble since it is smooth land, so they did not stumble in the deep.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:14:1)


**כַּבְּהֵמָה.** אֲשֶׁר **בַּבִּקְעָה תֵרֵד**, וּבִקְעָה הִיא אֶרֶץ חֲלָקָה וְאֵין בָּהּ מִכְשׁוֹל, קנפניי״א בלע״ז:


**As animals** that spread in the valley, and a valley is a smooth land, where there is no obstacle, campagne in French, open country.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:14:2)


**תֵרֵד.** תִּתְפַּשֵּׁט, כְּמוֹ ״לְרַד לְפָנָיו גּוֹיִם״ (ישעיהו מה:), כֵּן **רוּחַ ה׳ תְּנִיחֶנּוּ** לַתְּהוֹם, וְעָשָׂה בּוֹ דֶּרֶךְ כְּבוּשָׁה:


**spread out** Heb. תֵרֵד, spread out. Comp. (supra 45:1) “to flatten (לְרַד) nations before him.” So did the spirit of the Lord guide them to the deep and make therein a paved road.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:14:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:14:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:14:3)


**כֵּן נִהַגְתָּ עַמְּךָ.** כֵּן הָיָה הַכֹּל כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמַרְנוּ, נִהַגְתָּ עַמְּךָ:


**so You guided Your people** So was everything as we said; You guided Your people.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:15:1)


**אַיֵּה קִנְאָתְךָ.** הָרִאשׁוֹנָה:


**where are Your zeal** Your early zeal.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:15:2)


**הֲמוֹן מֵעֶיךָ.** שֶׁהָיוּ רְגִילִים לְהָמוֹת עָלֵינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר מֵאָז, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (ירמיהו לא:כ) ״עַל כֵּן הָמוּ מֵעַי לוֹ״, וַהֲמוֹן **רַחֲמֶיךָ** הָרִאשׁוֹנִים אֵלֵינוּ עַתָּה **הִתְאַפָּקוּ**, נִתְחַסְּנוּ מִהְיוֹת הוֹמִים עָלֵינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר מֵאָז:


**the yearning of Your heart** [Lit. the stirring of Your innards,] that were wont to stir concerning us, like the matter that was stated (Jer. 31:19), “Therefore, My heart yearns for him.” And the stirring of your first mercies toward us have been restrained now. They have been restrained from stirring over us as from then.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:15:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:15:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:15:3)


**הִתְאַפָּקוּ.** כְּמוֹ ״וַיִּתְאַפַּק וַיֹּאמֶר שִׂימוּ לָחֶם״ (בראשית מג:לא), נִתְאַפַּק, וְלֹא הִכִּירוּ אֶת אֲשֶׁר נִכְמְרוּ רַחֲמָיו אֶל אָחִיו:


**are restrained** Heb. הִתְאַפָּקוּ. Comp. (Gen. 43:31) “And he restrained himself and said, Put down food.” He restrained himself, and they did not recognize that his mercies were stirred toward his brother.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:16:1)


**כִּי אַתָּה אָבִינוּ.** וְעָלֶיךָ לְהַבִּיט וְלִרְאוֹת בְּצָרוֹתֵינוּ:


**For You are our father** and it is incumbent upon You to look and see our troubles.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:16:2)


**כִּי אַבְרָהָם לֹא יְדָעָנוּ.** בְּצָרַת מִצְרָיִם:


**for Abraham did not know us** in the trouble of Egypt.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:16:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:16:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:16:3)


**וְיִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יַכִּירָנוּ** בַּמִּדְבָּר, כִּי כְּבָר נִסְתַּלְּקוּ מִן הָעוֹלָם:


**neither did Israel recognize us** in the desert, for they had already passed away from the world.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:16:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:16:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:16:4)


**וְאַתָּה ה׳ אָבִינוּ.** בְּכֻלָּם נַעֲשֵׂיתָ לָנוּ אָב, וְרַבּוֹתֵינוּ דָּרְשׁוּ בּוֹ כְּמוֹ שֶׁדָּרְשׁוּ בְּמַסֶּכֶת שַׁבָּת (שבת פט ב):


**but You, O Lord, are our father** In all of them, You became our father. And our Rabbis expounded this as they expounded in Tractate Shabbath (89b).



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:17:1)


**לָמָּה תַתְעֵנוּ.** כִּי בְּיָדְךָ לְהָסִיר יֵצֶר הָרָע, כְּמָה שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״כַּחֹמֶר בְּיַד הַיּוֹצֵר וְגוֹ׳״ (ירמיהו יח:ו), וְאוֹמֵר ״וַהֲסִרֹתִי אֶת לֵב הָאֶבֶן וְגוֹ׳״ (יחזקאל לו:כו):


**Why do You lead us astray** Since You have the power to remove the evil inclination, as it is said (Jer. 18:6): “Like clay in the potter’s hand.” Scripture states elsewhere (Ezekiel 36:26): “And I will remove the heart of stone, etc.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:17:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:17:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:17:2)


**תַּקְשִׁיחַ.** לְשׁוֹן אִמּוּץ לֵב:


**You harden** Heb. תַּקְשִׁיחַ, an expression of hardening the heart.



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:18:1)


**לַמִּצְעָר יָרְשׁוּ עַם קָדְשֶׁךָ.** גְּדֻלָּתָם וִירֻשָּׁתָם זְמַן מוּעָט הָיְתָה לָהֶם:


**For [but] a short time, Your holy people inherited** They had their greatness and their inheritance for a short time.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:18:2

**בּוֹסְסוּ.** ״דּוֹשְׁשׁוּ״:


**trampled** [The term בוססו denotes] trampled underfoot.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:19:1)


**הָיִינוּ.** עַתָּה כְּעַם אֲשֶׁר **לֹא** בָּחַרְתָּ לִמְשׁוֹל **בָּם מֵעוֹלָם**, וּכְאִלּוּ **לֹא נִקְרָא שִׁמְךָ עֲלֵיהֶם**:


**We were** now like a people whom You did not choose ever to rule over them, and it is as though Your name was not called upon them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 63:19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/63:19:2)


**לוּא קָרַעְתָּ שָׁמַיִם.** וְיָרַדְתָּ לְהַצִּילֵנוּ עַתָּה, כַּאֲשֶׁר יָרַדְתָּ לְהַצִּיל מִיַּד מִצְרַיִם, אָז **מִפָּנֶיךָ הָרִים נָזֹלּוּ** בְּרֶתֶת וְזִיעַ:


**had You rent the heavens** and descended to save us now as You descended to save us from the hand of the Egyptians, then, mountains would drip from before You with fear and quaking.



## Chapter 64


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 64:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:1:1)


**כִּקְדֹחַ אֵשׁ.** אֶת דָּבָר הַנָּמֵס מִלְּפָנָיו, וְכַאֲשֶׁר הַ**מַּיִם תִּבְעֶה הָאֵשׁ** – כְּשֶׁתִּתֵּן גַּחֶלֶת אוֹ מַתֶּכֶת בַּמַּיִם יַעֲלוּ הַמַּיִם אֲבַעְבּוּעוֹת. כָּל זֶה עָשִׂיתָ בְּמִצְרַיִם, ״וַיְהִי בָרָד וְאֵשׁ מִתְלַקַּחַת בְּתוֹכָהּ״ (שמות ט:כד). אֲבָל יוֹנָתָן תִּרְגֵּם ״כִּקְדוֹחַ אֵשׁ הֲמָסִים״ עַל אֵלִיָּהוּ בְּהַר הַכַּרְמֶל, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר בּוֹ ״גַּם הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר בַּתְּעָלָה לִחֵכָה״ (מלכים א יח:לח):


**As fire burns** something that melts because of it, and as fire causes water to bubble; when you put a coal or glowing metal into water, the water bubbles. All this You did in Egypt, as it is written (Ex. 9: 24): “And there was hail, and fire burning in the midst of the hail.” Jonathan, however, renders: “As fire burned materials that melt,” in reference to Elijah on Mount Carmel, concerning whom it is stated (I Kings 18:38): “and the water which was in the trench, it licked up.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 64:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:1:2)


**לְהוֹדִיעַ שִׁמְךָ לְצָרֶיךָ.** כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר בְּאוֹתָהּ מַכָּה ״וְאוּלָם בַּעֲבוּר זֹאת הֶעֱמַדְתִּיךָ וְגוֹ׳״ (שמות ט:טז), לוּ עָשִׂיתָ עַתָּה כֵּן, אָז **מִפָּנֶיךָ גּוֹיִם יִרְגָּזוּ**:


**to make Your name known to Your adversaries** like the matter that is stated concerning that plague (Ex. 9:16): “But, because of this I preserved You, [in order to show you My strength, and in order to tell of My name throughout the entire land.]” Had You done this now, then nations would quake from before You.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 64:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:2:1)


**בַּעֲשׂוֹתְךָ.** בְּמִצְרַיִם וּבְכָל הָאוֹיְבִים **נוֹרָאוֹת**, אֲשֶׁר **לֹא** הָיִינוּ מְקַוִּים שֶׁתַּעֲשֶׂה לָנוּ כָּל אוֹתָן **נוֹרָאוֹת**, שֶׁלֹּא הָיִינוּ הֲגוּנִים לְכָךְ:


**When You performed** against the Egyptians and against all the adversaries awesome deeds, that we did not hope You would perform all those awesome deeds, for we were unworthy of them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 64:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:2:2)


**יָרַדְתָּ.** לְהַר סִינַי, אָז **מִפָּנֶיךָ הָרִים נָזֹלּוּ**. כָּךְ פֵּרֵשׁ דּוֹנַשׁ בֶּן לַבְרַט:


**You descended** to Mount Sinai, then mountains dripped from before You. In this manner, Dunash son of Labrat explained it.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 64:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:3:1)


**וּמֵעוֹלָם לֹא שָׁמְעוּ.** כְּאוֹתָן נוֹרָאוֹת שֶׁנַּעֲשׂוֹת לְאַחַת מִכָּל הָעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת לְפָנֵי כֵּן, וְגַם **עַיִן לֹא רָאָתָה אֱלֹהִים** אַחֵר **זוּלָתְךָ** אֲשֶׁר **יַעֲשֶׂה** הָאֱלֹהִים **לִמְחַכֵּה לוֹ.** מַה שֶּׁעָשִׂיתָ אַתָּה לִמְחַכֵּה לְךָ. כָּךְ שָׁמַעְתִּי מֵרַבִּי יוֹסֵי וְהַנָּאַנִי. אֲבָל רַבּוֹתֵינוּ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (ברכות לד א): ״כָּל הַנְּבִיאִים כֻּלָּם לֹא נִתְנַבְּאוּ אֶלָּא לִימוֹת הַמָּשִׁיחַ, אֲבָל לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא עַיִן לֹא רָאָתָה וְגוֹ׳״ – מַשְׁמָעוֹ: **עַיִן** שׁוּם נָבִיא **לֹא רָאָתָה** אֶת אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לִמְחַכֵּה לוֹ זוּלָתִי עֵינֶיךָ, אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים:


**And whereof no one had ever heard** like those awesome deeds performed for one of all the nations before that, and no eye had ever seen another god besides You, that the god would do for him who hoped for him what You did for him who hoped for You. I heard this from Rabbi Jose, and it pleased me. ([Manuscripts yield:] **And whereof no one had ever heard** like those awesome deeds performed for one of all the nations before that, neither had an eye seen God, besides your eyes, what He would do for one who hoped for Him. Another explanation is: **No eye had seen** that a god besides You should perform miracles for him who hoped for him, as You do for those who hope for You. From Rabbi Joseph I heard this. Our Rabbis, however, who stated (Ber. 34a): “None of the prophets prophesied except regarding the Messianic era, but the World to Come, ‘no eye saw etc.,’” expounded its meaning in the following manner: No prophet’s eye saw what the Holy One, blessed be He, will do for him who hopes for Him except Your eyes, You, O God.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 64:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:4:1)


**פָּגַעְתָּ אֶת שָׂשׂ וְעֹשֵׂה צֶדֶק.** כְּמוֹ ״וַיִּפְגַּע בּוֹ וַיָּמֹת״ (מלכים א ב:כה), סִלַּקְתָּ מִמֶּנּוּ וְהָרַגְתָּ אֶת הַצַּדִּיקִים שֶׁהָיוּ שָׂשִׂים לַעֲשׂוֹת צֶדֶק, לְדַרְכֵי רַחֲמֶיךָ הָיוּ מַזְכִּירִים אוֹתְךָ בִּתְפִלָּתָם:


**You smote him who rejoiced and worked righteousness** Heb. פָּגַעְתָּ. Comp. (I Kings 2:34) “and he fell (וַיִּפְגַּע) upon him and slew him.” You removed from us and slew the righteous, who would rejoice to work righteousness, and with the ways of Your mercies, they would mention You in their prayer.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 64:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:4:2)


**הֵן אַתָּה.** כְּשֶׁ**קָּצַפְתָּ** עָלֵינוּ עַל כָּל אֲשֶׁר הָיִינוּ חוֹטְאִים, **בָּהֶם** מֵ**עוֹלָם** נוֹשַׁעְנוּ בִּתְפִלָּתָם, נוֹשַׁעְנוּ מֵ**עוֹלָם**:


**behold,...You** When You became wroth with us for all that we would sin. **through them** of old we were saved; with their prayer. [Rashi according to Parshandatha; Printed editions are erroneous.]


###### Rashi on Isaiah 64:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:4:3)


**וְנִוָּשֵׁעַ.** לְשׁוֹן הוֹוֶה:


**we would be saved** A present tense [i.e., a continual procedure.]



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 64:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:5:1)


**וַנְּהִי כַטָּמֵא.** מֵאַחַר שֶׁנִּסְתַּלְּקוּ הַצַּדִּיקִים מִמֶּנּוּ:


**And we all have become like one unclean** since the righteous have departed from us.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 64:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:5:2)


**וּכְבֶגֶד עִדִּים.** וְכִלְבוּשׁ מְרֻחָק, כְּבֶגֶד מָאוּס שֶׁהַכֹּל אוֹמְרִים: ״הָסֵר״. **עִדִּים** תַּרְגּוּם שֶׁל ׳הֲסָרָה׳:


**and like a discarded garment** Heb. עַדִּים. [Jonathan renders:] and like a discarded garment, like a rejected garment, which all say, ‘Remove.’ עִדִּים is the Aramaic translation of removal.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 64:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:5:3)


**וַנָּבֶל כֶּעָלֶה.** וְנִכְמוֹשׁ כְּעָלֶה, פליישט״ר בלע״ז:


**and we...have withered like a leaf** Heb. וַנָּבֶל, and we have withered like a leaf; fletrire in French.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 64:5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:5:4)


**וַעֲוֺנֵנוּ כָּרוּחַ יִשָּׂאֻנוּ.** ״וּבְחוֹבָנָא כְּרוּחָא אִיתְנְטִילְנָא״ (תרגום יונתן):


**and our iniquities carry us away like the wind** [Jonathan renders:] And with our sins we were carried away like the wind.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 64:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:6:1)


**מִתְעוֹרֵר.** כְּמוֹ מִתְגַּבֵּר עַל יִצְרוֹ:


**arouses himself** Like ‘overpowers his temptation.’


###### Rashi on Isaiah 64:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:6:2)


**וַתְּמוּגֵנוּ.** וַתְּנִיעֵנוּ:


**and You caused us to wander** Heb. וַתְּמוּגֵנוּ, You caused us to wander.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 64:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/64:11:1)


**תֶּחֱשֶׁה וּתְעַנֵּנוּ.** תַּחֲרִישׁ עַל הֶעָשׂוּי לָנוּ. עַד כָּאן תְּפִלַּת הַנָּבִיא, וּתְחִלָּתָהּ ״חַסְדֵי ה׳ אַזְכִּיר״ (ישעיהו סג:ז):


**will You remain silent and afflict us** Will You remain silent concerning what is done to us? Until here is the prophet’s prayer. Its beginning is (supra 63:7) “The kind acts of the Lord I will mention.”



## Chapter 65


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:1:1)


**נִדְרַשְׁתִּי לְלֹא שָׁאָלוּ.** הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא מְשִׁיבוֹ: אִי אֶפְשָׁר שֶׁלֹּא לְהִנָּקֵם מֵהֶם, כִּי נִדְרַשְׁתִּי מֵהֶם לְהוֹכִיחָם עַל יְדֵי נְבִיאַי, וְהֵם לֹא הָיוּ שׁוֹאֲלִים:


**I allowed Myself to be sought by those who did not ask** The Holy One, blessed be He, replies to him, It is impossible not to avenge Myself on them, for I allowed Myself to be sought by them by reproving them through My prophets, but they did not ask.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:1:2)


**אָמַרְתִּי הִנֵּנִי הִנֵּנִי.** שׁוּבוּ אֵלַי, וְהִנְנִי מוּכָן לְקַבֵּל:


**I said, “Here I am; here I am!”** Return to Me, and I am ready to accept you.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:1:3)


**אֶל גּוֹי לֹא קֹרָא בִשְׁמִי.** אֲשֶׁר לֹא הָיָה חָפֵץ לִהְיוֹת נִקְרָא עַל שְׁמִי:


**to a nation not called by My name** That did not wish to be called by My name.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:2:1)


**פֵּרַשְׂתִּי יָדַי.** כְּדֵי לְקַבְּלָם בִּתְשׁוּבָה:


**I spread out My hands** in order to accept them with repentance.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:2:2)


**סוֹרֵר.** סָר מִן הַדֶּרֶךְ:


**contrary** Heb. סוֹרֵר, turning away from the road.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:3:1)


**זֹבְחִים בַּגַּנּוֹת.** מַעֲמִידִים עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה בְּגִנּוֹתֵיהֶן, וְשָׁם מְקַטְּרִין בְּשָׂמִים עַל הַלְּבֵנִים:


**those who sacrifice in gardens** They erect idols in their gardens, and there they burn incense on the bricks.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:4:1)


**הַיֹּשְׁבִים בַּקְּבָרִים.** שֶׁתִּשְׁרֶה עֲלֵיהֶם רוּחַ טֻמְאָה שֶׁל שֵׁדִים (סנהדרין סד ב):


**They sit among the graves** so that a spirit of defilement of demons should rest upon them.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:4:2)


**וּבַנְּצוּרִים.** הֵם פִּגְרֵי הַמֵּתִים, שֶׁהֵם כִּנְתוּנִים בְּמָצוֹר, שֶׁאֵינָם יְכוֹלִים לָצֵאת:


**and with corpses** Heb. וּבַנְּצוּרִים. They are the bodies of the dead, who are as placed in a siege (מָצוֹר), unable to get out.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:4:3)


**וּמְרַק פִּגֻּלִים.** רֹטֶב נִתְעָב, כְּמוֹ ״וְאֶת הַמָּרָק שְׁפֹךְ״ (שופטים ו:כ):


**and broth of abominations** Heb. מְרַק, despicable broth. Comp. (Jud. 6:20) “And the broth (הַמָּרָק) pour out.”



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:5:1)


**הָאֹמְרִים.** אֶל הַצַּדִּיקִים **קְרַב אֵלֶיךָ**, עֲמוֹד בְּעַצְמְךָ וְ**אַל תִּגַּשׁ בִּי**:


**Those who say** to the righteous, קְרַב אֵלֶיךָ, “Keep to yourself and do not come near me.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:5:2)


**כִּי קְדַשְׁתִּיךָ.** כִּי קָדַשְׁתִּי וְטָהַרְתִּי יוֹתֵר מִמְּךָ; כֵּן תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן:


**for I am holier than you** Heb. כִּי קְדַשְׁתִּיךָ. For I am holier and purer than you. In this manner Jonathan renders.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:5:3)


**אֵלֶּה.** הַתּוֹעֵבָה אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ, הִנֵּה לְ**עָשָׁן** חֵמָה **בְּאַפִּי**:


**these** abominations that they committed are as smoke, wrath in My nostrils.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:6:1)


**הִנֵּה כְתוּבָה.** חַטָּאתָם **לְפָנַי**, כְּבָר נִגְזַר דִּינָם וְנֶחְתַּם:


**Behold it is inscribed** Their sin is inscribed before Me, and their sentence has already been decreed and sealed.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:7:1)


**עֲוֺנֹתֵיכֶם.** שֶׁלָּכֶם וְשֶׁל **אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם יַחְדָּיו** אֲשַׁלֵּם לָכֶם:


**Your iniquities** Yours and your forefathers’ together I will recompense you.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:8:1)


**כַּאֲשֶׁר יִמָּצֵא הַתִּירוֹשׁ בָּאֶשְׁכּוֹל.** תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן: ״כְּמָה דְאִשְׁתְּכַח נֹחַ זַכַּאי בְּדָרָא דְטוֹפָנָא״:


**As when wine is found in the cluster** Jonathan renders: As Noah was found innocent in the generation of the Flood.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:8:2)


**הַתִּירוֹשׁ.** זֶה נֹחַ, שֶׁהָיָה מָתוֹק:


**the wine** This is Noah, who was sweet.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:8:3)


**בָּאֶשְׁכּוֹל.** בַּדּוֹר הַמְשֻׁכָּל, וְיֵשׁ לִפְתּוֹר כְּמַשְׁמָעוֹ:


**in the cluster** Heb. בָּאֶשְׁכּוֹל. In the bereft (הַמְשֻׁכָּל) generation. This may also be interpreted according to its apparent meaning.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:8:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:8:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:8:4)


**לְמַעַן עֲבָדַי.** לְמַעַן כָּל צַדִּיק וְצַדִּיק הַנִּמְצָא בָּם:


**for the sake of My servants** For the sake of every righteous man found among them.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:10:1)


**הַשָּׁרוֹן.** שֵׁם מָחוֹז שֶׁהָיָה בְּאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל:


**the Sharon** The name of a region in the land of Israel.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:10:2)


**וְעֵמֶק עָכוֹר.** כְּמַשְׁמָעוֹ:


**and the Valley of Achor** As its apparent meaning.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:11:1)


**עֹזְבֵי ה׳.** רִשְׁעֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, שֶׁהֶחֱזִיקוּ בַּעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה, וּמֵתוּ בְּרִשְׁעָם:


**who forsake the Lord** The wicked of Israel who adopted paganism and died in their wickedness.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:11:2)


**הָעֹרְכִים לַגַּד.** שֵׁם עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה הָעֲשׂוּיָה עַל שֵׁם הַמַּזָּל, וּבִלְשׁוֹן מִשְׁנָה יֵשׁ (שבת סז ב): ״גָּד גַּדִּי וְסִינוּק לָא״:


**who set a table for Gad** The name of a pagan deity on the name of the zodiac, and in the language of the mishnah, (Shabbath 67b) “May my fate be lucky (גָד גַּדִּי) and not fatigued.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:11:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:11:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:11:3)


**לַמְנִי.** לְמִנְיַן חֶשְׁבּוֹן הַכּוֹמְרִים הָיוּ מְמַלְאִים אֲגָנוֹת מֶזֶג יַיִן:


**for a number** Heb. לַמְנִי . According to the number of the computation of the priests, they would fill basins of mingled wine.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:11:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:11:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:11:4)


**מִמְסָךְ.** יַיִן מָזוּג בְּמַיִם כְּמִשְׁפָּטוֹ, כְּמוֹ ״לַחְקֹר מִמְסָךְ״ (משלי כג:ל), ״מָסְכָה יֵינָהּ״ (משלי ט:ב). וְיֵשׁ פּוֹתְרִים **לַמְנִי** לַעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה שֶׁמִּנִּיתֶם עֲלֵיכֶם, אֲבָל **וּמָנִיתִי אֶתְכֶם** שֶׁלֹּא נָקוּד **וּמִנִּיתִי** דָּגֵשׁ, יוֹרֶה שֶׁהוּא לְשׁוֹן ׳מִנְיָן׳:


**mingled wine** Heb. מִמְסָךְ, wine mingled with water as was customary. Comp. (Prov. 23:30) “To search for mingled wine (מִמְסָךְ).” Also (ibid. 9:2), “She mingled (מָסְכָה) her wine.” Some interpret לַמְנִי, to the pagan deities that you appointed (מִנִּיתֶם) over yourselves, but וּמָנִיתִי אֶתְכֶם, which is not punctuated וּמִנִּיתִי with a ‘dagesh,’ indicates that it is an expression of counting.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:13:1)


**עֲבָדַי.** הַצַּדִּיקִים (שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל):


**My servants** The righteous [of Israel].


###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:13:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:13:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:13:2)


**וְאַתֶּם.** הַפּוֹשְׁעִים בִּי:


**but you** who rebel against Me.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:15:1)


**שִׁמְכֶם לִשְׁבוּעָה.** לוֹקֵחַ מִשִּׁמְכֶם קְלָלָה וּשְׁבוּעָה לְדוֹרוֹת: ״אִם לֹא יִקְרֵנוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר אֵרַע לִפְלוֹנִי״ (ספרי דברים יח):


**your name for an oath** From your name shall be taken a curse and an oath for generations, “If it does not befall me as it befell So-and-so.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:15:2)


**וֶהֱמִיתְךָ.** מִיתַת עוֹלָם:


**and...shall slay you** an eternal death.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:15:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:15:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:15:3)


**וְלַעֲבָדָיו יִקְרָא שֵׁם אַחֵר.** שֵׁם טוֹב וְזֵכֶר לִבְרָכָה:


**but to His servants He shall call another name** A good name and a mention for a blessing.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:16:1)


**אֲשֶׁר הַמִּתְבָּרֵךְ בָּאָרֶץ.** כִּי תִהְיֶה יִרְאָתִי עַל כֻּלָּם, ״וּמָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ דֵּעָה״ (ישעיהו יא:ט), וְהַמִּתְהַלֵּל וּמִשְׁתַּבֵּחַ בָּאָרֶץ **יִתְבָּרֵךְ בֵּאלֹהֵי אָמֵן**, יִתְהַלֵּל שֶׁהוּא עֶבֶד לֵאלֹהֵי אָמֵן, אֱלֹהֵי הָאֱמֶת, שֶׁאִמֵּן וְשָׁמַר הַבְטָחָתוֹ זֹאת:


**For whoever blesses himself on the earth** For My fear shall be over all of them, and the earth shall be full of knowledge, and whoever praises himself or lauds himself on the earth, will bless himself by the true God, he will praise himself that he is a servant of the true God, the God of truth, Who realized and observed this, His promise.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:16:2)


**כִּי נִשְׁכְּחוּ הַצָּרוֹת.** לְכָךְ יִקְרָאוּנִי **אֱלֹהֵי אָמֵן**:


**for the first troubles have been forgotten** Therefore, they shall call Me the true God.



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:17:1)


**שָׁמַיִם חֲדָשִׁים.** יִתְחַדְּשׁוּ הַשָּׂרִים שֶׁל מַעְלָה, וְיִהְיוּ שָׂרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שָׂרֵי עֶלְיוֹנִים וְשָׂרֵי הָאֻמּוֹת תַּחְתּוֹנִים, וְכֵן בָּאָרֶץ; וְיֵשׁ אוֹמְרִים (פרקי דרבי אליעזר כא) שָׁמַיִם חֲדָשִׁים מַמָּשׁ, וְכֵן עִקָּר, כִּי מִקְרָא מוֹכִיחַ ״כִּי כַּאֲשֶׁר הַשָּׁמַיִם הַחֲדָשִׁים וְגוֹ׳״ (ישעיהו סו:כב):


**new heavens** The princes above shall be renewed, and the princes of Israel shall be the upper princes and the princes of the heathens (the nations [Parshandatha]) will be lower, and so on the earth. ([K’li Paz reads:] The princes above shall be renewed, to raise up the humble and to humble the high ones, and so on the earth.) And some say that there will actually be new heavens, and that is correct, for Scripture proves it (infra 66:22): “For as the new heavens, etc.”



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:20:1)


**עוּל יָמִים.** נַעַר, כְּמוֹ ״עוֹלֵל״ (איכה ב:יא); **עוּל יָמִים** – קָטָן בְּשָׁנִים:


**a youth** Heb. עוּל יָמִים, a youth. Comp. (Lam. 2:11) “young children (עוֹלֵל).” [Hence,] עוּל יָמִים means young in years.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:20:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:20:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:20:2)


**בֶּן מֵאָה שָׁנָה יָמוּת.** יְהֵא בֶּן עוֹנְשִׁין לְהִתְחַיֵּב מִיתָה בַּעֲבֵירָה שֶׁיֵּשׁ בָּהּ מִיתָה, כָּךְ מְפֹרָשׁ בִּבְרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה (כו ב):


**who is one hundred years old shall die** He shall be subject to punishments to be liable to death for a capital sin. So it is explained in Gen. Rabbah (26:2).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:20:3

**יְקֻלָּל.** בַּעֲבֵרָה שֶׁהִיא צְרִיכָה נִדּוּי:


**shall be cursed** for a sin requiring an anathema.

### Verse 25

###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:25:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:25:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:25:1)


**יֹאכַל תֶּבֶן.** וְלֹא יִצְטָרֵךְ לְהַשְׁחִית בַּבְּהֵמָה:


**shall eat straw** and will not have to destroy animals.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 65:25:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:25:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/65:25:2)


**וְנָחָשׁ.** הֲרֵי **עָפָר לַחְמוֹ** מָצוּי לוֹ תָּדִיר. וּמִדְרַשׁ אַגָּדָה (בראשית רבה צה א): **וְאַרְיֵה כַּבָּקָר יֹאכַל תֶּבֶן** – לְפִי שֶׁמָּצִינוּ שֶׁעֵשָׂו נוֹפֵל בְּיַד בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״בֵּית עֵשָׂו לְקַשׁ וּבֵית יוֹסֵף לְהָבָה וְגוֹ׳״ (עובדיה א:יח), אֲבָל בְּיַד בְּנֵי שְׁאָר הַשְּׁבָטִים שֶׁנִּמְשְׁלוּ לְחַיּוֹת לֹא מָצִינוּ. לְכָךְ נֶאֱמַר: **וְאַרְיֵה כַּבָּקָר יֹאכַל תֶּבֶן** – אוֹתָם הַשְּׁבָטִים שֶׁנִּמְשְׁלוּ כְּאַרְיֵה, כְּגוֹן יְהוּדָה וְדָן, כְּיוֹסֵף שֶׁנִּמְשַׁל כְּשׁוֹר, יֹאכְלוּ אוֹתוֹ שֶׁנִּמְשַׁל כְּתֶבֶן:


**and a serpent** Indeed, dust is his food, which is always available for him. And the Midrash Aggadah explains: And a lion, like cattle, shall eat straw. Since we find that Esau will fall into the hands of the sons of Joseph, as it is said (Obadiah 18): “The house of Esau shall become stubble, and the house of Joseph a flame etc.” But [that they should fall] into the hands of the remaining tribes, who were compared to beasts, we do not find. It is, therefore, stated: “And a lion, like cattle, shall eat straw.” Those tribes that were compared to a lion, such as Judah and Dan, like Joseph, who was compared to an ox, shall devour Esau who was compared to straw.



## Chapter 66


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:1:1)


**הַשָּׁמַיִם כִּסְאִי.** אֵינִי צָרִיךְ לְבֵית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ שֶׁלָּכֶם:


**The heavens are My throne** I do not need your Temple.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:1:2)


**אֵיזֶה בַיִת.** אֲשֶׁר הוּא כְּדַאי לִשְׁכִינָתִי:


**which is the house** that is fitting for My Shechinah.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:2:1)


**וְאֶת כָּל אֵלֶּה.** הַשָּׁמַיִם וְהָאָרֶץ **יָדִי עָשָׂתָה**, זֹאת אֲשֶׁר צִמְצַמְתִּי שְׁכִינָתִי בְּתוֹכְכֶם בִּהְיוֹתְכֶם נִשְׁמָעִים לִי, לְפִי שֶׁכֵּן דַּרְכִּי לְהַבִּיט **אֶל עָנִי וּנְכֵה רוּחַ וְחָרֵד עַל דְּבָרִי**. אֲבָל עַתָּה אֵין לִי חֵפֶץ בָּכֶם, שֶׁהֲרֵי **שׁוֹחֵט הַשּׁוֹר** הִכָּה אֶת בְּעָלָיו וּגְזָלוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ, לְפִיכָךְ **זוֹבֵחַ הַשֶּׂה** דּוֹמֶה לְפָנַי כְּ**עוֹרֵף** אֶת הַ**כֶּלֶב**, וְהַ**מַּעֲלֶה** אֶת הַ**מִּנְחָה** הֲרֵי הוּא לְפָנַי כְּ**דַם חֲזִיר**, וְהַ**מַּזְכִּיר לְבוֹנָה** מַקְטִיר לְבוֹנָה, כְּמוֹ ״אַזְכָּרָתָהּ״ (ויקרא ה:יב), ״וְהָיְתָה לַלֶּחֶם לְאַזְכָּרָה״ (ויקרא כד:ז):


**And all these** The heavens and the earth, and for this reason I confined My Shechinah among you when you obeyed Me, for so is My wont, to look at one poor and of crushed spirit, who hastens to do My bidding. But now, I have no desire for you, for whoever slaughters an ox, has smitten its owner and robbed him of it. Therefore, whoever slaughters a lamb seems to Me as one who beheads a dog, and whoever offers up a meal offering is before Me like swine blood, and מַזְכִּיר, he who burns incense. Comp. (Lev. 5:12) “its memorial part (אַזְכָּרָתָהּ).” Also (ibid. 24:7), “and it shall be for the bread as a memorial (לְאַזְכָּרָה).”



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:3:1)


**מְבָרֵךְ אָוֶן.** מְבָרֵךְ אוֹתִי בִּתְשׁוּרַת אֹנֶס, מְבָרֵךְ אָוֶן מַתְשִׁיר אֹנֶס – זֶהוּ פֵּרוּשׁוֹ. וּלְשׁוֹן ׳בְּרָכָה׳ נוֹפֵל בִּתְשׁוּרָה שֶׁהִיא לְהַקְבָּלַת פָּנִים, כְּמוֹ ״קַח נָא אֶת בִּרְכָתִי״ (בראשית לג:יא), ״עֲשׂוּ אִתִּי בְרָכָה וּצְאוּ אֵלַי״ (ישעיהו לו:טז):


**brings a gift of violence** Heb. מְבָרֵךְ, blesses Me with a gift of violence, brings a gift of violence. This is its explanation, and the expression of בְּרָכָה applies to a gift that is for a reception. Comp. (Gen. 33: 11) “Please take my gift (בִּרְכָתִי).” Also (supra 36:16), “Make peace (בְרָכָה) with me and come out to me.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:3:2)


**גַּם הֵמָּה בָּחֲרוּ בְדַרְכֵיהֶם.** הֵם חֲפֵצִים בַּדְּרָכִים הַלָּלוּ הָרָעִים, וְ**גַם אֲנִי אֶבְחַר** וְאֶחְפּוֹץ **בְּתַעֲלֻלֵיהֶם**. וְאִם תֹּאמַר מַהוּ **גַּם**? כֵּן דֶּרֶךְ לְשׁוֹן עִבְרִי לוֹמַר שְׁנֵי גַמִּין זֶה אֵצֶל זֶה, כְּמוֹ ״גַּם בָּחוּר גַּם בְּתוּלָה״ (דברים לב:כה), ״גַּם לִי גַּם לָךְ״ (מלכים א ג:כו), ״גַּם אַהֲבָה גַּם שִׂנְאָה״ (קהלת ט:א), ״וְלֹא יָמוּתוּ גַּם הֵם גַּם אַתֶּם״ (במדבר יח:ג). אַף כָּאן – גַּם הֵם בָּחֲרוּ וְ**גַם אֲנִי אֶבְחַר**:


**they, too, chose their ways** They desire these evil ways, and I, too, will choose and desire their mockeries. Now if you ask the meaning of גַּם, too, so is the style of the Hebrew language to say twice גַּם one next to the other. Comp. (Deut. 32:25) “Both a young man and a virgin (גַּם בָּחוּר גַּם בְּתוּלָה)”; (I Kings 3:26) “neither mine nor yours (גַּם לִי גַּם לָךְ)”; (Ecc. 9:1) “neither love nor hate (גַּם אַהֲבָה גַּם שִׂנְאָה)”; (Num. 18:3) “and neither they nor you shall die (גַּם הֵם גַּם אַתֶּם).” Here, too, both they chose and I will choose.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:4:1)


**בְּתַעֲלֻלֵיהֶם.** לִהְיוֹת עוֹלֵל בָּם, לְשׁוֹן ״כִּי הִתְעַלַּלְתְּ בִּי״ (במדבר כב:כט):


**their mockeries** Heb. בְּתַעֲלוּלֵיהֶם, to mock them, an expression like (ibid. 22:29) “For you mocked (הִתְעַלַּלְתְּ) me.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:4:2)


**וּמְגוּרֹתָם.** מַה שֶּׁהֵם יְרֵאִים:


**and their fears** What they fear.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:4:3)


**יַעַן קָרָאתִי:** שִׁמְעוּ וְ״שׁוּבוּ אֵלַי״ (זכריה א:ג):


**since I called** Hearken and return to Me.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:4:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:4:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:4:4)


**וְאֵין עוֹנֶה** לֵאמֹר: ״שָׁמַעְתִּי״:


**and no one answered** saying, “I heard.”



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:5:1)


**הַחֲרֵדִים אֶל דְּבָרוֹ.** הַצַּדִּיקִים הַמְמַהֲרִים בַּחֲרָדָה לְהִתְקָרֵב אֶל דְּבָרָיו:


**who quake at His word** The righteous who hasten with quaking to draw near to His words.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:5:2)


**אָמְרוּ אֲחֵיכֶם.** פּוֹשְׁעֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַנִּזְכָּרִים לְמַעְלָה. דָּבָר אַחֵר: **אָמְרוּ אֲחֵיכֶם מְנַדֵּיכֶם.** אֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ לָכֶם ״סוּרוּ טָמֵא״ (איכה ד:טו):


**Your brethren...said** The transgressors of Israel mentioned above. Another explanation: **Your brethren... who cast you out, said** Who said to you (Lam. 4:15), “Turn away, unclean one.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:5:3)


**שֹׂנְאֵיכֶם מְנַדֵּיכֶם.** הָאוֹמְרִים ״קְרַב אֵלֶיךָ אַל תִּגַּשׁ בִּי״ (ישעיהו סה:ה). **לְמַעַן שְׁמִי יִכְבַּד ה׳.** בִּגְדֻלָּתֵנוּ הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא מִתְכַּבֵּד, שֶׁאָנוּ קְרוֹבִים לוֹ יוֹתֵר מִכֶּם:


**who hate you, who cast you out** Who say (supra 65:5), “Keep to yourself, do not come near me.” [Because of the confusion, we quote other readings. Some manuscripts, as well as K’li Paz, read:] **Your brethren... said** The transgressors of Israel mentioned above. **who hate you, who cast you out** who say (supra 65: 5), “Keep to yourself, do not come near me.” Another explanation: **Your brethren...said** The children of Esau. **who cast you out** Who said to you (Lam. 4:15), “Turn away, unclean one.” **For the sake of my name, the Lord shall be glorified** With our greatness, the Holy One, blessed be He, is glorified, for we are closer to Him than you are.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:5:4)


**וְנִרְאֶה בְשִׂמְחַתְכֶם וְהֵם יֵבֹשׁוּ.** הַנָּבִיא אוֹמֵר: אֲבָל לֹא כֵן הוּא כְּדִבְרֵיהֶם, כִּי בְשִׂמְחַתְכֶם נִרְאֶה וְהֵם יֵבֹשׁוּ. לָמָּה? כִּי **קוֹל שָׁאוֹן** שֶׁלָּהֶם בָּא לִפְנֵי הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, מִמַּה שֶּׁעָשׂוּ בְּעִירוֹ, וְ**קוֹל** יוֹצֵא מֵהֵיכָלוֹ וּמְקַטְרֵג עַל מַחֲרִיבָיו, וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן **קוֹל ה׳ מְשַׁלֵּם גְּמוּל לְאֹיְבָיו**:


**but we will see your joy** The prophet says, But it is not so as their words, for “we will see your joy, and they shall be ashamed.” Why? For sound a sound of their stirring has come before the Holy One, blessed be He, from what they did in His city, and a sound emanates from His Temple and accuses those who destroyed it, and then the voice of the Lord, recompensing His enemies.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:7:1)


**בְּטֶרֶם תָּחִיל.** צִיּוֹן חִיל הַיּוֹלֶדֶת, **יָלָדָה** אֶת בָּנֶיהָ, כְּלוֹמַר: יִתְקַבְּצוּ בָּנֶיהָ לְתוֹכָהּ, אֲשֶׁר הָיְתָה שׁוֹמֵמָה מֵהֶם וּשְׁכוּלָה, וַהֲרֵי הוּא כְּאִלּוּ יְלָדַתָּן עַכְשָׁיו בְּלֹא חֶבְלֵי יוֹלֵדָה, כִּי כָּל הָעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת יְבִיאוּם לְתוֹכָהּ:


**When she has not yet travailed** When Zion has not yet travailed with birth pangs, she has borne her children; that is to say that her children will gather into her midst, which was desolate and bereft of them, and it is as though she bore them now without birth pangs, for all the nations will bring them into her midst.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:7:2)


**וְהִמְלִיטָה זָכָר.** כָּל יְצִיאַת דָּבָר בָּלוּעַ קָרוּי דהַמְלָטָהד, **וְהִמְלִיטָה** אישקמוציי״ר בלע״ז:


**she has been delivered of a male child** Heb. וְהִמְלִיטָה. Any emerging of an embedded thing is called הַמְלָטָה. And הַמְלָטָה is esmoucer, or eschamocier in O.F., to allow to escape.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:8:1)


**הֲיוּחַל אֶרֶץ בְּיוֹם אֶחָד.** הֲיָבוֹא חִיל לְיוֹלֶדֶת לֵילֵד מְלֹא אֶרֶץ בָּנִים בְּיוֹם אֶחָד?


**Is a land born in one day?** Can a pain come to a woman in confinement to bear a land full of sons in one day?



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:9:1)


**הַאֲנִי אַשְׁבִּיר וְלֹא אוֹלִיד.** הַאֲנִי אָבִיא אֶת הָאִשָּׁה עַל הַמַּשְׁבֵּר וְלֹא אֶפְתַּח רַחְמָהּ לְהוֹצִיא עֻבָּרָהּ? כְּלוֹמַר: שֶׁמָּא אַתְחִיל בְּדָבָר וְלֹא אוּכַל לִגְמוֹר? וַהֲלֹא **אֲנִי הַמּוֹלִיד** אֶת כָּל הַיּוֹלְדוֹת, וְעַכְשָׁיו שֶׁמָּא **עָצַרְתִּי**? בְּתְמִיהָה:


**Will I bring to the birth stool and not cause to give birth** Will I bring a woman to the birth stool and not open her womb to bring out her fetus? That is to say, Shall I commence a thing and not be able to complete it? Am I not the One Who causes every woman in confinement to give birth, and now will I shut the womb? This is a question.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:11:1)


**מִשֹּׁד.** לְשׁוֹן ׳שָׁדַיִם׳:


**from the breast** Heb. מִשֹּׁד, an expression of breasts (שָׁדַיִם).


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:11:2)


**תָּמֹצּוּ.** שוציי״ר בלע״ז:


**you drink deeply** Heb. תָּמֹצּוּ, sucer in French, to suck.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:11:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:11:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:11:3)


**מִזִּיז כְּבוֹדָהּ.** מִכָּבוֹד גָּדוֹל הַזָּז וּמְמַשְׁמֵשׁ לָבֹא לָהּ:


**from her approaching glory** Heb. מִזִּיז. From the great glory that is moving and coming nearer to her.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:11:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:11:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:11:4)


**זִיז.** אישמובימנ״ט בלע״ז:


זִיז means esmoviment in O.F., movement.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:12:1)


**וּכְנַחַל שׁוֹטֵף.** אֲנִי **נֹטֶה אֵלֶיהָ כְּבוֹד גּוֹיִם**:


**and like a flooding stream** I extend to her the wealth of the nations.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:12:2)


**עַל צַד.** עַל צִדֵּי אוֹמְנֵיכֶם, ״עַל גִּסְסִין״ (תרגום יונתן):


**on the side** On the sides of your nurses, [in Aramaic,] גִּסְסִין.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:12:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:12:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:12:3)


**תְּשָׁעֳשָׁעוּ.** תִּהְיוּ מְשֻׁעְשָׁעִין, כְּדֶרֶךְ שֶׁמְּשַׁעְשְׁעִין אֶת הַתִּינוֹק, אישבניי״ר בלע״ז:


**you shall be dandled** You shall be dandled as they dandle an infant. Esbanier in O.F.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:14:1)


**וְנוֹדְעָה יַד ה׳.** בַּעֲשׂוֹתוֹ נִקְמוֹתָיו וְנוֹרְאוֹתָיו, יֵדְעוּ עֲבָדָיו אֶת כֹּחַ גְּבוּרַת יָדוֹ:


**and the hand of the Lord shall be known** When He wreaks His vengeance and His awesome acts, His servants shall know the strength of the might of His hand.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:15:1)


**בָּאֵשׁ יָבוֹא.** בְּחֵמַת אֵשׁ יָבוֹא עַל הָרְשָׁעִים:


**shall come with fire** With the fury of fire He shall come upon the wicked.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:15:2)


**לְהָשִׁיב.** לְצָרָיו בְּ**חֵמָה** אֶת **אַפּוֹ**:


**to render** Heb. לְהָשִׁיב, [lit. to return] to His adversaries with fury His anger.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:16:1)


**כִּי בָאֵשׁ** שֶׁל גֵּיהִנֹּם **ה׳ נִשְׁפָּט** עִם צָרָיו, וּלְפִי שֶׁהוּא בַּעַל דִּין וְדַיָּן, נוֹפֵל בּוֹ לְשׁוֹן ׳**נִשְׁפָּט**׳, שֶׁאַף הוּא טוֹעֵן טַעֲנוֹתָיו לִמְצוֹא עֲוֹנָם וּפִשְׁעָם, וְכֵן ״וְנִשְׁפַּטְתִּי אִתּוֹ״ (יחזקאל לח:כב), ״הִנְנִי נִשְׁפָּט אוֹתָךְ״ (ירמיהו ב:לה), לְשׁוֹן ׳וִכּוּחַ׳ הוּא, דרישניי״ר בלע״ז, וּפְשׁוּטוֹ **כִּי בָאֵשׁ ה׳** וְחַרְבּוֹ **נִשְׁפָּט כָּל בָּשָׂר** וְכֵן רַבִּים מְסֹרָסִים בַּמִּקְרָאוֹת:


**For with fire** of Gehinnom will the Lord contend with His adversaries, and since He is the plaintiff and the judge, the expression of contending is appropriate for Him, for He, too, presents His claim to find their iniquity and their transgression. Comp. (Ezekiel 38:22) “And I will contend with him (וְנִשְׁפַּטְתִּי)”; (Jer. 2:35) “Behold, I contend with you.” It is an expression of debate. Derajjsner in O.F. [And its simple meaning is: For with the fire of the Lord and with His sword, all flesh shall be judged. Similarly, there are many inverted verses in Scriptures.]



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:17:1)


**הַמִּתְקַדְּשִׁים.** הַמִּזְדַּמְּנִים, ״אֲנִי וְאַתָּה נֵלֵךְ לְיוֹם פְּלוֹנִי לַעֲבוֹד לְעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה פְּלוֹנִית״:


**Those who prepare themselves** Heb. הַמִּתְקַדְּשִׁים. Those who prepare themselves, “Let you and me go on such-and-such a day to worship such-and-such an idol.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:17:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:17:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:17:2)


**אֶל הַגַּנּוֹת.** שֶׁזּוֹרְעִין שָׁם יָרָק, וְשָׁם הָיוּ מַעֲמִידִין עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה:


**to the gardens** where they plant vegetables, and there they would erect idols.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:17:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:17:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:17:3)


**אַחַר אַחַת.** כְּמָה שֶׁתִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן: ״סִיעָה בָּתַר סִיעָה״; מִתְקַדְּשִׁים וּמִטַּהֲרִים לַעֲבוֹד, סִיעָה אַחַר שֶׁגָּמְרָה חֲבֶרְתָּהּ אֶת עֲבוֹדָתָהּ:


**[one] after one** As Jonathan renders: a company after a company. They prepare themselves and purify themselves to worship, one company after its fellow has completed its worship.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:17:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:17:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:17:4)


**בַּתָּוֶךְ.** בְּאֶמְצַע הַגִּנָּה, כֵּן הָיָה דַּרְכָּם לְהַעֲמִידָהּ:


**in the middle** In the middle of the garden. Such was their custom to erect it.



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:18:1)


**וְאָנֹכִי מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם וּמַחְשְׁבֹתֵיהֶם בָּאָה וגו׳.** וְאָנֹכִי מָה לִי לַעֲשׂוֹת? מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם וּמַחְשְׁבוֹתֵיהֶם בָּאָה אֵלַי, וְהִיא תַּזְקִיקֵנִי **לְקַבֵּץ אֶת כָּל הַגּוֹיִם** וּלְהוֹדִיעַ שֶׁמַּעֲשֵׂיהֶם הֶבֶל, וּמַחְשְׁבוֹתָם שֶׁהֵם חוֹשְׁבִין ״לְמַעַן שְׁמִי יִכְבַּד ה׳״ (ישעיהו סו:ה), יָבִינוּ שֶׁהוּא שֶׁקֶר. וְהֵיכָן הוּא אוֹתוֹ קִבּוּץ? הוּא הָאָסִיף שֶׁנִּבָּא זְכַרְיָה ״וְאָסַפְתִּי אֶת כָּל הַגּוֹיִם אֶל יְרוּשָׁלִָם״ (זכריה יד:ב):


**And I - their deeds and their thoughts have come etc.** And I What am I to do? Their deeds and their thoughts have come to Me. And that forces Me to gather all the heathens (nations [Mss. and K’li Paz]), and to let them know that their deeds are vanity and the thoughts they are thinking, “For the sake of my name, the Lord shall be glorified,” let them understand that it is false. And where is the gathering? It is the gathering that Zechariah prophesied (14:2): “And I will gather all the nations to Jerusalem.”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:18:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:18:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:18:2)


**וְרָאוּ אֶת כְּבוֹדִי.** בְּהִלָּחֲמִי בָּהֶם בְּמַכַּת ״הָמֵק בְּשָׂרוֹ וְעֵינָיו וּלְשׁוֹנוֹ״ (זכריה יד:יב):


**and they shall see My glory** When I wage war with them with the plague of the following description (ibid. 14:12): “Their flesh shall disintegrate...and their eyes...and their tongue.”



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:19:1)


**וְשַׂמְתִּי בָהֶם אוֹת וְגוֹ׳. פְּלֵיטִים** יִנָּצְלוּ מִן הַמִּלְחָמָה וַאֲנִי אַשְׁאִירֵם, כְּדֵי לֵילֵךְ לְבַשֵּׂר לָ**אִיִּים הָרְחוֹקִים אֶת כְּבוֹדִי אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ** בַּמִּלְחָמָה, וְאַף בְּאוֹתָם **פְּלֵיטִים** אָשִׂים אַחַת מִן הָאוֹתוֹת שֶׁנִּדּוֹנוּ חֲבֵירֵיהֶם בָּהֶם, כְּדֵי לְהוֹדִיעַ לָרְחוֹקִים: בְּמַגֵּפָה זוֹ נִגְּפוּ הַצּוֹבְאִים עַל יְרוּשָׁלַיִם:


**And I will place a sign upon them etc.** Refugees will survive the war, and I will allow them to remain in order to go to report to the distant islands My glory that they saw in the war, and also upon those refugees I will place one of the signs with which their colleagues were punished, in order to let the distant ones know that with this plague, those who gathered about Jerusalem were smitten.



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:20:1)


**וּבַצַּבִּים.** הֵם עֲגָלוֹת מְטֻקָּסוֹת בִּמְחִיצוֹת וְאֹהֶל, וְדוֹמֶה לוֹ ״שֵׁשׁ עֶגְלֹת צָב״ (במדבר ז:ג):


**and with covered wagons** Heb. וּבַצַּבִּים. These are wagons equipped with partitions and a tent. Comp. (Num. 7:3) “Six covered wagons (עֶגְלוֹתצָב).”


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:20:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:20:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:20:2)


**וּבַכִּרְכָּרוֹת.** בְּשִׁיר מְשַׂחֲקִים וּמְכַרְכְּרִים, כְּמוֹ ״וְדָוִד מְכַרְכֵּר״ (שמואל ב ו:יד). טריפי״ר בלע״ז. וּמְנַחֵם פֵּרְשׁוֹ לְשׁוֹן ׳כֶּבֶשׂ׳, כְּמוֹ ״שִׁלְחוּ כַר מֹשֵׁל אֶרֶץ״ (ישעיהו טז:א):


**and with joyous songs** Heb. וּבַכִּרְכָּרוֹת. With a song of players and dancers. Comp. (II Sam. 6:14) “And David danced (מְכַרְכֵּר),” treper in O.F. [Menahem (p. 109) explains it as an expression meaning a lamb. Comp. (supra 16:1) “Send lambs (כַּר) of the ruler of the land.”]


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:20:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:20:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:20:3)


**כַּאֲשֶׁר יָבִיאוּ. מִנְחָה בִּכְלִי טָהוֹר** לְרָצוֹן, כֵּן יָבִיאוּ אֶת אֲחֵיכֶם לְמִנְחַת רָצוֹן:


**as...bring** an offering in a pure vessel for acceptance, so will they bring your brethren as an acceptable offering.



### Verse 21

###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:21:1)


**וְגַם מֵהֶם אֶקַּח לַכֹּהֲנִים לַלְוִיִּם.** מִן הָעַמִּים הַמְּבִיאִים אוֹתָם, וּמִן הַמּוּבָאִים אֶקַּח כֹּהֲנִים וּלְוִיִּם, וּלְפָנַי גְּלוּיִים הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם שֶׁבָּהֶם, וְאָבְרוֹר אוֹתָן מִתּוֹכָן, וְיִהְיוּ מְשַׁמְּשִׁין לְפָנַי:


**And from them too** From the peoples bringing them and from those brought, I will take priests and Levites, for they are now assimilated among the heathens (nations [Mss. and K’li Paz]) under coercion, and before Me the priests and the Levites among them are revealed, and I will select them from among them, and they shall minister before Me,


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:21:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:21:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:21:2)


**אָמַר ה׳.** וְהֵיכָן אָמַר? ״הַנִּסְתָּרוֹת לַה׳ אֱלֹהֵינוּ״ (דברים כט:כח). כָּךְ מְפֹרָשׁ בְּאַגָּדַת תְּהִלִּים:


said the Lord. Now where did He say it? (Deut. 29:28) “The hidden things are for the Lord our God.” In this manner it is explained in the Aggadah of Psalms (87:6).



### Verse 24

###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:24:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:24:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:24:1)


**תּוֹלַעְתָּם.** רִמָּה הָאוֹכֶלֶת אֶת בְּשָׂרָם:


**their worm** The worm that consumes their flesh.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:24:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:24:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:24:2)


**וְאִשָּׁם** בַּגֵּיהִנֹּם:


**and their fire** in Gehinnom.


###### Rashi on Isaiah 66:24:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:24:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Isaiah/r/66:24:3)


**דֵרָאוֹן.** לְשׁוֹן ׳בִּזָּיוֹן׳, וְיוֹנָתָן תִּרְגֵּם כְּמִין שְׁתֵּי תֵיבוֹת: דֵּי רְאִיָּה, ״עַד דְּיֵימְרוּן עֲלֵיהוֹן צַדִּיקַיָּא מִיסַת חֲזִינָא״:


**and abhorring** Heb. דֵרָאוֹן, an expression of contempt. Jonathan, however, renders it as two words: enough (דֵּי) seeing (רְאִיָה), until the righteous say about them, We have seen enough.
